testcases.instrumentation: Piezoelectric Quartz-Encapsulated Hydrophone Probe (Onda HNP-0400 or PP2000 Megasonic Meter) mounted on a 3-axis automated XY mapping stage.
testcases.pre_conditions: SC-2 tank filled with UPW or dummy SC-2 bath at 75°C; megasonic RF power generator set to 1.0 MHz, 300 W forward power; reflected power tuned to < 5 W.

Compute mean energy density, peak-to-peak variance, and identify cavitation onset spikes.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Acoustic energy density across all 25 measurement points must measure 1.2 W/cm² to 1.8 W/cm²; spatial non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) must be ≤ 6.5%; zero localized peak transients exceeding 3.0 W/cm² (cavitation safety threshold).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Hot SC-2 Acidic Immersion & In-Situ Megasonic Stripping Execution
**Module:** Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean Sequence  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Hot SC-2 Immersion   │
│       Bath Prep        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Bath Stabilization   │
│        70°C-80°C       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Megasonic Transducer  │
│      Activation &      │
│       Immersion        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    10-min Megasonic    │
│   Metallic Stripping   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Substrate Withdrawal  │
│  & 18.2 MΩ·cm Quick    │
│       Dump Rinse       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chemical Dispense & Bath Preparation**:
   - Charge the immersion quartz tank with **6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$** ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ resistivity).
   - Carefully meter and inject **1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\%\text{ HCl}$)** followed by **1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$)** to maintain the volumetric ratio of $6:1:1$ ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
2. **Bath Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Engage the in-line bath circulation and quartz immersion heater.
   - Ramp and stabilize the bath temperature target strictly to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. **In-Situ Megasonic Activation & Substrate Immersion**:
   - Power on the bath megasonic transducer array.
   - Transfer the wafer cassette robotically into the chemical bath, ensuring uniform acoustic wave propagation and laminar chemical exposure across all wafer surfaces.
4. **Acidic Metallic Stripping Execution**:
   - Perform continuous acidic immersion and in-situ megasonic stripping for **10 minutes** to dissolve alkali ionic traces ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and strip transition/heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
5. **Cassette Withdrawal & Quench Rinse**:
   - Slowly withdraw the cassette from the hot SC-2 tank to minimize chemical drag-out.
   - Immediately transfer wafers into a Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank primed with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water** to quench residual acid prior to final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Machine-Measurable Target | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-2 Bath Temperature** | `70 to 80` | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ | In-situ calibrated thermocouple sensor |
| **Immersion Stripping Duration** | `10` | $\text{min}$ | Automated wet bench recipe timer ($\pm 5\text{ s}$) |
| **Chemical Volumetric Ratio** | `6 : 1 : 1` ($\text{DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Dimensionless (vol/vol) | Flowmeter verification ($37\%\text{ HCl}, 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) |
| **DI Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity probe at QDR intake |

---

### 4. Literature Source Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical composition: $6\text{ parts Deionized }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part Hydrochloric Acid }(37\%\text{ HCl}) : 1\text{ part Hydrogen Peroxide }(30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2)$.
  - Process parameters: Bath temperature heated to $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$.
  - Contaminant elimination targets: Alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
  - Water purity standard: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Station exhaust and DI water loop (18.2 MOhm-cm, particle filter 0.1 um) must interlock prior to wafer boat immersion. Rinse cascade must terminate downstream acid carries before SC-2.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: BOE 6:1 (NH4F:HF) etch rate must be calibrated at 70-80 nm/min at 25°C. SC-1 (5:1:1 H2O:NH4OH:H2O2) must be maintained at 75°C +/- 2°C to eliminate light organics without pitting Si.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Electronic-grade semiconductor reagents (VLSI/MOS grade) must be procured from certified chemical distributors; technical-grade chemicals will induce metallic surface poisoning (Fe, Cu, Ni > 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24-32 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Chemical cross-contamination or incomplete dump rinse leaves watermark defects and micro-masking during subsequent etch).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Watermark defect formation during static pull-out from hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transition.
1. Exhaust face-velocity drop below 0.5 m/s causing acid vapor condensation on cleanroom tooling.
1. Over-etch in BOE undercut exceeding 50 nm, destroying contact via dimensional margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-2-2-01` | **Post-Clean Particle & Metallic Trace Contamination Assay** | Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor / Surfscan) & TXRF Spectrometer | 1. Load unpatterned witness silicon wafer into darkfield laser scatterometer. 2. Scan complete surface for light point defects (LPD) at size bin >= 180 nm. 3. Perform Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) for trace Fe, Cu, Ni surface concentrations. | `LPD count (>= 180 nm) < 10 defects/wafer (Pass); Transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) < 5e10 atoms/cm2 (Pass).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-2-2-02` | **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Step Height & Lateral Undercut Profilometry** | Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak XT) / Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Zero stylus force baseline at 3 mg on planar SiO2 field. 2. Scan 200 um profile across etched contact window step at 20 um/s scan speed. 3. Record step height h_step and lateral undercut under resist margin. | `Etch depth matches target +/- 5% (Pass); lateral undercut <= 35 nm (Pass); surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene gloves (0.7 mm thickness, tested for HF permeation), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield over ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeves (PVC/Neoprene), Acid gas vapor cartridge respirator (NIOSH approved for HF/HCl)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: MANDATORY ON-SITE ANTIDOTE: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%). In case of HF skin contact: Flush immediately under emergency drench shower for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage Calcium Gluconate Gel into affected skin continuously until emergency medical response arrives. Never apply standard burn creams.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated polypropylene wet bench with vertical laminar exhaust face velocity >= 0.55 m/s. Interlocked with wet acid scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride effluent. Neutralize with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2). Verify pH 7.0-8.5 before drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/MOS Electronic Grade (< 1 ppb metals) | `49% conc. or 1:50 DHF` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (NH4F)** | `12125-01-8` | Electronic Grade | `40% aq (for BOE 6:1 buffer)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (unstabilized) | `30% aq (for SC-1 & SC-2)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** | `7647-01-0` | Electronic Grade | `37% aq (for SC-2 clean)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `29% aq (for SC-1 clean)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic with native chemical oxide (Tox ~1.0 nm) and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare silicon (water contact angle > 75°), zero watermarks, Tox < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native SiO2 spontaneously regrows in ambient air at ~0.1 nm/hr, degrading interface state density Dit and causing uncontrolled threshold voltage shift in downstream gate oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Hot SC-2 Acidic Immersion & In-Situ Megasonic Stripping Execution: Chemical cleaning and surface preparation verified with zero watermark defects, bare hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon, and calibrated oxide etch rate.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Surface_particle_laser_scan_Surfscan.pdf`
- [ ] `Sessile_drop_contact_angle_measurement.png`
- [ ] `DHF_BOE_calibrated_etch_rate_sheet.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-DHF bare silicon water contact angle** | `>= 75.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI water droplet) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface particulate defect density (> 0.1 um)** | `< 15 particles/wafer` | Max acceptable particle count on 100mm wafer | Darkfield Laser Surface Inspection (Surfscan) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Surface metallic impurity concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | `< 1.0e10 atoms/cm²` | Max allowable contamination | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer surface exhibits 100% uniform dewetting / hydrophobicity with zero visible drying marks under bright light; residual native oxide Tox < 0.2 nm confirmed by spectroscopic ellipsometry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## TXRF Trace Metallic Impurity & Surface Particle Metrology Inspection

**Process Node & Architecture**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Cell Architecture Context**: 1T1C Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB), Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, Gate Dielectric Target Physical Thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$  
**Module**: Metrology (Post-SC-2 Clean / Pre-Dry Gate Oxidation)  
**Action Type**: Make / Inspection  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Transfer from   │
│     SC-2 / N2 Dry      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

             ▼

│                        │
│   Wafer Alignment &    │
│    Vacuum Clamping     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Angle Calibration &   │
│   Incident Critical    │
│      Angle Tuning      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Point TXRF    │
│  Trace Metal Spectrum  │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Surface Laser      │
│  Scattering Particle   │
│          Scan          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Threshold  │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │     │                        │
│   Transfer to 180nm    │     │   Rework / Re-Clean    │
│   Dry Gate Oxidation   │     │  Flag: Alert Council   │
│        Furnace         │     │                        │
│                        │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **FOUP / Cassette Ingestion & Environmental Verification**:
   - Transfer wafer batch immediately from the upstream RCA-2 (SC-2: 6 parts DI H2O, 1 part 37% HCl, 1 part 30% H2O2, followed by high-purity N2 blow-dry) station into the Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) metrology loadlock within a maximum cleanroom queue time of $\le 30\text{ min}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth and airborne re-contamination.
   - Verify cassette load port mini-environment maintains Class 1 cleanroom filtration with downflow velocity $0.45 \pm 0.05\text{ m/s}$.

2. **Pre-Alignment & Stage Vacuum Chucking**:
   - Robot end-effector transfers the silicon substrate onto the TXRF optical rotary stage.
   - Align wafer notch/flat to $0^\circ \pm 0.05^\circ$ reference position.
   - Engage backside vacuum chucking at $-80\text{ kPa}$ relative vacuum, verifying substrate surface flatness deviation $\le 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$.

3. **Critical Angle Optical Calibration**:
   - Set the monochromatic X-ray beam source (Mo-K$\alpha$ or W-L$\beta$ radiation target) to an incident grazing angle below the silicon total reflection critical angle ($\phi_c \approx 0.08^\circ - 0.13^\circ$).
   - Perform automatic reflective intensity peak scan to establish precise total external reflection condition, ensuring beam penetration depth is restricted to the top $3\text{ to }5\text{ nm}$ near-surface boundary without exciting bulk silicon substrate background.

4. **Multi-Point Surface Metallic Contamination Measurement**:
   - Execute a 9-point surface sampling inspection pattern (1 center, 4 half-radius, 4 edge exclusion zones at $3\text{ mm}$ edge border).
   - Dwell time per point: $300\text{ s}$ per site under Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) integration.
   - Extract spectral peak fluorescence counts for transition metal contaminants targeted by the SC-2 clean:
     - Iron ($\text{Fe}$) K$\alpha$ peak ($6.40\text{ keV}$)
     - Copper ($\text{Cu}$) K$\alpha$ peak ($8.04\text{ keV}$)
     - Nickel ($\text{Ni}$) K$\alpha$ peak ($7.47\text{ keV}$)
     - Alkaline ions: Sodium ($\text{Na}$) and Potassium ($\text{K}$).

5. **Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Defect Inspection**:
   - Transfer wafer to integrated dark-field surface laser scattering inspection module.
   - Execute full-surface spiral scan across the wafer at sensitivity threshold corresponding to critical lithography dimension ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Log total light point defect (LPD) count, particle size distribution ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$), and spatial coordinate map.

6. **Acceptance Evaluation & Downstream Dispatch**:
   - Correlate TXRF areal density and particle counts against acceptance criteria.
   - **Disposition**:
     - *Pass*: Generate automated inspection certificate and dispatch wafer lot to the thermal oxidation tube for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide growth ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).
     - *Fail*: Quarantine lot; flag for RCA-1 / SC-2 re-clean loop and alert the DRAM Foundation VN council.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                           ┌───────────────────────────┐
                           │███████████████████████████│
        Upstream SC-2 Rinse┤███████████████████████████│
                           │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓     │
Defect / Particle (>0.18um)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓     │
        Cu / Ni Trace Level┤▒▒▒▒▒                      │
                           │▒▒▒▒▒                      │
             Fe Trace Level┤░░░░░░░░                   │
                           │░░░░░░░░                   │
                           └┬──────┬─────┬──────┬─────┬┘
                           0.0    4.5   9.1   13.6 18.2 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Inspection Tool / Condition | Rationale & Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Surface Heavy Metal (Fe) Areal Density** | $\le 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF (9-point, Mo-K$\alpha$, $300\text{ s}$ dwell) | Prevents premature gate dielectric breakdown in $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ and protects $1\text{ fA/cell}$ leakage target at $85^\circ\text{C}$. |
| **Surface Trace Metal (Cu, Ni) Areal Density** | $\le 3.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF (9-point, grazing angle $\phi < \phi_c$) | Suppresses deep-level traps and junction leakage across access transistor channel ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$). |
| **Critical Surface Particle Count ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$)** | $\le 15$ | $\text{particles/wafer}$ (200mm substrate, $3\text{ mm}$ EE) | Dark-Field Laser Surface Scattering | Prevents pinholes and defects across wordline/bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$). |
| **Incoming Wet Rinse Deionized Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-Line Resistivity Sensor ($25^\circ\text{C}$) | Ensures incoming wafer batch from SC-2 clean meets baseline ionic cleanliness. |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited

1. **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
   - SC-2 chemical composition ($6\text{ parts DI H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\text{ HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$) formulated to eliminate alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy transition metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
   - Intermediate and final rinse specification with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water and ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Access transistor gate oxide target physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$; requires ultra-low metallic contamination to ensure dielectric integrity.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$) defining critical particle tolerance.
   - Storage capacitance requirement ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$) and data retention ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
3. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, mandating rigorous surface metallic screening.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integrating TXRF and optical surface particle metrology directly following the hot SC-2 acidic clean creates an operational bottleneck in the pre-oxidation gate stack pipeline. Measuring 100% of production wafers will instantly breach the 30-minute queue-time constraint into the dry oxidation tube furnace. We must establish a statistical sampling architecture—such as 1 wafer per cassette or monitor wafer pilot runs—and enforce an automated transfer protocol to prevent native oxide regrowth or airborne amine adsorption during stage dwell time.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For a 3.5 nm dry gate oxide in 180nm DRAM access transistors, surface transition metals like Fe, Cu, and Ni are catastrophic; Fe creates mid-gap states that inflate retention refresh failure rates, while Cu precipitates cause catastrophic gate dielectric breakdown (TDDB degradation). TXRF grazing angle must be meticulously tuned below the critical angle of silicon (typically ~0.08° to 0.13° depending on excitation line, e.g., Mo-Kalpha or W-Lbeta) to ensure total external reflection, limiting penetration depth to the top 3-5 nm rather than sampling the bulk Si matrix. Surface particle inspection must filter out haze from micro-roughness induced by prior SC-1/SC-2 etch cycles.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dedicated inline TXRF systems (such as Rigaku TXRF-V310 or Technos TREX) are capital intensive and scarce in local Vietnamese pilot-foundry ecosystems. If external lab service or an offline benchtop Rigaku system is utilized, turnaround times will drastically violate Q-time limits, forcing the use of sealed, ultra-pure N2-purged FOUPs or wafer canisters with chemical filtration (desiccant + activated carbon). Sourcing Mo/W X-ray tubes, silicon drift detectors (SDD), and NIST-traceable multielement trace metal calibration standards (Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn at 1E11 to 1E13 atoms/cm2) has a typical 16-24 week procurement lead time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Balancing tool availability against line yield is critical for Gen 1 milestone delivery. If TXRF metrology fails or standard calibration drifts, the thermal oxidation furnace cannot sit idle indefinitely without stalling upstream lot releases. We need a secondary fallback protocol—such as rapid laser surface particle scanning (KLA/Tencor Surfscan equivalent or high-contrast darkfield optical microscope inspection) combined with destructive batch VPD-ICP-MS on sacrificial pilot test wafers—to prevent wafer lot scrappage while sustaining throughput.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Breach of the 30-minute ambient air Q-time during metrology alignment or long TXRF integration dwells, causing uncontrolled native chemical oxide growth (SiO2 > 0.6 nm) and airborne organic/airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
1. Calibration error or incorrect grazing angle alignment (theta > theta_crit) exciting the bulk silicon substrate, suppressing trace transition metal signal-to-noise ratio and falsely passing killer Fe/Cu contamination above 1E10 atoms/cm2.
1. Mechanical particle re-contamination or robotic edge-grip slippage inside the metrology loadlock chamber, depositing metallic microparticulates onto the active gate channel prior to 3.5 nm thermal oxidation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-2-3-01` | **TXRF Quantitative Surface Trace Metal Areal Density Verification** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence Spectrometer (Mo-Kalpha source @ 17.4 keV or W-Lbeta, Silicon Drift Detector / SDD, high-precision goniometer stage) | 1. Load wafer into TXRF loadlock under Class 1 laminar flow hood.\n2. Pump down chamber or purge with ultra-pure He/N2 ambient.\n3. Align wafer surface optically and adjust grazing incidence angle to 0.10 degrees (below Si critical angle of 0.13 degrees for Mo-Kalpha).\n4. Perform 9-point surface scan (center, 4 mid-radius at 0.5R, 4 edge-exclusion points at R-5mm).\n5. Integrate fluorescent X-ray spectrum for 300 seconds per site across Fe-Ka (6.40 keV), Ni-Ka (7.47 keV), and Cu-Ka (8.04 keV) energy windows.\n6. Compute areal density in atoms/cm2 via fundamental parameter matrix deconvolution. | `Areal density for Fe < 5.0E+10 atoms/cm2, Ni < 5.0E+10 atoms/cm2, and Cu < 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 across all 9 measurement points; standard error of measurement <= 15%.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-2-3-02` | **Surface Defect and Light Point Defect (LPD) Particle Mapping** | Laser Surface Particle Scanner / Darkfield Defect Inspection System (405nm / 488nm solid-state laser, elliptical collector mirror, photomultiplier/photodiode array) | 1. Place wafer onto rotating vacuum chuck with 3mm edge-exclusion zone.\n2. Initialize spiral laser raster scan across the entire wafer surface with scan speed calibrated to 0.15 um LPD sensitivity.\n3. Collect scattered light intensity profile and bin detected scattering anomalies into size bins: 0.15-0.30 um, 0.30-0.50 um, and > 0.50 um.\n4. Generate full-wafer coordinate defect map and compute total defect density (defects/cm2). | `Total surface light point defects (LPD >= 0.20 um) <= 10 defects per 100mm wafer (defect density < 0.13 defects/cm2); zero clustered defects (> 5 defects in 1 cm2 area).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 10/100 Cleanroom Bunny Suit (antistatic Tyvek), Double Nitrile Cleanroom Gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with UV/laser radiation side shielding, Cleanroom antistatic ESD conductive footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of inert gas (N2/He) displacement or asphyxiation symptoms, immediately move victim to fresh air, administer artificial oxygen if breathing is labored, and initiate CPR if unresponsive. For physical wafer cleavage cuts, flush under UPW, apply pressure with sterile cleanroom dressing, and seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: TXRF X-ray generator housing must feature interlocked lead shielding with zero radiation leakage (< 0.5 uSv/h at cabinet surface). Enclosure vacuum pump exhausts and chamber purge gas lines must vent directly into certified cleanroom facility inert exhaust (GEX). Continuous O2 monitoring sensors required in small metrology alcoves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Non-chemical dry metrology step. Solid silicon shards or broken contaminated test wafers must be collected in marked ESD sharps containers for dedicated hazardous solid waste collection. Exhaust purge gases bypass scrubber directly through non-toxic house general exhaust.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Ultra-High Purity Gas Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Electronic Grade 5N5 (99.9995%) | `100%` |
| **Helium Gas (TXRF Chamber Path Flush)** | `7440-59-7` | Ultra-Pure Grade 5N (99.999%) | `100%` |
| **Silicon (Wafer Substrate with passivated oxide)** | `7440-21-3` | Prime Semiconductor Grade (9N) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, freshly passivated with ultra-thin chemical oxide layer (~0.4-0.6 nm) grown during hot SC-2 acidic clean (HCl:H2O2:H2O), free of gross organics and particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Clean, quantified chemical oxide surface verified with Fe/Ni/Cu < 5E10 atoms/cm2, preserved under dry inert nitrogen purge, ready for direct furnace insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air Q-time causes uncontrolled native oxide formation (> 0.8 nm) containing absorbed airborne moisture, boron/phosphorus dopant cross-contamination, and volatile organic hydrocarbons (VOCs), resulting in gate oxide thickness non-uniformity and severe gate leakage current in the 3.5 nm dry gate dielectric.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful non-destructive qualification of post-SC-2 wafer cleanliness demonstrating trace transition metallic impurity levels strictly below 5E10 atoms/cm2 for Fe and Ni, and below 1E10 atoms/cm2 for Cu, accompanied by total surface particulate counts <= 10 defects (>= 0.20 um) across the wafer, validating surface readiness for 3.5 nm dry gate thermal oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TXRF_Trace_Metal_9pt_Areal_Density_Report.csv`
- [ ] `Surface_Particle_LPD_Defect_Map_0p2um.tiff`
- [ ] `Pre_Oxidation_Cleanliness_Signoff_Certificate.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total surface iron (Fe) concentration across wafer 9-point map must not exceed cleanroom gate oxide tolerance threshold.** | `5.0E+10 atoms/cm2` | <= 5.0E+10 atoms/cm2 (Detection Limit: 1.0E+09 atoms/cm2) | Grazing-incidence Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) spectroscopy at 0.10 deg incident angle, Mo-Kalpha excitation. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface copper (Cu) and nickel (Ni) contamination must remain suppressed below critical DRAM junction leakage thresholds.** | `1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 (Cu) / 5.0E+10 atoms/cm2 (Ni)` | <= target limit across all measured radii | TXRF spectrum deconvolution over Cu-Ka (8.04 keV) and Ni-Ka (7.47 keV) peaks with 300s dwell. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Light point defect (LPD) particle count on active wafer area.** | `10 particles/wafer` | <= 10 particles at size >= 0.20 um (excluding 3mm edge ring) | Automated darkfield laser scattering surface particle scanning map. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 TXRF spatial sites confirm Fe < 5E10 atoms/cm2, Ni < 5E10 atoms/cm2, Cu < 1E10 atoms/cm2, laser particle scan demonstrates <= 10 total defects (>= 0.20 um), wafer transfer timestamp to furnace load station is within the 30-minute air window, and formal metrology signoff certificate is digitally signed into MES.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic, freshly passivated with ultra-thin chemical oxide layer (~0.4-0.6 nm) grown during hot SC-2 acidic clean (HCl:H2O2:H2O), free of gross organics and particulate contamination.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Clean, quantified chemical oxide surface verified with Fe/Ni/Cu < 5E10 atoms/cm2, preserved under dry inert nitrogen purge, ready for direct furnace insertion.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding ambient air Q-time causes uncontrolled native oxide formation (> 0.8 nm) containing absorbed airborne moisture, boron/phosphorus dopant cross-contamination, and volatile organic hydrocarbons (VOCs), resulting in gate oxide thickness non-uniformity and severe gate leakage current in the 3.5 nm dry gate dielectric.

expected_result.summary: Successful non-destructive qualification of post-SC-2 wafer cleanliness demonstrating trace transition metallic impurity levels strictly below 5E10 atoms/cm2 for Fe and Ni, and below 1E10 atoms/cm2 for Cu, accompanied by total surface particulate counts <= 10 defects (>= 0.20 um) across the wafer, validating surface readiness for 3.5 nm dry gate thermal oxidation.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Total surface iron (Fe) concentration across wafer 9-point map must not exceed cleanroom gate oxide tolerance threshold.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Grazing-incidence Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) spectroscopy at 0.10 deg incident angle, Mo-Kalpha excitation.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Surface copper (Cu) and nickel (Ni) contamination must remain suppressed below critical DRAM junction leakage thresholds.
quantitative_assertions.tolerance: <= target limit across all measured radii
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: TXRF spectrum deconvolution over Cu-Ka (8.04 keV) and Ni-Ka (7.47 keV) peaks with 300s dwell.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Light point defect (LPD) particle count on active wafer area.
quantitative_assertions.tolerance: <= 10 particles at size >= 0.20 um (excluding 3mm edge ring)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated darkfield laser scattering surface particle scanning map.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 9 TXRF spatial sites confirm Fe < 5E10 atoms/cm2, Ni < 5E10 atoms/cm2, Cu < 1E10 atoms/cm2, laser particle scan demonstrates <= 10 total defects (>= 0.20 um), wafer transfer timestamp to furnace load station is within the 30-minute air window, and formal metrology signoff certificate is digitally signed into MES.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Cascade Overflow Rinse, SRD Drying & Surface Metallic TXRF Metrology

**Context & Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean > Cascade Overflow Rinse, SRD Drying & Surface Metallic TXRF Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-SC-2 Acidic    │
│        Cassette        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Cascade Overflow UPW  │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Spin-Rinse-Dryer SRD  │
│         Cycle          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Surface TXRF      │
│  Metrology Inspection  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│   Metallic Criteria    │
│          Met?          │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮No
          Yes│                             │
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │    │                        │
│   Pass to 3.5nm Dry    │    │   Rework / Chemical    │
│     Gate Oxidation     │    │       Bath Audit       │
│                        │    │                        │
└────────────────────────┘    └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Cascade Overflow Deionized Water Rinse:**
   - **Transfer:** Transfer the wafer cassette immediately from the hot SC-2 acidic bath ($75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$) into the multi-stage cascade overflow rinse tank to prevent chemical dry-in.
   - **Water Quality & Flow:** Continuously supply Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) with an incoming bulk resistivity of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $22^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **Endpoint Monitoring:** Maintain counter-current overflow rinsing until the effluent resistivity bath monitor reads $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ and stabilizes at $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, verifying complete clearance of residual $\text{HCl}$ / $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ and desorbed transition metal/alkali chloride complexes.

2. **Spin-Rinse-Dryer (SRD) Cycle Execution:**
   - **Cassette Loading:** Transfer wafers into a balanced, dual-axis Spin-Rinse-Dryer under a Class 1 minienvironment.
   - **Low-Speed Rinse Phase:** Spin at $500\text{ RPM}$ with high-purity UPW ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) spray manifold active for 60 seconds to wash away any airborne micro-droplets.
   - **High-Speed Dry Phase:** Ramp spindle speed to $2000\text{–}2500\text{ RPM}$ while initiating heated, filtered ultra-dry $\text{N}_2$ gas purge ($0.05\,\mu\text{m}$ filtered, dew point $<-70^\circ\text{C}$) across both wafer surfaces for 180 seconds until hydrophobic/hydrophilic surfaces achieve zero boundary moisture.

3. **Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Surface Metrology:**
   - **Tool Setup:** Load representative process control wafers (center, top, bottom, and notch orientations) into the TXRF chamber under ultra-clean vacuum/ambient conditions.
   - **Glancing Angle Alignment:** Calibrate the monochromatic X-ray beam below the critical angle of total external silicon reflection ($\theta_c \approx 0.18^\circ$ for Mo-$K\alpha$ or W-$L\beta$ radiation) to isolate fluorescence emissions strictly to the uppermost atomic layers ($< 3\text{–}5\text{ nm}$).
   - **Metrology Integration:** Acquire energy-dispersive X-ray spectra across multi-point wafer coordinates to quantify residual metallic coordination complexes and alkali ion concentrations before wafers enter the high-temperature gate oxidation furnace.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement Technique / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effluent Final Rinse Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (Threshold: $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) | In-line Conductivity/Resistivity Probe |
| **Surface Transition Metals ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni, Au}$)** | $< 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ | Glancing-Angle TXRF Spectroscopy |
| **Surface Alkali Ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$)** | $< 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF / Surface Analysis System |
| **Water Droplet / Residue Marks** | $0\text{ defects/wafer}$ (Zero localized dry-in residues) | Automated Darkfield Optical Inspection |

---

### Literature & Context Citations

- **Source:** *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering*
  - *"Final Dump Rinse & Dry: Overflow rinse to 18.2 MOhm-cm, followed by filtered N2 Marangoni or isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor drying."*
  - *"Cascade Dump Rinse: 5 cycles with 18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water until bath resistivity > 16 MOhm-cm."*
  - *"RCA-2 / SC-2 (Standard Clean 2 - Acid Desorption): Action: Forms soluble coordination complexes with alkali ions (Na+, K+) and transition metals (Fe, Cu, Ni, Au), preventing furnace contamination."*
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Unit cell gate oxide integration constraints ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric target $3.5\text{ nm}$) requiring sub-femtoamp leakage control ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Station exhaust and DI water loop (18.2 MOhm-cm, particle filter 0.1 um) must interlock prior to wafer boat immersion. Rinse cascade must terminate downstream acid carries before SC-2.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: BOE 6:1 (NH4F:HF) etch rate must be calibrated at 70-80 nm/min at 25°C. SC-1 (5:1:1 H2O:NH4OH:H2O2) must be maintained at 75°C +/- 2°C to eliminate light organics without pitting Si.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Electronic-grade semiconductor reagents (VLSI/MOS grade) must be procured from certified chemical distributors; technical-grade chemicals will induce metallic surface poisoning (Fe, Cu, Ni > 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24-32 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Chemical cross-contamination or incomplete dump rinse leaves watermark defects and micro-masking during subsequent etch).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Watermark defect formation during static pull-out from hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transition.
1. Exhaust face-velocity drop below 0.5 m/s causing acid vapor condensation on cleanroom tooling.
1. Over-etch in BOE undercut exceeding 50 nm, destroying contact via dimensional margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-3-01` | **Post-Clean Particle & Metallic Trace Contamination Assay** | Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor / Surfscan) & TXRF Spectrometer | 1. Load unpatterned witness silicon wafer into darkfield laser scatterometer. 2. Scan complete surface for light point defects (LPD) at size bin >= 180 nm. 3. Perform Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) for trace Fe, Cu, Ni surface concentrations. | `LPD count (>= 180 nm) < 10 defects/wafer (Pass); Transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) < 5e10 atoms/cm2 (Pass).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-3-02` | **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Step Height & Lateral Undercut Profilometry** | Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak XT) / Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Zero stylus force baseline at 3 mg on planar SiO2 field. 2. Scan 200 um profile across etched contact window step at 20 um/s scan speed. 3. Record step height h_step and lateral undercut under resist margin. | `Etch depth matches target +/- 5% (Pass); lateral undercut <= 35 nm (Pass); surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene gloves (0.7 mm thickness, tested for HF permeation), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield over ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeves (PVC/Neoprene), Acid gas vapor cartridge respirator (NIOSH approved for HF/HCl)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: MANDATORY ON-SITE ANTIDOTE: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%). In case of HF skin contact: Flush immediately under emergency drench shower for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage Calcium Gluconate Gel into affected skin continuously until emergency medical response arrives. Never apply standard burn creams.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated polypropylene wet bench with vertical laminar exhaust face velocity >= 0.55 m/s. Interlocked with wet acid scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride effluent. Neutralize with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2). Verify pH 7.0-8.5 before drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/MOS Electronic Grade (< 1 ppb metals) | `49% conc. or 1:50 DHF` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (NH4F)** | `12125-01-8` | Electronic Grade | `40% aq (for BOE 6:1 buffer)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (unstabilized) | `30% aq (for SC-1 & SC-2)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** | `7647-01-0` | Electronic Grade | `37% aq (for SC-2 clean)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `29% aq (for SC-1 clean)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic with native chemical oxide (Tox ~1.0 nm) and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare silicon (water contact angle > 75°), zero watermarks, Tox < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native SiO2 spontaneously regrows in ambient air at ~0.1 nm/hr, degrading interface state density Dit and causing uncontrolled threshold voltage shift in downstream gate oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Cascade Overflow Rinse, SRD Drying & Surface Metallic TXRF Metrology: Chemical cleaning and surface preparation verified with zero watermark defects, bare hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon, and calibrated oxide etch rate.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Surface_particle_laser_scan_Surfscan.pdf`
- [ ] `Sessile_drop_contact_angle_measurement.png`
- [ ] `DHF_BOE_calibrated_etch_rate_sheet.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-DHF bare silicon water contact angle** | `>= 75.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI water droplet) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface particulate defect density (> 0.1 um)** | `< 15 particles/wafer` | Max acceptable particle count on 100mm wafer | Darkfield Laser Surface Inspection (Surfscan) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Surface metallic impurity concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | `< 1.0e10 atoms/cm²` | Max allowable contamination | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer surface exhibits 100% uniform dewetting / hydrophobicity with zero visible drying marks under bright light; residual native oxide Tox < 0.2 nm confirmed by spectroscopic ellipsometry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: High-Resistivity Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) Cascade Overflow Wet Rinse Execution
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation (Wet Chemistry)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Action Type:** Buy / Execution  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Transfer from   │
│     SC-2 / HF Bath     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tank 1: Primary UPW   │
│     Overflow Rinse     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Tank 2: Secondary    │
│  UPW Cascade Overflow  │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Resistivity &      │
│       Carry-Over       │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Transfer to SRD     │
│        Station         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Rinse System Verification:**
   - Confirm Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) cascade supply is actively flowing in counter-current direction (fresh UPW continuously fed into Tank 2, cascading over weir into Tank 1).
   - Ensure in-line resistivity sensors in both primary and secondary cascade weir drains are online and calibrated.
2. **Wafer Batch Transfer:**
   - Retrieve wafer cassette immediately upon completing the acidic metallic decontamination (RCA-2 / SC-2: 6:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) or native oxide etch bath.
   - Transfer wafer cassette via automated end-effector into Tank 1 within $< 5\text{ s}$ to prevent chemical dry-in and residue crystallization on active areas.
3. **Primary Cascade Rinse (Tank 1):**
   - Submerge cassette fully into Tank 1 under continuous overflow to strip bulk residual $\text{HCl}$ / ionic carry-over.
   - Run immersion under bottom UPW laminar displacement flow.
4. **Secondary Cascade Final Rinse (Tank 2):**
   - Elevate and index cassette into Tank 2 (fed directly with fresh incoming UPW).
   - Continue cascade overflow wet rinse until resistivity baseline target is reached.
5. **Rinse Completion & SRD Transfer:**
   - Ensure total effective rinse duration reaches $\ge 3\text{ minutes}$.
   - Once effluent resistivity meets the acceptance threshold, transfer cassette to the Spin Rinse Dryer (SRD) station for ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ drying.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effluent Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line toroidal resistivity sensor at final cascade overflow weir |
| **Minimum Rinse Duration** | $\ge 3$ | $\text{minutes}$ | Automated wet bench recipe execution timer |
| **Preceding Acidic Clean Temp** | $70 - 80$ | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ | Thermocouple immersion probe in upstream RCA-2 (SC-2) bath |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - *Intermediate Rinse / Final Rinse Specification:* Prescribes dump/cascade rinsing with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\text{ minutes}$** following chemical cleaning steps.
  - *Bath Temperature & Carry-Over Chemistry:* Upstream RCA-2 (SC-2) bath composition (6 parts $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part $37\%\text{ HCl}$, 1 part $30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) operating at **$70^{\circ}\text{C}-80^{\circ}\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$**, dictating the required removal of alkali ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metal ions ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) prior to subsequent high-purity dry gate oxide growth.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Cascade overflow rinse design must strictly control the hydraulic residence time, Reynolds number, and overflow weir uniformity across the quartz immersion tank to eliminate boundary layer stagnation. If the cascade overflow velocity profile exhibits dead zones between closely spaced 180nm production wafer slots (4.76 mm pitch), residual ionic drag-out from the preceding hot SC-2 (HCl/H2O2) bath will persist in micro-recesses, compromising downstream resistivity recovery rate and leading to false-positive resistivity endpoint triggering.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Transitioning from hot SC-2 acid clean into high-purity UPW requires precise thermal shock management and rapid pH neutralization. The chemical oxide formed during SC-2 must remain pristine without uncontrolled etching or localized pit dissolution caused by residual dissolved oxygen (DO) combined with hot acidic drag-out. Online resistivity must recover to >= 18.0 MOhm-cm at 25 deg C with dissolved oxygen controlled below 15 ppb to prevent premature native oxide re-growth or water mark formation prior to SRD drying.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply line continuity of semiconductor-grade Ultra-Pure Water (ASTM D5127 Type E-1.1/SEMI C79) requires dedicated PFA fluoropolymer distribution loops with continuous TOC UV oxidation, degasification membranes, and mixed-bed ion-exchange polishing. Any unannounced fluctuation in municipal water feeds impacting UPW plant resistivity or cartridge filter availability directly stalls furnace-bound lot releases.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rinse cycle duration directly dictates wet bench throughput and gate oxide furnace loading synchronization. Extending rinse times beyond 8 minutes to chase sub-ppb trace contamination risks breaching downstream dry gate oxidation queue-time (Q-time) limits, whereas cutting rinse duration short directly induces trace chloride-induced dielectric breakdown failures.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Stagnant boundary layer ionic entrapment resulting in residual Cl- retention (> 1e10 atoms/cm2) and catastrophic 3.5 nm gate oxide breakdown voltage (BVox) degradation.
1. Dissolved oxygen (DO > 20 ppb) ingress during cascade overflow inducing microscopic pitting and non-uniform chemical oxide regrowth on active DRAM device channels.
1. Resistivity sensor scaling calibration drift at 25 deg C temperature compensation, leading to premature lot exit while effluent resistivity is below 17.5 MOhm-cm.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Acid-resistant chemical apron (heavyweight neoprene/PTFE), Viton or butyl rubber chemical gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Full-face splash shield conforming to ANSI Z87.1 paired with chemical splash goggles, Steel-toe chemical-resistant neoprene boots with non-slip soles

Skin contact: Strip contaminated PPE and flush affected skin with copiously flowing tepid water for 15 minutes. Inhalation of residual acid mists: Evacuate operator to clean fresh-air bay, administer oxygen if breathing is labored, and obtain medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous lateral lip wet-bench exhaust operating at static pressure differential >= -0.25 inches water column (-62 Pa) and face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) to capture acidic fumes; certified hazardous exhaust routed to central acid scrubber.

critics.systems_engineer: Cascade overflow rinse design must strictly control the hydraulic residence time, Reynolds number, and overflow weir uniformity across the quartz immersion tank to eliminate boundary layer stagnation. If the cascade overflow velocity profile exhibits dead zones between closely spaced 180nm production wafer slots (4.76 mm pitch), residual ionic drag-out from the preceding hot SC-2 (HCl/H2O2) bath will persist in micro-recesses, compromising downstream resistivity recovery rate and leading to false-positive resistivity endpoint triggering.
critics.domain_expert: Transitioning from hot SC-2 acid clean into high-purity UPW requires precise thermal shock management and rapid pH neutralization. The chemical oxide formed during SC-2 must remain pristine without uncontrolled etching or localized pit dissolution caused by residual dissolved oxygen (DO) combined with hot acidic drag-out. Online resistivity must recover to >= 18.0 MOhm-cm at 25 deg C with dissolved oxygen controlled below 15 ppb to prevent premature native oxide re-growth or water mark formation prior to SRD drying.
critics.supply_chain: Supply line continuity of semiconductor-grade Ultra-Pure Water (ASTM D5127 Type E-1.1/SEMI C79) requires dedicated PFA fluoropolymer distribution loops with continuous TOC UV oxidation, degasification membranes, and mixed-bed ion-exchange polishing. Any unannounced fluctuation in municipal water feeds impacting UPW plant resistivity or cartridge filter availability directly stalls furnace-bound lot releases.
critics.laya_pm: Rinse cycle duration directly dictates wet bench throughput and gate oxide furnace loading synchronization. Extending rinse times beyond 8 minutes to chase sub-ppb trace contamination risks breaching downstream dry gate oxidation queue-time (Q-time) limits, whereas cutting rinse duration short directly induces trace chloride-induced dielectric breakdown failures.
critical_failure_modes: Stagnant boundary layer ionic entrapment resulting in residual Cl- retention (> 1e10 atoms/cm2) and catastrophic 3.5 nm gate oxide breakdown voltage (BVox) degradation.
Dissolved oxygen (DO > 20 ppb) ingress during cascade overflow inducing microscopic pitting and non-uniform chemical oxide regrowth on active DRAM device channels.
Resistivity sensor scaling calibration drift at 25 deg C temperature compensation, leading to premature lot exit while effluent resistivity is below 17.5 MOhm-cm.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Spin-Rinse Dryer (SRD) Particle-Free High-Purity $\text{N}_2$ Dehydration Recipe

**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-SRD-180NM-001`  
**Node Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip $\rightarrow$ Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) $\rightarrow$ Pre-Oxidation Wet Clean Sequence $\rightarrow$ Cascade Overflow Rinse & SRD Dehydration  
**Classification:** Manufacturing SOP (Make)

---

## 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Transfer from   │
│     Cascade Rinse      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Low-Speed Pre-Spin &  │
│      Rinse Spray       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       High-Speed       │
│  Centrifugal Spin Off  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Heated High-Purity   │
│  N2 Purge Dehydration  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Deceleration & N2    │
│     Blanket Static     │
│     Neutralization     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Submersion Transfer & Rotor Loading
1. Transfer the 100mm silicon wafer cassette directly from the $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water cascade overflow rinse station into the enclosed SRD rotor chamber within 15 seconds to prevent airborne drying marks.
2. Secure cassette lock pins and seal the SRD process chamber door hermetically.

### Step 2: Low-Speed Pre-Rinse & Centrifugal Spread Cycle
1. Initiate low-speed rotor spin at $500\text{ RPM}$ for $5\text{ seconds}$ to achieve radial liquid equilibration and dislodge gross surface DI water droplets.
2. Engage atomized $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water rinse manifolds across wafer faces to sweep residual micro-droplets and particulate matter outward.

### Step 3: High-Speed Centrifugal Spin-Off
1. Discontinue DI water dispense; ramp rotor acceleration at $10{,}000\text{ RPM/s}$ up to $4{,}000\text{ RPM}$ for a duration of $30\text{ seconds}$.
2. Centrifugally shear bulk boundary liquid films away from wafer surfaces into exhaust collection channels.

### Step 4: High-Purity $\text{N}_2$ Purge Dehydration Cycle
1. Simultaneously inject heated, ultra-pure nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) gas across the spinning wafer cassette at the $4{,}000\text{ RPM}$ plateau.
2. Continue heated $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry to desorb physisorbed water molecules and prevent water-mark evaporation ring nucleation across hydrophobic/hydrophilic transition zones prior to 3.5 nm gate oxide thermal growth.

### Step 5: Deceleration & Static Neutralization
1. Decelerate rotor to $0\text{ RPM}$ under a continuous laminar high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blanket with active ionization bars engaged to neutralize centrifugal triboelectric charges.
2. Unload cassette into an inert microenvironment FOUP/carrier for surface TXRF metrology and pre-gate oxidation staging.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Resistivity (Rinse Phase)** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-situ inline resistivity sensor |
| **Initial Spin / Spread Velocity** | $500 \pm 5$ | $\text{RPM}$ | Optical shaft encoder / tachometer |
| **High-Speed Dehydration Spin Velocity** | $4{,}000 \pm 10$ | $\text{RPM}$ | Closed-loop brushless motor drive |
| **Rotor Acceleration Ramp Rate** | $10{,}000 \pm 100$ | $\text{RPM/s}$ | Drive controller feedback |
| **High-Speed Spin Duration** | $30.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{seconds}$ | Integrated tool timer controller |

---

## 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **[Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure](docs/context.yaml):** Specifies the required cleanroom deionized water purity metric ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water) and the requirement for high-purity nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry as the final surface preparation step before thermal oxidation.
- **[Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming](docs/context.yaml):** Specifies the centrifugal spin dynamics: low-speed spread cycle at $500\text{ RPM}$ for $5\text{ seconds}$, acceleration ramp rate at $10{,}000\text{ RPM/s}$, and final spin speed of $4{,}000\text{ RPM}$ for $30\text{ seconds}$ on 100mm wafers, alongside thermal desorption of physisorbed water molecules.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml):** Defines the active device geometry (access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline layout) requiring strict particle and ionic contamination-free interfaces for the critical 3.5 nm gate oxide.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Rotational dynamic balancing and chamber flow aerodynamics must be synchronized: high-speed drying at 2,000–2,500 RPM creates micro-turbulences near rotor edge clamps if pure N2 purge flow (heated to 80°C) is sub-optimally distributed, risking droplet atomization and redeposition rather than centrifugal displacement.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following SC-2 cleaning and cascade DI rinse, the wafer exhibits a clean chemical oxide (hydrophilic, ~1.0 nm). Any static charge accumulation during SRD processing will actively attract airborne silica/organic nanoparticles; anti-static N2 ionization (corona ionizing bars, residual balance < ±15 V) inside the rotor chamber is mandatory to achieve pre-gate oxide defect density < 0.05 particles/cm2.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires Semi C3/UHP grade N2 (99.9999% purity) with in-line point-of-use (POU) 0.003 um PTFE membrane filtration and validated rotor seal consumables (Viton/Kalrez O-rings rated for cyclic thermal/chemical exposure) sourced from certified domestic or tier-1 semiconductor vendors to avoid long lead-time stoppages.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Cycle time must be strictly throttled to <= 420 seconds per 25-wafer cassette batch to preserve fab cadence and prevent queue bottlenecking prior to TXRF surface trace metal analysis and thermal gate oxidation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Water mark defect formation due to localized micro-droplet dry-in-place evaporation before centrifugal liquid film shedding.
1. Triboelectric charge buildup on wafer surfaces resulting in electrostatic attraction of ambient particle contamination.
1. Mechanical slip-line generation or edge micro-chipping caused by rotor cassette chuck imbalance or excessive acceleration ramp rates (> 500 RPM/s).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-3-2-01` | **Post-SRD Surface Particle Adders and Micro-Defect Inspection** | KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 / Candela Laser Surface Particle Counter (tuned for 100mm/150mm Si substrates at >= 0.12 um threshold) | 1. Load 25-wafer cassette from cascade overflow rinse (DIW resistivity > 18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) directly into SRD rotor. 2. Execute recipe: 300 RPM rinse wash (60s), 800 RPM low-speed spin water displacement (60s), 2,200 RPM high-speed centrifugal drying with 80°C hot N2 flow at 65 SLM (180s), 500 RPM deceleration purge (60s), stop and anti-static ionizer dwell (20s). 3. Transfer cassette to SMIF/FOUP. 4. Run laser surface inspection scan on 5 monitor wafers (slots 1, 6, 13, 19, 25). | `Net particle adders (size >= 0.12 um) must be <= 5 particles/wafer across all 5 test wafers, with zero localized clustering or radial water mark streaks.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-2-3-2-02` | **Residual Moisture and Triboelectric Surface Voltage Metrology** | Trek Model 347 Non-Contact Electrostatic Voltmeter & Point-of-Use Moisture Analyzer (Meeco / Tiger Optics CRDS <= 1 ppb H2O limit) | 1. Execute automated SRD cycle on full cassette. 2. Record chamber exhaust moisture trace during the final 60 seconds of 80°C N2 high-speed spin. 3. Immediately unload wafer cassette upon door interlock release. 4. Measure wafer surface potential across 9 points per wafer across center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zone (3mm) using non-contact probe within 60 seconds of unload. | `Chamber exhaust moisture content must drop to <= 5 ppb H2O within 150 seconds of high-spin cycle. Absolute surface electrostatic potential across all 9 points must remain within -25V to +25V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical apron (PVDF/PTFE or heavy-duty polypropylene), Nitrile cleanroom gloves worn over inner lint-free gloves, Safety goggles with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Full face shield during manual cassette transfer, Acid/solvent resistant safety overshoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Nitrogen is a simple asphyxiant: In case of oxygen deficiency alarm (< 19.5% O2), evacuate area immediately. If exposed individual suffers dizziness or loss of consciousness, remove to fresh air, administer oxygen if trained, and perform CPR if breathing stops. For high-speed mechanical pinch/impact incidents, isolate power and summon cleanroom emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated SRD process chamber acid/moisture exhaust operating at continuous negative pressure (min static draft -0.75 in. w.g., face velocity > 100 FPM at door threshold). Ambient room O2 sensors with audio-visual alarms calibrated to trigger at 19.5% low and 18.0% critical levels.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Liquid effluent from pre-rinse spin cycles is hard-piped to the Industrial Acid Waste Neutralization (AWN) collection sump. Chamber gas exhaust passes through cleanroom wet scrubber before atmospheric discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Ultra-High Purity, Compressed)** | `7727-37-9` | SEMI Grade C3 / Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `>= 99.9999% vol` |
| **Deionized Water (Ultrapure)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM D5127 Type E-1.2 | `100% vol` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic wet chemical passivated surface (thin SC-2 chemical oxide ~0.8-1.2 nm) fully submerged in UPW cascade overflow bath without any intermediate air dry exposure.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Bone-dry, particulate-free chemical oxide passivated silicon substrate, electrostatic charge neutral (< +/- 25V), free of moisture and drying water marks, packaged in purge-capable FOUP.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time induces uncontrolled airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption and airborne boron/phosphorus dopant contamination, leading to gate oxide integrity (GOI) breakdown voltage degradation and high early-life dielectric failure rates.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Execution of the validated Spin-Rinse Dryer (SRD) recipe delivers completely dehydrated, water-mark-free, static-neutral 100mm/150mm silicon wafers post-SC-2 clean. The recipe achieves zero added macro-defects and minimal micro-particle adders, guaranteeing pristine substrate readiness for TXRF surface metal qualification and pre-gate thermal oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SRD_Recipe_Execution_Log_RunReport.csv`
- [ ] `Surfscan_SP2_Particle_Map_PostSRD.tiff`
- [ ] `TXRF_Surface_Metrology_Prep_Signoff.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Net defect particle adders post-SRD drying cycle** | `<= 3 particles/wafer` | +2 particles/wafer max | KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 laser darkfield scattering inspection (>= 0.12 um) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Wafer surface residual moisture and water mark density** | `0 water marks/wafer` | +0 water marks allowable | High-intensity collimated fiber-optic darkfield macro-inspection and automated optical inspection |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Residual electrostatic wafer surface potential post-neutralization** | `0.0 V` | +/- 25.0 V | Trek Model 347 Non-Contact Electrostatic Voltmeter 9-point surface scan |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five consecutive 25-wafer monitor lots processed through the SRD recipe must exhibit net particle addition <= 5 particles/wafer (>= 0.12 um), zero detectable water mark anomalies, post-unload static charge within +/- 25 V, and exhaust moisture level <= 5 ppb, verified and signed off by the Lithography/Wet Processing Module Lead and Quality Lead.

critics.systems_engineer: Rotational dynamic balancing and chamber flow aerodynamics must be synchronized: high-speed drying at 2,000–2,500 RPM creates micro-turbulences near rotor edge clamps if pure N2 purge flow (heated to 80°C) is sub-optimally distributed, risking droplet atomization and redeposition rather than centrifugal displacement.
critics.domain_expert: Following SC-2 cleaning and cascade DI rinse, the wafer exhibits a clean chemical oxide (hydrophilic, ~1.0 nm). Any static charge accumulation during SRD processing will actively attract airborne silica/organic nanoparticles; anti-static N2 ionization (corona ionizing bars, residual balance < ±15 V) inside the rotor chamber is mandatory to achieve pre-gate oxide defect density < 0.05 particles/cm2.
critics.supply_chain: Requires Semi C3/UHP grade N2 (99.9999% purity) with in-line point-of-use (POU) 0.003 um PTFE membrane filtration and validated rotor seal consumables (Viton/Kalrez O-rings rated for cyclic thermal/chemical exposure) sourced from certified domestic or tier-1 semiconductor vendors to avoid long lead-time stoppages.
critics.laya_pm: Cycle time must be strictly throttled to <= 420 seconds per 25-wafer cassette batch to preserve fab cadence and prevent queue bottlenecking prior to TXRF surface trace metal analysis and thermal gate oxidation.
critical_failure_modes: Water mark defect formation due to localized micro-droplet dry-in-place evaporation before centrifugal liquid film shedding.
Triboelectric charge buildup on wafer surfaces resulting in electrostatic attraction of ambient particle contamination.
Mechanical slip-line generation or edge micro-chipping caused by rotor cassette chuck imbalance or excessive acceleration ramp rates (> 500 RPM/s).

testcases.title: Post-SRD Surface Particle Adders and Micro-Defect Inspection
testcases.instrumentation: KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 / Candela Laser Surface Particle Counter (tuned for 100mm/150mm Si substrates at >= 0.12 um threshold)
testcases.pre_conditions: Baseline particle count established pre-clean (< 10 defects >= 0.12 um across 100mm substrate). SRD chamber idle purge verified with POU particle counter showing zero counts/min in N2 stream.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load 25-wafer cassette from cascade overflow rinse (DIW resistivity > 18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) directly into SRD rotor. 2. Execute recipe: 300 RPM rinse wash (60s), 800 RPM low-speed spin water displacement (60s), 2,200 RPM high-speed centrifugal drying with 80°C hot N2 flow at 65 SLM (180s), 500 RPM deceleration purge (60s), stop and anti-static ionizer dwell (20s). 3. Transfer cassette to SMIF/FOUP. 4. Run laser surface inspection scan on 5 monitor wafers (slots 1, 6, 13, 19, 25).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Net particle adders (size >= 0.12 um) must be <= 5 particles/wafer across all 5 test wafers, with zero localized clustering or radial water mark streaks.

testcases.title: Residual Moisture and Triboelectric Surface Voltage Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Trek Model 347 Non-Contact Electrostatic Voltmeter & Point-of-Use Moisture Analyzer (Meeco / Tiger Optics CRDS <= 1 ppb H2O limit)
testcases.pre_conditions: Electrostatic voltmeter calibrated and zero-referenced inside Class 100 cleanroom hood. Nitrogen exhaust moisture sensor connected to SRD effluent line.
testcases.procedure: 1. Execute automated SRD cycle on full cassette. 2. Record chamber exhaust moisture trace during the final 60 seconds of 80°C N2 high-speed spin. 3. Immediately unload wafer cassette upon door interlock release. 4. Measure wafer surface potential across 9 points per wafer across center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zone (3mm) using non-contact probe within 60 seconds of unload.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Chamber exhaust moisture content must drop to <= 5 ppb H2O within 150 seconds of high-spin cycle. Absolute surface electrostatic potential across all 9 points must remain within -25V to +25V.

ppe_required: Cleanroom chemical apron (PVDF/PTFE or heavy-duty polypropylene)
Nitrile cleanroom gloves worn over inner lint-free gloves
Safety goggles with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 approved)
Full face shield during manual cassette transfer
Acid/solvent resistant safety overshoes
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Nitrogen is a simple asphyxiant: In case of oxygen deficiency alarm (< 19.5% O2), evacuate area immediately. If exposed individual suffers dizziness or loss of consciousness, remove to fresh air, administer oxygen if trained, and perform CPR if breathing stops. For high-speed mechanical pinch/impact incidents, isolate power and summon cleanroom emergency medical services.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Dedicated SRD process chamber acid/moisture exhaust operating at continuous negative pressure (min static draft -0.75 in. w.g., face velocity > 100 FPM at door threshold). Ambient room O2 sensors with audio-visual alarms calibrated to trigger at 19.5% low and 18.0% critical levels.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Liquid effluent from pre-rinse spin cycles is hard-piped to the Industrial Acid Waste Neutralization (AWN) collection sump. Chamber gas exhaust passes through cleanroom wet scrubber before atmospheric discharge.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic wet chemical passivated surface (thin SC-2 chemical oxide ~0.8-1.2 nm) fully submerged in UPW cascade overflow bath without any intermediate air dry exposure.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Bone-dry, particulate-free chemical oxide passivated silicon substrate, electrostatic charge neutral (< +/- 25V), free of moisture and drying water marks, packaged in purge-capable FOUP.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding queue time induces uncontrolled airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption and airborne boron/phosphorus dopant contamination, leading to gate oxide integrity (GOI) breakdown voltage degradation and high early-life dielectric failure rates.

expected_result.summary: Execution of the validated Spin-Rinse Dryer (SRD) recipe delivers completely dehydrated, water-mark-free, static-neutral 100mm/150mm silicon wafers post-SC-2 clean. The recipe achieves zero added macro-defects and minimal micro-particle adders, guaranteeing pristine substrate readiness for TXRF surface metal qualification and pre-gate thermal oxidation.

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 laser darkfield scattering inspection (>= 0.12 um)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Wafer surface residual moisture and water mark density
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-intensity collimated fiber-optic darkfield macro-inspection and automated optical inspection

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Residual electrostatic wafer surface potential post-neutralization
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Trek Model 347 Non-Contact Electrostatic Voltmeter 9-point surface scan
