critics.systems_engineer: Ambient airborne molecular contamination (AMC), specifically volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and ambient humidity, exponentially accelerates parasitic native oxide regrowth and carbon chemisorption on freshly HF-dipped, hydrogen-terminated silicon substrates. If cleanroom ambient exposure is not tightly coupled via closed-loop FOUP/SMIF or purged desiccator transfers, incubation times exceeding 45 minutes will skew the target 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thickness and degrade interface state density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2).
critics.domain_expert: Following the dilute HF native oxide etch and RCA-2 strip, the Si(100) surface exhibits metastable monohydride and dihydride termination. Exposure to cleanroom clean-air containing parts-per-billion amines, siloxanes, or phthalates displaces surface hydrides and initiates localized, non-uniform islands of uncontrolled SiO_x, leading to catastrophic gate dielectric breakdown voltage (Vbd) dispersion and premature time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB).
critics.supply_chain: Automated FOUP purgers and real-time ion mobility spectrometry (IMS) / surface acoustic wave (SAW) AMC monitoring pods are capital-prohibitive for Gen 1 open-source fabs. The team must rely on locally fabricated N2-purged acrylic desiccator cabinets and commercial mobile gas-phase filtration units; replacement cycles for specialized chemical carbon/permanganate chemisorbent filters must be strictly baselined to avoid undetected organic saturation.
critics.laya_pm: Pre-gate queue-time certification is the single most sensitive schedule chokepoint between wet-bench pre-cleans and the dry thermal oxidation furnace. Any delay in furnace staging, quartz tube temperature stabilization, or qualification wafer dispatch immediately voids the pre-clean lot, forcing an expensive and yield-damaging re-clean cycle through dilute HF.
critical_failure_modes: Uncontrolled native oxide regrows past 0.4 nm threshold prior to furnace insertion, inducing > 10% thickness variation across the 3.5 nm physical gate oxide target.
Chemisorbed organic amine/siloxane airborne contamination during staging creates trapped carbonaceous pinholes and severe threshold voltage (Vth) roll-off.
Nitrogen desiccator purge failure or seal leak introducing moisture-induced rapid oxidation and boron surface deactivation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Certified Cleanroom Nitrogen Purge FOUP Carrier Procurement & Qualification
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB180-MET-FOUP-001`  
**Classification:** Industrial Standard Operating Procedure (Gen 2 / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture)  
**Parent Process Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation > Pre-Gate Surface Cleanliness Quality Qualification & Queue-Time Certification > **Certified Cleanroom Nitrogen Purge FOUP Carrier Procurement & Qualification**

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This SOP establishes the protocol for procuring, testing, and qualifying cleanroom Nitrogen ($N_2$) Purge Front Opening Unified Pod (FOUP) / SMIF carriers. At the 180nm technology node, gate oxide target thickness is strictly ~3.5 nm grown at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation following RCA-1, dilute HF (1:50 native oxide strip), and RCA-2 wet surface preparation. Minimizing post-clean native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) during queue time prior to thermal oxidation requires positive-pressure ultra-high-purity (UHP) $N_2$ purged mini-environments.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Procurement &      │
│  Receiving Inspection  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Particle &       │
│  Outgassing Baseline   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    N2 Purge Flow &     │
│  Pressure Validation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        O2 & RH         │
│   De-enrichment Rate   │
│          Test          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Production       │
│  Qualification & Tool  │
│        Tagging         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Procurement & Incoming Physical Inspection
1. Verify procurement specifications for ultra-clean polycarbonate or carbon-filled PEEK FOUP shells featuring dual bottom-valve $N_2$ purge ports and low-outgassing fluoroelastomer perimeter seals.
2. Unpack FOUP units in ISO Class 4 (or cleaner) incoming inspection bay under vertical laminar flow.
3. Inspect kinematic coupling plates, robot handling flanges, door clamping latches, and purge check valves for mechanical integrity and micro-scratching.

#### Step 2: Mechanical Docking & Door Seal Interface Verification
1. Dock FOUP onto automated Load Port Unit (LPU) interface.
2. Engage kinematic pins and execute 20 consecutive door opening/closing cycles.
3. Validate door perimeter seal compression and verify purge port valve sealing under leak test mode.

#### Step 3: Purge Flow Rate & Internal Overpressure Balancing
1. Connect carrier purge ports to automated UHP $N_2$ supply (gas purity grade $\ge 99.999\%$, filtered to $\le 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$).
2. Regulate $N_2$ purge flow rate between 20 to 50 SLM (standard liters per minute).
3. Confirm positive internal pod differential pressure relative to the cleanroom ambient ($\Delta P = +5\text{ to }+25\text{ Pa}$) to prevent particle infiltration.

#### Step 4: Environmental De-enrichment Metrology ($O_2$ & Relative Humidity)
1. Load optical trace oxygen analyzer and capacitive relative humidity sensors into monitor slots inside the sealed FOUP.
2. Initiate purge and record the time to achieve target residual levels ($O_2 \le 1.0\text{ ppm}$, Relative Humidity $\text{RH} \le 1.0\%$).
3. Perform static seal-decay test: disconnect active purge and track oxygen re-ingress rate over 2 hours.

#### Step 5: Cleanliness Baseline & Dynamic Particle Airborne Qualification
1. Run airborne particle counter (optical particle counter, minimum sensitivity $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$) hooked to pod exhaust port during rapid door actuation and 50 SLM purge flow.
2. Certify FOUP internal particle count remains $\le 2\text{ particles/m}^3$ at $\ge 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$.
3. Affix automated RFID tracking tag and clear carrier for pre-gate oxide wafer transport queue.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Purge $O_2$ De-enrichment Concentration** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{ppm}$ (parts per million) | In-situ Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy (CRDS) / Optical $O_2$ Sensor |
| **Purge Moisture / Relative Humidity (RH)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\%$ (relative humidity) | Trace Moisture Dew-Point Sensor / Capacitive Hygrometer |
| **Internal Positive Differential Pressure ($\Delta P$)** | $+5.0\text{ to }+25.0$ | $\text{Pa}$ (pascals) | High-precision differential pressure transducer at purge interface |
| **Dynamic Particulate Cleanliness** | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{particles/m}^3$ ($\ge 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$) | Laser Airborne Optical Particle Counter (OPC) at exhaust port |

---

### 4. Source Citations & Context Justification
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context:* Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB). Minimum cell capacitance of $28\text{ fF}$ and sub-threshold/junction leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.
  - *SOP Link:* Minimizing sub-threshold and interface trap leakage on 180nm access gates requires uncompromising gate oxide interface quality and queue-time protection.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Context:* Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *SOP Link:* A physical oxide layer of only $3.5\text{ nm}$ is highly susceptible to uncontrolled native oxide growth; uncontrolled air/ambient exposure can add 0.5–1.0 nm of defective native oxide, severely skewing the $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal gate oxide target thickness and breakdown voltage.
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:**
  - *Context:* Dilute hydrofluoric dip (1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) strips native oxide, transitioning the silicon surface from hydrophilic to hydrophobic ($Si\text{-}H$ passivated), followed by $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry with high-purity nitrogen.
  - *SOP Link:* Freshly stripped, hydrophobic $Si\text{-}H$ surfaces are chemically active. Transporting wafers in certified $N_2$ purge FOUP carriers maintains an inert ambient ($O_2 \le 1.0\text{ ppm}$, $\text{RH} \le 1.0\%$), preserving passivation and preventing surface re-oxidation before entering the $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation furnace.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integration of automated N2-purged FOUP carriers into legacy 180nm wet bench unloaders and vertical diffusion furnace load ports requires strict mechanical SEMI E47.1/E57 compliance. The dynamic gas delivery coupling (inlet/outlet check valves at 0.5-2.0 slm N2 flow) must not generate pressure differentials that displace wafer seating within PEEK/carbon-fiber cassettes or cause door seal micro-leakage during overhead automated transport.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Immediately following dilute HF native oxide etch and SC-2 metallic decontamination, the Si(100) surface is hydrodynamically passivated with Si-H bonds. Residual ambient O2 and H2O partial pressures within the carrier must remain below 10 ppm to suppress regrowth of non-stoichiometric native sub-oxide (SiOx) to < 0.15 nm and prevent volatile airborne molecular contamination (AMC, specifically airborne siloxanes and amines) before 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of specialized front-opening unified pods (or 150/200mm SMIF pods with sealed N2 purge interfaces) involves 16-24 week vendor lead times for ultra-clean Entegris/Fluoroware-grade polycarbonate/polyetherimide (PEI) shells. Second-source qualification of purge gaskets, fluoroelastomer door seals, and ISO Class 1 compatible internal diffusers is mandatory to prevent single-supplier assembly downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The capital expenditure for certified purge carriers and automated load-port N2 charging docks must be phased against the Gen 1 pilot line timeline; carrier qualification cannot delay pre-oxidation thermal furnace qualification runs, requiring an interim manual purge validation protocol with mobile flow rotameters during initial site acceptance testing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Purge check-valve particulate shedding during active N2 gas charging exceeding ISO Class 1 cleanliness (> 1 particle >= 0.1 um per m3).
1. Elastomer perimeter door seal degradation or micro-gap causing ambient air back-diffusion and moisture spikes above 25 ppm within 60 minutes of queue time.
1. Outgassing of plasticizers (phthalates, organophosphates, siloxanes) from FOUP shell polymer matrices causing organic carbon poisoning on freshly stripped silicon surfaces.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-3-3-3-01` | **Hermetic Purge Depletion and Ambient Moisture/Oxygen Ingress Decay Metrology** | Servomex Ultra-Trace O2 Analyzer (Zirconia Sensor), Tiger Optics Cavity Ring-Down Spectrometer (CRDS for H2O), Integrated Carrier N2 Purge Flowmeter (0.1-5.0 slm) | 1. Dock FOUP onto certified N2 purge station and initiate Grade 6.0 N2 purge at 2.0 slm for 15 minutes. 2. Continuous sampling of exhaust line until H2O and O2 reach < 5 ppm. 3. Undock FOUP from active purge to simulate inter-bay transport, storing under ambient cleanroom air for 4 hours. 4. Re-dock FOUP to sampling plenum and extract headspace gas at 100 sccm directly into CRDS and O2 trace analyzer. 5. Record internal O2 and H2O concentrations as a function of sealed queue duration. | `O2 concentration <= 10 ppm and H2O concentration <= 15 ppm after 4 hours sealed holding without active purge line connected.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-2-3-3-3-02` | **Aerosol Particulate Shedding During N2 Injection and High-Velocity Purge Dynamics** | PMS Ultra DI-50 / Lasair III Aerosol Particle Counter (detection threshold >= 0.1 um), Mass Flow Controller calibrated for High Purity N2 at 0-10 slm | 1. Connect high-purity N2 line (filtered via 0.003 um point-of-use PTFE filter) to FOUP inlet port. 2. Position isokinetic particle sampling probe directly adjacent to the wafer slot #1, #13, and #25 front edges inside carrier exhaust manifold. 3. Pulse purge gas at 5.0 slm for 60 seconds (rapid purge cycle), followed by 1.5 slm steady-state purge for 10 minutes. 4. Count total airborne particles >= 0.1 um over 10 consecutive 1-minute integration periods. | `Zero cumulative particle counts >= 0.3 um; total counts >= 0.1 um must not exceed 2 particles per standard cubic foot (< 0.07 particles/L) during dynamic flow pulses.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free), Polycarbonate safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Cleanroom antistatic ESD coverall with hood and conductive booties, Personal portable oxygen deficiency monitor (clip-on O2 alarm set at 19.5% threshold)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Asphyxiation Hazard: In case of high-flow N2 release or low O2 alarm (<19.5%), evacuate personnel immediately to fresh air. If victim is unconscious, apply CPR with supplemental automated oxygen resuscitator. In case of liquid N2 / cold gas freeze contact, flush affected skin with lukewarm water (never hot); seek immediate emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom air exchange at >= 60 air changes per hour (ACH). Carrier purge docks must vent exhaust purge gas directly to the dedicated cleanroom process exhaust plenum with verified static backpressure < -50 Pa. Ambient O2 sensors mounted at 1.5 m elevation every 20 m2 of cleanroom floor.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Gaseous nitrogen exhaust requires no chemical neutralization and is routed to building general exhaust ducting. Spent cleaning wipes contaminated with 70% IPA must be sealed in airtight antistatic hazardous solvent waste bags and disposed of in accordance with local Class 1 flammable solvent waste regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0)** | `7727-37-9` | 99.9999% (VLSI / Electronic Grade) | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Carrier Sanitization Wipe)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI-C12) | `70.0% in UPW` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `15 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated Si(100) surface (contact angle > 75 deg) with native oxide thickness <= 0.1 nm post-DHF etch, free of metallic contaminants (< 1E10 atoms/cm2 via TXRF).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine hydrogen-passivated Si(100) surface with native oxide regrowth <= 0.15 nm, airborne organic contamination <= 1.0E12 carbon atoms/cm2, ready for immediate thermal oxidation entry.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled ambient oxygen and moisture penetration causing premature native oxide nucleation (> 0.3 nm SiOx), introducing interface traps (Dit > 1E11 eV-1 cm-2) and breakdown voltage (Ebd) reduction in the final 3.5 nm gate dielectric.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Formal Site Acceptance Test (SAT) qualification and baseline certification of certified cleanroom N2-purged FOUP carriers, confirming sub-10 ppm moisture/oxygen headspace maintenance over 8 hours and zero particle generation during automated docking and purge cycles.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FOUP_N2_Purge_Hermeticity_and_Decay_Report_Rev1.pdf`
- [ ] `Aerosol_Particle_Count_Dynamic_Purge_Log_Slot1_25.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

critics.systems_engineer: Integration of automated N2-purged FOUP carriers into legacy 180nm wet bench unloaders and vertical diffusion furnace load ports requires strict mechanical SEMI E47.1/E57 compliance. The dynamic gas delivery coupling (inlet/outlet check valves at 0.5-2.0 slm N2 flow) must not generate pressure differentials that displace wafer seating within PEEK/carbon-fiber cassettes or cause door seal micro-leakage during overhead automated transport.
critics.domain_expert: Immediately following dilute HF native oxide etch and SC-2 metallic decontamination, the Si(100) surface is hydrodynamically passivated with Si-H bonds. critics.supply_chain: Procurement of specialized front-opening unified pods (or 150/200mm SMIF pods with sealed N2 purge interfaces) involves 16-24 week vendor lead times for ultra-clean Entegris/Fluoroware-grade polycarbonate/polyetherimide (PEI) shells. Second-source qualification of purge gaskets, fluoroelastomer door seals, and ISO Class 1 compatible internal diffusers is mandatory to prevent single-supplier assembly downtime.
critics.laya_pm: The capital expenditure for certified purge carriers and automated load-port N2 charging docks must be phased against the Gen 1 pilot line timeline; carrier qualification cannot delay pre-oxidation thermal furnace qualification runs, requiring an interim manual purge validation protocol with mobile flow rotameters during initial site acceptance testing.

Elastomer perimeter door seal degradation or micro-gap causing ambient air back-diffusion and moisture spikes above 25 ppm within 60 minutes of queue time.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology
**Branch Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Thermal Processing (180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth, 3.5 nm) > Wet Chemistry (Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Inline Metrology Toolset)

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Wafer Ingress      │
│      Post-RCA/HF       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│         Angle          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Laser Surface      │
│     Particle Scan      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    TXRF Heavy Metal    │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Release to Gate     │
│    Oxidation (3.5nm    │
│         SiO2)          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Lot Ingress & Nitrogen Purge Transfer:**
   - Unload wafer cassette directly from the automated spin-rinse-dry (SRD) module following the pre-oxidation RCA clean and dilute HF dip sequence.
   - Stage the cassette in a Class 1 minienvironment under continuous ultra-high purity (UHP) $N_2$ purge ($O_2 < 10\text{ ppm}$, relative humidity $< 30\%$).
   - *Time constraint:* Total queue time ($\text{Q-Time}$) from final HF rinse to metrology and furnace ingress must not exceed $60\text{ minutes}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth.

2. **Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Measurement:**
   - Load the pilot/monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer chuck.
   - Dispense a deionized (DI) water droplet of $1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ using an automated micro-syringe at 5 distinct site locations (Center, North, South, East, West with $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
   - Capture droplet profile at $t = 2.0\text{ s}$ post-dispense via high-resolution CCD camera. Measure tangent angle to verify surface hydrophobicity ($Si\text{-}H$ bond passivation after HF dip vs. hydrophilic chemical oxide).

3. **Laser Surface Particle Inspection (LSIS / Light Scattering):**
   - Transfer monitor and production wafers onto the darkfield laser surface inspection station (calibrated against NIST PSL spheres).
   - Execute full-surface spiral scan with defect threshold set to bin particles $\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ (corresponding to the minimum critical feature size $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Generate defect density map and record total particle count per wafer across the active area ($3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

4. **Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Metallic Defect Sampling:**
   - Transfer the dedicated control wafer into the high-vacuum TXRF chamber ($P < 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
   - Position grazing-incidence X-ray beam ($\text{Mo-K}\alpha$ or $\text{W-L}\beta$ source at angle $\theta < \theta_c \approx 0.1^\circ$) across 3 test sites (Center, Mid-radius, Edge).
   - Integrate fluorescence energy spectrum for $300\text{ s}$ per site to quantify surface trace metal contaminants ($Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn$).

5. **Pass/Fail Disposition & Gate Oxide Lot Release:**
   - Aggregate metrology data via inline SECS/GEM interface.
   - If all criteria are met, release the wafer lot to the thermal oxidation bay for immediate loading into the vertical oxidation furnace for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $SiO_2$ gate oxide growth ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░                               │
   Gate Ox Target EOT┤░░                               │
                     │▒▒▒                              │
    Fe/Cu/Ni Impurity┤▒▒▒                              │
Part. Count (>0.18um)┤▓▓▓▓▓                            │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓                            │
  Water Contact Angle┤█████████████████████████████████│
                     │█████████████████████████████████│
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    18.8    37.5    56.2   75.0 
```

| Parameter ID | Metrology Parameter | Target / Limit Value | Unit | Instrument / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Water Contact Angle (WCA) | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ (Hydrophobic $Si\text{-}H$ surface) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Automated Optical Goniometer (5-point) |
| **AC-02** | Critical Surface Defect Count | $\le 10$ defects per wafer ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ PSL equivalent) | Counts/Wafer | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (LSIS) |
| **AC-03** | Transition Metal Contamination ($Fe, Cu, Ni$) | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | Grazing-Incidence TXRF |
| **AC-04** | Queue Time to Gate Oxidation | $\le 60$ | Minutes | Inline MES / Dispatch Timer |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Gate dielectric requirement: *Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($SiO_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.*
  - Minimum critical feature dimension: *Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (matching the particle sensitivity lower bound).*
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: *Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Leakage current target $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ directly mandates zero metallic-defect and particle-induced dielectric breakdown in the gate region.*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-clean metrology must act as an in-line gatekeeper prior to loading wafers into the 180nm dry oxidation furnace tube. Introducing contact angle goniometry directly onto production wafers risks droplet residue contamination (drying marks, organic aerosol pick-up, local carbon deposition) unless dedicated edge-exclusion zones or sacrificial monitor witness dice/wafers are utilized. Furthermore, metrology latency directly erodes the strict 30-minute queue-time (Q-time) window before native oxide regrows and environmental airborne molecular contamination (AMC) degrades the pristine hydrogen-terminated Si(100) surface.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: A freshly stripped HF-last silicon surface must exhibit strong hydrophobicity characterized by an initial static deionized water contact angle of >= 75 degrees, indicating complete removal of chemical oxide and robust Si-H passivation. Any contact angle falling below 70 degrees signals incomplete oxide strip, sub-monolayer chemical oxide pinning, or surfactant/organic redeposition from contaminated rinse baths. Surface darkfield laser scattering or high-resolution macro-optical scanning must confirm particle defect density < 0.1 defects/cm2 at >= 0.5 um resolution to prevent catastrophic pinhole defects and premature dielectric breakdown (TDDB) across the ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxide.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring production-grade automated wafer surface particle counters (e.g., KLA-Tencor Surfscan) and optical goniometers exceeds early open-source pilot budgets. The work package must rely on accessible garage/lab-scale instrumentation: a calibrated manual optical goniometer with a micro-syringe dispenser, paired with a darkfield metallurgical optical microscope (e.g., 10x Plan Achromat objective, NA 0.25) or high-intensity green grazing laser scatter setup. Ultra-pure HPLC/electronic grade water (resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) must be secured locally with certified shelf life to eliminate false contact angle measurements.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: To maintain high fabrication throughput without violating thermal furnace dispatch schedules, contact angle and optical particle screening must be executed and logged within a strict 10-minute window post-spin-rinse-dry (SRD). If the metrology protocol breaches this operational limit, the entire batch must be rejected or redirected to an HF dip rework loop, causing cascading schedule delays in furnace utilization and consumable budget overruns.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Water Droplet Evaporation Residue: Evaporating water droplets during goniometry leave behind non-volatile silica, ionic, or hydrocarbon ring stains (coffee-ring effect) that seed localized pinhole defects during subsequent 3.5 nm thermal oxidation.
1. AMC and Native Oxide Regrowth Inversion: Prolonged metrology inspection in ambient cleanroom air exceeding 30 minutes triggers native chemical oxide re-oxidation and airborne volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption, shifting the surface from hydrophobic (Si-H) to hydrophilic (Si-OH) and altering dry oxide growth kinetics.
1. Metallic Cross-Contamination during Manual Handling: Manual wafer transfer between the wet bench cassette and optical inspection stages introduces trace iron, copper, or sodium contamination via handling wands or stage chucks, inducing gate leakage current and threshold voltage shifts.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-01` | **Static Sessile Drop Contact Angle Verification for HF-Last Surface Passivation** | Calibrated manual/semi-automated optical goniometer with digital CMOS camera, micro-syringe dispenser (1-2 uL droplet capacity), and 18.2 MOhm-cm ultra-pure DI water source. | 1. Mount the cleaned silicon witness wafer onto the goniometer stage and level the sample plane horizontally. 2. Dispense a precise 1.5 uL droplet of ultra-pure deionized water onto the wafer surface using the micro-syringe. 3. Capture high-resolution digital profile images of the sessile droplet within 15 seconds of deposition to minimize evaporation. 4. Fit the droplet baseline and tangent profile using the Young-Laplace or circle-fitting algorithm to calculate the left and right static contact angles. 5. Repeat across 3 designated peripheral test locations and compute the mean contact angle. | `PASS: Mean static DI water contact angle >= 75.0 degrees across all measured points, confirming stoichiometric Si-H termination. FAIL: Mean contact angle < 70.0 degrees, indicating incomplete native oxide stripping or organic film contamination.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-02` | **Darkfield Surface Particle and Micro-Defect Density Inspection** | Metallurgical inspection microscope equipped with darkfield illumination, 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25), motorized X-Y scanning stage, digital camera, and automated particle counting/thresholding software. | 1. Position the test wafer onto the darkfield optical microscope stage under filtered yellow/amber light. 2. Set darkfield illumination intensity and calibrate pixel-to-micron scale against a certified stage micrometer standard. 3. Execute a serpentine scan covering a minimum 5-point sampling grid (center, north, south, east, west) with 1 cm2 inspection area per field. 4. Apply digital thresholding to identify scattering events corresponding to surface particulate defects >= 0.5 um in equivalent optical diameter. 5. Tally total detected particles across all inspected fields and normalize to defects per square centimeter (defects/cm2). | `PASS: Cumulative surface particle defect density <= 0.10 defects/cm2 for particles >= 0.5 um, with zero macroscopic liquid stains or drying marks detected. FAIL: Defect density > 0.10 defects/cm2 or presence of visible streaks/stains.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Powder-free cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown/coat and hair cover, Lint-free cleanroom shoe covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of water from eyewash station for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek medical attention if irritation persists. Skin contact: Wash affected area with soap and water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move individual to fresh air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology stage must be operated under an ISO 5 (Class 100) laminar flow HEPA clean bench with localized exhaust ducting for solvent wipe evaporation. Minimum face velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 fpm).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes must be disposed of in dedicated flame-retardant, self-closing hazardous solvent waste receptacles. Excess DI water droplets are evaporated or blotted with cleanroom wipes and disposed of as non-hazardous solid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water** | `7732-18-5` | Electronic / HPLC Grade (>= 18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Stage Wipe Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated Si(100) (monohydride/dihydride surface) exiting spin-rinse-dry post-HF dip; free of residual fluoride ions, surfactants, and chemical oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Screened hydrophobic Si(100) verified with contact angle >= 75 deg and defect density <= 0.1 defects/cm2, transferred under nitrogen purged carrier directly to dry gate oxidation furnace loader.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time causes uncontrolled room-temperature native oxide regrowth (0.2-0.5 nm SiO2) accompanied by airborne hydrocarbon condensation, distorting 3.5 nm Deal-Grove oxidation growth kinetics and causing severe gate oxide thickness non-uniformity (> 5%) and elevated interface trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Metrological signoff validating complete native oxide removal, robust hydrogen surface termination (contact angle >= 75 deg), and pristine surface particle defect levels (<= 0.1 defects/cm2) on post-RCA/HF-dip Si(100) wafers within the 30-minute air Q-time window, authorizing dry gate oxidation furnace loading.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `METROLOGY_CONTACT_ANGLE_RUN_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `SURFACE_PARTICLE_DARKFIELD_MAP.tiff`
- [ ] `WP_PRE_OX_SURFACE_SIGNOFF_CERTIFICATE.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Static deionized water sessile contact angle indicating complete Si-H passivation** | `78.0 degrees` | +/- 3.0 degrees (Minimum acceptable threshold: 75.0 degrees) | Multi-point sessile droplet digital optical goniometry with circle/Young-Laplace tangent fitting |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface optical defect and particle density for features >= 0.5 um** | `0.05 defects/cm2` | <= 0.10 defects/cm2 maximum limit | 5-point darkfield optical metallurgical microscopy inspection across 5 cm2 total sampled area |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Total metrology inspection elapsed duration post-SRD exit** | `8.0 minutes` | +/- 2.0 minutes (Strict hard ceiling: <= 12.0 minutes to safeguard 30-minute furnace Q-time) | Digital execution timestamp logging cross-referenced from wet bench SRD completion to furnace load lock |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit approval requires verified contact angle >= 75 deg across all witness points, defect density <= 0.10 defects/cm2 without drying stain artifacts, and complete transfer into N2 purge box within 12 minutes of SRD completion, with automated hash-signed CSV and TIFF reports attached to the lot traveler.

3. Capture high-resolution digital profile images of the sessile droplet within 15 seconds of deposition to minimize evaporation.
4. Fit the droplet baseline and tangent profile using the Young-Laplace or circle-fitting algorithm to calculate the left and right static contact angles.
5. Repeat across 3 designated peripheral test locations and compute the mean contact angle.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: PASS: Mean static DI water contact angle >= 75.0 degrees across all measured points, confirming stoichiometric Si-H termination. FAIL: Mean contact angle < 70.0 degrees, indicating incomplete native oxide stripping or organic film contamination.

testcases.instrumentation: Metallurgical inspection microscope equipped with darkfield illumination, 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25), motorized X-Y scanning stage, digital camera, and automated particle counting/thresholding software.
testcases.pre_conditions: Ambient cleanroom environment verified at Class 100 (ISO 5) or better; inspection stage wiped clean with cleanroom polyester wipes and semiconductor-grade IPA; wafer loaded using vacuum wand on backside only.
testcases.procedure:
1. Position the test wafer onto the darkfield optical microscope stage under filtered yellow/amber light.
2. Set darkfield illumination intensity and calibrate pixel-to-micron scale against a certified stage micrometer standard.
3. Execute a serpentine scan covering a minimum 5-point sampling grid (center, north, south, east, west) with 1 cm2 inspection area per field.
4. Apply digital thresholding to identify scattering events corresponding to surface particulate defects >= 0.5 um in equivalent optical diameter.
5. Tally total detected particles across all inspected fields and normalize to defects per square centimeter (defects/cm2).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification  
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Prep > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Automated Contact Angle Goniometer System)

---

## 1. Process Flowchart

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Sample Loading:     │
│    HF-Dipped Wafer     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated Sessile DI  │
│    Water Dispensing    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Optical Profiling &   │
│    Tangent Fitting     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     Contact Angle      │
│    Acceptance Check    │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
             │ Pass: θ ≥ 70°                                     │ Fail: θ < 70° (Oxide regrown/wetting)
             ▼                                                   ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                          ┌────────────────────────┐
│  Release to 850°C-900°C│                          │  Quarantine & Rework:  │
│   Dry Gate Oxidation   │                          │     Re-dip BOE 6:1     │
└────────────────────────┘                          └────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Protective Pre-Checks:**
   - Verify that personal protective equipment (PPE) is donned and Calcium Gluconate gel is present at the wet prep / transfer station prior to handling any HF-treated or BOE 6:1 residual surfaces (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
2. **Wafer Transfer & Queuing:**
   - Immediately following the pre-oxidation wet clean and in-situ HF / BOE 6:1 oxide etch dip (etch rate ~100 nm/min or 1000 Å/min at 25°C), load the dry, hydrogen-passivated silicon test/monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck within ≤ 15 minutes to minimize atmospheric native oxide re-growth.
3. **Droplet Dispensing (Sessile Drop Method):**
   - Position the motorized micro-syringe containing ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (resistivity ≥ 18.2 MΩ·cm) 2.0 mm above the wafer target die location.
   - Dispense a precision sessile droplet of $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ at ambient cleanroom conditions ($25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$).
4. **Image Acquisition & Baseline Fitting:**
   - Capture high-resolution droplet silhouette imaging within 3 to 5 seconds of surface contact using the telecentric lens camera.
   - Execute baseline detection and Young-Laplace / circle-tangent fitting algorithm to calculate the left and right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$).
5. **Multi-Site Mapping & Lot Release:**
   - Execute a 5-point measurement across the wafer diameter (Center, North, South, East, West at 10 mm edge exclusion).
   - If mean contact angle meets acceptance criteria ($\theta \ge 70^\circ$), release the batch directly to the dry oxidation furnace for 3.5 nm physical gate oxide growth at 850°C–900°C.
   - If contact angle fails ($\theta < 70^\circ$), quarantine the lot for re-cleaning and surface re-etching in BOE 6:1.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Action on Failure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Water Contact Angle ($\theta$)** | $\ge 70.0$ | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Min: $70.0^\circ$ (Hydrophobic, H-terminated Si) | Quarantine lot; re-dip in BOE 6:1 |
| **Metrology Dispense Temperature** | $25$ | Celsius ($^\circ\text{C}$) | $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ | Suspend measurement until thermal equilibrium |
| **Pre-Oxidation Etch Rate Verification** | $100$ ($1000$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) | $\pm 10\text{ nm/min}$ (BOE 6:1 at $25^\circ\text{C}$) | Re-qualify BOE 6:1 bath composition |
| **Post-Passivation Target Gate Oxide** | $3.5$ | Nanometers ($\text{nm}$) | Physical thickness target for subsequent dry oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$) | Adjust oxidation thermal budget |

```text
Key Physical Metrics Baseline (Normalised Values / Scale)
                            ┌──────────────────────────┐
                            │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
BOE 6:1 SiO2 Etch Rate (25C)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
 Gate Oxide Thickness Target┤▒▒                        │
                            │▒▒                        │
        Target Contact Angle┤███████████████████       │
                            │███████████████████       │
                            └┬─────┬──────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                             0    25     50    75   100 
```

---

## 4. Source Context Citations

- **Etchant Composition, Thermal Rate & Safety:** *Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — BOE 6:1 (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ and 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$), etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 25°C is ~100 nm/min (1000 Å/min); Calcium Gluconate gel mandate.
- **Downstream Thermal Gate Dielectric:** *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* — Pre-oxidation passivated surface targets thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness.
- **Access Transistor Dimension & Layout Integration:** *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — Gate oxide integration controls the 180nm node access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Contact angle metrology provides indirect surface energy quantification but acts as a potential contamination vector. Introducing sessile UPW droplets directly onto bare Si-H terminated active gate areas prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation risks localized organic recontamination, capillary droplet residue stains, and airborne VOC adsorption during transfer. The metrology step must be strictly segregated to dedicated wafer edge exclusion zones (test coupon areas) or monitor companion wafers, and must not violate downstream furnace load lock robotics queue times.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: A freshly stripped HF-last (1% to 2% HF or BOE 6:1 dip) silicon (100) surface exhibits mono-, di-, and tri-hydride passivation terminating dangling silicon bonds, yielding a sessile water contact angle (WCA) typically between 75° and 86°. Any value below 70° indicates incomplete chemical oxide removal or rapid re-oxidation/polar contaminant uptake. Measurement must occur in a filtered dry N2 purge micro-environment within 10 minutes of blow-dry; baseline drift occurs rapidly due to airborne hydrocarbons elevating perceived hydrophobicity while native SiO2 growth depresses it.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated optical goniometers with motorized micro-dispensing syringes and controlled environmental chambers are standard metrology assets (e.g., ramé-hart, Krüss, or Dataphysics). Needle tips must use fluoropolymer/PTFE-coated or quartz capillary materials to avoid metallic cation leaching (Fe, Cu, Ni) into the 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW dispense loop, which would degrade the subsequent gate oxide breakdown field (Ebd). Calibrated calibration balls and certified surface energy standard tiles must be procured for daily qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: WCA measurement introduces a manual or semi-automated inline queue bottleneck between wet chemical cleaning and the dry thermal oxidation furnace. Because the maximum allowable air exposure queue time before gate oxide growth is 30 minutes, dedicating 10 minutes to multi-point goniometry on product wafers introduces a yield-killing Q-time excursion risk. Monitor wafers running in parallel must be used to authorize gate oxidation furnace lot dispatch.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. In-situ evaporation droplet stain residue: UPW sessile drops leaving nanoscale silica/organic watermark halos on active areas leading to gate oxide thinning and catastrophic gate-to-channel punchthrough.
1. Hydrocarbon false-passivation artifact: Ambient cleanroom airborne organic contamination adsorbing onto Si-H bonds within minutes, mimicking high contact angles despite defective sub-oxide interfaces.
1. Q-time excursion leading to uncontrollable native oxide regrowth: Exceeding the 30-minute air exposure limit, causing non-uniform 3-6 Å native SiO2 growth that skews the target 3.5 nm thermal gate oxide thickness and shifts threshold voltage (Vth).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-01` | **Post-HF-Last Si-H Surface Hydrophobicity 5-Point Static WCA Mapping** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with motorized XYZ stage, high-resolution telecentric CMOS camera, Hamilton 50 uL gas-tight micro-syringe with PTFE needle, and class 1 cleanroom N2 environmental enclosure | 1. Load monitor wafer onto goniometer vacuum chuck purged with continuous 99.999% N2 laminar curtain. 2. Dispense a 2.0 uL (+/- 0.1 uL) droplet of 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW at 21.0 deg C at 5 standard wafer sites (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right with 10 mm edge exclusion). 3. Capture droplet profile image within 2 seconds of surface contact using high-speed camera. 4. Calculate baseline-tangent Young-Laplace fitted contact angle for both left and right flanks across all 5 points. 5. Average the 5 measurement locations and calculate within-wafer non-uniformity. | `Mean Static Contact Angle >= 75.0 degrees across all 5 sites; Within-Wafer Angle Standard Deviation <= 2.5 degrees; No individual measurement site < 72.0 degrees.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-02` | **Cleanroom Air Ambient Hydrophobic Passivation Degradation Kinetics Test** | Automated Optical Goniometer, class 10 mini-environment with calibrated humidity/temperature sensors (21 deg C +/- 0.5 deg C, 40% +/- 2% RH), automated automated image acquisition sequence | 1. Dispense 2.0 uL UPW droplet at t = 2 min, t = 10 min, t = 20 min, and t = 30 min on separate pristine coupon tracks. 2. Record dynamic sessile contact angle profile using Young-Laplace fitting. 3. Monitor contact angle decay and droplet spreading kinetics as a function of ambient Q-time exposure to assess passive native oxide formation. | `Contact angle at t = 30 min must maintain >= 68.0 degrees; Total delta-WCA (WCA_t2 - WCA_t30) <= 8.0 degrees, verifying acceptable passivation retention within the furnace loading queue window.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavyweight butyl/neoprene chemical protective gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Full chemical splash face shield combined with ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles, Acid-resistant PTFE/polyethylene apron and chemical sleeves, Closed-toe cleanroom ESD safety boots with chemical over-covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Calcium gluconate gel (2.5% USP) must be present in immediate reaching distance of the wet bench and goniometer staging station. In case of skin exposure: immediately flush with copious cold water for 2 minutes, apply calcium gluconate gel liberally, massage into affected area using a gloved hand, reapply every 15 minutes, and seek immediate emergency medical evaluation. In case of ocular exposure: flush at dedicated eyewash for >= 15 minutes with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye solution or saline, then transport to hospital.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical etch prep must occur inside a continuous exhaust chemical wet bench maintaining a face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) with dedicated polypropylene scrubbed exhaust ducting. Goniometer station must be installed inside a laminar flow hood with active chemical filtration to prevent acid fume cross-migration and operator exposure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: All HF/BOE rinse solutions and droplet drain waste must be segregated into designated fluoride acid waste (FAW) drains. Neutralize offline using automated dual-stage calcium chloride / hydrated lime (Ca(OH)2) precipitation systems to form insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2), filtering sludge before neutralizing supernatant with NaOH/H2SO4 to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (pre-clean dip & residue trace)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI/ULSI) | `0.5% - 49.0% w/w` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (BOE constituent)** | `12125-01-8` | SEMI Grade 4 | `40.0% w/w in BOE 6:1` |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water (dispense liquid)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM D5127 Type E-1 (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0% v/v` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated Si(100) surface (Si-H, Si-H2) free of metallic impurities (<1e10 atoms/cm2) and organic residue post-RCA/HF clean.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Verified fully passivated hydrophobic silicon surface entering horizontal/vertical diffusion furnace quartz boat for 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time triggers uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (1-3 monolayers of low-density sub-stoichiometric SiOx), causing uncontrollable initial gate oxide thickness, degraded interface trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2), and high gate dielectric leakage current.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Metrology verification confirming robust hydrogen passivation and complete chemical oxide strip on cleanroom wafers, ensuring pristine Si-H interfaces ready for high-reliability 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_5PT_MAP_LOT_LOG.csv`
- [ ] `GONIOMETER_YOUNG_LAPLACE_DROPLET_PROFILES.tiff`
- [ ] `HF_LAST_SURFACE_PASSIVATION_SIGNOFF_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Average 5-point water contact angle across wafer surface confirms full Si-H hydrophobic termination** | `78.5 degrees` | +/- 3.5 degrees (Lower limit: >= 75.0 degrees) | Automated baseline Young-Laplace optical contact angle analysis on 2.0 uL UPW droplets at 21 deg C |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-wafer contact angle non-uniformity across 150mm substrate diameter** | `1.8 degrees` | <= 2.5 degrees (1-sigma) | Statistical calculation of radial 5-point goniometer inspection sites (Center and 4 orthogonal radii) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Pre-oxidation queue time elapsed from spin-dry to furnace load lock insertion** | `12 minutes` | <= 30 minutes in cleanroom air ambient (or <= 4.0 hours inside sealed N2 purged FOUP) | MES timestamp integration tracking wafer transfer from wet bench spin-dryer to furnace push cycle |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five-point WCA map on the companion monitor wafer yields a mean contact angle >= 75.0 degrees with standard deviation <= 2.5 degrees, completed within 15 minutes of HF-last drying, with zero visible water mark stains under high-intensity collimated inspection light, authorizing immediate dispatch to the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide furnace tube.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Goniometer Optical Alignment & DI Water Sessile Drop Dosing Calibration

**Process Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean & In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification > **Goniometer Optical Alignment & DI Water Sessile Drop Dosing Calibration**  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage Leveling &    │
│        Baseline        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Optical Axis & Focus  │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Microsyringe Dosing   │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Baseline Drop      │
│     Contact Angle      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Vibration Isolation & Macro Stage Mechanical Leveling**
   - Mount the goniometer assembly onto a vibration-damped optical breadboard.
   - Place a precision spirit bubble level on the sample stage. Adjust the three-point kinematic leveling thumbscrews until the stage pitch and roll tilt are within $\pm 0.1^\circ$.

2. **Optical Rail & Telecentric Illumination Alignment**
   - Align the diffuse LED monochromatic backlight (365 nm / green-pass filtered or white collimated backlight) along the primary optical rail.
   - Adjust the camera and microscope objective (Plan Achromat, $10\times$, NA 0.25) so that the optical axis runs precisely parallel to the sample stage surface baseline.
   - Verify that the stage edge projects as a crisp, razor-thin horizontal baseline across the CMOS sensor without vignetting or parallax tilt.

3. **Optical Scale & Magnification Spatial Calibration**
   - Place a certified optical calibration reticle / micro-scale on the stage along the focal plane.
   - Focus the optics using the fine Z/X stage micrometers. Calibrate the image analysis software pixel-to-micrometer scale ratio ($\mu\text{m}/\text{pixel}$) to conform to the Gen 2 positional alignment tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

4. **PTFE Dispenser Needle Alignment & DI Water Purge**
   - Install a 30-gauge blunt-end PTFE-coated stainless steel dispensing needle onto the motorized micro-syringe dispenser.
   - Align the needle tip perpendicularly directly above the stage center of field-of-view (FOV) along the Y-axis.
   - Purge the micro-syringe with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water for 5 dispense cycles to eliminate trapped air bubbles and micro-particulates.

5. **Sessile Drop Dosing Calibration & Baseline Validation**
   - Program the motorized stepper drive to dispense a calibrated droplet volume ($2.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$).
   - Lower the needle toward a clean test substrate until the droplet touches the surface, then withdraw the needle to complete sessile drop detachment without mechanical droplet agitation.
   - Fit the droplet shadowgraph profile using the Young-Laplace / circle-fitting algorithm to ensure baseline optical symmetry (left-right contact angle differential $\le 1^\circ$).

---

### Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Context Source & Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Optical Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Microscope Objective Resolution Setup** | $10\times$ (NA 0.25) | Magnification / NA | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Sessile Droplet Target Volume** | $2.0 \pm 0.2$ | $\mu\text{L}$ | Dispenser volumetric accuracy |
| **Left/Right Contact Angle Asymmetry** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{deg}\ (^\circ)$ | Optical baseline parallelism & telecentric alignment |

---

### Context Citations

- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**: Provides the optical microscope objective baseline ($10\times$ Plan Achromat, NA 0.25), rigorous deionized (DI) water clean/rinse protocols, and the Gen 2 micrometer-scale alignment tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$, improved from Gen 1 macro-scale $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**: Establishes high-precision thin-film optical metrology standards, non-destructive surface parameter tracking, and interface reflection modeling.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical baseline tilt and stage tilt cross-coupling represent the primary systematic error in contact angle metrology. A horizontal baseline misorientation of even 0.5 degrees introduces asymmetric droplet profile fitting (Young-Laplace / circle fit bias > 2.5 degrees). Rigid kinematic coupling of the goniometer stage, automated sub-pixel telecentric tilt leveling, and closed-loop micro-dispenser syringe motor calibration are required to ensure repeatable sessile drop volume delivery down to 1.0 uL without kinetic droplet bouncing or kinetic impact spreading.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm gate dielectric pre-oxidation inspection, contact angle metrology monitors hydrogen termination (Si-H) after HF-last cleaning. Pure sessile drop contact angle on clean Si(100)-H should typically reach 70 to 86 degrees depending on mono/di-hydride distribution. Inaccurate drop volume dosing (e.g. > 2.0 uL vs nominal 1.0 uL) causes gravitational sag to dominate over capillary forces, distorting the Young-Laplace contour. Furthermore, ambient hydrocarbon VOCs rapidly degrade Si-H passivation within minutes; alignment and calibration must be verified using cleanroom-stable certified calibration targets (such as quartz shadow masks or sapphire optical balls) prior to wafer testing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying off-the-shelf automated optical contact angle goniometers (e.g., Dataphysics OCA series, Kruss DSA100, or Kyowa DM series) is cost-effective under a 'Buy' strategy. However, sourcing automated micro-syringe glass assemblies (e.g. Hamilton Gastight 50 uL with PTFE/hydrophobic-coated 27G blunt needles) and optical grid reticle calibration standards faces lead times up to 8-12 weeks in Southeast Asia. Precision certified calibration balls (sapphire/PTFE) must be pre-ordered with traceable DAkkS/NIST certificates.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The goniometer optical alignment and dosing calibration must be locked down as a strict prerequisite milestone before processing production-grade 180nm thermal oxide test wafers. Calibration must execute in under 15 minutes at shift start to minimize downtime. Clear automated logging of dosing repeatability and baseline parallelism directly prevents operator-dependent variance across engineering shifts.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sub-pixel baseline tilt error causing artificial left-right contact angle asymmetry exceeding 3 degrees.
1. Dispensing tip meniscus pinning or droplet free-fall kinetic impact distorting the equilibrium advancing/receding boundary into kinetic spread.
1. DI water delivery syringe micro-bubble entrapment causing volumetric dosing instability (> 10% volume jitter) and premature drop detachment.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-1-01` | **Goniometer Telecentric Optical Plane Leveling and Reticle Magnification Calibration** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with telecentric lens, monochrome CMOS camera (>= 2048x1536 resolution), precision NIST-traceable grid reticle target (0.05 mm line pitch, +/- 0.5 um accuracy), and dual-axis digital clinometer (+/- 0.01 deg). | 1. Mount NIST-traceable calibrated optical reticle onto the wafer stage vacuum chuck. 2. Adjust stage tilt micrometers until digital clinometer reads 0.00 deg +/- 0.02 deg in both pitch and roll axes. 3. Focus camera optics onto reticle fiducial scale; capture high-resolution frame. 4. Run automated edge-detection image processing algorithm to measure scale pitch across full horizontal field of view (FOV) and compute pixel-to-micrometer calibration factor. 5. Measure baseline tilt angle across the 100mm horizontal traverse of the stage. | `Pixel scaling calibration factor verified at nominal magnification with error < 0.2%. Baseline tilt across field of view <= 0.05 degrees. Left-to-right optical distortion across central 80% FOV <= 0.1%.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-1-02` | **Automated DI Water Micro-Sessile Drop Dosing Precision and Volume Repeatability** | Motorized precision micro-syringe dosing module with 50 uL Gastight syringe, 27G hydrophobic PTFE-sleeved needle, Sartorius ultra-microbalance (0.001 mg resolution) for gravimetric verification, and telecentric droplet analysis software. | 1. Program automated dosing controller for nominal drop volume of 1.00 uL at a controlled dispense rate of 0.20 uL/s. 2. Dispense 10 successive droplets onto a certified hydrophobic PTFE reference standard, allowing droplet to contact the substrate via controlled Z-stage lift-off (zero free-fall height). 3. Measure droplet volume via optical spherical/Young-Laplace contour integration for each run. 4. Simultaneously perform 10 discrete gravimetric dispense cycles into a sealed micro-balance weighing vessel to correlate optical volume with gravimetric mass (density 0.9978 g/cm^3). | `Mean dispensed droplet volume must equal 1.00 uL +/- 0.05 uL (1.00 mg +/- 0.05 mg). Volumetric dosing relative standard deviation (RSD) over 10 consecutive dispenses <= 2.0%. Droplet detachment must be smooth without liquid neck snapping or satellite drop formation.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Full cleanroom bunny suit with ESD-safe footwear, Particle-filtering cleanroom face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For UPW: No chemical hazard. For IPA needle/optics cleaning solvent: In case of eye contact, flush eyes with copious clean eye-wash water for >= 15 minutes. In case of skin exposure, wash thoroughly with soap and clean water. If vapors inhaled, relocate to fresh cleanroom air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating HEPA/ULPA laminar airflow workstation (0.45 m/s face velocity). Secondary localized solvent exhaust required only during IPA-based syringe and needle maintenance.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent DI water drains to cleanroom industrial waste water neutralization facility. IPA-soaked cleanroom lint-free wipes must be collected in closed dedicated flammables waste bins with grounded flame arrestors.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C35 / Type E-1) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, optical lens and needle cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Grade 4) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `15 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched, hydrophobic Si(100) surface terminated with covalent Si-H bonds from 0.5% in-situ HF-last dip; native oxide completely stripped.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-metrology wafer surface with localized DI water droplet residuals; inspected spot must be quarantined or designated for sacrificial scribe-line area, or wafer must undergo quick spin-rinse-dry (SRD) prior to dry oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in cleanroom air leads to airborne airborne volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption and spurious native chemical re-oxidation (forming sub-stoichiometric SiOx), degrading contact angle accuracy (> 15 deg shift) and seeding interface traps (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2) during subsequent 3.5 nm gate oxide growth.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete commissioning, optical alignment, and volumetric dosing calibration of the automated contact angle goniometer. System delivers certified baseline parallelism, high-precision Young-Laplace edge contour detection, and reproducible 1.0 uL UPW drop dosing ensuring accurate verification of post-clean HF-last silicon surface hydrophobicity prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `goniometer_optical_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `di_water_dosing_repeatability_data.csv`
- [ ] `telecentric_reticle_distortion_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical baseline tilt relative to horizontal stage plane across full imaging FOV** | `0.00` | <= 0.05 degrees | Automated edge-detection image analysis of NIST-calibrated reticle grid on leveled stage |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Mean sessile drop dispensed volume of degassed UPW** | `1.00 uL` | +/- 0.05 uL | Gravimetric ultra-microbalance weighing correlated with optical contour volume integration across 10 dispenses |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Left-versus-right contact angle asymmetry on certified isotropic hydrophobic PTFE standard** | `0.00 degrees` | <= 1.00 degrees | Young-Laplace profile fitting on 10 consecutive sessile drops on certified standard |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires passing all three quantitative assertions (ASSERT-01 to ASSERT-03), generating the signed calibration report PDF, archiving raw calibration CSV data into the DRAM metrology database, and verifying zero bubble presence in the 50 uL Hamilton syringe.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Multi-Site Sessile Drop Dispense & Contact Angle Transient Profile Capture

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation [Wet Chemistry] > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology [Metrology] > Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification [Metrology] > Multi-Site Sessile Drop Dispense & Contact Angle Transient Profile Capture [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Oxide Thickness Tox: 3.5 nm (Gate) / 350 nm (Field).
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / C-V Profiler.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automating multi-site sessile drop dispense across a 150mm/200mm wafer post-HF dip requires sub-millimeter stage positioning and sub-microliter droplet repeatability (<0.05 uL) without droplet-induced cross-contamination. Kinetic evaporation during the transient profile capture will artificially inflate the apparent dynamic receding contact angle if optical fitting takes longer than 5 seconds per site.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Hydrogen-terminated Si(100) surfaces generated by 0.5-1% DHF etch must exhibit static water contact angles theta_c > 75 degrees, ideally 80-84 degrees. A transient profile dropping below 72 degrees within 60 seconds indicates either incomplete native oxide stripping (residual sub-oxide islands), premature airborne organic siloxane/hydrocarbon adsorption, or water droplet contamination.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated goniometer dispense modules require certified HPLC/semiconductor-grade ultra-pure water (UPW) with resistivity > 18.2 MOhm*cm and Total Organic Carbon (TOC) < 2 ppb. Sourcing PTFE dispense needles and non-reactive sapphire/PEEK syringe tips locally in Vietnam requires dual-sourcing contracts to prevent single-supplier downtime during pilot production.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The multi-site goniometer run must be executed within the strict 30-minute cleanroom queue time between RCA-clean/HF-last rinse-dry and gate oxidation furnace tube loading. An over-extended 9-point or 13-point transient mapping protocol exceeding 12 minutes per pilot wafer risks catastrophic air exposure and native oxide regrowth before gate oxidation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. In-situ airborne hydrocarbon/organic condensation on Si-H terminated surface during dispensing, yielding false-positive hydrophobicity shifts or erratic pin-down hysteresis.
1. Evaporative volume reduction and contact line pinning causing spurious contact angle decay rates exceeding 0.15 deg/s during transient baseline tracking.
1. Dispense needle micro-droplet satellite splashing or kinetic impact distortion altering droplet equilibrium geometry and baseline droplet diameter.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-01` | **5-Site Static Equilibrium Water Contact Angle Passivation Verification** | Automated Optical Goniometer with motorized XYZ stage, high-speed CMOS camera (>= 60 fps), telecentric lens, automated micro-dispenser with 30-gauge PTFE-coated needle, and UPW delivery system (< 2 ppb TOC, 18.2 MOhm*cm). | 1. Load wafer onto goniometer vacuum chuck with notch/flat oriented south. 2. Automatically translate stage to 5 standard radial sites: Center (0,0), Top (0, +R/2), Bottom (0, -R/2), Left (-R/2, 0), Right (+R/2, 0). 3. Dispense a sessile droplet of 2.0 uL UPW at a controlled dispense rate of 0.5 uL/s. 4. Retract needle vertically at 1.0 mm/s to detach droplet cleanly. 5. Capture side-profile image at t = 2.0 s post-detachment using Young-Laplace baseline fitting algorithm. 6. Record left, right, and mean contact angles for all 5 sites. | `Static contact angle theta_mean >= 78.0 degrees across all 5 sites; 5-site within-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma) <= 2.5 degrees; zero sites exhibiting theta_mean < 74.0 degrees.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-02` | **Transient Contact Angle Stability and Evaporation-Decay Rate Capture** | Optical Goniometer equipped with continuous video logging (10 fps over 60 s), high-resolution edge detection with sub-pixel Young-Laplace fitting, environmentally shielded enclosure. | 1. Position dispensing tip 1.0 mm above wafer center. 2. Dispense 3.0 uL UPW droplet and initiate continuous frame capture at 10 fps for 60.0 seconds. 3. Extract contact angle theta(t), droplet base diameter D(t), and drop volume V(t) as functions of time t from 0 to 60 seconds. 4. Calculate contact angle decay rate d(theta)/dt over the initial linear window (t = 5 s to t = 35 s). 5. Verify pinning behavior by evaluating base diameter delta_D = D(35s) - D(5s). | `Initial contact angle theta(t=2s) >= 80.0 degrees; decay rate |d(theta)/dt| <= 0.08 deg/s between t = 5 s and t = 35 s; base diameter variation delta_D <= 0.05 mm (no premature dewetting or contact line slip).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom anti-static ESD-safe polypropylene gowning and hood, PTFE chemical apron and face shield during UPW reservoir replenishment
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye exposure to IPA: Flush with clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact with IPA: Wash thoroughly with UPW and soap. Inhalation of organic solvent vapors: Move victim to fresh air immediately. For UPW slips/spills: Clean area to eliminate slip hazards.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Goniometer measurement station must be housed within a laminar flow hood (Class 10 / ISO Class 4) providing filtered downflow velocity of 0.45 m/s +/- 20%, integrated with local solvent exhaust snorkel (minimum 50 CFM) for IPA needle cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent sessile water droplets and UPW purge rinse routed to standard cleanroom industrial waste drain. Contaminated IPA solvent wipes and needle flushes collected in sealed, grounded stainless steel flammable waste carboys for specialized hazardous chemical incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (ASTM D5127 Type E-1.2) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, for needle/optics cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Nitrogen (carrier/purge gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP 99.9999%) | `100%` |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched, 100% Si-H mono/di-hydride passivated hydrophobic silicon (100) surface following RCA-2 / 0.5% DHF clean and Marangoni/spin-rinse dry, free of native oxide and watermarks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized hydrophobic Si-H surface verified for gate dielectric growth, with sessile droplet test sites designated as sacrificial edge zones or wafers routed directly to pre-diffusion tube load lock.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes in cleanroom air results in spontaneous native oxide regrowth (Si-O-Si bridging) and organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption, reducing contact angle below 65 degrees and degrading gate oxide breakdown field (E_bd < 10 MV/cm).

**Exit Objective Summary**:

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_5Site_Spatial_Profile_LotA1.csv`
- [ ] `Transient_Decay_Kinetics_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Raw_Droplet_Shadowgraph_Captures.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Center site initial water contact angle on post-HF Si(100) surface** | `81.5 deg` | +/- 3.5 deg | Automated Young-Laplace optical edge-contour fitting at t = 2.0 s post-dispense |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-wafer 5-site contact angle standard deviation (1-sigma)** | `1.8 deg` | <= 2.5 deg | Radial 5-point mathematical dispersion calculation across Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right sites |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Droplet transient contact angle decay rate over 30-second measurement window** | `0.045 deg/s` | <= 0.080 deg/s | Linear regression analysis of continuous 10 fps WCA tracking from t = 5 s to t = 35 s |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 radial sites exhibit initial contact angles >= 78.0 degrees with 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 2.5 degrees, transient decay rate <= 0.08 deg/s, automated report generated within 12 minutes of wafer dry, and total queue time to gate furnace load under 30 minutes.

critics.systems_engineer: Automating multi-site sessile drop dispense across a 150mm/200mm wafer post-HF dip requires sub-millimeter stage positioning and sub-microliter droplet repeatability (<0.05 uL) without droplet-induced cross-contamination. Kinetic evaporation during the transient profile capture will artificially inflate the apparent dynamic receding contact angle if optical fitting takes longer than 5 seconds per site.
critics.domain_expert: Hydrogen-terminated Si(100) surfaces generated by 0.5-1% DHF etch must exhibit static water contact angles theta_c > 75 degrees, ideally 80-84 degrees.
