Dispense needle micro-droplet satellite splashing or kinetic impact distortion altering droplet equilibrium geometry and baseline droplet diameter.

testcases.title: 5-Site Static Equilibrium Water Contact Angle Passivation Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Optical Goniometer with motorized XYZ stage, high-speed CMOS camera (>= 60 fps), telecentric lens, automated micro-dispenser with 30-gauge PTFE-coated needle, and UPW delivery system (< 2 ppb TOC, 18.2 MOhm*cm).
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm p-type Si(100) test wafer subjected to standard RCA-1, RCA-2, and 0.5% HF-last dip with N2 spin-rinse dry; elapsed time since dry < 10 minutes in Class 100 cleanroom; ambient RH 45 +/- 3%, temperature 22.0 +/- 0.5 deg C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer onto goniometer vacuum chuck with notch/flat oriented south.
2. Automatically translate stage to 5 standard radial sites: Center (0,0), Top (0, +R/2), Bottom (0, -R/2), Left (-R/2, 0), Right (+R/2, 0).
3. Dispense a sessile droplet of 2.0 uL UPW at a controlled dispense rate of 0.5 uL/s.
4. Retract needle vertically at 1.0 mm/s to detach droplet cleanly.
5. Capture side-profile image at t = 2.0 s post-detachment using Young-Laplace baseline fitting algorithm.
6. Record left, right, and mean contact angles for all 5 sites.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Static contact angle theta_mean >= 78.0 degrees across all 5 sites; 5-site within-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma) <= 2.5 degrees; zero sites exhibiting theta_mean < 74.0 degrees.

testcases.title: Transient Contact Angle Stability and Evaporation-Decay Rate Capture
testcases.instrumentation: Optical Goniometer equipped with continuous video logging (10 fps over 60 s), high-resolution edge detection with sub-pixel Young-Laplace fitting, environmentally shielded enclosure.
testcases.pre_conditions: Center site of freshly prepared HF-last wafer; goniometer chamber sealed with laminar N2 purge off to avoid forced convection; ambient temperature stable at 22.0 +/- 0.2 deg C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Position dispensing tip 1.0 mm above wafer center.
2. Dispense 3.0 uL UPW droplet and initiate continuous frame capture at 10 fps for 60.0 seconds.
3. Extract contact angle theta(t), droplet base diameter D(t), and drop volume V(t) as functions of time t from 0 to 60 seconds.
4. Calculate contact angle decay rate d(theta)/dt over the initial linear window (t = 5 s to t = 35 s).
5. Verify pinning behavior by evaluating base diameter delta_D = D(35s) - D(5s).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Initial contact angle theta(t=2s) >= 80.0 degrees; decay rate |d(theta)/dt| <= 0.08 deg/s between t = 5 s and t = 35 s; base diameter variation delta_D <= 0.05 mm (no premature dewetting or contact line slip).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Goniometer Micro-Syringe Calibration & Multi-Site Stage Mapping Setup

- **Process Node / Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2: $\mu\text{m}$)
- **Process Step**: Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation Metrology — Goniometer Water Contact Angle (WCA) & HF-Last Hydrophobic Passivation Verification prior to 3.5 nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth.
- **Action Type**: Buy / Commercial Instrument Setup

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│    Micro-Syringe    │
│     Calibration     │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Optical Baseline   │
│      Alignment      │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Multi-Site Stage   │
│       Mapping       │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Transient Sessile  │
│    Drop Capture     │
│                     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Micro-Syringe Inspection and DI Water Priming**:
   - Inspect the precision gastight micro-syringe and blunt PTFE/stainless steel dispensing needle (gage 30–32) for bubble entrapment or particulate contamination.
   - Purge and prime with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (following pre-clean HF-last rinse standards) to establish a stable meniscus with zero air pockets.
2. **Dispense Volume & Optical Pixel Calibration**:
   - Place a certified optical calibration sphere or reference wire in the optical axis. Adjust illumination and the telecentric/macro lens focus until edge contrast is maximized.
   - Perform needle outer diameter (OD) optical edge calibration to correlate pixel coordinates ($\mu\text{m/pixel}$).
   - Set the automated micro-stepper motor displacement to dispense calibrated sessile droplets (1.0 to 2.0 $\mu\text{L}$). Verify dispensed drop volume repeatability across 5 consecutive trial dispenses.
3. **Multi-Site Substrate Stage Mapping**:
   - Mount the post-HF dip silicon wafer onto the vacuum stage.
   - Program a multi-site coordinate map (Center, North, South, East, West, and peripheral die locations) to evaluate surface hydrophobicity uniformity across the wafer prior to loading into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation tube.
   - Align stage coordinates to Gen 2 precision standards, ensuring automated X-Y stage motion maintains focus across all pre-mapped test sites.
4. **Baseline Planarity and Needle Clearance Z-Indexing**:
   - Execute automated Z-axis homing to position the dispensing tip at a fixed clearance above the wafer plane.
   - Verify stage tilt and baseline horizon alignment across all mapped coordinates to avoid contact angle baseline distortion.
5. **Multi-Site Transient Sessile Drop Capture**:
   - Command the automated stage to step through each mapped target location.
   - Dispense sessile droplet, execute gentle touch-off onto the hydrophobic Si-H surface, and trigger high-speed camera acquisition to capture the dynamic contact angle profile before liquid evaporation occurs.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        Goniometer Metrology Targets    
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
      Stage Rep (um)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Dispense Vol Acc (%)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
Gen 2 Align Tol (um)┤██████████████████████████████████│
                    │██████████████████████████████████│
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.0     1.2      2.5     3.8    5.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\pm 5$ | Max deviation $\le 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Stage Repeatability (X-Y-Z)** | $\le 5$ | Max positional drift $\le 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Micro-Syringe Dispense Accuracy** | $\pm 2.5$ | Repeated sessile volume drift $\le 2.5$ | $\%$ |
| **Optical Baseline Leveling Tilt** | $\le 0.1$ | Maximum horizon angle deviation | degrees ($^{\circ}$) |

---

### 3. Context Citations & Technical Justification

- **Alignment Tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$)**: Sourced directly from *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*, where macroscopic contact/projection equipment transitions from Gen 1 ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) to Gen 2 precision alignment target of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **Pre-Oxidation Target Requirements (3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C)**: Sourced from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*, dictating strict surface passivation verification (HF-last hydrophobicity) to ensure uniform interface state density and 3.5 nm physical thickness control.
- **Deionized Water Rinse Compatibility**: Sourced from *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* regarding post-wet-chemical rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse protocols.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Gen 1 manual and semi-automated macroscopic linear translation stages using extruded aluminum 4040 frames and C7 rolled ball screws exhibit Abbe errors up to 15 um over 100 mm and non-negligible mechanical backlash. In water contact angle (WCA) goniometry, stage pitch, yaw, and vibration transmission directly distort the baseline alignment between the optical telecentric camera and the dispensed droplet edge. A rigid granite base or Sorbothane-damped optical breadboard coupled with MGN12H linear guide rails must be enforced to keep stage plane tilt below 0.05 degrees across the entire 100 mm mapping traverse.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate sessile drop contact angle characterization on HF-last silicon (typically exhibiting hydrophobic WCA > 75 degrees) requires ultra-precise droplet volume control (2.0 to 5.0 uL). Using uncalibrated Hamilton gastight glass micro-syringes or blunt dispensing needles with hydrophobic PTFE or metallic surface fouling introduces droplet volume variance (> 15%) and parasitic pinning, skewing contact angle readings by 3 to 7 degrees. Automated multi-site mapping must synchronize stage deceleration with droplet detachment to avoid kinetic splashing or drop vibration artifacts during transient profile capture.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring precision automated micro-syringe pumps and COTS optical goniometers with motorized XY stages presents long import lead times (8 to 12 weeks) and high capex. For DRAM Foundation VN Gen 1, sourcing commercial precision gastight Hamilton 100 uL syringes paired with NEMA 17 lead-screw micro-stepper actuators and local precision CNC aluminum stage fixtures with MGN12H rails provides a modular, rapid-deployment path under 14 days, provided calibration standards (certified hydrophobic calibration spheres/targets) are secured.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Stage mapping setup and needle volume calibration must not become a bottleneck that violates the tight pre-oxidation Q-time window. Calibration and 5-point wafer stage mapping routines must execute within 180 seconds per monitor wafer to prevent HF-dipped hydrophobic surfaces from regrowing native oxide (chemical re-oxidation) while waiting on the goniometer stage prior to oxidation furnace loading.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Syringe tip droplet pinning or non-reproducible detachment causing volume deviations > 0.5 uL, producing kinetic drop spreading and artificial contact angle underestimation.
1. Mechanical pitch/roll runout across the 100 mm stage mapping axis exceeding optical depth of focus, causing automated baseline edge detection failure in computer vision algorithms.
1. Ambient airborne organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption onto the micro-syringe needle or wafer surface during prolonged calibration, shifting baseline contact angle by > 5 degrees.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-1-01` | **Micro-Syringe Dispense Volume Gravimetric and Optical Calibration** | Hamilton 100 uL Gastight Syringe (Model 1710), 30-gauge PTFE-coated blunt needle, Sartorius Quintix 5-decimal analytical microbalance (0.01 mg resolution), optical contact angle telecentric camera with calibrated reticle. | 1. Prime the micro-syringe fluid path to ensure zero air bubbles in the barrel or needle. 2. Command the syringe dispenser to eject 10 consecutive droplets targeted at 3.00 uL directly into a tared, evaporation-shielded weighing vessel on the microbalance. 3. Record individual mass for each drop. 4. Simultaneously capture optical droplet silhouette at needle tip prior to detachment and calculate optical volume via axisymmetric drop shape analysis (ADSA). 5. Compute mean dispense volume, standard deviation, and dispense repeatability percentage. | `Dispense volume must be 3.00 +/- 0.15 uL across 10 runs (mean mass between 2.85 mg and 3.15 mg assuming water density 0.998 g/cm3), with relative standard deviation (RSD) <= 2.5% and optical-to-gravimetric correlation deviation < 3.0%.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-1-02` | **Multi-Site Stage Mapping Coordinate Repeatability and Optical Baseline Coplanarity** | 2-axis linear motor/stepper translation stage (100 mm x 100 mm travel, MGN12H rails, C7 ball screws), dual-axis electronic dial indicator (0.5 um resolution), certified optical goniometer grid calibration target (Thorlabs R1L3S3P). | 1. Mount certified grid calibration target on the wafer vacuum chuck. 2. Define 5-point mapping coordinates: Center (0,0), Top (0, +40 mm), Bottom (0, -40 mm), Left (-40 mm, 0), Right (+40 mm, 0). 3. Command stage through 10 cyclical traversals across all 5 target points at a slew rate of 10 mm/s. 4. At each point, measure mechanical XY positioning error using electronic indicators. 5. Measure the optical baseline angle tilt relative to the camera horizontal sensor axis via edge-detection algorithm. | `Bidirectional stage positioning repeatability <= 5.0 um at all 5 points. Stage pitch/yaw runout across full travel must keep focal drift < 10.0 um and optical baseline plane tilt < 0.05 degrees across all mapping sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields, Lint-free cleanroom gown and ESD-safe conductive footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean running water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. In case of IPA vapor inhalation: Remove individual to fresh air immediately. For DI water, standard cleanroom ergonomic safety protocols apply.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within laminar flow hood (ISO Class 5) with HEPA filtration providing 0.45 m/s uniform downflow. Syringe flush and solvent cleaning procedures must be performed under local cleanroom exhaust canopy.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent effluent collected into certified closed polypropylene flammables waste containers for secondary recycling. DI water effluent neutral, routed to standard industrial wastewater drain after automated pH verification (pH 6.5 - 8.5).

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Ultrapure Type 1, 18.2 MOhm-cm)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade Type 1 | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, for syringe rinse/degreasing)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI/MOS) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched, hydrogen-terminated Si (100) surface directly following in-situ dilute HF (1% HF:H2O) clean, characterized by high hydrophobicity (WCA > 75 degrees) and zero chemical oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Five-point WCA-mapped wafer surface with sessile drops blown off with high-purity filtered N2 gun (< 0.05 bar), retaining passivated Si-H bonds ready for gate dielectric pre-oxidation furnace insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time causes ambient airborne molecular contamination (organic VOCs) and native silicon oxide regrowth (SiO2 thickness > 0.3 nm), degrading HF-last passivation, dropping contact angle by > 10 degrees, and introducing fixed gate oxide traps (Dit > 5e11 eV-1 cm-2) upon subsequent 3.5 nm dry thermal oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full calibration and qualification of the automated goniometer micro-syringe dispenser and 5-point mapping linear stage, establishing validated droplet repeatability (3.0 uL +/- 0.15 uL) and micron-level stage coplanarity across 100 mm wafers, enabling automated WCA verification of HF-last passivation within cleanroom Q-time limits.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `syringe_gravimetric_calibration_report_run01.csv`
- [ ] `multisite_stage_mapping_repeatability_matrix.pdf`
- [ ] `telecentric_optical_baseline_coplanarity_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Micro-syringe dispensed droplet volume accuracy and repeatability for Type 1 DI water** | `3.00 uL` | +/- 0.15 uL (RSD <= 2.5%) | Gravimetric microbalance measurement across 10 consecutive drop dispenses correlated with axisymmetric drop shape analysis (ADSA). |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Two-axis stage positioning repeatability across 5-point mapping grid over 100 mm wafer travel** | `0.00 um` | <= 5.0 um bidirectional error | Automated cyclical traversal measured via calibrated dual-axis linear optical encoders and electronic dial indicator. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Stage planar tilt and focal optical plane baseline runout across all 5 metrology sites** | `0.00 deg` | <= 0.05 deg tilt, <= 10.0 um focal plane variance | Optical edge-detection software analysis of baseline fit angle on certified flat optical target across all mapping coordinates. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researchers must verify that 10 consecutive 3.0 uL DI water dispenses pass gravimetric RSD <= 2.5%, the 5-point stage mapping runout maintains focal tilt <= 0.05 degrees, and the entire automated multi-site mapping cycle completes within 180 seconds, signed off in the metrology qualification logbook prior to processing gate oxide monitor lots.

testcases.title: Micro-Syringe Dispense Volume Gravimetric and Optical Calibration
testcases.instrumentation: Hamilton 100 uL Gastight Syringe (Model 1710), 30-gauge PTFE-coated blunt needle, Sartorius Quintix 5-decimal analytical microbalance (0.01 mg resolution), optical contact angle telecentric camera with calibrated reticle.
testcases.pre_conditions: Cleanroom ambient temperature controlled to 21.0 +/- 0.5 deg C, relative humidity 45 +/- 5%. Analytical grade Type 1 DI water (18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity, surface tension 72.8 mN/m at 20 deg C) degassed via ultrasonic bath.
testcases.procedure: 1. Prime the micro-syringe fluid path to ensure zero air bubbles in the barrel or needle. 2. Command the syringe dispenser to eject 10 consecutive droplets targeted at 3.00 uL directly into a tared, evaporation-shielded weighing vessel on the microbalance. 3. Record individual mass for each drop. 4. Simultaneously capture optical droplet silhouette at needle tip prior to detachment and calculate optical volume via axisymmetric drop shape analysis (ADSA). 5. Compute mean dispense volume, standard deviation, and dispense repeatability percentage.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Dispense volume must be 3.00 +/- 0.15 uL across 10 runs (mean mass between 2.85 mg and 3.15 mg assuming water density 0.998 g/cm3), with relative standard deviation (RSD) <= 2.5% and optical-to-gravimetric correlation deviation < 3.0%.

testcases.title: Multi-Site Stage Mapping Coordinate Repeatability and Optical Baseline Coplanarity
testcases.instrumentation: 2-axis linear motor/stepper translation stage (100 mm x 100 mm travel, MGN12H rails, C7 ball screws), dual-axis electronic dial indicator (0.5 um resolution), certified optical goniometer grid calibration target (Thorlabs R1L3S3P).
testcases.pre_conditions: Stage mounted to vibration-isolated optical breadboard with Sorbothane damping feet. Stage coordinate zero calibrated via homing optical limit switches.
testcases.procedure: 1. Mount certified grid calibration target on the wafer vacuum chuck. 2. Define 5-point mapping coordinates: Center (0,0), Top (0, +40 mm), Bottom (0, -40 mm), Left (-40 mm, 0), Right (+40 mm, 0). 3. Command stage through 10 cyclical traversals across all 5 target points at a slew rate of 10 mm/s. 4. At each point, measure mechanical XY positioning error using electronic indicators. 5. Measure the optical baseline angle tilt relative to the camera horizontal sensor axis via edge-detection algorithm.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Bidirectional stage positioning repeatability <= 5.0 um at all 5 points. Stage pitch/yaw runout across full travel must keep focal drift < 10.0 um and optical baseline plane tilt < 0.05 degrees across all mapping sites.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved)
ANSI Z87.1 certified impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields
Lint-free cleanroom gown and ESD-safe conductive footwear
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean running water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. In case of IPA vapor inhalation: Remove individual to fresh air immediately. For DI water, standard cleanroom ergonomic safety protocols apply.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Operation conducted within laminar flow hood (ISO Class 5) with HEPA filtration providing 0.45 m/s uniform downflow. Syringe flush and solvent cleaning procedures must be performed under local cleanroom exhaust canopy.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent IPA solvent effluent collected into certified closed polypropylene flammables waste containers for secondary recycling. DI water effluent neutral, routed to standard industrial wastewater drain after automated pH verification (pH 6.5 - 8.5).

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly etched, hydrogen-terminated Si (100) surface directly following in-situ dilute HF (1% HF:H2O) clean, characterized by high hydrophobicity (WCA > 75 degrees) and zero chemical oxide.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Five-point WCA-mapped wafer surface with sessile drops blown off with high-purity filtered N2 gun (< 0.05 bar), retaining passivated Si-H bonds ready for gate dielectric pre-oxidation furnace insertion.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding queue time causes ambient airborne molecular contamination (organic VOCs) and native silicon oxide regrowth (SiO2 thickness > 0.3 nm), degrading HF-last passivation, dropping contact angle by > 10 degrees, and introducing fixed gate oxide traps (Dit > 5e11 eV-1 cm-2) upon subsequent 3.5 nm dry thermal oxidation.

expected_result.summary: Full calibration and qualification of the automated goniometer micro-syringe dispenser and 5-point mapping linear stage, establishing validated droplet repeatability (3.0 uL +/- 0.15 uL) and micron-level stage coplanarity across 100 mm wafers, enabling automated WCA verification of HF-last passivation within cleanroom Q-time limits.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Micro-syringe dispensed droplet volume accuracy and repeatability for Type 1 DI water
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Gravimetric microbalance measurement across 10 consecutive drop dispenses correlated with axisymmetric drop shape analysis (ADSA).

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Two-axis stage positioning repeatability across 5-point mapping grid over 100 mm wafer travel
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated cyclical traversal measured via calibrated dual-axis linear optical encoders and electronic dial indicator.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Stage planar tilt and focal optical plane baseline runout across all 5 metrology sites
quantitative_assertions.tolerance: <= 0.05 deg tilt, <= 10.0 um focal plane variance
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Optical edge-detection software analysis of baseline fit angle on certified flat optical target across all mapping coordinates.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researchers must verify that 10 consecutive 3.0 uL DI water dispenses pass gravimetric RSD <= 2.5%, the 5-point stage mapping runout maintains focal tilt <= 0.05 degrees, and the entire automated multi-site mapping cycle completes within 180 seconds, signed off in the metrology qualification logbook prior to processing gate oxide monitor lots.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-WCA-GEN2-001`
**Title:** Automated Multi-Site Deionized Water Micro-Droplet Dispensing Recipe Execution  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification > Multi-Site Sessile Drop Dispense & Contact Angle Transient Profile Capture > Automated Multi-Site Deionized Water Micro-Droplet Dispensing Recipe Execution  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the automated recipe execution for multi-site sessile micro-droplet dispensing of ultra-pure deionized (DI) water onto silicon wafers following pre-oxidation clean and HF-last etching. The objective is to verify surface termination and hydrophobicity/passivation across the wafer diameter prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thermal growth.

---

### 2. Materials & Equipment
- **Goniometer / Contact Angle Metrology System**: Equipped with an automated motorized X-Y-Z wafer stage and synchronized high-speed digital video camera.
- **Micro-Dispense Module**: Automated motorized syringe pump with a PTFE-coated stainless steel blunt micro-needle.
- **Metrology Fluid**: High-purity deionized (DI) water (18.2 MΩ·cm resistivity).
- **Substrate**: 100 mm silicon wafers processed through RCA and HF-last clean.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
  [Stage Initialization] 
           │
           ▼
 [Purge & Baseline Check] 
           │
           ▼
[Automated Recipe Execution] (Multi-Site Move & Dispense)
           │
           ▼
[Transient Profile Capture] 
           │
           ▼
  [Clean & Standby Reset]
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Operational Alignment & Environmental Baseline Check
1. Power on the automated goniometer metrology station, optical illumination source, and syringe delivery pump.
2. Initialize and zero the motorized stage in X, Y, and Z axes. Confirm Gen 2 stage travel repeatability baseline within **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.
3. Inspect the DI water delivery reservoir and tubing lines to ensure no micro-bubbles or particulate contamination are present.

#### Step 2: Automated Syringe Purge & Droplet Calibration
1. Command an automated pre-dispense purge of DI water into the waste receptacle to eliminate stagnant air or meniscus drying at the needle orifice.
2. Form a calibrated pendant micro-droplet at the needle tip to verify symmetric droplet detachment dynamics and volume metering repeatability.

#### Step 3: Wafer Loading & Automated Multi-Site Recipe Execution
1. Transfer the 100 mm post-HF cleaned wafer onto the vacuum chuck; activate vacuum retention.
2. Execute the automated multi-site dispensing recipe:
   - Program a standard multi-point radial grid (e.g., center, top, bottom, left, right edge sites across the 100 mm wafer substrate).
   - For each programmed inspection site, step the motorized stage to target coordinates maintaining stage positioning tolerance within **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Lower the dispensing tip to the target dispense height above the wafer surface.
   - Actuate the micro-dispenser to deliver the sessile DI water droplet onto the wafer surface.
   - Retract the dispensing tip smoothly along the Z-axis without inducing secondary splashing or droplet vibration.

#### Step 4: Synchronized Video/Profile Capture & Metrology Interface
1. Concurrently trigger optical video capture at droplet touchdown to record the transient spreading profile and baseline sessile contact angle.
2. Index to the subsequent coordinate on the 100 mm substrate until all target sites are dispensed and captured.

#### Step 5: Post-Execution Clean & Reset
1. Deactivate chuck vacuum and unload the wafer to the staging cassette.
2. Execute an automated tip rinse cycle with fresh DI water to avoid residue buildup, then return the goniometer stage to its origin home position.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment & Positioning Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Motorized stage linear encoder feedback |
| **Wafer Substrate Diameter Compatibility** | 100 | $\text{mm}$ | Automated vacuum chuck specification verification |
| **Purge & Rinse Fluid Resistivity** | 18.2 | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line DI water resistivity sensor reading |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: Stage alignment and positioning tolerance standards across generations (establishing Gen 2 alignment tolerance at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ compared to Gen 1 at $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$); integration of deionized (DI) water rinsing protocols.
- **Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming**: Substrate geometry baseline referencing 100 mm wafer processing.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated multi-site micro-droplet dispensing requires deterministic synchronization between the 3-axis motorized goniometer stage (stepping resolution <= 10 um) and the micro-solenoid/piezoelectric syringe actuator. Dispensing height must be precisely regulated to 1.0 +/- 0.2 mm above the wafer plane to prevent droplet kinetic bouncing or needle tip collision with the wafer surface, while ensuring drop detachment without mechanical shearing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following HF-last surface preparation, the Si(100) surface exhibits Si-H hydride passivation with an expected static water contact angle of 75° to 86°. Dispensing must deliver ultra-pure DI water droplets (1.5 to 2.0 uL) across 5 standard sites (Center, North, South, East, West at 10 mm edge exclusion) within 60 seconds of stage loading to prevent native chemical re-oxidation and airborne volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption, which artificially suppresses the contact angle.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Syringe needle barrels require hydrophobic PTFE-coated 30-gauge stainless steel dispensing needles to guarantee repeatable drop breakaway without residual wetting up the needle shank. 18.2 MOhm-cm point-of-use DI water filters (0.05 um PTFE membrane) and disposable gas-tight Hamilton micro-syringes must be second-sourced from domestic laboratory distributors to mitigate single-supplier delivery disruptions.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated 5-point dispensing cycle time must complete in <= 120 seconds per 100mm wafer to prevent bottlenecking the pre-oxidation gate queue. Automated recipe execution replaces manual pipette variations, directly safeguarding the 30-minute clean-to-furnace Q-time ceiling prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Micro-bubble entrainment within the dispensing fluid path causing droplet volume variation (> 15% delta) and premature detachment, falsifying wetting baseline measurements.
1. Needle crash or physical contact with the active wafer surface during vertical descent, introducing localized mechanical scratches and catastrophic silicon particulate shedding.
1. Organic cross-contamination of dispensing needle tip or DI water reservoir, lowering surface tension and producing false hydrophilic contact angle readings (< 70° on hydrogen-passivated silicon).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-2-01` | **Automated Micro-Droplet Volumetric and Positional Dispense Precision Verification** | Automated Optical Goniometer with 5-megapixel CMOS camera, telecentric zoom lens, 3-axis motorized stage, and calibrated analytical micro-balance (0.01 mg resolution). | 1. Load recipe executing 5-site dispense pattern (Center, R=35mm at 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°) onto a dummy hydrophilic silicon wafer. 2. Execute automated micro-stepping sequence dispensing 2.0 uL nominal droplets at 1.0 mm needle clearance. 3. Acquire side-view drop profile images via telecentric optics and compute droplet volume via automated Young-Laplace contour fitting. 4. Record dispense coordinates and droplet base diameters across all 5 sites. | `Dispensed volume across all 5 sites must be 2.00 +/- 0.15 uL (C.V. <= 5.0%). Dispense location accuracy must be within +/- 100 um of programmed coordinates. Zero satellite droplet formation.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-2-02` | **Post-HF Silicon Hydride Passivation Multi-Site Contact Angle Uniformity** | Automated Contact Angle Goniometer with integrated drop-shape image analysis software, equipped with Class 1 clean dry air (CDA) purge enclosure. | 1. Mount HF-treated wafer on vacuum chuck under filtered CDA shroud. 2. Trigger automated 5-site dispensing recipe (1.8 uL DI water per site). 3. Capture baseline optical drop profile within 2.0 seconds of needle retraction at each site. 4. Calculate left and right static contact angles via automated polynomial circle/ellipse fitting algorithms. | `Mean static water contact angle across all 5 sites must be >= 75.0° and <= 86.0°. Total within-wafer contact angle non-uniformity (3-sigma / mean) must be <= 6.0%. Contact angle hysteresis between left and right flanks <= 2.0°.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Lint-free cleanroom gowning (Class 1000 compatible hood, suit, and ESD boot covers)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: UPW presents no toxicological or corrosive hazard. In the event of high-pressure fluid splash or syringe needle puncture, irrigate affected area with clean eyewash/water for 15 minutes, apply standard antiseptic dressing to needle puncture, and report incident to facility EHS officer.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within a Class 100 laminar flow hood (HEPA-filtered, face velocity 0.45 +/- 0.05 m/s) with dedicated exhaust port to remove local humidity and ambient volatile organics.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent DI water droplets collected via cleanroom lint-free wipes or drained directly into the cleanroom aqueous non-hazardous waste drain (neutral pH 6.5 - 7.5). Syringe needle consumables disposed of in designated biohazard/puncture-resistant sharps container.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (ASTM D5127 Type E-1.2, 18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (Si-H monohydride/dihydride passivation) immediately post 2.0% HF dip and rapid N2 spin-dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic Si-H passivated surface with localized DI water micro-droplet residue wiped/N2-blown, ready for immediate thermal furnace boat loading.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding the 30-minute ambient air threshold induces native oxide growth (> 0.4 nm sub-stoichiometric SiOx) and adventitious carbon contamination, degrading 3.5 nm dry gate oxide breakdown voltage (E_bd < 10 MV/cm) and causing threshold voltage instability in DRAM transfer gates.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full automated recipe execution across 5 wafer sites delivering 1.8 - 2.0 uL UPW droplets, capturing high-resolution sessile drop images, and validating uniform Si-H hydrophobicity (contact angle 75° - 86°) to approve 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation lot release.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RECIPE_EXEC_SUMMARY_TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-2-2.csv`
- [ ] `FIVE_SITE_CONTACT_ANGLE_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `RAW_SESSILE_DROP_PROFILES_SITE1_5.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Dispensed deionized water droplet volume per site** | `1.80 uL` | +/- 0.15 uL | Automated telecentric Young-Laplace contour volume calculation verified against micro-balance gravimetric calibration |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Mean static water contact angle across 5 inspection sites** | `80.5 deg` | +/- 5.5 deg | Automated circle/tangent fitting on calibrated goniometer CCD side-view frames within 2.0s of drop deposition |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Total automated 5-site recipe execution cycle duration** | `90 seconds` | <= 120 seconds | Integrated goniometer motion controller execution timestamp log from recipe start to final stage unload |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 inspection sites demonstrate static water contact angles within 75.0° to 86.0° with no needle contact marks or particulate generation, automated execution finishes within 120 seconds, and the wafer is staged into the N2 purge box within the allowable 30-minute pre-oxidation Q-time envelope.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Transient Contact Angle Video Profiling & Surface Hydrophobicity Uniformity Analysis

**Process Module:** Metrology / Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation  
**Target Device Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Parent Process:** [180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)](docs/knowledge/transient_contact_angle_profiling.md) via 850°C–900°C Dry Thermal Oxidation  
**Documentation:** Knowledge persisted to [transient_contact_angle_profiling.md](docs/knowledge/transient_contact_angle_profiling.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Wafer Load & N2     │
│         Purge          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Multi-Site Sessile   │
│    Droplet Dispense    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    High-Speed Video    │
│     Acquisition &      │
│   Baseline Tracking    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Transient Dynamic    │
│      Angle θ_t &       │
│  Uniformity Profiling  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Screening  │
│  & Gate Oxide Release  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Environmental & Metrology Stage Stabilization:**
   - Verify automated optical goniometer chamber environment at $23.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and $45\% \pm 3\%\text{ RH}$.
   - Ensure stage laminar box maintains clean $N_2$ purge to prevent airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and premature native oxide regrowth post-HF clean.

2. **Automated Wafer Alignment & Recipe Loading:**
   - Transfer wafer immediately post-HF dip / BOE clean via robot end-effector.
   - Align notch and map a 5-site layout: **Site 1 (Center), Site 2 (Top), Site 3 (Right), Site 4 (Bottom), Site 5 (Left)** with a 5 mm edge exclusion zone.

3. **Multi-Site Sessile Drop Dispense:**
   - Dispense Ultra-Pure Water (UPW, resistivity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, degassed) at $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ using an automated micro-syringe at $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{L/s}$.
   - Lower the needle to initiate automated touch-down contact with zero droplet oscillation.

4. **High-Speed Video Capture & Real-Time Baseline Edge Fitting:**
   - Trigger camera synchronization at $\ge 60\text{ fps}$ for $10.0\text{ s}$ immediately upon needle detachment.
   - Utilize automated polynomial baseline tracking and Young-Laplace contour profile fitting across left/right triple contact points.

5. **Transient Decay & Uniformity Extraction:**
   - Extract contact angle $\theta(t)$ from $t = 0\text{ s}$ to $t = 10\text{ s}$. 
   - Record the stabilized contact angle $\theta_0$ at $t = 1.0\text{ s}$ and dynamic relaxation $|\Delta \theta|$ over the interval $[1.0\text{ s}, 5.0\text{ s}]$.
   - Compute across-wafer uniformity ($3\sigma$ / Mean).

6. **Cassette Release to Gate Oxidation:**
   - Qualify wafer if within acceptance windows; route wafer cassette to the dry oxidation furnace for 3.5 nm gate oxide growth within the 2-hour queue-time (Q-time) window.

---

### 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Defines the downstream target where access transistors require gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (with access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):** Specifies the upstream wet surface preparation chemistry (BOE 6:1 with $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ and $\text{HF}$ with etching rate of $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$), producing the required hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon surface verified by this metrology step.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated transient contact angle profiling requires rigorous synchronization between the micropipette dispense trigger (2.0 µL ± 0.1 µL) and high-speed CMOS video capture (minimum 60 FPS). Any mechanical vibration transmitted through the optical bench or stage alters the droplet baseline detection, corrupting the Young-Laplace numerical fitting algorithm and producing false contact angle transient decay curves.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following an HF-last RCA clean, Si(100) exhibits pristine hydrogen-passivation (Si-H monohydride/dihydride) yielding a characteristic high contact angle (>75°). Transient contact angle relaxation over a 10-second observation window is sensitive to droplet evaporation, native oxide re-growth, and airborne molecular organic contamination (AMOC). A rapid decay rate (dθ/dt > 0.5°/s) directly signals sub-optimal surface passivation or high ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dedicated automated contact angle goniometers (e.g., ramé-hart, Krüss) carry steep capital expenditures ($25k–$50k). For Gen 1 open-source semiconductor fabrication in Vietnam, an open-hardware goniometer rig utilizing a calibrated 10x Plan Achromat macro lens, high-uniformity telecentric LED backlight, and an open-source Python OpenCV Young-Laplace fitting pipeline must be standardized to eliminate single-vendor lock-in while ensuring micron-level droplet profile repeatability.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Multi-site mapping across 5-point locations (Center, North, South, East, West) can easily breach the strictly budgeted 30-minute cleanroom air Q-time between HF-dip and horizontal tube furnace loading. Automated high-throughput profiling must execute multi-point sessile dispense, video capture, and automated blow-off within <= 3 minutes per wafer to maintain furnace batch synchronization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Premature native oxide growth or AMOC physisorption due to exceeding the 30-minute ambient air Q-time, dropping contact angle below the required 72° threshold.
1. Young-Laplace baseline misalignment caused by wafer surface tilt (>0.5°) or stage vibration, leading to non-physical contact angle asymmetric variations exceeding ±5° between left and right droplet contact points.
1. Trace organic or ionic contamination in the dispense DI water needle resulting in droplet pinning, contact angle hysteresis, and erroneous uniformity grading across wafer radii.

Automatically aspirate/purge droplets using clean dry N2 blow before indexing to the next coordinate. | `Initial contact angle at all 5 test sites must be >= 75.0°; across-wafer contact angle non-uniformity ((Max - Min) / (2 * Mean)) must be <= 4.0%; baseline tilt angle across left/right contact points must be <= 0.3°.` |

Inspect droplet baseline stability and contact diameter pinning behavior across the full 15s window. | `Transient decay rate S_decay must be <= 0.25°/s between t = 1.0s and t = 10.0s; total contact angle drop (Delta-theta) over 10 seconds must be <= 2.5°; droplet contact line baseline diameter must remain pinned within ±20 µm without unprompted dewetting.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Double-gloved heavy-duty Nitrile (outer) over thin Nitrile (inner) gloves, Chemical splash face shield combined with ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles, Acid-resistant neoprene chemical apron and sleeve protectors, Cleanroom anti-static non-linting coveralls with integrated ESD booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF contact: Immediately wash affected skin with copious flowing water for 1-2 minutes, then massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into skin until medical attention arrives. In case of ocular exposure: Flush eyes at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes using sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye solution or saline; summon emergency medical response immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Goniometer station must be enclosed under a dedicated ISO Class 4 mini-environment with Class 100 laminar flow HEPA/ULPA filtration equipped with activated carbon chemisorption pre-filters to scrub ambient volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and acid vapors; minimum face velocity of 0.45 m/s.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispensed UPW droplets collected via suction purge must be routed to the cleanroom acid waste neutralization (AWN) system. Any contaminated wipes or pipette tips containing trace HF residues must be segregated into sealed, labeled polyethene hazardous waste bins and neutralized with calcium hydroxide/calcium carbonate slurry prior to disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |

| **Hydrofluoric Acid (residual vapor/liquid risk from upstream prep)** | `7664-39-3` | Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C12) | `0.5% - 49% aqueous` |
| **Ultrapure Deionized Water (Sessile dispense medium)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type E-1 (18.2 MOhm-cm, 0.05 µm filtered) | `100%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Droplet clearance & purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 5.0 (99.999% pure, filtered) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Atomically smooth, fully hydrogen-terminated hydrophobic silicon surface (Si-H monohydride/dihydride) immediately following 0.5% HF-last etching, UPW rinse, and Marangoni/spin-dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Verified hydrophobic, ultra-low contamination Si-H surface with zero water droplets remaining, inspected and cleared for immediate quartz boat transfer into the oxidation furnace.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time causes ambient oxygen and moisture to break Si-H bonds, nucleating uncontrolled sub-stoichiometric native silicon oxide (SiOx, x < 2) and adsorbing organic hydrocarbons. This degrades 3.5 nm dry gate oxide breakdown field (E_bd < 10 MV/cm) and spikes interface trap density (D_it > 1E11 eV^-1 cm^-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full 5-point transient contact angle mapping and dynamic video profiling completed across 100mm wafers, confirming uniform Si-H surface passivation (mean CA >= 76°, across-wafer variation <= 4%) and negligible transient decay, certifying optimal surface readiness for 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-WCA-001`
**Module:** Metrology / Surface Chemistry  
**Sub-Module:** Young-Laplace Fitting & Surface H-Passivation Uniformity Screening  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     HF-Last Wafer      │
│        Transfer        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Sessile Drop      │
│  Dispense 2.0 uL UPW   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Edge Detection &    │
│      Baseline Fit      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Young-Laplace      │
│    Contour Fitting     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Site Theta    │
│       Screening        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│      Passivation       │
│    Uniformity Check    │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │     │                        │
│  Release to 3.5nm Dry  │     │  Rework: RCA Clean &   │
│        Gate Ox         │     │         HF Dip         │
│                        │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the quantitative optical goniometry and axisymmetric drop shape analysis (ADSA) procedure using Young-Laplace profile fitting to screen surface hydrogen termination ($\text{Si-H}$ passivation) and cross-wafer uniformity on bare silicon surfaces directly following RCA cleaning and in-situ dilute HF dipping. Ensuring complete native oxide removal and homogeneous hydrophobicity is required prior to dry thermal oxidation of the 3.5 nm gate dielectric for 180nm DRAM access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Physical Principles & Equipment Setup
* **Metrology Tool:** Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with motorized stage and high-speed telecentric CMOS camera.
* **Liquid Medium:** Degassed Ultra-Pure Water (UPW), resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25.0^\circ\text{C}$, surface tension $\gamma_{LV} = 72.8\text{ mN/m}$.
* **Theoretical Fitting Model:** Full axisymmetric Young-Laplace equation:
  $$\Delta P = \gamma \left( \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} \right) = \Delta P_0 + \Delta \rho g z$$
  where the profile is numerically fitted to account for hydrostatic gravitational deformation and determine the equilibrium static contact angle $\theta$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Environmental & Tool Equilibrium:**
   * Verify metrology chamber environment: temperature at $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity at $45.0 \pm 3.0\%$.
   * Confirm camera optical magnification calibration using the precision standard calibration sphere ($4.000 \pm 0.001\text{ mm}$ diameter).

2. **Substrate Handling & Queue Time:**
   * Load the 200 mm wafer directly onto the vacuum chuck within a maximum post-HF queue time ($\text{Q-Time}$) of $\le 30\text{ minutes}$ in an $N_2$-purged minienvironment to prevent native oxide regrowth.

3. **Automated Multi-Site Dispense Routine:**
   * Program a standard 9-site cross-wafer map: Center, 4 points at $R = 45\text{ mm}$, and 4 edge points at $R = 90\text{ mm}$ ($10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
   * Actuate the micro-syringe with a 30-gauge blunt PTFE-coated needle: dispense a sessile droplet of $2.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ UPW at a dispensing rate of $0.5\ \mu\text{L/s}$.
   * Lower the stage to detach the droplet cleanly without mechanical kinetic perturbation.

4. **Image Acquisition & Young-Laplace Profile Fitting:**
   * Acquire digital silhouette images at $t = 3.0\text{ seconds}$ post-deposition (avoiding droplet evaporation skew).
   * Perform sub-pixel edge detection along the droplet profile and establish the horizontal solid-liquid baseline.
   * Execute non-linear regression using the Young-Laplace model from baseline intercept to apex, extracting the left angle ($\theta_L$), right angle ($\theta_R$), and mean equilibrium contact angle ($\theta = \frac{\theta_L + \theta_R}{2}$).
   * Verify fit error: root-mean-square error ($\text{RMSE}$) of the contour fit must be $< 0.02\text{ mm}$.

5. **Passivation Screening & Lot Disposition:**
   * Evaluate the site values against threshold limits.
   * If all 9 sites meet the acceptance criteria, clear the wafer for transfer to the quartz tube furnace for 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$).
   * If contact angle falls below the screening limit, flag lot as "Incomplete H-passivation / Native Oxide Residue" and route to rework (RCA Clean & dilute HF dip).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Control Limit | Unit | Physical Significance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mean Water Contact Angle ($\theta_{\text{mean}}$)** | $\ge 75.0$ | $\ge 72.0$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Confirms complete removal of hydrophilic native $\text{SiO}_2$ and complete hydrophobic $\text{Si-H}$ passivation. |
| **Cross-Wafer Contact Angle Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | $\le 1.5$ | $\le 2.0$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Ensures homogeneous pre-oxidation surface across center-to-edge. |
| **Profile Fit Residual ($\text{RMSE}$)** | $\le 0.015$ | $< 0.020$ | mm | Validates Young-Laplace contour convergence free from particulate interference or asymmetry. |
| **Subsequent Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | nm | Validates pre-clean interface quality enabling uniform thermal growth targeting $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$. |

---

### 5. Context Citations
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; sub-threshold/junction leakage targets require pristine gate interfaces.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
* **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:** Interface reaction-rate limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) producing dense, high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide ($E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) with minimal interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$) at $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ target thickness. Clean initial silicon surface termination ensures uniform interface reaction rate constant $k_l = B/A$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated Young-Laplace fitting on sessile DI water droplets requires optical telecentric imaging and baseline detection robustness against ambient vibration. The goniometer stage integration must coordinate rapid robotic or manual multi-point wafer mapping (5-point: center, top, bottom, left, right) within the tight pre-oxidation queue time budget without introducing particulate contamination from droplet dispensing or ambient aerodynamic drag.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following an HF-last RCA clean, Si(100) exhibits pristine Si-H monohydride/dihydride surface termination yielding a nominal water contact angle (WCA) of 75° to 86°. Any local degradation below 70° indicates incomplete native oxide stripping or premature re-oxidation/hydrocarbon adsorption. Accurate Young-Laplace numerical extraction accounts for droplet gravity deformation and baseline curvature, ensuring sub-degree resolution and screening out localized pinhole oxidation prior to gate oxide thermal growth.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires semiconductor-grade ultra-pure deionized (UPDI) water (>18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity, TOC < 5 ppb) and pre-cleaned PTFE/polypropylene disposable syringe tips certified particulate-free. Goniometer calibration targets (sapphire or quartz precision spheres and etched optical grid reticles) must be sourced from ISO 17025 accredited metrology suppliers to maintain reproducible baseline and optical aspect-ratio calibrations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: WCA screening is a non-destructive gatekeeping checkpoint directly on pilot or monitor wafers immediately prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation. Process execution per wafer must not exceed 4 minutes total overhead to prevent consuming the critical 30-minute clean-to-furnace Q-time window, keeping cycle times and furnace batch loading strictly synchronized.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Hydrocarbon airborne molecular contamination (AMC) causing false high contact angles on partially oxidized surfaces.
1. Droplet evaporation during multi-point fitting distorting baseline contact diameter and altering the dynamic contact angle.
1. Micro-particulate generation or water residue drying stain (watermark) remaining in active device areas post-dispense.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-3-01` | **5-Point Wafer Surface H-Passivation Young-Laplace Contact Angle Mapping** | Automated Optical Goniometer with telecentric lens, monochrome CMOS camera (>= 60 FPS), vibration isolation table, and automated micro-syringe dispenser (0.5 - 2.0 uL). | 1. Place monitor/pilot wafer onto vacuum chuck of goniometer under laminar flow hood. 2. Dispense 1.5 uL droplet of 18.2 MOhm-cm UPDI water onto Center (0,0), Top (0, +40mm), Bottom (0, -40mm), Left (-40mm, 0), and Right (+40mm, 0). 3. Capture droplet shadowgraph profile within 3 seconds of droplet landing to avoid evaporation. 4. Execute non-linear Young-Laplace profile fit algorithm to extract left, right, and mean static contact angles. | `Mean contact angle across all 5 points >= 75.0°; 5-point within-wafer non-uniformity (max - min) <= 4.0°; no individual point < 72.0°.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-3-02` | **Young-Laplace Algorithm Goodness-of-Fit and Baseline Curvature Verification** | Digital image processing software engine with certified calibration optical standard mask (droplet shadow target at 80.0° ± 0.2°). | 1. Load calibration target image and verify edge-detection thresholding. 2. Run automated Young-Laplace numerical solver across 100 contour points along droplet boundary. 3. Calculate root-mean-square error (RMSE) between experimental boundary points and theoretical Young-Laplace capillary equation curve. | `Optical magnification calibration error <= ±0.2%; Young-Laplace fit boundary RMSE <= 1.5 pixels; measured contact angle on calibration standard within 80.0° ± 0.3°.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, ESD cleanroom coat/smock, Class 100 cleanroom face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Non-hazardous test liquid. In case of minor IPA splash to eyes during tool cleaning, flush with eyewash station for 15 minutes. For skin contact, wash thoroughly with soap and clean water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation inside standard Class 100 / ISO 5 laminar flow hood with HEPA/ULPA filtration; local mini-exhaust for solvent-wetted wipe disposal during maintenance.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent UPDI droplets evaporated or wiped with cleanroom wipes; IPA rinse waste segregated into designated flammable solvent carboys for certified disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Ultra-Pure)** | `7732-18-5` | UPDI Grade / ASTM Type I | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Stage/Syringe Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched hydrophobic Si(100):H surface terminated with minimal (<0.1 nm) native oxide post-DHF rinse and dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: H-passivated Si(100) surface verified uniform (WCA >= 75°), dry, and watermark-free, staged for immediate load-lock insertion into dry oxidation furnace.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Spontaneous atmospheric re-oxidation forming non-stoichiometric native sub-oxide (SiOx) and airborne hydrocarbon contamination, leading to interface trap density (Dit) spikes and gate dielectric breakdown failure at 3.5 nm target thickness.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed 5-point Young-Laplace water contact angle characterization confirming robust, uniform hydrogen surface passivation across the wafer with no localized hydrophilic oxide patches or watermark contamination, qualifying the lot for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide furnace transfer.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_5PT_UNIFORMITY_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `YOUNG_LAPLACE_FIT_PROFILES.tiff`
- [ ] `LOT_GATE_OX_PRECLEAN_METROLOGY_SIGNOFF.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wafer-average static water contact angle across 5 inspection sites** | `80.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg | Automated 5-point Young-Laplace contour extraction on 1.5 uL UPDI sessile drops. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **5-point contact angle within-wafer range (max - min)** | `2.5 deg` | <= 4.0 deg | Statistical calculation from 5-point automated goniometric measurement data. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Young-Laplace edge contour residual root-mean-square error (RMSE)** | `0.8 pixels` | <= 1.5 pixels | Non-linear regression analysis of captured droplet edge profile vs theoretical Laplace profile. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 measurement coordinates exhibit WCA >= 75.0° with total range <= 4.0°, RMSE <= 1.5 pixels, droplet inspect areas dried cleanly with dry N2 blow without residue stains, and lot transferred into oxidation tube or N2 purge box within 30 minutes of DHF dip completion.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-WCA-002`
**Title:** Automated Multi-Point Sessile Droplet Dispense & Optical Profile Acquisition  
**Context / Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Gate Dielectric Clean Metrology (Pre-Dry Gate Oxidation: ~3.5 nm physical thickness target) > Goniometer Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & H-Passivation Screening  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum Chuck   │
│   Load & Alignment    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Automated Syringe   │
│   Priming & 2.0 µL    │
│   Droplet Formation   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Controlled Z-Axis   │
│  Touch-Off & Sessile  │
│       Dispense        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Multi-Point Stage   │
│  Step: 9-Pt / 49-Pt   │
│         Grid          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Telecentric      │
│  Tele-Macro Optical   │
│  Profile Acquisition  │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Load and Stage Referencing:**
   - Transfer the post-HF cleaned 200 mm bare Si wafer from the nitrogen-purged FOUP/cassette onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck.
   - Engage chuck vacuum and execute optical notch/flat alignment to establish the wafer origin $(X_0, Y_0, Z_0)$.
2. **Deionized (DI) Water Syringe Priming & Purge:**
   - Prime the automated micro-syringe (PTFE/glass barrel with hydrophobic fluoropolymer-coated needle) using high-purity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
   - Purge 3 dummy droplets to clear trapped micro-bubbles and stabilize the meniscus at the tip.
3. **Pendant Droplet Dosing & Controlled Deposition:**
   - Command the automated micro-pump to extrude a calibrated pendant droplet of $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ at the needle tip.
   - Lower the $Z$-axis stage at a controlled rate ($0.5\text{ mm/s}$) until droplet touch-off occurs on the silicon surface without mechanical needle impact ($Z$-clearance $\ge 0.5\text{ mm}$).
   - Retract the needle along the $Z$-axis to release the sessile droplet cleanly onto the H-passivated silicon substrate.
4. **Automated Multi-Point Stepping (9-Point / 49-Point Grid):**
   - Execute programmed stage displacement across the predefined wafer coordinates following the standard 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping protocol (center, mid-radius, edge exclusion $\ge 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Allow droplet baseline equilibration for $1.0\text{ s}$ prior to image capture to minimize transient hydrodynamic oscillation.
5. **High-Speed Optical Profile Image Acquisition:**
   - Trigger the monochrome CMOS camera equipped with a telecentric tele-macro lens and diffused LED backlight.
   - Capture side-view optical shadowgraph profiles at 30 fps for 60 frames under freeze-frame exposure ($< 1\text{ ms}$).
   - Stream raw uncompressed TIFF frames with embedded spatial scale calibration ($\mu\text{m/pixel}$) to the Young-Laplace fitting buffer.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dispense Droplet Volume** | `2.0` | $\mu\text{L}$ | $\pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ | Automated micro-dispenser optical volumetric calibration |
| **Multi-Point Stage Grid Pattern** | `9` or `49` | points / wafer | Exact discrete points (`9-pt` or `49-pt` grid) | Recipe encoder verification across wafer radial coordinates |
| **Optical Spatial Resolution** | `± 0.05` | $\mu\text{m/pixel}$ | $\le 0.05\text{ }\mu\text{m/pixel}$ calibrated optical uncertainty | Telecentric optical grid target magnification calibration |
| **Pre-Oxidation Target Surface Layer** | `3.5` | $\text{nm}$ | Physical gate oxide target: $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ | Post-oxidation spectroscopic ellipsometry validation |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **Source: *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology***:
  - *Context applied:* Direct justification for automated **9-point or 49-point wafer mapping** to evaluate radial film and surface uniformity across spin-coating/furnace operations, as well as metrology precision requirements targeting dry gate oxide physical thickness of **$3.5\text{ nm}$** with sub-Angstrom precision (**$\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$**).
- **Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering***:
  - *Context applied:* Defines the thermal gate dielectric integration target: **thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness**, which requires pre-oxidation HF-last surface H-passivation and hydrophobicity qualification.
- **Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***:
  - *Context applied:* 180nm access transistor channel geometry (**$L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$**) and gate integrity constraints required to maintain sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automating multi-point sessile droplet dispense on Gen 1 mm-scale hardware introduces mechanical vibration coupling from motorized syringe pumps and XY translation stages directly into the high-speed optical capture axis. The optical goniometer must isolate mechanical resonances to prevent meniscus oscillation during high-speed image acquisition. Furthermore, droplet volume repeatability at the sub-microliter level (1.0 to 2.0 uL) is critically sensitive to syringe needle gauge, hydrophobic PTFE needle coating wear, and air entrapment in the dispense manifold, directly biasing the measured contact angle baseline.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following an HF-last clean, the silicon surface is H-terminated (Si-H, Si-H2, Si-H3) and highly hydrophobic with a nominal contact angle between 75° and 86°. Any delay during multi-point spatial mapping risks airborne trace organic contamination (volatile organic compounds) and native oxide regowth, which rapidly lowers the contact angle toward hydrophilicity (<30°). The dispense-to-acquisition cycle time per point must not exceed 10 seconds, and the droplet dispense volume must remain below 2.0 uL to avoid gravitational flattening violating the Young-Laplace spherical cap assumption.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying a commercial automated goniometer (e.g., Krüss DSA or ramé-hart) under 'Buy' constraints for Gen 1 requires tracking lead times on calibrated micro-syringe assemblies (Hamilton gastight syringes), optical calibration reticles (certified circle/angle targets), and optical-grade anti-reflection coated telecentric lenses. Dual-sourcing standard PTFE-coated stainless steel dispense needles (gauge 30-32) is critical to prevent supply bottlenecks from single-vendor proprietary consumables.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Budget and schedule must account for certified optical magnification calibration grid standards and recurring needle replacement logs. Multi-point mapping protocols must complete 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping within the strict pre-oxidation queue-time window without starving downstream dry thermal oxidation furnace loads, preventing wafer batch scrap due to clean-to-furnace hold violations.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Micro-vibration induced capillary wave distortion during high-speed optical edge detection resulting in >3° Young-Laplace baseline fitting error.
1. Droplet evaporation and organic adsorption during sequential multi-point mapping causing artificial drift in contact angle measurements from point 1 to point 9.
1. Dispense needle clogging or PTFE tip delamination causing droplet pinning, asymmetrical droplet volume ejection, and optical distortion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-3-1-01` | **Automated 9-Point Sessile Droplet Dispense Precision and Contact Angle Reproducibility** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with telecentric lens, 60 fps CMOS camera, motorized precision XY stage, and programmable micro-syringe pump. | 1. Mount calibration wafer on motorized goniometer vacuum chuck. 2. Initialize automated 9-point wafer map (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge exclusion 5mm). 3. Automatically dispense 1.5 uL droplet of ASTM Type I ultra-pure deionized water via 30-gauge PTFE-coated needle at 1.0 uL/s. 4. Retract needle 5 mm and acquire 60 frames of profile video within 2.0 seconds post-touchdown. 5. Perform baseline detection and Young-Laplace profile fit across both left and right contact angles. 6. Repeat dispense and acquisition sequence across all 9 locations. | `Dispense volume across all 9 points must be 1.50 ± 0.05 uL; mean water contact angle on freshly H-terminated Si must be between 75.0° and 86.0°; 9-point within-wafer standard deviation (1-sigma) must be <= 1.2°; total 9-point run time must be <= 180 seconds.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-1-3-1-3-1-02` | **Goniometer Optical Magnification Calibration and Edge Detection Verification** | Certified Optical Calibration Standard (Ceramic/Glass Target with certified chrome-on-glass 4.000 mm sphere and 60°/90°/120° precision angles), vibration isolation optical table. | 1. Place certified optical calibration standard on goniometer sample holder. 2. Focus telecentric lens onto calibration sphere silhouette. 3. Execute automated edge-detection calibration routine in software to establish pixel-to-micrometer aspect ratio. 4. Acquire 10 static frames of certified 90.00° and 120.00° contact angle reference geometries. 5. Run automated edge detection and polynomial/Laplace boundary extraction. | `Optical spatial resolution must calibrate to >= 120 pixels/mm; measured calibration sphere diameter must measure 4.000 ± 0.002 mm; measured reference angles must report 90.00° ± 0.15° and 120.00° ± 0.15° across all 10 consecutive frames.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom anti-static ESD coat, Face mask and cleanroom hood
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Although measurement uses non-hazardous UPW, wafers enter directly from HF wet bench. Calcium gluconate 2.5% topical gel must be available in immediate metrology area. In case of contact with suspect residual HF-dip droplets, flush skin with copious water for 5 minutes, apply calcium gluconate gel continuously, and seek immediate medical attention. For eye exposure, rinse at emergency eyewash station for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Install goniometer within a mini-environment or laminar flow bench maintaining Class 100 (ISO 5) laminar downward airflow with local exhaust point (min 50 CFM) to eliminate solvent/trace vapor accumulation and prevent particle entrapment on fresh wafers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent sessile droplets and rinse purge water collect in dedicated polypropylene catch tray. Drain effluent into cleanroom acid-waste neutralization (AWN) stream or containerize for neutralization with 10% calcium carbonate / potassium hydroxide prior to sewer discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Ultra-Pure, ASTM Type I)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (UPW, 18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) | `100%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (trace residues on incoming wafers from prior wet-bench step)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `<0.1% trace vapor/liquid residue` |
| **Isopropanol (Goniometer optical cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Cleanroom Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare Si(100) directly post-0.5% HF dip, UPW cascade overflow rinse, and spin-rinse-dry (nominal contact angle 78°-84°).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Verified uniform H-terminated hydrophobic surface with sessile droplet residues evaporated under localized dry N2 jet, qualified for immediate transfer to gate oxidation furnace.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide (SiO2) re-growth and atmospheric airborne organic/hydrocarbon adsorption degrading H-passivation, resulting in non-uniform sub-3.5nm dry thermal gate oxide thickness, elevated interface trap density (Dit), and premature gate dielectric breakdown.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Automated 9-point sessile droplet dispense, optical shadowgraph acquisition, and Young-Laplace profile fit successfully verified on 150mm H-passivated silicon substrates. All points demonstrate stable hydrophobic contact angles verifying uniform HF-last surface conditioning within strict pre-oxidation queue-time limits.
