# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-WET-001`
**Title:** Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology for Surface Hydrophobicity and Passivation Quality  
**Process Step Hierarchy:**  
`180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration]` > `180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing]` > `Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) [Thermal Oxidation]` > `RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) [Wet Chemistry]` > `Post-Clean Surface Contact Angle and TXRF Trace Metal Metrology [Metrology]` > `Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology for Surface Hydrophobicity and Passivation Quality`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 1 (180nm, 1T1C DRAM Architecture)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Automated Optical Sessile Drop Goniometer Toolset)

---

### 1. Purpose & Context
This procedure defines the execution protocol for automated sessile drop contact angle metrology on silicon wafer surfaces immediately following the pre-gate oxidation clean (RCA SC-1/SC-2 with dilute HF final dip). At the 180nm node, growing high-integrity, ultrathin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide (thermally grown at 850°C–900°C) for access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) demands uniform hydrogen passivation and complete native oxide strip across the active channel area prior to oxidation furnace load.

---

### 2. Equipment, Tooling & Environmental Specifications
- **Metrology Tool:** Automated Optical Sessile Drop Contact Angle Goniometer with automated motorized multi-point stage ($X$-$Y$-$\theta$), environmental enclosure, and CCD camera with telecentric optics.
- **Probe Liquid:** Deionized (DI) Water, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$, TOC $< 5\text{ ppb}$, filtered to $0.05\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **Dispensing Subsystem:** Micro-syringe with calibrated PTFE blunt needle (gage 30 to 32); droplet volume target: $1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$.
- **Cleanroom Ambient:** Class 1 / ISO Class 3 minienvironment; temperature $21.5^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$; relative humidity $45\% \pm 3\%$.
- **Max Permissible Q-Time:** Post-DHF rinse/dry to goniometric measurement $\le 30\text{ minutes}$ (to prevent airborne hydrocarbon re-contamination and native oxide regrowth).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
       [Wafer Unload: Post-RCA DHF Clean]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Transfer to Goniometer Tool Stage (Q-Time <= 30 min)]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Automated 5-Point Wafer Alignment & Recipe Load]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Sessile Drop Dispense: 1.0 uL DI Water at 21.5 deg C]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Image Capture at t = 2.0 s Post-Dispense via CCD]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Young-Laplace / Tangent Fit Evaluation of Theta (deg)]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Pass / Fail SPC Gate Validation -> Send to 850-900 deg C Furnace]
```

#### Step 3.1: Metrology Tool Preparation & Syringe Priming
1. Verify optical calibration grid using certified ruby spherical calibration standard ($\theta = 90.0^\circ \pm 0.5^\circ$).
2. Flush the micro-dispenser lines with freshly drawn $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ ultra-pure DI water for 5 cycles to eliminate micro-bubbles.
3. Verify baseline droplet volume stability by dispensing test drops onto a dummy target ($1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$).

#### Step 3.2: Wafer Loading & Spatial Mapping
1. Load the 200mm production silicon wafer post-RCA/DHF clean into the automated wafer load port.
2. Select the metrology recipe: `RECIPE_180NM_GATE_OX_PREP_WET`.
3. Auto-align wafer notch/flat and initialize a standardized 5-point measurement map across the substrate:
   - Point 1: Center $(0, 0\text{ mm})$
   - Points 2–5: North, South, East, West at radius $R = 90\text{ mm}$ ($10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

#### Step 3.3: Droplet Dispense and Dynamic Sessile Angle Capture
1. Move stage to coordinate location $(X_i, Y_i)$ at a vertical working distance of $2.0\text{ mm}$ between needle tip and substrate.
2. Dispense a sessile droplet of $1.0\ \mu\text{L}$ DI water at a controlled dosing rate of $0.5\ \mu\text{L/s}$.
3. Lower stage to transfer the droplet onto the Si surface gently with zero kinetic impact splashing.
4. Capture high-resolution droplet silhouette images exactly $2.0\text{ seconds} \pm 0.2\text{ seconds}$ post-surface touchdown.

#### Step 3.4: Automated Edge Fitting & Calculation
1. Apply the automated Young-Laplace contour fitting algorithm along the liquid-vapor-solid three-phase boundary line.
2. Calculate left and right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$); record the mean contact angle $\theta_{\text{avg}} = (\theta_L + \theta_R) / 2$.
3. Repeat steps for all remaining coordinates across the 5-point map.
4. Purge droplet via non-contact micro-vacuum aspiration if executing on production-sacrificial sites, or reject wafer if destructive contact metrology is configured without monitor sites.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Unit | Target Specification | Lower / Upper Control Limit (LCL / UCL) | Metrology Tool / Action on Out-of-Spec |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Water Contact Angle ($\theta_{\text{avg}}$)** | Degrees ($^\circ$) | $\ge 72.0^\circ$ | LCL: $70.0^\circ$ (Passivated hydrophobic Si–H surface) | Goniometer: Abort thermal furnace run; re-route wafer to DHF pre-clean if $\theta < 70^\circ$. |
| **Cross-Wafer Wetting Non-Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | Percent ($\%$) | $\le 3.0\%$ | UCL: $4.5\%$ across 5-point radial distribution | Automated SPC alarm; flag RCA bath recirculation and spray nozzle blockage. |
| **Pre-Furnace Q-Time Exposure Window** | Minutes ($\text{min}$) | $\le 30.0$ | UCL: $45.0\text{ min}$ max queue time before 850°C–900°C furnace ramp | MES interlocking gate; lockout wafer entry to thermal oxidation cluster. |
| **Droplet Measurement Volume Precision** | Microliters ($\mu\text{L}$) | $1.00$ | $0.90\ \mu\text{L} \le V_{\text{drop}} \le 1.10\ \mu\text{L}$ | Dispenser optical verification; re-prime fluidics on deviation. |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Technical Justification

1. **Gate Dielectric Baseline & Thermal Processing:**
   - *Context:* *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."* (Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
   - *Process Justification:* A pristine 3.5 nm gate oxide requires complete removal of sub-oxides and chemical oxide prior to dry thermal oxidation; achieving a hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated surface ($\theta \ge 70^\circ$) prevents premature interfacial pinhole defect generation.
2. **Access Transistor Dimensions & Integrity:**
   - *Context:* *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm."* (Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
   - *Process Justification:* For $L = 180\text{ nm}$ sub-micron channels, non-uniform cleaning or trace chemical oxide residual causes threshold voltage ($V_{\text{th}}$) roll-off and catastrophic sub-threshold leakage exceeding the $1\text{ fA/cell}$ target limit.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Contact angle goniometry must operate on dedicated witness wafer coupons or perimeter exclusion test dice to prevent particulate contamination and droplet drying stain residue on active DRAM device regions. Sessile drop dispensing of UPW (ultrapure water) must be synchronized with immediate clean dry nitrogen (CDA/N2) blow-off or wafer coupon discard before introducing the batch into the quartz oxidation furnace tube.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following Dilute HF (DHF 50:1 or 100:1) etching, a pristine Si(100) surface terminates in mono- and di-hydrides (Si-H, Si-H2), creating a strongly hydrophobic regime with static water contact angles theta >= 70 degrees (ideally 75-84 degrees). Incomplete native oxide stripping or chemical re-oxidation from rinse water dissolved oxygen yields sub-stoichiometric Si-OH silanol termination, degrading theta to < 30 degrees, which indicates insufficient passivation and elevated interface state density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2) prior to dry gate oxide growth.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision motorized micro-syringe goniometers with automated optical baseline fitting (Young-Laplace / circle approximation) and telecentric lenses are capital-intensive. Gen 1 mm-scale prototyping can leverage an optical bench microscope (e.g. 10x Plan Achromat objective, high-resolution CMOS camera, diffuse backlight LED) with a calibrated micropipette (0.5 to 2.0 uL droplets), provided automated open-source image analysis scripts (e.g., ImageJ Drop-Analysis plugin or Python OpenCV edge detection) are standardized across fab nodes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Goniometric verification adds a gating step between RCA clean and furnace boat loading. To avoid breaking strict pre-gate oxidation Q-time limits (< 45 minutes clean-to-furnace), the metrology must execute on coupon splits within <= 8 minutes, avoiding scheduling bottlenecks for the dry thermal oxidation furnace batch run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Hydrocarbon airborne molecular contamination (AMC) causing false high contact angle readings on oxidized or silanol-rich surfaces.
1. Droplet evaporation and line pinning during measurement leading to hysteresis and artificial skew in advancing vs receding contact angle extraction.
1. Residual water spot drying marks causing localized trace oxide formation and micro-roughness defects upon high-temperature furnace insertion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-01` | **Static Sessile Drop Contact Angle Verification of Post-DHF Si-H Passivation** | Optical contact angle goniometer with telecentric backlight, high-speed CMOS camera, 34-gauge PTFE-coated dispensing needle, and automated Young-Laplace contour fitting software. | 1. Position test coupon on goniometer vacuum chuck under class 100 laminar flow hood. 2. Dispense 1.0 uL sessile drop of 18.2 MOhm-cm degassed UPW at 0.1 uL/s rate. 3. Settle for 2.0 seconds to eliminate kinetic vibration. 4. Capture baseline and droplet profile image at 60 fps. 5. Apply Young-Laplace edge contour fitting to calculate left and right contact angles across 5 spatial points (center, top, bottom, left, right). | `Static water contact angle theta >= 75.0 degrees across all 5 measurement locations; standard deviation sigma <= 2.5 degrees; zero visible droplet pinning asymmetry (|theta_left - theta_right| <= 2.0 degrees).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-02` | **Air Exposure Passivation Degradation Rate (Q-Time Dynamic Wetting Tracking)** | Automated goniometer bench with environmental enclosure, temperature/humidity logger, calibrated micropipette, and image processing engine. | 1. Perform sessile drop contact angle test at T = 0 minutes. 2. Repeat sessile drop deposition and measurement on untouched coupon coordinates at T = 15, T = 30, and T = 45 minutes air exposure. 3. Calculate contact angle decay slope delta_theta / delta_t. | `Contact angle theta at T = 30 minutes must remain >= 70.0 degrees; decay slope must not exceed 0.25 degrees/minute, verifying cleanroom ambient AMC and moisture do not prematurely strip hydride passivation prior to furnace boat entry.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety glasses, Lint-free cleanroom coat, ESD wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Non-toxic fluid metrology. For accidental water splash to eyes, flush with cleanroom eyewash station for 5 minutes. If handling witness coupons directly downstream of HF bath, ensure Calcium Gluconate 2.5% gel is accessible in the cleanroom station in case of residual acid drag-out.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within laminar flow cleanroom bench (ISO Class 5 / Class 100) with HEPA/ULPA filtration to eliminate airborne particulate and organic amine contamination.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent sessile droplets and witness rinse effluents drain into cleanroom acid/solvent-free industrial drain or dedicated non-hazardous UPW reclaim system.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultrapure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | SEMI C35 Grade 1 (Resistivity 18.2 MOhm-cm at 25°C, TOC < 5 ppb) | `100%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purified CDA/N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Electronic Grade 5.0 (99.999% purity, moisture < 1 ppm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly stripped Si(100) surface with uniform mono/di-hydride (Si-H / Si-H2) passivation termination following 50:1 DHF dip and spin-rinse dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Verified hydrophobic, contaminant-free H-terminated silicon coupon, validated for immediate quartz boat staging and push into dry oxidation furnace.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient cleanroom oxidation and airborne hydrocarbon chemisorption, leading to uncontrolled native oxide formation (0.3 - 0.8 nm SiOx), high fixed oxide charge (Qox > 5e11 cm^-2), and severe gate dielectric breakdown variability.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified hydrogen-passivated silicon surface quality via goniometric static sessile drop metrology, confirming contact angle >= 75 degrees and absence of organic/native-oxide contamination, qualifying the wafer lot for 3.5 nm dry gate thermal oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CA_METROLOGY_REPORT_GEN1.pdf`
- [ ] `DROPLET_PROFILE_RAW_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `YOUNG_LAPLACE_FITTED_CONTOURS.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean static ultrapure water contact angle on freshly etched Si(100) coupon** | `78.0 deg` | +/- 3.0 deg | 5-point automated Young-Laplace profile extraction on optical goniometer |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-wafer contact angle non-uniformity across 5 measurement points** | `1.5 deg` | <= 2.5 deg (1-sigma) | Statistical standard deviation of 5-point radial wafer map measurements |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Measurement cycle time per witness coupon** | `5.0 minutes` | <= 8.0 minutes | Recipe execution timestamp log from goniometer automation controller |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five-point contact angle mean >= 75.0 deg with sigma <= 2.5 deg achieved within <= 30 minutes of DHF clean dry, with zero observed droplet pinning defects, enabling immediate furnace boat insertion for dry gate oxidation.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Goniometer Optical Alignment and Micro-Dosing Syringe Calibration

- **Process Title:** Goniometer Optical Alignment and Micro-Dosing Syringe Calibration
- **Node / Step Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Conditioning > Post-Clean Surface Contact Angle and TXRF Trace Metal Metrology > Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology > Optical Alignment & Micro-Dosing Calibration
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage Leveling &    │
│         Focus          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Optical Telecentric   │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Micro-Dosing      │
│     Dispenser Cal      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Baseline Water     │
│  Droplet Verification  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Vibration Isolation & Macroscopic Stage Leveling**
   - Secure the goniometer assembly onto a stable, vibration-isolated optical breadboard stage.
   - Place a precision spirit level across the wafer chuck; adjust dual-axis kinematic leveling screws until chuck tilt is planar within the Gen 2 macroscopic mechanical baseline.

2. **Optical Axis Alignment & Plan Achromat Focus**
   - Mount a certified calibration target or optical reticle onto the wafer stage.
   - Align the camera optical axis perpendicular to the droplet baseline using a high-magnification plan achromat objective (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25).
   - Adjust the diffuse LED collimated backlight intensity to achieve a sharp, high-contrast silhouette boundary with zero edge blooming.
   - Adjust the fine Z-micrometer drive to bring the target edge into sharp focus across the optical field of view.

3. **Pixel-Scale Telecentric Calibration**
   - Measure the known dimensional feature of a certified optical grid or precision needle gauge under the 10x Plan Achromat imaging system.
   - Perform software pixel-to-micrometer calibration, confirming optical alignment precision within Gen 2 mechanical and optical tolerances (±5 µm).

4. **Micro-Dosing Syringe Preparation & Prime**
   - Load clean, semiconductor-grade Deionized (DI) water (or high-purity chemical testing fluid) into a gastight micro-syringe fitted with a clean, blunt-tip stainless needle (30–32 AWG).
   - Mount the micro-syringe into the automated micro-stepper dosing actuator.
   - Prime the dispenser by purging DI water through the fluid path until all micro-bubbles are evacuated.

5. **Droplet Dispense Calibration & Baseline Verification**
   - Execute test micro-dosing steps using the stepper motor actuator to dispense pendant droplets at controlled sub-microliter volumes (e.g., 1.0–2.0 µL).
   - Lower the needle toward the test substrate to touch off and seat the droplet.
   - Capture droplet profile images; calculate baseline baseline tilt and contact angle fitting repeatability using Young-Laplace baseline fitting.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Optical Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical reticle / micrometer gauge image scaling |
| **Imaging Numerical Aperture / Objective** | $10\times\text{ Plan Achromat, NA } 0.25$ | Dimensionless | Hardware optical specification verification |
| **Dispensed Droplet Baseline Repeatability** | Stable silhouette contrast without optical distortion | Visual / Gray-level threshold | Automated edge-detection intensity profile |

---

### Context Citations

- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - *Stable macroscopic stage & optical objective:* Utilizes a 10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25 objective for micron-scale feature resolution.
  - *Alignment & Positioning Tolerances:* Alignment tolerance specification at Gen 1 is $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ ($0.1\text{ mm}$), improving down to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ in Gen 2.
  - *Deionized Water Baseline:* Rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse standards for wet clean and surface preparation conditioning.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical baseline tilt and camera non-orthogonality directly propagate cosine errors into the sessile drop profile fitting algorithm (Young-Laplace / circle fit). Integrating high-magnification telecentric optics with precise pitch-and-roll mechanical leveling of the sample stage is mandatory to eliminate perspective distortion across the liquid-solid-vapor contact interface.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For evaluating 180nm DHF-last hydrophobic passivation (Si-H termination with contact angles >75°) versus hydrophilic SC-1/SC-2 native oxide regrowth (<10°), droplet volume reproducibility is critical. Micro-dosing dispensing volume must be calibrated to 2.0 ± 0.1 µL; exceeding 3 µL introduces gravitational sag distorting Young-Laplace curvature, while sub-1 µL promotes rapid droplet evaporation in cleanroom ambient.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying specialized quartz Hamilton micro-syringes and fluoropolymer (PTFE)-lined dispensing needles presents a single-point procurement dependency. Sourcing protocols must guarantee alternate suppliers for precision micro-stepping syringe pumps and certified optical calibration reticles to prevent metrology downtime during pilot line qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration execution must not become a bottleneck for pilot lot tracking before dry gate oxidation. Standardize daily automated optical reticle verification routines to under 15 minutes, with full multi-point syringe volumetric gravimetric certification scheduled bi-weekly to balance metrology uptime against wafer queue times.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Optical stage tilt causing baseline tilt angle >0.15°, inducing systematic asymmetric contact angle overestimation (>4°) between left and right droplet contact points.
1. Micro-dosing syringe tip contamination or air bubble entrapment, causing droplet volume drift (>15%) and non-spherical pinned drop profiles.
1. PTFE needle tip degradation or wetting hysteresis causing pendant drop climbing, resulting in partial droplet detachment and unpredictable contact dynamics.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-1-01` | **Goniometer Optical Axis Alignment and Telecentric Magnification Distortion Verification** | Certified Optical Calibration Reticle (10.00 mm scale, 10 µm division, NIST-traceable), High-Resolution Telecentric CMOS Goniometer Vision System, Precision Goniometer Leveling Stage | 1. Mount NIST-traceable calibration reticle onto the sample stage parallel to the optical axis. 2. Adjust telecentric camera focus and stage tilt until reticle grid lines are sharply resolved. 3. Measure optical baseline horizontal inclination across 10 mm field-of-view using integrated image analysis software. 4. Measure horizontal and vertical magnification scale factors across 5 distinct grid divisions. 5. Compute optical distortion percentage and tilt baseline deviation. | `Baseline tilt angle deviation <= 0.05 degrees; optical distortion across entire field of view <= 0.1%; magnification calibration error <= 0.2% against NIST reticle standard.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-1-02` | **Micro-Dosing Syringe Dispense Precision and Sessile Drop Volume Repeatability Test** | Analytical Microbalance (0.001 mg resolution, Mettler Toledo or equivalent), Motorized Micro-Stepping Syringe Dispenser, 100 µL Gastight Hamilton Syringe with 30-gauge PTFE-coated needle, 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW | 1. Program automated syringe pump to dispense 10 consecutive droplets targeted at 2.000 µL into a sealed micro-balance evaporation chamber. 2. Record exact mass of each dispensed droplet, converting mass to volume using water density at 21.0°C (0.99799 g/cm³). 3. Dispense 10 droplets onto a hydrophobic fluoropolymer reference standard and acquire sessile drop baseline images. 4. Calculate dispensing mean volume, standard deviation, and drop-to-drop volume coefficient of variation (CV). | `Mean dispensed volume must be 2.000 ± 0.050 µL; dispensing volume coefficient of variation (CV) <= 1.5% across 10 consecutive shots; drop detachment must be clean without liquid pendant tailing.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom Class 100 polyester ESD-safe lab gown and head cover
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye splash with IPA: Flush affected area with clean water for minimum 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent fumes: Move personnel to fresh air immediately. UPW presents no toxicological hazard.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar airflow bench (ISO Class 4/5) with dedicated local solvent exhaust cup for IPA syringe flush waste.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous UPW effluent drained to general cleanroom drain; spent IPA rinse solvent collected in dedicated flammables carboy for organic waste reprocessing.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ultrapure Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (ASTM Type E-1 / 18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Flushing/Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C4) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-DHF / RCA-cleaned 150mm p-type Si (100) wafers with freshly etched hydrophobic Si-H passivated surface (target baseline contact angle >75°).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Inspected wafer surface with characterized wetting profile, cleared for immediate load-lock pump-down into dry thermal gate oxidation tube.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and uncontrolled native oxide (SiO2) re-growth, causing contact angle collapse towards hydrophilic (<40°) and uncontrolled initial interfacial traps during 3.5nm dry oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full optical alignment and volumetric calibration of the contact angle goniometer, establishing verified telecentric optical orthogonality, sub-0.05° stage baseline flatness, and reproducible 2.00 µL micro-dosing dispensing capability required for DHF-last Si-H wetting metrology.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Goniometer_Optical_Distortion_and_Tilt_Calibration_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `MicroDosing_Syringe_Dispense_Volume_Repeatability_Run10.csv`
- [ ] `NIST_Reticle_Telecentric_Field_Verification_Image.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical baseline stage inclination angle relative to camera horizontal pixel array** | `0.00` | +/- 0.05 deg | Automated software edge-detection fit of NIST-traceable horizontal reticle grid line across 10 mm FOV |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Automated micro-dosing syringe dispense volume repeatability** | `2.000` | +/- 0.050 uL | Gravimetric microbalance measurement of 10 consecutive UPW droplets at 21.0 deg C (density-corrected) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Sessile drop contact angle measurement symmetry on reference fluoropolymer standard** | `0.0` | +/- 0.5 deg difference (left vs right angle) | Young-Laplace profile fit comparison of bilateral contact angles over 5 independent droplet placements |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires 10 consecutive gravimetric dispenses meeting <=1.5% CV, optical reticle distortion verified <=0.1% across full FOV, and bilateral contact angle symmetry confirmed within +/- 0.5° on certified standard.

critical_failure_modes: Optical stage tilt causing baseline tilt angle >0.15°, inducing systematic asymmetric contact angle overestimation (>4°) between left and right droplet contact points.
Micro-dosing syringe tip contamination or air bubble entrapment, causing droplet volume drift (>15%) and non-spherical pinned drop profiles.
PTFE needle tip degradation or wetting hysteresis causing pendant drop climbing, resulting in partial droplet detachment and unpredictable contact dynamics.

testcases.title: Goniometer Optical Axis Alignment and Telecentric Magnification Distortion Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Certified Optical Calibration Reticle (10.00 mm scale, 10 µm division, NIST-traceable), High-Resolution Telecentric CMOS Goniometer Vision System, Precision Goniometer Leveling Stage
testcases.pre_conditions: Vibration isolation table floating with active pneumatic damping at 0.4-0.6 MPa; telecentric light source warmed up for 30 minutes; cleanroom ambient temperature at 21.0 ± 0.5°C and RH 45 ± 3%.
testcases.procedure:
1. Mount NIST-traceable calibration reticle onto the sample stage parallel to the optical axis.
2. Adjust telecentric camera focus and stage tilt until reticle grid lines are sharply resolved.
3. Measure optical baseline horizontal inclination across 10 mm field-of-view using integrated image analysis software.
4. Measure horizontal and vertical magnification scale factors across 5 distinct grid divisions.
5. Compute optical distortion percentage and tilt baseline deviation.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Baseline tilt angle deviation <= 0.05 degrees; optical distortion across entire field of view <= 0.1%; magnification calibration error <= 0.2% against NIST reticle standard.

testcases.title: Micro-Dosing Syringe Dispense Precision and Sessile Drop Volume Repeatability Test
testcases.instrumentation: Analytical Microbalance (0.001 mg resolution, Mettler Toledo or equivalent), Motorized Micro-Stepping Syringe Dispenser, 100 µL Gastight Hamilton Syringe with 30-gauge PTFE-coated needle, 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW
testcases.pre_conditions: Syringe flushed 5 times with fresh 18.2 MOhm-cm ultrapure water (UPW); fluid circuit fully degassed with zero visible micro-bubbles in barrel or needle hub.
testcases.procedure:
1. Program automated syringe pump to dispense 10 consecutive droplets targeted at 2.000 µL into a sealed micro-balance evaporation chamber.
2. Record exact mass of each dispensed droplet, converting mass to volume using water density at 21.0°C (0.99799 g/cm³).
3. Dispense 10 droplets onto a hydrophobic fluoropolymer reference standard and acquire sessile drop baseline images.
4. Calculate dispensing mean volume, standard deviation, and drop-to-drop volume coefficient of variation (CV).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Mean dispensed volume must be 2.000 ± 0.050 µL; dispensing volume coefficient of variation (CV) <= 1.5% across 10 consecutive shots; drop detachment must be clean without liquid pendant tailing.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer)
ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields
Cleanroom Class 100 polyester ESD-safe lab gown and head cover
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin or eye splash with IPA: Flush affected area with clean water for minimum 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent fumes: Move personnel to fresh air immediately. UPW presents no toxicological hazard.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Standard cleanroom laminar airflow bench (ISO Class 4/5) with dedicated local solvent exhaust cup for IPA syringe flush waste.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Aqueous UPW effluent drained to general cleanroom drain; spent IPA rinse solvent collected in dedicated flammables carboy for organic waste reprocessing.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Post-DHF / RCA-cleaned 150mm p-type Si (100) wafers with freshly etched hydrophobic Si-H passivated surface (target baseline contact angle >75°).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Inspected wafer surface with characterized wetting profile, cleared for immediate load-lock pump-down into dry thermal gate oxidation tube.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding Q-time induces ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and uncontrolled native oxide (SiO2) re-growth, causing contact angle collapse towards hydrophilic (<40°) and uncontrolled initial interfacial traps during 3.5nm dry oxidation.

expected_result.summary: Full optical alignment and volumetric calibration of the contact angle goniometer, establishing verified telecentric optical orthogonality, sub-0.05° stage baseline flatness, and reproducible 2.00 µL micro-dosing dispensing capability required for DHF-last Si-H wetting metrology.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Optical baseline stage inclination angle relative to camera horizontal pixel array
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated software edge-detection fit of NIST-traceable horizontal reticle grid line across 10 mm FOV

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Automated micro-dosing syringe dispense volume repeatability
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Gravimetric microbalance measurement of 10 consecutive UPW droplets at 21.0 deg C (density-corrected)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Sessile drop contact angle measurement symmetry on reference fluoropolymer standard
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Young-Laplace profile fit comparison of bilateral contact angles over 5 independent droplet placements

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Formal signoff requires 10 consecutive gravimetric dispenses meeting <=1.5% CV, optical reticle distortion verified <=0.1% across full FOV, and bilateral contact angle symmetry confirmed within +/- 0.5° on certified standard.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Point Sessile Drop DI Water Wetting Recipe Execution on Pre-Oxidation Silicon

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-WET-180NM-001`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-Clean Wafer    │
│          Load          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated Dispense:   │
│   1.0 - 2.0 uL DIW     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Optoelectronic     │
│  Edge-Fitting & Angle  │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Multi-Point Map:    │
│  Center, Middle, Edge  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance Gate Pass: │
│    H-Passivated Si     │
│   Contact Angle >75°   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Purge**:
   - Verify the automated contact angle goniometer environmental chamber is equilibrated at $22.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ and $45\% \pm 5\%$ relative humidity.
   - Purge the ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) micro-syringe delivery line to remove trapped micro-bubbles.
2. **Substrate Transfer**:
   - Transfer the post-RCA/DHF treated silicon wafer from the nitrogen purge box directly to the motorized goniometer vacuum stage within $<5\text{ minutes}$ to prevent native chemical re-oxidation.
3. **Multi-Point Recipe Execution**:
   - Run the automated 5-point/9-point polar coordinate wetting program: Center $(R=0)$, Middle $(R=r/2\text{ at } 0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ)$, and Edge Exclusion zone $(3\text{ mm}$ edge margin).
   - At each site, automatically lower the PTFE-coated needle ($30\text{ gauge}$) and dispense a sessile droplet volume of $1.5\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ DI water at a controlled rate of $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{L/s}$.
4. **Acquisition & Young-Laplace Fitting**:
   - Acquire profile shadowgraphs via high-resolution telecentric CCD camera at $60\text{ fps}$ within $1.0\text{ to } 3.0\text{ seconds}$ post-surface detachment (prior to droplet evaporation effects).
   - Execute baseline detection and tangent / Young-Laplace profile fit to calculate left, right, and mean static contact angles ($\theta_c$).
5. **Post-Measurement Purge**:
   - Vacuum aspirate droplets or route wafer to dry spin/blow station prior to advancing to furnace load locks for the 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation growth.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Tool / Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sessile Droplet Dispense Volume** | $1.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\mu\text{L}$ | Calibrated Micro-Dispenser Pump Encoder |
| **Contact Angle ($\theta_c$) Post-DHF Passivation** | $> 75.0$ | $\ge 75.0$ (Hydrophobic) | $\text{deg } (^\circ)$ | Automated Optical Goniometer (Young-Laplace fit) |
| **Across-Wafer Wetting Non-Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | $\le 2.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $\text{deg } (^\circ)$ | 5-point/9-point Radial Distribution Standard Deviation |
| **Stage Radial Travel Positioning Accuracy** | $0.0$ | $\pm 10.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-Loop Motorized Stage Linear Encoders |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Pre-oxidation surface preparation directly impacts the initial rapid oxidation regime and interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$) for target dry gate oxides of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}1000^\circ\text{C}$ with breakdown fields $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Precise gate oxide preparation governs the 180nm access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) to maintain junction and sub-threshold leakage below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**: High etch resistance to concentrated HF/BOE ($<0.5\text{ nm/min}$) confirms DHF selectivity over nitride boundaries during pre-clean surface conditioning.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Multi-point sessile drop metrology directly touches the wafer surface with ultra-pure DI water droplets, introducing a critical risk of localized airborne hydrocarbon pickup and evaporation-induced trace residue if droplets are left on the wafer. Because this step immediately feeds into 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation where interface trap density (Dit) must stay below 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1, the metrology must either be executed on dedicated monitor wafers (dummy/test Si) or use a non-contaminating, automated microsyringe dispensing system followed by an immediate high-purity N2 blow-off and desiccated queue protocol.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following DHF oxide stripping in the RCA pre-clean sequence, pristine Si(100) surfaces exhibit complete hydrogen termination (monohydride/dihydride Si-H bonds) and high hydrophobicity with an advancing contact angle theta_c between 75° and 85°. Conversely, if RCA-2 (SC-2) chemical re-oxidation is preserved without DHF dip, the chemical oxide must be uniformly hydrophilic (theta_c < 5°). The recipe must explicitly verify whether the pre-oxidation incoming state is H-passivated bare Si or clean chemical oxide, dispensing sub-microliter drops (1.0 to 2.0 uL) using Young-Laplace tangent fitting within 15 seconds of dispensing to avoid ambient moisture condensation or drop retraction artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated goniometers and optical tensiometers require certified calibration calibration-standard spheres or quartz optical targets certified to ISO/IEC 17025. Syringe tips must be disposable PTFE or high-purity fluoropolymer-coated 30-gauge needles to eliminate trace transition metal (Fe, Ni, Cu) leaching into DI water, which would violate the TXRF < 1E10 atoms/cm^2 baseline for gate oxidation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing a 9-point or 13-point sessile drop map on production wafers risks violating the 30-minute strict air Q-time budget between pre-oxidation clean and oxidation furnace push. Metrology cycle time per wafer must be locked to < 180 seconds, or scheduled exclusively on companion witness wafers to avoid furnace idle timeouts and wafer scrap.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Water droplet evaporation staining leaving silica/mineral micro-rings that seed pinholes and early dielectric breakdown in 3.5 nm dry gate oxide.
1. Uncontrolled native oxide re-growth during prolonged ambient exposure in the goniometer stage chamber, causing false drift in contact angle measurements and exceeding gate oxide target thickness.
1. Cross-contamination of the wafer surface by trace airborne volatile organic compounds (VOCs) inside the goniometer housing, artificially increasing contact angle on hydrophilic chemical oxide.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-2-01` | **9-Point Radial Sessile Drop Contact Angle Mapping on DHF-Treated Hydrogen-Terminated Si(100)** | Automated Optical Goniometer / Tensiometer with 0.1 uL precision micro-dosing pump, telecentric lens CCD, and vibration isolation table located in ISO Class 4 cleanroom. | 1. Load wafer onto goniometer stage under laminar HEPA flow. 2. Dispense 1.5 +/- 0.1 uL 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW droplet at center (0,0) and 8 perimeter sites (r = 65 mm, 45-degree intervals) via automated dispense needle. 3. Capture droplet profile at 30 fps for 5 seconds post-dispense. 4. Fit baseline and droplet contour using Young-Laplace algorithm. 5. Rapidly aspirate/blow-dry droplet with ultra-pure filtered N2 (99.9999%). | `Mean static contact angle across 9 points must be 80.0° <= theta <= 86.0°, with 1-sigma across-wafer standard deviation <= 1.8°. Individual point deviation from mean must not exceed +/- 3.0°.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-2-02` | **SC-2 Chemical Oxide Complete Wetting Verification (Hydrophilicity Screen)** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with automated image contrast edge detection and tilt stage. | 1. Position wafer under motorized dispense head. 2. Dispense 2.0 uL UPW droplet at wafer center and 4 quadrant points (r = 50 mm). 3. Record contact angle within 3 seconds of contact. 4. Measure droplet wetting diameter and contact angle profile. | `Complete wetting observed: static contact angle theta < 5.0° (or complete sheet out / spreading beyond optical fitting limit) at all 5 points; zero dewetting or droplet pinning defects.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, Class 100 compatible), ANSI Z87.1 certified clear safety glasses, Full static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, and ESD boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Water is non-hazardous. In case of cleanroom slips or ergonomic strain from manual loading, follow standard first-aid. If compressed N2 line leaks or pressure releases, immediately vacate area to prevent asphyxiation risk and verify oxygen levels (>19.5% O2).
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating air with ISO Class 4 (Class 10) laminar flow hood; positive pressure N2 purge inside goniometer optical measurement enclosure to exclude ambient hydrocarbons.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent UPW effluent drained directly into standard industrial semiconductor UPW reclaim or non-hazardous aqueous waste loop. Disposable needle tips collected in dedicated non-hazardous sharps bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | SEMI C35 Grade 5 (18.2 MOhm-cm at 25°C) | `100%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | SEMI Grade Ultra-High Purity 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed and Marangoni-dried Si(100) surface with either 100% covalent Si-H termination (post-DHF) or stoichiometric pristine chemical oxide (post-SC-2).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry, inspected, spot-free silicon substrate ready for immediate quartz boat loading and oxidation furnace drive-in.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes in ambient air results in adventitious hydrocarbon adsorption and uncontrolled native oxide nucleation (0.2-0.5 nm non-stoichiometric SiOx), altering oxidation kinetics and degrading 3.5 nm gate oxide breakdown field (E_bd < 10 MV/cm).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Demonstration and quantitative validation of automated multi-point sessile drop contact angle metrology on pre-oxidation silicon wafers, verifying either uniform hydrophobic Si-H passivation or clean hydrophilic chemical oxidation across the 150mm diameter within strict clean-to-furnace Q-time constraints.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `sessile_drop_contact_angle_9pt_map.csv`
- [ ] `wetting_profile_young_laplace_fits.pdf`
- [ ] `droplet_edge_telecentric_snapshots.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Average 9-point static water contact angle on DHF-etched pre-oxidation wafer conforms to uniform hydrogen termination.** | `83.0 degrees` | +/- 3.0 degrees | Automated Young-Laplace droplet profile analysis of 1.5 uL UPW sessile drops across 9-site radial map. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total metrology run execution time per wafer including 9-point positioning, dispense, capture, and N2 dry.** | `150 seconds` | <= 180 seconds | Automated equipment recipe log timestamp difference between wafer chuck clamp and wafer unclamp. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full 9-point contact angle profile completed with 100% of sites meeting contact angle bounds (80°-86° for DHF-passivated or <5° for chemical oxide), zero visual or optical drying marks post-N2 blow, and wafer transferred to dry oxidation furnace loadlock within <= 25 minutes of pre-clean completion.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-CA01`  
**Title:** Contact Angle Image Fitting Analysis and Hydrogen Passivation Mapping  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM, $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$)  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology > **Contact Angle Image Fitting Analysis and Hydrogen Passivation Mapping**  
**Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Visual Execution Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Sessile DIW Drop    │
│        Dispense        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       High-Speed       │
│   Telecentric Image    │
│        Capture         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sub-Pixel Baseline &  │
│     Edge Detection     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Young-Laplace /     │
│   Polynomial Fitting   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Multi-Site       │
│  Passivation Mapping   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Substrate Positioning & Environmental Stabilization**:
   - Transfer the post-DHF treated wafer from nitrogen purge transport pod onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck within $< 15\text{ minutes}$ post-clean to prevent ambient hydrocarbon contamination and native re-oxidation.
   - Maintain metrology chamber environment at $22.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and $45 \pm 5\%$ relative humidity.

2. **Automated Sessile Drop Dispensing**:
   - Dispense a calibrated $1.00 \pm 0.05\ \mu\text{L}$ sessile droplet of ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) using a PTFE-coated micro-needle ($30\text{-gauge}$) at a dispense rate of $0.5\ \mu\text{L/s}$.
   - Position needle tip at $1.5\text{ mm}$ above the wafer surface, auto-retract immediately upon droplet detachment to prevent vibration disturbance.

3. **High-Speed Telecentric Image Acquisition**:
   - Trigger image acquisition within $500\text{ ms}$ after droplet touchdown using a monochromatic telecentric camera ($1024 \times 768$ pixels, LED back-illumination) at a frame rate $\ge 30\text{ fps}$.
   - Capture a 10-frame sequence to verify droplet equilibrium before evaporation affects wetting geometry.

4. **Sub-Pixel Baseline Detection & Profile Fitting**:
   - Execute Canny edge detection with sub-pixel interpolation on the liquid-gas and liquid-solid boundary interfaces.
   - Establish the horizontal solid-liquid baseline by identifying the reflection mirror line.
   - Apply the **Young-Laplace drop profile fitting** (or tangent circle/polynomial fitting) algorithm to determine the left contact angle $\theta_L$ and right contact angle $\theta_R$; compute $\theta_{\text{mean}} = (\theta_L + \theta_R)/2$.

5. **Multi-Point Passivation Mapping & Die-Grid Interpolation**:
   - Perform automated 5-site or 9-site radial sampling across the wafer (Center, Inner, Middle, Outer, Edge at 3 mm edge exclusion).
   - Generate full-wafer contour map of $\theta_{\text{mean}}$ to evaluate Si-H (monohydride/dihydride) termination completeness prior to loading into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation furnace for the 3.5 nm gate oxide growth.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ │
  Site 5 (Edge)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ │
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
 Site 4 (Outer)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
Site 3 (Middle)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 Site 2 (Inner)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Site 1 (Center)┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      18.6     37.2      55.9    74.5 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sessile Droplet Dispense Volume** | `1.00` | $\pm 0.05$ | $\mu\text{L}$ |
| **Passivated Silicon Contact Angle ($\theta_{\text{mean}}$)** | `74.0` | $\ge 72.0$ | degrees (°) |
| **Droplet Asymmetry ($\lvert \theta_L - \theta_R \rvert$)** | $\le 1.5$ | $\le 2.0$ | degrees (°) |
| **Across-Wafer Contact Angle Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\le 1.5$ | % |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sourced Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric Thickness and Oxidation Thermal Budget**:
   - *Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
   - Dry oxidation performed in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ targets $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ physical gate oxide thickness ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$), requiring complete and uniform pre-oxidation H-passivation to maintain low interface trap density.
2. **Access Transistor Dimension & Oxidation Regime**:
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - Gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
3. **Cell Layout & Channel Geometries**:
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
   - Access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in an $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ folded bitline layout, where pre-oxidation surface quality directly governs leakage retention limits ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated Young-Laplace baseline extraction across the 150mm wafer must synchronize spatial coordinates with the downstream oxidation furnace boat map; optical distortion or tilt on the macroscopic goniometer stage introduces systematic contact angle measurement errors (>3°) that propagate into false-negative H-passivation coverage models.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF 100:1) etching, an ideal Si(100) surface exhibits mono-hydride and di-hydride termination giving a water contact angle theta >= 75°-82°. Fast sessile drop evaporation and droplet-induced native oxide regrowth will artificially drop theta if optical capture exceeds 15 seconds after dispense, corrupting the Young-Laplace tangential fit.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Optical goniometer camera calibration standards (certified chrome-on-glass dot targets) and HPLC/Semiconductor Grade UPW (18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 1 ppb) are prone to local supply bottlenecks in Vietnam; substitution with lower-grade DI water introduces surfactant/organic trace contaminants that skew wetting metrics.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput must not throttle the critical 30-minute pre-furnace Q-time window; the 9-point contact angle mapping routine and image fitting execution must complete within 8 minutes per wafer to allow timely transfer to the N2 purge box.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Young-Laplace ellipse fitting convergence failure due to ambient lighting glare or droplet baseline reflection blurring on bare polished silicon.
1. Hydrocarbon contamination accumulation from cleanroom ambient atmosphere causing artificial contact angle increase or rapid drop pinning during sessile droplet deposition.
1. Organic or trace metal cross-contamination of clean wafer surface during droplet contact metrology prior to critical 3.5nm dry gate oxidation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

Position wafer on vacuum chuck aligned to Center (0,0). 2. Dispense 1.0 uL sessile UPW droplet at 0.5 uL/s rate via automated needle descent (1.0 mm stand-off). 3. Capture droplet profile at 60 fps for 5 seconds. 4. Execute automated baseline edge detection and Young-Laplace contour fitting across left and right contact angles. 5. Repeat across 3 concentric radii. | `Static water contact angle theta >= 75.0° across all sites. Fitting root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the Young-Laplace profile < 1.5 pixels. Contact angle asymmetry |theta_left - theta_right| <= 2.0°.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-1-3-02` | **9-Point Full-Wafer Hydrogen Passivation Uniformity Mapping** | Automated R-Theta motorized wafer stage coupled with high-speed goniometer and automated cartesian-to-polar mapping script. | 1. Load 150mm wafer and map 9 designated coordinates: Center, 4 points at R=45mm (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°), and 4 points at R=70mm (45°, 135°, 225°, 315°). 2. At each site, deposit 1.0 uL UPW, record contact angle at t = 2.0s post-touchdown. 3. Automatically wick/blow-dry droplet with filtered N2 nozzle before stage movement to prevent cross-site wetting residue. 4. Calculate mean contact angle, standard deviation, and fractional hydrogen passivation coverage map. | `Mean contact angle >= 76.0°. Within-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) <= 3.5%. Hydrogen surface coverage (Si-H) inferred from wetting model >= 92.0% across all 9 locations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Antistatic ESD lab coat/gown, Cleanroom shoe covers and bouffant cap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Water contact poses no acute chemical hazard. In case of mechanical pinch or eye strain from optics, rinse eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes. Report any ergonomic strains from manual wafer loading.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow bench (ISO Class 5 / Class 100 vertical laminar air velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 20%) to prevent airborne particulate sedimentation during measurement.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispensed UPW micro-droplets on test wafers are wicked onto cleanroom-certified low-particulate wipers and disposed in standard cleanroom solid waste; effluent rinses route directly to industrial neutral drainage.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C35, 18.2 MOhm-cm, 0.05 um filtered) | `100%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge/Dry)** | `7727-37-9` | High Purity Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated silicon surface (Si-H, Si-H2) immediately following DHF oxide strip, trace oxide thickness < 0.1 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized H-passivated silicon surface verified clean, dry, and immediately packaged in sealed N2-purged FOUP/carrier for oxidation furnace insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient moisture and oxygen exposure beyond 30 minutes initiates uncontrolled native oxide growth (SiO2 > 0.4 nm) and airborne hydrocarbon physisorption, degrading 3.5nm dry thermal gate oxide dielectric breakdown voltage (EBD) and increasing interface trap density (Dit).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> High-fidelity sessile drop image acquisition and Young-Laplace contour fitting workflow validated across a 9-point wafer grid, confirming robust Si-H passivation (theta >= 75°) prior to 3.5nm dry thermal oxidation while preserving wafer integrity within the 30-minute queue time.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `contact_angle_spatial_map_9pt.csv`
- [ ] `young_laplace_contour_fitting_report.pdf`
- [ ] `calibrated_droplet_profiles_raw.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean static contact angle for H-terminated Si(100)** | `78.0°` | +/- 3.0° | Automated Young-Laplace sessile drop profile fitting algorithm averaging 9 wafer coordinates. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Full wafer passivation uniformity across 150mm substrate** | `95.0%` | +/- 3.0% | Percentage of surface area exhibiting inferred Si-H coverage >= 90% derived from spatial theta interpolation. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Total metrology run execution duration per wafer** | `360 seconds` | +/- 60 seconds | Automated software execution log timestamp tracking from chuck vacuum lock to final N2 blowoff. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 sites demonstrate water contact angle >= 75.0° with Young-Laplace fitting RMSE < 1.5 px, total cycle time <= 8 minutes, and complete wafer transfer to N2 storage carrier within 15 minutes of post-DHF rinse.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal Contamination Screening

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-TXRF-180NM`  
**Process Step:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal Contamination Screening  
**Target Structure:** Pre-Oxidation RCA Cleaned Si (100) Substrate Prior to 3.5 nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│     Pre-Alignment      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Incident Angle     │
│   Alignment & Tuning   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Fluorescence      │
│  Spectrum Acquisition  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Peak Deconvolution &  │
│  Contamination Check   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Loading & Pre-Alignment:**
   - Transfer the post-RCA cleaned (SC-1/SC-2/DHF conditioned) 200 mm bare test/monitor wafer from the nitrogen-purged FOUP/SMIF pod onto the TXRF endstation vacuum chuck via robotic pick-and-place.
   - Execute mechanical notch alignment to establish the polar coordinate grid ($r, \theta$) across the wafer surface.

2. **Goniometer Z-Height & Incident Angle ($\Phi$) Calibration:**
   - Initialize the X-ray source (monochromatic Mo-$K\alpha$ or W-$L\beta$ radiation beam).
   - Perform automatic Z-height surface leveling using laser reflection sensors.
   - Sweep incident angle $\Phi$ and fix the measurement beam below the critical angle for total external reflection on silicon ($\Phi < \Phi_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.15^\circ$), ensuring excitation depth is confined strictly to the topmost 3–5 nm surface layer without deep substrate penetration.

3. **Multi-Point Spectral Acquisition:**
   - Position the Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) / Energy Dispersive Spectrometer directly above the sampling points.
   - Execute a multi-point measurement pattern (5-point cross or 9-point radial map including center, mid-radius, and edge-exclusion boundary of 3 mm).
   - Integrate characteristic fluorescence counts for preset live time ($t = 500\text{ s}$ to $1000\text{ s}$ per site).

4. **Spectral Deconvolution & Trace Metal Quantification:**
   - Process acquired spectra using reference sensitivity factors (RSF) for key transition metals: Iron ($\text{Fe}$), Nickel ($\text{Ni}$), Copper ($\text{Cu}$), and Zinc ($\text{Zn}$).
   - Deconvolve overlapping silicon escape peaks and compute areal contamination density in units of $\text{atoms/cm}^2$.
   - Confirm substrate cleanliness before releasing the batch into the quartz furnace for dry thermal gate oxidation at 850°C–900°C.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Verification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **X-ray Incident Glancing Angle ($\Phi$)** | $< 0.15$ (Below critical angle $\Phi_c$) | $\text{degrees } (^\circ)$ | Automated Goniometer Stage Encoder |
| **Critical Transition Metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Ni}, \text{Cu}$)** | $\le 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | Energy Dispersive TXRF Spectrum Integration |
| **Subsequent Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Mercury Probe / MOS Cap Breakdown ($I\text{-}V$) |
| **Pre-Oxidation Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$ Limit)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Post-oxidation high/low frequency $C\text{-}V$ check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **Source: *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace***
  - *Dry Gate Dielectric Targets*: Thermal gate oxide physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $900^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - *Dielectric Quality*: Requires breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$, dictating strict sub-$10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ trace metal purity to eliminate premature Fowler-Nordheim oxide breakdown.
- **Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering***
  - *Gate Oxide Thermal Envelope*: Gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***
  - *Leakage Target*: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required DRAM refresh cycles, prohibiting interstitial heavy-metal contamination that acts as generation-recombination centers.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Upstream RCA SC-1/SC-2 wet cleaning and DHF etch directly determine whether TXRF encounters an H-terminated or thin native oxide surface. If TXRF screening exceeds the strict queue time window before 850°C-900°C dry oxidation furnace loading, organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and native oxide regrow uncontrollably, skewing both the critical angle alignment (phi_c ~0.18° for Mo-Ka on Si) and introducing uncharacterized interface trap density (Dit) in the critical 3.5 nm gate dielectric stack.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM access transistor gate dielectrics, transition metal contaminants (Fe, Cu, Ni) must remain strictly below 1E10 atoms/cm2 to prevent dielectric breakdown voltage (Vbd) suppression and junction leakage degradation in the 1T1C storage node. Total reflection conditions require grazing incidence below the critical angle (typically 0.05° to 0.15°) to limit X-ray penetration to ~3-5 nm, ensuring sensitivity strictly to surface trace adatoms rather than bulk silicon signal swamping.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of an in-line cleanroom-rated commercial TXRF spectrometer (e.g., Rigaku TXRF 3760 / Bruker S2 PICOFOX with Mo/W rotating anode or microfocus sealed tube and high-resolution Silicon Drift Detector) requires a 32-40 week lead time and dedicated liquid nitrogen or closed-loop chiller lines. Sourcing high-purity single-element calibration micro-droplet standards (Fe, Ni, Cu reference wafers calibrated via ICP-MS) is subject to regional export controls and strict lot-to-lot traceability.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Screening throughput is limited to 3-5 production monitor wafers per furnace batch due to long dwell times (1000s per measurement point across 5-point wafer maps). Integrating TXRF metrology into the direct inline flow creates a serious bottleneck against the pre-furnace 60-minute Q-time ceiling, necessitating an offline or monitor-coupon sampling plan rather than 100% prime wafer screening.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Glancing incidence angle misalignment exceeding +/- 0.01 deg causing beam penetration into bulk silicon, triggering intense substrate Si-Ka fluorescence saturation and blinding the detector to trace Fe/Ni/Cu surface peaks.
1. Trace surface metallic cross-contamination or secondary droplet contamination introduced during robotic wafer transfer or end-effector contact inside the load-lock chamber.
1. Airborne moisture and trace chlorine/hydrocarbon adsorption during extended measurement vacuum cycling, causing pseudo-peak shifts or inaccurate background continuum subtraction near the Fe-Ka (6.40 keV) peak.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-1-3-2-01` | **TXRF Incident Critical Angle Calibration and Instrument Sensitivity Verification** | Automated TXRF Spectrometer equipped with Mo-Ka X-ray tube (17.44 keV), multilayer monochromator, high-purity Silicon Drift Detector (SDD, FWHM < 140 eV at Mn-Ka), and automated goniometer stage (0.001 deg angular resolution). | 1. Perform automated rocking curve scan from 0.000 deg to 0.350 deg in 0.002 deg increments using Mo-Ka radiation on bare Si calibration wafer. 2. Identify Si total reflection edge to establish zero-offset and determine critical angle phi_c (nominally 0.178 deg). 3. Set measurement incident angle to 0.090 deg (+/- 0.005 deg) in total external reflection regime. 4. Acquire 1000-second live-time fluorescence spectrum over central coordinate (0, 0). 5. - **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/radiation protective safety spectacles, Personal passive thermoluminescent dosimeter (TLD) badge or active electronic radiation dosimeter, Anti-static Class 100 cleanroom full-body bunny suit with integrated hood and ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For ionizing radiation overexposure: Immediately shut down X-ray generator via emergency off (EMO); evacuate chamber perimeter; transport exposed personnel for immediate medical evaluation and complete blood count (CBC). critics.systems_engineer: Upstream RCA SC-1/SC-2 wet cleaning and DHF etch directly determine whether TXRF encounters an H-terminated or thin native oxide surface. If TXRF screening exceeds the strict queue time window before 850°C-900°C dry oxidation furnace loading, organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and native oxide regrow uncontrollably, skewing both the critical angle alignment (phi_c ~0.18° for Mo-Ka on Si) and introducing uncharacterized interface trap density (Dit) in the critical 3.5 nm gate dielectric stack.
critics.domain_expert: For 180nm DRAM access transistor gate dielectrics, transition metal contaminants (Fe, Cu, Ni) must remain strictly below 1E10 atoms/cm2 to prevent dielectric breakdown voltage (Vbd) suppression and junction leakage degradation in the 1T1C storage node. Total reflection conditions require grazing incidence below the critical angle (typically 0.05° to 0.15°) to limit X-ray penetration to ~3-5 nm, ensuring sensitivity strictly to surface trace adatoms rather than bulk silicon signal swamping.
critics.supply_chain: Procurement of an in-line cleanroom-rated commercial TXRF spectrometer (e.g., Rigaku TXRF 3760 / Bruker S2 PICOFOX with Mo/W rotating anode or microfocus sealed tube and high-resolution Silicon Drift Detector) requires a 32-40 week lead time and dedicated liquid nitrogen or closed-loop chiller lines. Sourcing high-purity single-element calibration micro-droplet standards (Fe, Ni, Cu reference wafers calibrated via ICP-MS) is subject to regional export controls and strict lot-to-lot traceability.
critics.laya_pm: Screening throughput is limited to 3-5 production monitor wafers per furnace batch due to long dwell times (1000s per measurement point across 5-point wafer maps). Integrating TXRF metrology into the direct inline flow creates a serious bottleneck against the pre-furnace 60-minute Q-time ceiling, necessitating an offline or monitor-coupon sampling plan rather than 100% prime wafer screening.
critical_failure_modes: Glancing incidence angle misalignment exceeding +/- 0.01 deg causing beam penetration into bulk silicon, triggering intense substrate Si-Ka fluorescence saturation and blinding the detector to trace Fe/Ni/Cu surface peaks.
Trace surface metallic cross-contamination or secondary droplet contamination introduced during robotic wafer transfer or end-effector contact inside the load-lock chamber.

Airborne moisture and trace chlorine/hydrocarbon adsorption during extended measurement vacuum cycling, causing pseudo-peak shifts or inaccurate background continuum subtraction near the Fe-Ka (6.40 keV) peak.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Pre-Oxidation Clean Surface Spec Verification and Furnace Loading Disposition Report
**Process Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Metrology Verification & Furnace Disposition  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow & Routing

```text
│                        │
│    Post-RCA Surface    │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼

│                        │
│  Water Contact Angle   │
│  & TXRF Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│  Surface Spec Passed?  │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮Yes: Within Spec
             │No: Metallic Contamination / Native Oxide                          │
             ▼                                                                   ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                                          ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │                                          │                        │
│   Rework / Re-clean    │                                          │  Generate Disposition  │
│      Disposition       │                                          │         Ticket         │
│                        │                                          │                        │
└────────────────────────┘                                          └────────────┬───────────┘
                                                                                 │
             ╭───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Load Quartz Furnace   │
│    Center Flat Zone    │
│         350mm          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Oxidation Metrology Inspection & Spec Verification**:
   - Inspect incoming P-type (100) Si wafer surface immediately following the RCA Clean and DHF dip sequence.
   - Run Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) spectroscopy across 5-point radial wafer coordinates to measure trace metallic impurities and mobile alkali ions (notably $\text{Na}^+$).
   - Perform sessile drop deionized water contact angle measurement to confirm complete native oxide removal and hydrogen passivation integrity post-DHF conditioning.

2. **Automated Spec Disposition Decision**:
   - Verify that metallic contamination and contact angle align with contamination-free interface limits required to achieve target interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\,\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ and breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\,\text{MV/cm}$.
   - If limits fail, quarantine the cassette and tag for SC-1/SC-2/DHF re-clean disposition.
   - If limits pass, sign off the digital Furnace Loading Disposition Report and issue a lot release barcode ticket. Maintain queue-time under cleanroom ambient control to eliminate native oxide regrowth prior to furnace load.

3. **Furnace Ambient & Zone Preparation**:
   - Set up the horizontal fused quartz process tube (outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$) with 3-zone thermal regulation (Source zone, Center zone, Load zone) regulated by dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples and digital PID controllers.
   - Establish a continuous sweep of high-purity ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ / $\text{Ar}$ at 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM (standard liters per minute) laminar gas sweep velocity to prevent ambient air back-diffusion through the door end.
   - Prepare recipe mass flow controllers (MFC) calibrated for high-purity $\text{O}_2$ (99.999%) and dry $\text{HCl}$ (1% to 3% addition) for cleaning metallic impurities and mobile $\text{Na}^+$ ions.

4. **Quartz Boat Wafer Loading Disposition**:
   - Mount the passed product wafers into quartz boats positioned strictly within the middle 350 mm Center Flat Zone of the process tube (maintaining thermal uniformity within $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Insert quartz dummy/baffle wafers in the Source and Load zone ends to ensure steady-state laminar gas velocity and uniform thermal profiling before ramping to dry oxidation process conditions (850°C–900°C target growth for 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
Critical Gate Dielectric & Thermal Process Acceptance Metrics
```
