```text
│   Verify Center Flat   │
│   Zone +/-0.5°C over   │
│         300 mm         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Purge & Gas Environment Stabilization**:
   - Establish a continuous, laminar carrier sweep of ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ through the fused quartz process tube (OD 150 mm to 200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$) via the calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** to prevent ambient air back-diffusion.

2. **Furnace Setup & Thermocouple Verification**:
   - Verify proper positioning and signal integrity of the dual Type-R or Type-S Platinum-Rhodium ($\text{Pt}$-$\text{Pt}/\text{Rh}$) thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells across all three zones: **Source Zone** (gas inlet), **Center Zone** (wafer process flat zone), and **Load Zone** (door end).
   - Ensure wafer boat mechanical push/pull speed is set to **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to prevent mechanical vibration and thermal shock.

3. **Thermal Ramp & PID Baseline Setpoint**:
   - Energize the resistive heating element coils (Kanthal A1 / APM / MoSi$_2$) via the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller.
   - Ramp all three zones up to the target baseline setpoint of **850°C**.

4. **Multi-Zone Profiling & PID Offset Optimization**:
   - Allow the furnace to reach thermal equilibrium at 850°C.
   - Read the profile thermocouple array across the central wafer boat region.
   - Adjust feedforward decoupling and PID power output offsets on the **Source** and **Load** zones relative to the **Center** zone to counteract convective gas cooling at the inlet and radiative/convective heat losses at the furnace door.

5. **Isothermal Flat-Zone Confirmation**:
   - Record temperature measurements across a minimum span of **300 mm** (up to 350 mm) in the center zone over a 30-minute steady-state window.
   - Confirm thermal variation remains strictly within **$\pm 0.5\text{°C}$**.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    Thermal Flat-Zone Target Metrics    
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
Flat-Zone Length┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │░░░░░░                                │
 Boat Push Speed┤░░░░░░                                │
    Gas N2 Sweep┤▒                                     │
                │▒                                     │
 Zone Uniformity┤█                                     │
                │█                                     │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       75        150      225     300 
```

| Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tooling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Center Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5\text{ °C}$** across $\ge 300\text{ mm}$ (up to $350\text{ mm}$) | Multi-point profiling Type-R/S thermocouple array |
| **Process Setpoint Temperature** | **$850.0\text{ °C}$** steady-state at center flat zone | Dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples in quartz thermowell |
| **Purge Gas Laminar Flow Rate** | **$2.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$** ($\text{N}_2$) | Digital Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |
| **Wafer Boat Drive Speed** | **$< 50\text{ mm/min}$** | Mechanical boat loader axis encoder / tachometer |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Sources

- **Source 1**: *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery*
  - Fused quartz process tube (OD 150 mm–200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$); Kanthal A1/APM heating elements; Source/Center/Load zone division; dual Type-R/S thermocouples; digital PID control; center flat zone $\le \pm 0.5\text{°C}$ across 350 mm; laminar gas sweep rate 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM.
- **Source 2**: *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation*
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type-R/S thermocouples in quartz thermowells; $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ temperature uniformity across 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C; 1 to 5 SLPM MFC gas flow; boat drive speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip.
- **Source 3**: *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
  - Fused silica tube with 3-zone PID controller maintaining $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ over 30 cm flat zone.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal coupling between the Load, Center, and Source heating zones induces significant cross-talk during dynamic ramping; independent single-loop PID tuning will lead to underdamped oscillations and thermal overshoot exceeding the strict 0.5°C threshold. A multivariable decoupling feedforward matrix or coupled gain-scheduled PID loop must be implemented to compensate for conductive end-losses at the quartz tube flange and gas pre-heating thermal drag at the source inlet.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 850°C for ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth, an axial temperature variation of merely ±1.0°C translates to an oxide thickness deviation of approximately ±0.08 nm across the wafer load, severely compromising gate dielectric threshold voltage (Vth) and leakage uniformity across the 180nm DRAM access transistors. Profiling must be conducted under identical laminar carrier gas sweep rates (3.0 SLPM N2/O2) using a calibrated profiling thermocouple paddle to capture real convective boundary layer thermal offsets.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Traceable Class 1 calibrated Type-R (Pt-13%Rh/Pt) profiling thermocouples with high-purity quartz sheath assemblies are prone to rhodium migration and calibration drift if exposed to residual chlorine or thermal cycling, leading to replacement lead times exceeding 8 to 12 weeks. High-purity fused silica furnace liners (99.999% SiO2) and APM/Kanthal heating coils must have verified local buffer stock to mitigate unplanned downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal flat-zone stabilization and multi-point profile mapping can consume excessive tool time (up to 16 furnace hours per qualification run) if automated profile profiling scripts are not pre-validated. The milestone requires signing off temperature profiling at 850°C within a single 8-hour shift to prevent delaying the downstream gate oxidation qualification lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Furnace end-loss overcompensation causing localized saddle-profile thermal peaking in the transition regions between Center and Load/Source zones.
1. Spurious thermocouple junction drift or quartz sheath devitrification resulting in false feedback and unmonitored center flat-zone temperature gradient exceeding ±0.5°C.
1. Convective chilling induced by ambient back-drafting or cold gas injection at the gas inlet due to improper MFC laminar sweep pre-heating.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-2-01` | **Static Multi-Point Axial Flat-Zone Thermal Uniformity Profiling at 850°C** | 9-point NIST-traceable calibrated Type-R profiled thermocouple array encased in a 99.999% fused quartz sheath, Keysight 34970A Data Acquisition Unit (0.01°C resolution), and Eurotherm 3-Zone PID Digital Controller. | 1. Insert the 9-point calibrated quartz profiling paddle into the center of the horizontal quartz tube along the central 350 mm wafer boat region at an insertion rate of 25 mm/min. 2. Allow thermal equilibrium to re-establish for 45 minutes under 3.0 SLPM N2 purge. 3. Log real-time temperature data across all 9 junction points (spaced 40 mm apart from -160 mm to +160 mm relative to tube center) at 1 Hz for 30 minutes. 4. Calculate the spatial temperature delta (T_max - T_min) across all 9 measurement points. | `Temperature profile across the central 300 mm wafer processing zone must satisfy 849.50°C <= T_zone <= 850.50°C for all 9 measurement points continuously over 30 minutes (Delta T <= 1.0°C total spread, or <= ±0.50°C deviation from 850.00°C nominal setpoint).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-2-02` | **Dynamic Gas-Switch and Boat-Motion Thermal Recovery Verification** | Multi-junction quartz profiling thermocouple rod, automated motorized cantilever boat loader, calibrated mass flow controllers (Aera/Horiba UHP N2 and O2 MFCs), Keysight 34972A logging system. | 1. Command the automated cantilever boat loader carrying a full dummy silicon wafer load (50 wafers) to drive into the furnace tube at 40 mm/min. 2. Switch process gas from standby N2 (2.5 SLPM) to oxidation-equivalent laminar sweep (3.5 SLPM UHP N2 / 0.5 SLPM O2). 3. Monitor and record Center, Source, and Load zone thermocouple feedback during insertion and for 60 minutes post-insertion. 4. Measure maximum transient temperature droop, recovery time to within ±0.5°C of 850.0°C, and maximum overshoot. | `Thermal recovery to 850.0°C ± 0.5°C must be achieved within <= 25.0 minutes following boat insertion completion; maximum transient thermal overshoot must not exceed +1.5°C above setpoint; steady-state stability must remain within ±0.2°C for >= 20 minutes.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Aluminized heat-resistant thermal handling gloves rated to 1000°C, Full-face polycarbonate heat and UV radiation protective shield, Flame-retardant cleanroom Nomex lab coat, Safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 approved)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For thermal burns: Immediately immerse affected skin in cool, clean water or apply cold sterile saline packs for >= 20 minutes; do not apply salves or ointments; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek emergency medical attention. For nitrogen asphyxiation / oxygen displacement: Immediately move victim to fresh air or administer supplemental oxygen via certified personnel; initiate CPR if breathing has ceased.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid/heat scrubber exhaust plenum connected to furnace scavengers with differential pressure interlock maintaining -0.25 to -0.50 in. w.g. negative pressure; ambient O2 deficiency monitoring sensors installed around furnace load stations calibrated to alarm at < 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Thermal exhaust effluent routed through water scrubber and thermal oxidizer system; inactive dry purge gases diluted with clean dry air (CDA) through dedicated facility exhaust prior to atmospheric release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nitrogen (Gas, UHP Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 (99.9999% purity, VLSI Grade) | `100.0%` |
| **Oxygen (Gas, UHP Dry Oxidation)** | `7782-44-7` | Grade 5.5 (99.9995% purity, Electronic Grade) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-diffusion RCA-cleaned (SC-1, dilute HF 50:1 etch, SC-2 rinsed, spin-rinse dried) silicon wafers with hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated (Si-H) native oxide-free surface (< 0.2 nm native oxide).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thermally stabilized furnace tube idling at 850°C under continuous 2.0 SLPM UHP N2 blanketing, conditioned and ready for immediate gate oxidation wafer load transfer.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient cleanroom air Q-time causes uncontrolled native oxide growth (> 0.6 nm) and airborne organic/molecular contamination (siloxanes/hydrocarbons), resulting in gate dielectric interface trap density (Dit) degradation, fixed charge buildup, and gate oxide breakdown voltage variability.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful baseline establishment of a 350 mm isothermal center flat zone at 850°C across the 3-zone horizontal quartz diffusion furnace, verifying temperature uniformity within ±0.5°C under continuous process-simulating laminar gas flow (3.0 SLPM UHP N2). Fully tuned and decoupled PID parameter tables deliver stable steady-state thermal behavior with zero overshoot and acceptable recovery dynamics under automated boat movement.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `thermal_flatzone_850C_profile_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `pid_zone_tuning_and_decoupling_report.pdf`
- [ ] `nine_point_static_stability_chart.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Static axial temperature uniformity across the 300 mm central wafer flat zone at 850°C** | `850.0°C` | ±0.50°C | Multi-point profile measurement using calibrated 9-junction Type-R thermocouple paddle logged across 30 minutes at 1 Hz |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum dynamic temperature recovery time post-cantilever boat loading** | `20.0 minutes` | +5.0 minutes maximum | Automated acquisition logging of center zone thermocouple recovery to within ±0.5°C of setpoint following 40 mm/min boat insertion |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Temporal temperature drift at center zone during steady-state idle under 3.0 SLPM N2** | `0.0°C/hr` | ±0.20°C/hr | Continuous 4-hour internal control thermocouple drift assessment via digital controller logging |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 profiling thermocouple measurement points across the central 300 mm wafer processing zone maintain 850.0°C ± 0.50°C concurrently for >= 30 consecutive minutes under 3.0 SLPM UHP N2 flow; PID gain decoupling coefficients are committed to furnace controller memory; formal sign-off report co-signed by Process Integration Lead and Furnace Tool Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP Title: Type-S Quartz Thermocouple Profiling Rig Setup & PID Baseline Tuning at 850°C
**Process Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C) > Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry O2 Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C) > Quartz Furnace Tube Prep, Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & MFC Gas Calibration > Three-Zone PID Thermal Flat-Zone Profiling at 850°C (±0.5°C Uniformity)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Inspect Type-S     │
│  Quartz Thermocouple  │
│          Rig          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Insert Rig via     │
│    Cantilever Boat    │
│        Loader         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Establish Pure N2   │
│      Purge Flow       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Execute Three-Zone   │
│  Baseline Tuning at   │
│         850°C         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Log Flat-Zone     │
│  Uniformity & Verify  │
│       Criteria        │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Rig Pre-Inspection & Assembly**:
   - Inspect the profiling rig comprising multi-junction Type-S (Platinum-Rhodium) thermocouples encased in high-purity fused silica quartz thermowells.
   - Verify junction placement spans the Load, Center, and Source heating zones across the central 300 mm (30 cm) wafer boat region.
   - Connect the Type-S reference junctions to the triple-loop digital PID profiling acquisition module.

2. **Furnace Insertion & Thermal Shock Prevention**:
   - Position the quartz profiling rig onto the cantilever paddle/boat support.
   - Initiate motorized cantilever push into the high-purity quartz process tube at a mechanical insertion speed strictly controlled to $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid mechanical deformation and thermal shock.
   - Seal the tube end-cap flange and engage the process exhaust.

3. **Atmosphere Stabilization via MFC**:
   - Establish a laminar carrier gas flow by setting the ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ mass flow controller (MFC) between $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
   - Ensure tube pressure and flow dynamics stabilize before initiating high-temperature ramp sequences.

4. **PID Baseline Tuning & Feedforward Decoupling**:
   - Set the multi-zone digital PID controller setpoints to $850^\circ\text{C}$ across all three zones (Load, Center, Source).
   - Engage feedforward decoupling loops on the Load and Source zones to compensate for convective end-losses against the central flat zone.
   - Allow furnace temperature to stabilize at steady state for a minimum of 60 minutes.

5. **Thermal Flat-Zone Profiling & Verification**:
   - Acquire temperature data simultaneously across all profiling junctions.
   - Verify that all points along the 300 mm central wafer flat zone remain within target tolerance.
   - Upon completion, retract the thermocouple rig at $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rig Mechanical Insertion / Retraction Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Cantilever Drive Encoder / Controller Log |
| **Carrier Gas ($\text{N}_2$ Purge) Flow Rate** | $1 \text{ to } 5$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Log |
| **Flat-Zone Length** | $300$ ($30$) | $\text{mm}$ ($\text{cm}$) | Profiling Rig Junction Map & Quartz Tube Layout |
| **Temperature Flat-Zone Uniformity at 850°C** | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type-S Thermocouple Acquisition Data |

---

### Literature Citations

- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - *Heating & Thermocouples*: Fused silica quartz thermowells encasing Platinum-Rhodium (Type S or Type R) thermocouples across Load, Center, and Source zones; triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
  - *Uniformity & Flat Zone*: Maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region between $800^\circ\text{C}$ and $1150^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Gas Dynamics*: Regulated laminar carrier gas flow at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ via mass flow controller (MFC).
  - *Thermal Shock Prevention*: Cantilever boat motion speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - *Furnace Equipment*: High-purity fused silica quartz process tube with 3-zone PID temperature control maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over a $30\text{ cm}$ ($300\text{ mm}$) flat zone.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Multi-zone thermal cross-talk between the Load, Center, and Source zones poses severe instability if single-loop PID controllers operate independently without a decoupling gain matrix. Installing a NIST-traceable multi-junction Type-S profiling thermocouple wand requires rigid mechanical concentricity within the fused silica process tube to prevent asymmetric convective boundary layer distortions under a 3.0 SLPM laminar N2 purge. Automated calibration software must enforce feedforward decoupling algorithms to prevent oscillatory thermal hunting across adjacent zones at the 850°C target.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM gate dielectric synthesis targeting 3.5 nm dry SiO2, a thermal fluctuation of just ±1.0°C translates to a ~0.15 nm physical oxide thickness variation, exceeding 4% of the nominal gate thickness and causing catastrophic threshold voltage (Vth) dispersion across the 200mm wafer array. Type-S (Pt-10%Rh vs Pt) thermocouples are susceptible to Rhodium migration and catalytic drift if metallic contamination is present; therefore, quartz sheath integrity (>99.999% high-purity fused silica) and absolute isolation from transition metals are paramount to prevent thermocouple degradation and localized wafer contamination during baseline 850°C profiling.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Pre-calibrated 5-point to 9-point multi-junction Type-S quartz profiling thermocouples with traceable NIST/DAkkS calibration certificates carry extended lead times of 10 to 14 weeks from specialized vendors (e.g., Heraeus Electro-Nite or Chino). Sourcing high-purity Kanthal-A1 or APM embedded element ceramic heating blocks alongside replacement quartz thermowells must include dual-vendor redundancy to insulate the Gen 1 pilot line from single-source supply chain disruptions in platinum-group metals.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal characterization and PID loop auto-tuning at 850°C reside on the critical path preceding dummy wafer runs and dry thermal oxidation qualification. All profiling hardware, digital multi-channel dataloggers, and furnace automation interlocks must be commissioned and accepted within a rigid 72-hour operational window. Failure to achieve stable ±0.5°C flat-zone convergence within 3 tuning iterations will trigger an immediate engineering escalation and stall subsequent 3.5 nm gate oxide baseline recipes.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:

1. Mechanical quartz thermowell fracture or micro-cracking during profiling rig insertion at high traverse velocity (>50 mm/min), exposing Type-S platinum-rhodium junctions to ambient air and inducing rapid thermoelectric emf drift.
1. Thermocouple Rhodium volatilization and surface contamination from alkali/transition metal trace residues, inducing a spurious negative drift in reported mV signals and causing runaway furnace overheating.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Zone Dynamic Feedforward Loop Optimization for 300 mm Flat Zone (±0.5°C)

**Module:** Thermal Oxidation / 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth  
**Document ID:** SOP-DIFF-OX-007  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm DRAM  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture

Maintaining strict thermal uniformity across the 300 mm central wafer flat zone is critical for dry gate oxide thickness repeatability ($3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$, $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$). This procedure optimizes the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller by tuning the feedforward decoupling gain matrices across Load, Center, and Source heating zones to suppress convective and radiative end losses during gas switching and wafer boat transfers.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Initialize Furnace & Profiling Spike TC"] --> B["Establish Laminar Carrier Gas Baseline (N2 1-5 SLPM)"]
    B --> C["Dynamic Disturbance Injection (Gas Flow & Ramp)"]
    C --> D["Measure Cross-Coupled Thermal Gradients"]
    D --> E["Tune Multi-Zone Feedforward Decoupling Matrix"]
    E --> F["Perform Dynamic Verification Sweep at 850°C"]
    F --> G["Lock Production Thermal Profile (±0.5°C)"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Check & Thermocouple Setup:**
   - Verify that quartz thermowells house calibrated Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples across Load, Center, and Source zones.
   - Insert a profile thermocouple test rake spanning the central 300 mm wafer boat region inside the fused silica process tube.
   - Set furnace baseline setpoint to $850^\circ\text{C}$ on all three zones.

2. **Carrier Gas Flow Stabilization:**
   - Establish a steady laminar carrier gas flow using Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) calibrated between $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ ($N_2$ purge baseline).
   - Verify chamber pressure stability and confirm laminar boundary layer flow across the tube cross-section.

3. **Feedforward Decoupling Matrix Parameter Identification:**
   - Inject step-disturbances via MFC gas transitions (switching from $N_2$ to dry $O_2$ at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$).
   - Measure thermal transient droop across the Load zone (gas inlet/convective cooling) and Source zone (exhaust radiative loss).
   - Calculate cross-zone coupling coefficients ($K_{Load\to Center}$, $K_{Source\to Center}$). Adjust feedforward gain in the digital triple-loop PID controller so power compensation applies concurrently with gas valve actuation before Center zone error manifests.

4. **Boat Motion Thermal Shock & Feedforward Compensation:**
   - Configure mechanical wafer boat push/pull insertion mechanism to a speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
   - Characterize heat sink load as the boat enters the Load zone. Map dynamic feedforward power boost to the Load zone heater (Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$) synchronized with boat motor travel position.

5. **Closed-Loop Verification & Lock:**
   - Execute a full thermal recipe cycle at $850^\circ\text{C}$ simulating process conditions.
   - Log profile thermocouple data across the entire 300 mm boat area for $\ge 30\text{ minutes}$.
   - Ensure deviations remain within the $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ window before certifying the furnace tube for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal gate oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Thermal Flat Zone & Dynamic Feedforward Target Specs
                           ┌───────────────────────────┐
                           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
           Flat Zone Length┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                           │▒                          │
     Carrier Gas Flow (MFC)┤▒                          │
       Boat Push/Pull Speed┤▓▓▓▓▓                      │
                           │▓▓▓▓▓                      │
Temp Uniformity (Flat Zone)┤█                          │
                           │█                          │
                           └┬──────┬─────┬──────┬─────┬┘
                            0     75    150    225  300 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Specification | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** across $300\text{ mm}$ boat zone | Type R / Type S profile thermocouple rake |
| **Isothermal Flat-Zone Length** | **$\ge 300\text{ mm}$** ($30\text{ cm}$) central zone | Multi-point quartz profile probe |
| **Carrier Gas Mass Flow Rate** | **$1.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$** | Calibrated thermal MFC readback |
| **Wafer Boat Translation Speed** | **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** | Motorized cantilever push/pull drive encoder |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:**
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling across Load, Center, and Source zones with Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ elements.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region ($800^\circ\text{C}$ to $1150^\circ\text{C}$).
  - Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Laminar gas flow regulation via MFC at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - Mechanical boat push/pull speed limit of $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - High-purity quartz process tube (fused silica) with 3-zone PID controller maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over $30\text{ cm}$ ($300\text{ mm}$) flat zone.
  - Interface dielectric target: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ dry oxide ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Strict prerequisite on upstream SC-1 / DHF 1:50 / SC-2 chemical clean. Wafers must enter furnace tube within <= 30 minutes of DHF dip to prevent uncontrolled native oxide regrowth.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Deal-Grove kinetic regime at 850°C-1000°C requires dry O2 with < 1 ppm moisture for gate oxide (3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm). Field wet oxidation (350 nm) requires pyrogenic H2/O2 torch. Flat-zone temperature uniformity must hold within +/- 0.5°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-purity electronic grade Quartz process tube (100mm-150mm) and SiC boat must be sourced COTS; do not attempt local machining of quartz seals.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 36 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (Thermal overshoot > 5°C alters gate oxide thickness by > 15%, shifting MOS threshold voltage Vth outside 0.45V +/- 0.05V).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Furnace thermal gradient (> +/- 1.5°C) across wafer diameter causing non-uniform oxide breakdown.
1. Sodium/potassium ionic contamination in quartz tube causing mobile ionic gate oxide hysteresis.
1. Delayed furnace insertion causing native oxide regrowth and degraded Si-SiO2 interface state density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-2-2-01` | **Gate Dielectric Thickness & Refractive Index Ellipsometry** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (J.A. Woollam / Rudolph AutoEL) with 632.8 nm He-Ne Laser | 1. Calibrate ellipsometer against standard bare silicon calibration reference. 2. Execute 9-point radial wafer scan across 100mm/150mm substrate (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge at 5mm exclusion). 3. Extract physical film thickness Tox and refractive index n_ox from Cauchy model fit. | `Gate Tox: 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm (Pass); Refractive index n_ox: 1.457 +/- 0.005 (Pass); Radial non-uniformity <= 2.5% (Pass).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-2-2-02` | **High-Field Dielectric Breakdown & Interface Trap Density (C-V)** | Mercury Probe (Materials Development Corp) & 1 MHz C-V Impedance Analyzer | 1. Form temporary mercury Schottky/MOS dot contact (area = 0.001 cm2). 2. Sweep gate voltage from accumulation (-3V) to deep inversion (+3V) at 1 MHz to record high-frequency C-V curve. 3. Ramp electric field until dielectric hard breakdown occurs (I_gate > 100 uA). | `Breakdown field E_ox >= 10.0 MV/cm (Pass); Midgap interface state density Dit <= 2e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: High-temperature aluminized Kevlar thermal gloves (rated to 500°C for wafer boat loading), Infrared/UV protective safety glasses (shade 3.0), Cotton cleanroom lab coat (non-synthetic to prevent melting)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn first aid station: Cold sterile water irrigation, hydrogel burn dressing. For high-temp quartz contact, seek immediate medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Quartz process tube exhaust scavenger with continuous N2 ballast (> 100 CFM flow rate). Flame safety interlock on pyrogenic H2/O2 burner torch.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Thermal effluent passing through point-of-use burn box / thermal combustor before facility exhaust stack.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oxygen (O2)** | `7782-44-7` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP 99.999%) | `100% dry gas (< 1 ppm H2O)` |
| **Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Electronic Grade UHP (99.9999%) | `Furnace idle purge gas (< 0.1 ppm H2O)` |
| **Hydrogen (H2)** | `1333-74-0` | Research Grade 99.999% | `Pyrogenic torch wet ox (LEL 4.0% - Explosion Risk)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed H-terminated silicon post-DHF dip with zero airborne molecular contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Grown thermal SiO2 dielectric layer (3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm dry ox or 350 nm wet ox), highly uniform.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Adsorption of airborne trace organics or sodium ions onto unoxidized wafer leads to mobile charge hysteresis and premature gate dielectric breakdown (E_ox < 6 MV/cm).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Multi-Zone Dynamic Feedforward Loop Optimization for 300mm Flat Zone (±0.5°C): Controlled thermal dielectric growth achieves target thickness uniformity across wafer diameter with minimal interface trap density and verified dielectric breakdown field.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Spectroscopic_Ellipsometry_25_point_map.csv`
- [ ] `MOS_CV_quasi_static_characterization.pdf`
- [ ] `Furnace_flat_zone_pyrometer_log.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Thermal oxide film thickness (Tox)** | `3.5 nm (gate) / 350 nm (field)` | +/- 0.2 nm (gate) / +/- 5.0 nm (field) | Multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometry across 25 wafer sites |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Dielectric breakdown field strength (E_bd)** | `>= 10.0 MV/cm` | Zero premature breakdown below 8.0 MV/cm | Ramped voltage dielectric breakdown (J-E curve) on MOS test capacitors |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Si-SiO2 interface trap density (Dit)** | `<= 1.0e11 eV^-1 cm^-2` | Max upper bound at midgap | High-low frequency C-V technique (Terman method) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 25-point film thickness radial uniformity within <= +/- 2.5%; breakdown field E_bd >= 10 MV/cm with mobile ionic charge flatband hysteresis Delta Vfb <= 50 mV.

critics.supply_chain: Supply Chain veto: High-purity electronic grade Quartz process tube (100mm-150mm) and SiC boat must be sourced COTS; do not attempt local machining of quartz seals.
critics.laya_pm: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 36 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (Thermal overshoot > 5°C alters gate oxide thickness by > 15%, shifting MOS threshold voltage Vth outside 0.45V +/- 0.05V).
critical_failure_modes: Furnace thermal gradient (> +/- 1.5°C) across wafer diameter causing non-uniform oxide breakdown.
Sodium/potassium ionic contamination in quartz tube causing mobile ionic gate oxide hysteresis.
Delayed furnace insertion causing native oxide regrowth and degraded Si-SiO2 interface state density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2).

testcases.title: Gate Dielectric Thickness & Refractive Index Ellipsometry
testcases.instrumentation: Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (J.A. Woollam / Rudolph AutoEL) with 632.8 nm He-Ne Laser
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer cooled to ambient 22°C in Class 100 laminar clean bench post-furnace pull.
testcases.procedure:
1. Calibrate ellipsometer against standard bare silicon calibration reference.
2. Execute 9-point radial wafer scan across 100mm/150mm substrate (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge at 5mm exclusion).
3. Extract physical film thickness Tox and refractive index n_ox from Cauchy model fit.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Gate Tox: 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm (Pass); Refractive index n_ox: 1.457 +/- 0.005 (Pass); Radial non-uniformity <= 2.5% (Pass).

testcases.title: High-Field Dielectric Breakdown & Interface Trap Density (C-V)
testcases.instrumentation: Mercury Probe (Materials Development Corp) & 1 MHz C-V Impedance Analyzer
testcases.pre_conditions: Backside native oxide stripped for ohmic contact; room temperature 22°C, dry N2 ambient.
testcases.procedure:
1. Form temporary mercury Schottky/MOS dot contact (area = 0.001 cm2).
2. Sweep gate voltage from accumulation (-3V) to deep inversion (+3V) at 1 MHz to record high-frequency C-V curve.
3. Ramp electric field until dielectric hard breakdown occurs (I_gate > 100 uA).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Breakdown field E_ox >= 10.0 MV/cm (Pass); Midgap interface state density Dit <= 2e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 (Pass).

ppe_required: High-temperature aluminized Kevlar thermal gloves (rated to 500°C for wafer boat loading)
Infrared/UV protective safety glasses (shade 3.0)
Cotton cleanroom lab coat (non-synthetic to prevent melting)

cas_chemicals.name: Nitrogen (N2)
cas_chemicals.concentration: Furnace idle purge gas (< 0.1 ppm H2O)

cas_chemicals.name: Hydrogen (H2)
cas_chemicals.concentration: Pyrogenic torch wet ox (LEL 4.0% - Explosion Risk)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Thermal burn first aid station: Cold sterile water irrigation, hydrogel burn dressing. For high-temp quartz contact, seek immediate medical evaluation.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Quartz process tube exhaust scavenger with continuous N2 ballast (> 100 CFM flow rate). Flame safety interlock on pyrogenic H2/O2 burner torch.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Thermal effluent passing through point-of-use burn box / thermal combustor before facility exhaust stack.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly rinsed H-terminated silicon post-DHF dip with zero airborne molecular contamination.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Grown thermal SiO2 dielectric layer (3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm dry ox or 350 nm wet ox), highly uniform.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Adsorption of airborne trace organics or sodium ions onto unoxidized wafer leads to mobile charge hysteresis and premature gate dielectric breakdown (E_ox < 6 MV/cm).

expected_result.summary: Completion of Multi-Zone Dynamic Feedforward Loop Optimization for 300mm Flat Zone (±0.5°C): Controlled thermal dielectric growth achieves target thickness uniformity across wafer diameter with minimal interface trap density and verified dielectric breakdown field.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Thermal oxide film thickness (Tox)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometry across 25 wafer sites

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Dielectric breakdown field strength (E_bd)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Ramped voltage dielectric breakdown (J-E curve) on MOS test capacitors

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Si-SiO2 interface trap density (Dit)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-low frequency C-V technique (Terman method)

expected_result.signoff_criteria: 25-point film thickness radial uniformity within <= +/- 2.5%; breakdown field E_bd >= 10 MV/cm with mobile ionic charge flatband hysteresis Delta Vfb <= 50 mV.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Steady-State In-Situ Profiling & Thermal Flat-Zone Metrology under 5 SLPM $\text{N}_2$ Purge  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN | 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Thermal Oxidation Module  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  

---

### Metrology & Control Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   1. N2 Purge Init 5   │
│          SLPM          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   2. Triple-Loop PID   │
│       Soak 850 C       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   3. In-Situ Quartz    │
│     Profile Sweep      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      4. Decoupled      │
│    Flat-Zone Tuning    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   5. Metrology Audit   │
│  +-0.5 C across 300mm  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Purge & MFC Baseline Verification**:
   - Establish steady laminar carrier flow by configuring the Mass Flow Controller (MFC) to deliver ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ at exactly **$5\text{ SLPM}$** into the horizontal quartz furnace tube.
   - Verify downstream exhaust back-pressure and tube sealing integrity under continuous purge.

2. **Thermal Soak & Multi-Zone Stabilization**:
   - Power the furnace heating elements (Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils) across all three zones: **Load**, **Center**, and **Source**.
   - Engage the triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling to ramp the furnace to **$850^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Hold at $850^\circ\text{C}$ for a minimum soak stabilization period under $5\text{ SLPM }\text{N}_2$ flow until convective end-losses reach steady-state equilibrium.

3. **In-Situ Profiling Assembly Insertion**:
   - Verify the multi-junction in-situ profiling thermocouple wand (Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium) encased in high-purity quartz thermowells.
   - Insert the calibration assembly / dummy wafer boat into the quartz tube using the mechanical cantilever paddle drive at a controlled speed strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and mechanical vibration.

4. **Multi-Point In-Situ Flat-Zone Metrology**:
   - Map temperature readings across the central **$300\text{ mm}$** wafer boat region.
   - Record continuous thermal profiles at defined axial intervals to evaluate convective offsets induced by the $5\text{ SLPM }\text{N}_2$ laminar stream between the gas inlet (Source) and exhaust/door (Load).

5. **Feedforward Decoupling Adjustment & Final Sign-Off**:
   - Tune individual zone trim offsets (Load Zone bias $\Delta T_{\text{Load}}$ and Source Zone bias $\Delta T_{\text{Source}}$ relative to the Center Zone) on the multi-loop PID controller.
   - Re-acquire profile data to verify that the central $300\text{ mm}$ flat zone maintains target uniformity prior to initiating dry gate oxidation recipes ($3.5\text{ nm }\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Purge Gas Flow Rate** | `5.0` | $\text{SLPM}$ ($\text{N}_2$) | Steady laminar setpoint ($1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ envelope) |
| **Nominal Soak Temperature** | `850.0` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Operating setpoint within $800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$ furnace range |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | `±0.5` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Maintained across central $\mathbf{300\text{ mm}}$ wafer boat region |
| **Boat Drive Insertion/Withdrawal Speed** | `< 50` | $\text{mm/min}$ | Hard maximum velocity to prevent thermal shock / slip dislocations |

---

### 3. Context Citations

* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - *Zones & Elements*: Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal molybdenum disilicide ($\text{MoSi}_2$) coils divided into Load, Center, and Source zones.
  - *Thermocouples & Instrumentation*: Platinum-Rhodium Type R or Type S thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells; triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
  - *Thermal Flat Zone*: Requirement to maintain $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region within $800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Gas Dynamics*: Regulated laminar carrier gas purge ($\text{N}_2$) via MFC within $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - *Thermal Shock Prevention*: Mechanical push/pull boat ramp rate constrained to $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
* **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Validates downstream gate dielectric target ($3.5\text{ nm }\text{SiO}_2$ for 180nm node) requiring steady-state thermal flat-zone precision at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Maintaining a steady-state flat zone under 5.0 SLPM continuous N2 purge requires close loop-coupling between the internal process-tube spike thermocouple assembly and the external heating element controllers. High gas velocity from the source flange creates convective heat loss disproportionately at the gas inlet zone, forcing the source PID loop to run at a higher power duty cycle than the center zone. Without calibrated feed-forward trimming for gas cooling, convective turbulence will destabilize the thermal boundary layer across the 350 mm process zone.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 3.5 nm dry gate oxide grown at 850°C, the Deal-Grove reaction operates in the linear surface-reaction rate limited regime where temperature variation has an exponential Arrhenius dependence (~2.0 eV activation energy). A temperature error of merely ±1.0°C translates to a ~3% gate oxide thickness drift (~0.1 nm), directly shifting transistor threshold voltage (Vth) and degrading subthreshold swing. Flat-zone thermal metrology under 5 SLPM N2 purge must achieve <= ±0.5°C across all wafer carrier slots to preserve gate dielectric integrity.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: In-situ multi-junction profile thermocouples (Type R/S Pt-Pt/Rh clad in ultra-high purity quartz sheaths) are subject to platinum drift and grain recrystallization during sustained 850°C operation. Sourcing certified 99.999% SiO2 sheaths is critical to prevent trace transition metal contamination (Fe, Cu, Ni) into the gate-quality furnace tube, and procurement lead times for NIST-traceable multi-point thermocouple calibration rigs must be secured well ahead of furnace qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal profiling under 5 SLPM N2 purge is a gating milestone before introducing pyrophoric or reactive gases (dry O2 / dilute HCl). Thermal stabilization time must be accurately quantified to prevent scheduling bottlenecks; recipe idle times exceeding 45 minutes for thermal re-equilibration will restrict run frequency and impact cleanroom wafer throughput.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal boundary layer distortion: Convective N2 entry at 5 SLPM induces cold-finger localized thermal sag (>1.5°C) at the first 50 mm of the wafer boat, leading to severe axial thickness non-uniformity.
1. Profile thermocouple drift/contamination: Sheath micro-cracks allowing quartz devitrification or metallic impurity outgassing, shifting thermocouple calibration by >2.0°C and invalidating furnace PID setpoints.
1. Back-diffusion of atmospheric oxygen/moisture: Exhaust check-valve malfunction or insufficient purge velocity during profiling allows ambient O2 ingress, triggering uncontrolled parasitic native oxidation on monitor wafers.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-2-3-01` | **Axial Multi-Point Thermal Flat-Zone Gradient Mapping under 5 SLPM N2** | 9-junction NIST-traceable Type-R Pt-Rh profiling thermocouple wand, quartz profiling paddle, Fluke 1586A Super-DAQ Precision Temperature Scanner, Alicat M-Series 0-10 SLPM N2 Mass Flow Controller. | 1. Insert the 9-junction profiling thermocouple wand axially into the furnace tube flat zone spanning 350 mm centered at furnace coordinate Z=0 mm. 2. Establish steady-state 5.00 SLPM N2 flow. 3. Log temperature readings on all 9 junctions at 1 Hz for 1800 seconds. 4. Calculate spatial temperature delta (T_max - T_min) across the 350 mm span and temporal peak-to-peak fluctuation per junction. | `Total spatial temperature deviation across the 350 mm center flat-zone must be <= ±0.50°C relative to 850.0°C; temporal stability over 30 minutes must satisfy standard deviation sigma <= 0.15°C across all 9 junctions.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-2-3-02` | **Thermal Flat-Zone Gas Flow Disturbance & Recovery Dynamic Response** | In-situ center-zone Type-S profile thermocouple, Eurotherm 3504 3-Zone PID Controller, calibrated mass flow controller with analog step-command trigger, high-speed data logger. | 1. Step N2 flow abruptly from 1.0 SLPM to 5.0 SLPM within 1.0 second via MFC setpoint step. 2. Record center-zone and source-zone temperature deviations at 5 Hz for 15 minutes. 3. Quantify maximum transient thermal undershoot and total stabilization time required to return within ±0.30°C of 850.0°C. | `Transient thermal undershoot during the 1 to 5 SLPM step must not exceed 2.0°C; system must fully recover and achieve steady-state flat-zone equilibrium (within ±0.30°C of 850.0°C) within <= 420 seconds.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: High-temperature aluminized Kevlar thermal gloves (rated >= 900°C contact), Full-face polycarbonate heat and UV shield, Flame-retardant cleanroom lab coat (Nomex), Safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Closed-toe cleanroom safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn emergency: Immediately flush affected skin with clean cold water for >= 20 minutes; do not apply salves; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek urgent medical evaluation. Asphyxiation hazard from N2: Move victim immediately to fresh air; if breathing is labored, administer oxygen by certified personnel; perform CPR if breathing ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Process tube connected to active dedicated scrubber/house exhaust maintaining a negative static pressure of -15 to -25 Pa relative to cleanroom bay; continuous oxygen depletion monitoring sensors (alarm threshold at < 19.5% O2) interlocked with furnace gas shut-off valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Nitrogen purge effluent routed through the cleanroom acid/toxic house exhaust ducting to prevent local room nitrogen buildup; no liquid neutralization required for pure N2 purge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 (99.9999% Ultra-High Purity) | `>= 99.9999% (H2O < 20 ppb, O2 < 10 ppb)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-cleaned Si monitor wafers subjected to standard RCA-1/RCA-2 and dilute HF (1:50) dip, rinsed to 18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity, dried via isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor, exhibiting 100% hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (water contact angle > 75°).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thermally stabilized, hydrogen-passivated or ultra-thin initial native oxide (< 0.5 nm) monitor wafer surface maintained under inert 5 SLPM N2 purge, zero organic hydrocarbon deposition, particle adders <= 5 at >= 0.18 um.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces parasitic native oxide growth (> 0.6 nm) and airborne molecular contamination (AMC, amine/siloxane adsorption), causing uncontrolled gate oxide thickness growth non-uniformity and interface state density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Demonstrated spatial thermal flat zone of 350 mm along the horizontal quartz furnace process tube at 850.0°C under continuous 5.0 SLPM N2 purge, meeting <= ±0.5°C total axial variation and <= 0.15°C temporal stability over 30 minutes.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FURNACE_850C_5SLPM_N2_PROFILING_LOG.csv`
- [ ] `THERMAL_FLATZONE_CALIBRATION_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `AXIAL_TEMPERATURE_PROFILE_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Furnace center flat-zone axial temperature uniformity across 350 mm process zone** | `850.0°C` | ±0.50°C | Multi-point 9-junction calibrated Type-R thermocouple wand logging at 1 Hz for 30 minutes across axial positions -175 mm to +175 mm |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Temporal temperature stability across center zone under 5.0 SLPM N2 continuous flow** | `0.08°C` | <= 0.15°C (1-sigma) | Continuous 1800-point time-series standard deviation analysis via Fluke 1586A Super-DAQ on center-zone thermocouple |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Mass flow controller delivery accuracy at 5.0 SLPM N2 purge rate** | `5.00 SLPM` | ±0.05 SLPM | NIST-traceable in-line dry piston flow calibrator (Mesa Labs Defender) verification |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 spatial thermocouple positions record within 849.50°C - 850.50°C continuously for 30 consecutive minutes under 5.0 SLPM N2 flow, transient recovery under step perturbation completes within 420 seconds, and calibration artifacts are validated and archived by the metrology lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Thermocouple Spike Validation & Baseline Oxide Growth Metrology
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB1-OX-180NM-006`  
**Classification:** Technical / Standard Operating Procedure (Gen 1 mm / 180nm Node)  
**Parent Process:** Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry $\text{O}_2$ Oxidation Recipe Execution ($850^\circ\text{C}$, Pure $\text{O}_2/\text{N}_2$ Dilution)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Pre-Furnace Setup    │
│     and Test Wafer     │
│        Loading         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Spike Profile      │
│   Insertion and PID    │
│   Thermal Balancing    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      850°C N2 Flow     │
│   Stabilization and    │
│    Dry O2 Oxidation    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Controlled Boat     │
│     Extraction and     │
│        Cooling         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  In-Line Ellipsometry  │
│     and Thickness      │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Furnace Inspection & Monitor Wafer Loading**:
   - Inspect the fused quartz tube (outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$ purity) and quartz thermowells for particulate contamination or devitrification.
   - Load pre-cleaned prime p-type test monitor wafers into the slotted quartz boat, positioning monitors across the **Load**, **Center**, and **Source** process regions.
2. **Spike Profile Insertion**:
   - Engage the profile thermocouple assembly (dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone encased in quartz thermowells).
   - Drive the quartz wafer boat into the furnace tube at a controlled insertion speed **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and suppress crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. **Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & PID Balancing**:
   - Set the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller to target **$850^\circ\text{C}$** across all three heating zones (Kanthal A1 / APM / $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils: Source, Center, and Load).
   - Validate thermocouple spike responses against feedforward decoupling loops until the central 300 mm to 350 mm wafer flat zone is isothermal with temperature variation $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
4. **Gas Sweep Stabilization & Dry Oxidation**:
   - Establish a baseline sweep of ultra-pure carrier $\text{N}_2$ at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** via calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) to maintain laminar flow and prevent ambient air back-diffusion.
   - Transition gas delivery to high-purity dry $\text{O}_2$ (99.999% purity) at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** (optionally diluted with ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ and 1% to 3% dry $\text{HCl}$ to getter mobile sodium ions and metallic impurities) at $850^\circ\text{C}$ to initiate baseline gate oxide growth targeting $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal thickness.
5. **Post-Oxidation Purge & Controlled Pull**:
   - Terminate active $\text{O}_2$ delivery and switch back to dry $\text{N}_2$ purge at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** for 10 minutes.
   - Extract the quartz boat at a mechanical retraction rate **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** into the nitrogen-purged load vestibule; cool to ambient cleanroom temperature ($< 100^\circ\text{C}$).
6. **Metrology & Baseline Oxide Validation**:
   - Transfer monitor wafers to the multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometer.
   - Execute a 49-point polar map across the wafer diameter to measure gate dielectric physical thickness ($\text{SiO}_2$) and cross-wafer non-uniformity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Units | Validation Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Zone Temperature Uniformity** | $850.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Dual Type-R/S Spike Thermocouple Profiler across $\ge 300\text{ mm}$ center flat zone |
| **Boat Ramp In/Out Speed** | $< 50.0$ | Max allowable: $49.9$ | $\text{mm/min}$ | Stepper motor encoder / furnace drive controller |
| **MFC Process Gas Flow Rate** | $2.0\text{ -- }5.0$ | $\pm 1.0\%$ Full Scale | $\text{SLPM}$ | In-situ calibrated thermal Mass Flow Controllers ($\text{O}_2$ / $\text{N}_2$) |
| **Baseline Gate Oxide Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ ($3.3\text{ -- }3.7$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (49-point wafer mapping) |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**:
  * *Parameters cited*: Horizontal fused quartz process tube ($150\text{ mm to }200\text{ mm OD}$, $99.999\%\text{ SiO}_2$ purity); 3-zone resistive heating element (Kanthal A1 / APM coils: Source, Center, Load); dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone; center flat zone uniformity $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (over $350\text{ mm}$); MFC gas delivery for high-purity $\text{O}_2$ ($99.999\%$), $\text{N}_2$, and dry $\text{HCl}$ ($1\text{--}3\%$); laminar flow sweep rate of $2.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$.
* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  * *Parameters cited*: Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells; $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ uniformity across central $300\text{ mm}$ region; gas delivery range of $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$; boat insertion/extraction speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  * *Parameters cited*: 180nm DRAM gate dielectric thermal oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness target.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal loop decoupling between the outer profile heater thermocouple and the inner quartz spike thermocouple is vulnerable to transient overshoot. Because dry gate oxide growth at 850°C to achieve a 3.5 nm film operates predominantly in the Deal-Grove reaction-controlled linear regime where oxidation rate depends exponentially on temperature (Arrhenius dependence with Ea ~ 2.0 eV), a mere 1.5°C transient spike during wafer boat insertion can induce a 5% to 8% thickness variance across the central 300 mm wafer flat zone. The feedforward cascade PID loop must be tuned specifically with derivative dampening during boat push/pull transitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm target gate oxide thickness, native oxide growth prior to insertion and uncontrolled initial oxidation during push-in under residual oxygen present extreme metrological hazards. Insertion must occur in an ultra-pure N2 environment at <= 50 mm/min boat speed to avoid slip dislocations and pre-oxidation. Furthermore, optical multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometry baseline calibrations must fix refractive index n = 1.465 and account for interface sub-oxide (SiOx, x < 2) transition layers (typically 0.4-0.6 nm), otherwise physical oxide thickness will be systematically overestimated by up to 15%.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Type-R (Pt-13% Rh vs Pt) and Type-S thermocouples encased in semiconductor-grade fused quartz thermowells face rhodium migration and grain recrystallization embrittlement over repetitive thermal cycling at 850°C-1000°C. High-purity ultra-dry quartz replacement tubes (hydroxyl content OH < 5 ppm) have lead times exceeding 16 weeks from global vendors (e.g., Heraeus, Tosoh). Sourcing redundant, pre-calibrated multi-junction profile spike thermocouple assemblies and traceable secondary calibration standards is critical to avoid single-point pilot fabrication stoppages.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Qualification of baseline oxide growth and spike validation gates the entire 180nm CMOS dry gate oxidation sequence. If temperature profile stabilization and baseline thickness run-to-run repeatability (Cpk >= 1.33) slip beyond the scheduled 5 working days, downstream poly-Si gate deposition and threshold implant metrology will be blocked. Clear milestone criteria must decouple mechanical profile profiling from spectroscopic wafer qualification runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal spike overshoot exceeding +1.0°C during wafer boat push-in due to untuned PID derivative gains, resulting in irreversible over-oxidation (>3.7 nm) and severe wafer-to-wafer gate thickness nonuniformity.
1. Trace ambient air or moisture back-streaming at the furnace load zone during boat transit due to inadequate N2 purge velocity (< 2.0 SLPM), inducing premature uncontrolled oxidation and elevated interface trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2).
1. Thermocouple calibration drift or quartz sheath devitrification causing unnoticed temperature offset, skewing Deal-Grove linear oxidation rate constants (B/B) and invalidating baseline metrology correlation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-3-01` | **Three-Zone Profile Thermocouple Dynamic Spike & Flat-Zone Uniformity Validation** | 9-point profiled calibration spike thermocouple array (Type-S Pt/Rh, NIST-traceable), digital 3-zone cascade PID furnace temperature controller with 0.1°C resolution, mechanical quartz push-pull paddle motor with optical velocity encoder. | 1. Set continuous data logging on all three internal spike thermocouples and external heater loop sensors at 1.0 Hz sampling rate. 2. Command wafer boat mechanical push-in at a constant 40 mm/min velocity across the 1200 mm stroke length under 4.0 SLPM ultra-pure N2 sweep. 3. Monitor and record peak transient temperature deviations (spikes/dips) in Source, Center, and Load zones during and after boat seating. 4. Allow furnace to recover to steady state for 20 minutes. 5. Record isothermal temperature values across the 300 mm center flat zone continuously for 60 minutes. | `Transient temperature overshoot/undershoot on all zones must not exceed +/- 1.0°C during and after boat push-in. Recovery time to 850.0°C +/- 0.5°C must be <= 12 minutes. Center zone 300 mm spatial temperature uniformity must remain within +/- 0.5°C steady-state throughout the 60-minute holding period.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-2-1-3-02` | **Baseline 3.5 nm Dry Thermal Oxide Growth & Cross-Wafer Thickness Metrology** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (wavelength range 190 nm - 1000 nm, beam spot size <= 1 mm), 4-point probe station, SEM/TEM cross-section metrology (qualification audit). | 1. Load monitor wafers at 5 designated boat positions (Slot 1 Load, Slot 12 Center-Front, Slot 25 Center, Slot 38 Center-Back, Slot 50 Source). 2. Execute automated dry oxidation recipe: push-in under N2 (40 mm/min), temperature stabilization at 850°C (10 min), dry O2 oxidation step at 3.5 SLPM, N2 purge flush (15 min), and pull-out under N2 (40 mm/min). 3. Transfer monitor wafers to Spectroscopic Ellipsometer within 30 minutes. 4. Measure oxide thickness using a 49-point polar map (5 mm edge exclusion) on all 5 monitor wafers, modeling optical dispersion with Cauchy/Sellmeier layer over crystalline Si substrate. | `Target thickness across Center monitor wafer must be 3.50 nm +/- 0.15 nm (3.35 nm to 3.65 nm). Within-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) must be <= 1.5%. Wafer-to-wafer thickness range across all 5 boat positions must be <= 0.25 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: High-temperature thermal aluminized aramid furnace gloves (rated >= 1000°C) with long gauntlets, UV/Infrared-filtering polycarbonate safety face shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Flame-resistant Nomex cleanroom lab coat, Chemical-resistant nitrile gloves over inner cotton liners for wafer loading/handling, Steel-toe ESD cleanroom safety footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn emergency: Immediately cool burned skin with copious clean cold water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply salves or oils; cover with sterile non-adherent dressing and seek immediate medical evaluation. DHF/HF skin contact emergency: Immediately strip contaminated clothing, flood skin with eyewash/drench shower for 2-3 minutes, vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected area until medical personnel arrive. In case of oxygen displacement/asphyxiation risk from N2 gas leakage: Move victim to fresh air, administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored, initiate CPR if pulseless.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative-pressure furnace scavenger exhaust box operating at >= 150 CFM with static pressure differential monitor (-0.2 to -0.5 in. w.g.) and interlocked low-flow alarm. Cleanroom ambient N2/O2 optical atmospheric depletion sensors positioned at breathing zone (alarm threshold < 19.5% O2). Dedicated acid wet-bench exhaust for DHF prep hoods operating at minimum face velocity of 100 FPM.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Furnace quartz tube process effluent passes through high-temperature point-of-use burn/wet exhaust scrubber. Pre-oxidation DHF rinse baths routed to industrial acid-waste neutralization (AWN) system utilizing automated 2-stage caustic (20% NaOH / Ca(OH)2) addition to precipitate calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge and neutralize effluent to pH 6.5 - 8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Compressed Oxygen Gas (Ultra-High Purity 99.999% dry O2)** | `7782-44-7` | Grade 5.0 (Electronic / Semiconductor Grade, H2O < 0.5 ppm) | `>= 99.999 vol%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Ultra-High Purity N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 (Carrier/Purge Grade, H2O < 0.1 ppm, O2 < 0.1 ppm) | `>= 99.9999 vol%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (pre-oxidation DHF wafer prep clean)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier C / MOS Grade | `0.5% - 1.0 wt% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated, native-oxide-free pristine silicon surface (100) immediately following dilute HF (0.5% DHF) etch, deionized water cascade rinse (resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm*cm), and spin-rinse dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Ultra-thin stoichiometric amorphous SiO2 dielectric film (3.5 nm +/- 0.15 nm), smooth planar interface (RMS roughness < 0.2 nm), hydrophilic, particles <= 5 at >= 0.16 um.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in cleanroom air results in uncontrolled native chemical oxide regrowth (0.3 - 0.7 nm SiOx) and airborne hydrocarbon/moisture condensation, causing gate oxide thickness drift (>3.8 nm total), poor dielectric breakdown field (< 10 MV/cm), and unacceptable threshold voltage shifts (delta-Vth > 50 mV) in 180nm core transistors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical, thermal, and metrological signoff of the three-zone quartz oxidation furnace at 850°C. Verified PID loop dynamic spike control without thermal overshoot (>1.0°C) during wafer push, proven isothermal flat zone (+/- 0.5°C across 300 mm), and validated baseline 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth meeting within-wafer uniformity <= 1.5% and run-to-run Cpk >= 1.33.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC_SPIKE_THERMAL_PROFILING_850C_RUN01.csv`
- [ ] `BASELINE_GATE_OX_3.5NM_ELLIPSOMETRY_49PT_MAP.pdf`
- [ ] `FURNACE_TUBE_SPIKE_CALIBRATION_CERT_SIGN_OFF.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum dynamic temperature spike overshoot across all 3 zones during 40 mm/min boat insertion** | `0.0°C` | <= +1.0°C peak transient | High-speed 1.0 Hz Pt-Rh Type-S spike thermocouple array data-logging during boat push sequence |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Center flat-zone steady-state temperature spatial uniformity over 300 mm wafer processing length at 850°C** | `850.0°C` | +/- 0.5°C maximum deviation | Multi-point profiled thermocouple steady-state 60-minute holding thermal scan |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dry gate oxide baseline mean physical thickness on prime center monitor wafer** | `3.50 nm` | +/- 0.15 nm (3.35 nm - 3.65 nm) | 49-point polar spectroscopic ellipsometry map (n=1.465 fixed, 5 mm edge exclusion) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 3 quantitative assertions strictly met; ellipsometer wafer map demonstrates 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 1.5% on all 5 boat monitor locations; Q-time tracking logs confirm wafer clean-to-insertion interval <= 30 minutes; joint sign-off approved by Process Integration Lead and Metrology Module Engineer.
