# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-MOSCAP-001`
**Title:** MOS Capacitor Test Structure Calibration & Ellipsometer Recipe Standardization  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Council / Area:** Architecture & Integration / Thermal Processing / Metrology & Quality Assurance  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

The following vertical workflow details the standardization of the spectroscopic ellipsometry recipe and the fabrication/characterization of planar MOS capacitor (MOSCAP) test structures on thermally grown dry gate oxide.

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Substrate Prep:    │
│     P-type 100 Si     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Ellipsometer Recipe  │
│    Standardization    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Al Sputter Shadow   │
│       Mask Dots       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Backside Ohmic     │
│     Contact Metal     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  High-Frequency 1MHz  │
│     CV Metrology      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cross-Calibration:   │
│      Tox vs EOT       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Substrate Preparation & Dry Gate Oxidation
1. Load P-type (100) Silicon monitor/test wafers into the thermal oxidation quartz tube furnace.
2. Execute dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }900^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ ambient targeting a nominal physical $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ of $3.5\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 2: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Recipe Standardization
1. Calibrate the spectroscopic ellipsometer using a certified $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ reference standard.
2. Set model dielectric function: $\text{Si}$ substrate with a standard Cauchy/Sellmeier optical dispersion model for thin thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ film ($n \approx 1.46$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$).
3. Measure multi-point film thickness across the wafer to acquire initial non-destructive optical thickness ($t_{\text{ox,ellip}}$).

#### Step 3: MOSCAP Top Gate Electrode Deposition
1. Mount the oxidized wafer in the physical vapor deposition (PVD) sputtering chamber with a precision shadow mask.
2. Sputter pure Aluminum ($\text{Al}$) circular gate dots using shadow mask apertures with standard circular diameters:
   - Dot Diameters: $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Ensure clean dot edge definition and uniform metallic coverage without pinhole bridging.

#### Step 4: Backside Substrate Ohmic Contact Formation
1. Strip any native or thermal oxide from the wafer backside using selective buffered oxide etch / dilute HF swab or back-lap mechanical clean.
2. Deposit Gold ($\text{Au}$) or Aluminum ($\text{Al}$) metallization layer onto the unpolished wafer backside to form a low-resistance ohmic substrate contact.

#### Step 5: High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasi-Static C-V Metrology Execution
1. Place the fabricated MOSCAP device on a shielded probing station chuck connected to an LCR meter and parameter analyzer.
2. Sweep gate voltage $V_G$ from accumulation ($V_G < V_{\text{fb}}$) through depletion ($V_{\text{fb}} < V_G < V_T$) to inversion ($V_G > V_T$):
   - **High-Frequency C-V (1 MHz):** Acquire capacitance profile. In strong accumulation ($V_G \ll V_{\text{fb}}$), capacitance saturates at maximum oxide capacitance:
     $$C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\epsilon_{\text{ox}} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$$
   - **Quasi-Static / Low-Frequency C-V:** Monitor low-frequency inversion capacitance recovery to $C_{\text{ox}}$ via thermal electron generation-recombination.

#### Step 6: Test Structure Cross-Calibration & Recipe Tuning
1. Calculate electrical physical oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox,CV}}$ from the saturated accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{ox}}$ for each dot diameter ($200\ \mu\text{m}, 500\ \mu\text{m}, 1000\ \mu\text{m}$).
2. Correlate $t_{\text{ox,CV}}$ with the optical thickness $t_{\text{ox,ellip}}$ determined by spectroscopic ellipsometry.
3. Update and standardize the ellipsometer tool optical model offset to align within $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ against electrical C-V extracted physical thickness.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | 1 MHz High-Frequency C-V Accumulation Extraction |
| **Gate Dot Diameters (Shadow Mask)** | $200,\ 500,\ 1000$ | Nominal nominal mask sizing | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Metrology / Profilometry |
| **C-V Test Frequency** | $1.0$ | Exact ($1\text{ MHz}$) | $\text{MHz}$ | Impedance / Precision LCR Analyzer |
| **Dry Oxidation Furnace Temperature** | $850 - 900$ | Steady state process window | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermocouple Profiling / Furnace Controller |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
   - Substrate and top dot definition: P-type (100) Si, circular Aluminum gate dots ($200\ \mu\text{m}, 500\ \mu\text{m}, 1000\ \mu\text{m}$), and Gold or Aluminum backside ohmic contact.
   - High-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) accumulation saturation $C_{\text{ox}} = (\epsilon_{\text{ox}} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{\text{ox}}$ yielding physical oxide thickness with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.
   - Voltage operating regimes: Accumulation ($V_G < V_{\text{fb}}$), Depletion ($V_{\text{fb}} < V_G < V_T$), and Inversion ($V_G > V_T$).
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Gate dielectric parameters: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - DRAM node physical dimensions: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Correlating physical optical thickness measured via Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) at 3.5 nm with electrical Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from MOSCAP C-V profiling introduces systematic discrepancies if quantum mechanical confinement and poly-depletion/gate quantum effects are uncoupled. Sputtered circular aluminum gate dots introduce edge-fringing capacitance and shadow mask geometrical blur (~5-10 um penumbra), which distorts the active area normalization. Without exact optical constants (n, k) parameterized via Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz models accounting for the sub-stoichiometric SiOx interface layer (~0.4-0.8 nm), optical SE will underestimate EOT by up to 0.4 nm relative to C-V accumulation measurements.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm physical thickness, parasitic series resistance (Rs) and substrate back-contact non-idealities severely attenuate high-frequency (1 MHz) accumulation capacitance C_ox. A standard 2-element parallel circuit model yields inaccurate C_ox; a 3-element model (including Rs and substrate admittance) or two-frequency correction (e.g., Nicollian-Goetzberger at 100 kHz and 1 MHz) must be standardized in the recipe. Furthermore, Al sputtering directly onto 3.5 nm SiO2 without post-metallization forming gas annealing (FGA: 400°C, 10% H2/90% N2) leaves an unpassivated interface trap density (Dit > 1e12 eV^-1 cm^-2), creating severe stretch-out and hysteresis in the depletion-to-inversion transition.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision shadow masks fabricated from laser-cut invar/beryllium-copper foil with aperture diameters of 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um have single-source lead times and degrade through localized Al buildup, causing aperture shrinkage and edge burrs. High-purity 5N5 (99.9995%) Al sputtering targets and NIST-traceable 3.5 nm thermally grown SiO2 calibration standard wafers must be secured with certified ellipsometric delta/psi reference tables; local supplier substitutions of shadow masks with chemical-etched stainless steel risk mechanical particulate contamination and scratch damage on ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate dielectric.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The qualification schedule for Gen 1 (mm) baseline requires simultaneous lock-in of the SE optical recipe (wavelength range 190-850 nm, angle of incidence 65°-75°) and the multi-frequency C-V extraction automated script. Iterative delays in shadow-mask mounting and wafer alignment inside the sputtering chamber will blow through the tightly budgeted 30-minute post-oxidation queue time. We must enforce frozen recipe parameter sets across both tools rather than allowing ad-hoc operator adjustments during MOSCAP fabrication.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Shadow mask clamping friction causing mechanical rupture, micro-cracks, or pinholes across the 3.5 nm gate oxide, leading to catastrophic gate dielectric breakdown (J_gate > 1 A/cm2 at -1V).
1. Optical dispersion model mismatch (ignoring Si-SiO2 sub-oxide transition layer) causing spectroscopic ellipsometry algorithm divergence, resulting in an unphysical fitted refractive index (n < 1.40 or n > 1.55 at 632.8 nm) and >0.5 nm thickness measurement drift.
1. Backside silicon native oxide left intact prior to Al/Au metallization, forming a back-to-back Schottky barrier that collapses accumulation capacitance and corrupts Dit extraction via the Terman or High-Low frequency method.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Angle Delta-Psi Recipe Standardization for 3.5nm SiO2** | Variable Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE) with Xe Arc source (190 nm - 1000 nm), automated theta-2theta goniometer, micro-spot focusing optics (100 um spot size) | 1. Load 100 mm p-type wafer with 3.5 nm nominal dry gate oxide onto SE stage with vacuum lock. 2. Align beam normal and establish sample z-height using automated laser quadrant detector. 3. Acquire raw Psi and Delta spectra across 250 nm to 850 nm in 5 nm increments at three distinct incident angles: 65 deg, 70 deg, and 75 deg. 4. Execute standard optical fit using a 2-layer model: Si (substrate) / SiOx interface (0.5 nm EMA 50% Si + 50% SiO2) / SiO2 (Cauchy layer: An=1.457, Bn=0.00354 um^2, Cn=0). 5. Record mean square error (MSE), physical thickness (t_ox), and refractive index n at 632.8 nm across a 9-point diameter map (edge exclusion 5 mm). | `Model fit Goodness of Fit MSE <= 1.80; 9-point mean physical thickness t_ox = 3.50 nm +/- 0.15 nm; intra-wafer thickness standard deviation (1-sigma) <= 0.08 nm; fitted refractive index n @ 632.8 nm within 1.455 - 1.470.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-02` | **MOSCAP Multi-Frequency High-Frequency/Quasi-Static C-V Gate Oxide EOT and Dit Calibration** | Keysight B1505A / B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multi-Frequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), shielded semi-automatic probe station, dark Faraday box, vibration isolation table | 1. Position tungsten probe tip (radius 5 um) on 500 um circular Al gate dot inside shielded dark box. 2. Connect high-side terminal to gate and low-side terminal to chuck backside ohmic contact. 3. Perform C-V sweep from accumulation (-3.0 V) to deep inversion (+2.0 V) at frequencies 10 kHz, 100 kHz, and 1 MHz with 25 mV AC oscillation level and sweep rate 50 mV/s. 4. Extract series resistance Rs and calculate corrected oxide capacitance C_ox using dual-frequency Nicollian-Goetzberger algorithm. 5. Perform Quasi-Static C-V sweep (-3.0 V to +2.0 V, step delay 100 ms) and extract midgap Dit using High-Low (Castagne-Vapaille) method. 6. Calculate electrical EOT = (epsilon_SiO2 * epsilon_0 * Area) / C_ox. | `Series resistance Rs < 25.0 Ohm; C-V hysteresis Delta-Vfb (forward vs reverse sweep @ 100 kHz) <= 25 mV; extracted electrical EOT = 3.50 nm +/- 0.20 nm; interface trap density at midgap Dit <= 2.5e10 eV^-1 cm^-2; leakage current density J_gate @ V_G = -1.0 V <= 1.0e-4 A/cm^2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Acid-resistant neoprene gloves (double gloving over nitrile), Chemical-splash apron and face shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Cleanroom safety glasses with side shields, Closed-toe cleanroom ESD boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Calcium gluconate gel (2.5%) must be immediately accessible at wet bench. In case of HF skin exposure: immediately flush with high-volume emergency water for 2 minutes, then continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel into affected area until medical personnel arrive. Eye exposure: irrigate immediately with 1% calcium gluconate ophthalmic solution or isotonic saline for 15 minutes. Inhalation: move victim to fresh air, administer 100% oxygen; seek immediate advanced critical medical care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical hood dedicated to HF with face velocity verified at 100 +/- 10 fpm (0.5 m/s) with continuous magnehelic differential pressure monitoring. Dedicated fluoropolymer-lined exhaust ducting tied to central acid wet scrubber. Sputter tool high-vacuum turbomolecular pump exhaust tied directly to house toxic/flammable gas burn-box abatement unit.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: All HF spent rinse effluent routed to dedicated segregated fluoride waste drainage system; neutralize with calcium chloride / lime slurry (Ca(OH)2) to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) cake; verify supernatant pH between 6.5 and 8.5 and dissolved fluoride content < 10 ppm prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Hydrofluoric Acid (for pre-metallization oxide dip and backside clean)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier C / VLSI Grade | `0.5% to 2.0% aqueous solution` |
| **Forming Gas (Annealing ambient)** | `1333-74-0 (H2) / 7727-37-9 (N2)` | Grade 5.5 (99.9995%) | `10% H2 in 90% N2 balance (Non-flammable certified blend)` |
| **Aluminum Sputtering Target** | `7429-90-5` | 5N5 (99.9995%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry thermal SiO2 on P-type Si(100), atomically smooth (RMS roughness < 0.15 nm), hydrophobic-free stoichiometric oxide with zero airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Gate dot patterned MOSCAP wafer with 150-200 nm Al top electrode and backside Al ohmic contact, stored in dry N2 purged nitrogen desiccator (RH < 2%) ready for forming gas anneal and C-V probe characterization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne hydrocarbon and moisture adsorption onto 3.5 nm SiO2 surface, causing anomalous high interface state generation (Dit > 5e11 eV^-1 cm^-2), localized pinhole leakage, and variable shadow-mask adhesion resulting in Al dot edge lifting and inaccurate active gate area.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Standardized, fully converged Spectroscopic Ellipsometry optical recipe and calibrated MOSCAP C-V metrology flow validating 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thickness matching between optical SE (t_ox) and electrical C-V (EOT) within 0.15 nm, with interface trap density Dit <= 2.5e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 across Gen 1 test chips.

| `ASSERT-MOSCAP-02` | **Post-FGA MOSCAP interface trap density (Dit) at midgap (Et - Ei = 0 eV)** | `1.8e10 eV^-1 cm^-2` | <= 2.5e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 | Castagne-Vapaille High-Low Frequency C-V extraction between 100 kHz HF and Quasi-Static C-V curves. |

critics.systems_engineer: Correlating physical optical thickness measured via Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) at 3.5 nm with electrical Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from MOSCAP C-V profiling introduces systematic discrepancies if quantum mechanical confinement and poly-depletion/gate quantum effects are uncoupled. Sputtered circular aluminum gate dots introduce edge-fringing capacitance and shadow mask geometrical blur (~5-10 um penumbra), which distorts the active area normalization. Without exact optical constants (n, k) parameterized via Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz models accounting for the sub-stoichiometric SiOx interface layer (~0.4-0.8 nm), optical SE will underestimate EOT by up to 0.4 nm relative to C-V accumulation measurements.
critics.domain_expert: At 3.5 nm physical thickness, parasitic series resistance (Rs) and substrate back-contact non-idealities severely attenuate high-frequency (1 MHz) accumulation capacitance C_ox. A standard 2-element parallel circuit model yields inaccurate C_ox; a 3-element model (including Rs and substrate admittance) or two-frequency correction (e.g., Nicollian-Goetzberger at 100 kHz and 1 MHz) must be standardized in the recipe. Furthermore, Al sputtering directly onto 3.5 nm SiO2 without post-metallization forming gas annealing (FGA: 400°C, 10% H2/90% N2) leaves an unpassivated interface trap density (Dit > 1e12 eV^-1 cm^-2), creating severe stretch-out and hysteresis in the depletion-to-inversion transition.
critics.supply_chain: Precision shadow masks fabricated from laser-cut invar/beryllium-copper foil with aperture diameters of 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um have single-source lead times and degrade through localized Al buildup, causing aperture shrinkage and edge burrs. High-purity 5N5 (99.9995%) Al sputtering targets and NIST-traceable 3.5 nm thermally grown SiO2 calibration standard wafers must be secured with certified ellipsometric delta/psi reference tables; local supplier substitutions of shadow masks with chemical-etched stainless steel risk mechanical particulate contamination and scratch damage on ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate dielectric.
critics.laya_pm: The qualification schedule for Gen 1 (mm) baseline requires simultaneous lock-in of the SE optical recipe (wavelength range 190-850 nm, angle of incidence 65°-75°) and the multi-frequency C-V extraction automated script. Iterative delays in shadow-mask mounting and wafer alignment inside the sputtering chamber will blow through the tightly budgeted 30-minute post-oxidation queue time. We must enforce frozen recipe parameter sets across both tools rather than allowing ad-hoc operator adjustments during MOSCAP fabrication.
critical_failure_modes: Shadow mask clamping friction causing mechanical rupture, micro-cracks, or pinholes across the 3.5 nm gate oxide, leading to catastrophic gate dielectric breakdown (J_gate > 1 A/cm2 at -1V).

Optical dispersion model mismatch (ignoring Si-SiO2 sub-oxide transition layer) causing spectroscopic ellipsometry algorithm divergence, resulting in an unphysical fitted refractive index (n < 1.40 or n > 1.55 at 632.8 nm) and >0.5 nm thickness measurement drift.

Backside silicon native oxide left intact prior to Al/Au metallization, forming a back-to-back Schottky barrier that collapses accumulation capacitance and corrupts Dit extraction via the Terman or High-Low frequency method.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): MOS Capacitor Test Chip Layout & Probe Pad Mask Preparation

**Discipline / Category**: Circuit Design  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Layout must integrate guarded nested structures alongside open circular dots (200 um, 500 um, 1000 um) with dedicated Kelvin 4-point probe pad geometry to de-embed series resistance (R_s) and parasitic coaxial cable capacitance during 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V sweeps. Sputter shadow-mask mechanical tolerances (+/-25 um) or photolithographic hard-contact run-out must not clip scribe-line optical verniers or Karl Suss MA6 split-field WEC alignment targets.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm physical EOT, circular dot edge fringe fields and perimeter-to-area leakage current dominate over ideal bulk accumulation capacitance. The probe pad layout requires ring-dot guard structures with sub-5 um concentric spacing to isolate bulk C_ox from surface inversion channels, and guard against gate-dielectric soft-breakdown during quasi-static voltage ramps up to 2.5 V.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Soda-lime glass mask blanks suffer from high thermal expansion coefficients causing >1.5 um overlay drift across 100 mm wafers under high-intensity i-line/g-line exposure; quartz (fused silica) 5-inch x 5-inch 0.090-inch chrome mask plates with low-reflectivity AR chrome (Cr/CrOx) must be sourced to preserve dimensional fidelity down to the 2.0 um feature limit.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Clear-field versus dark-field tone polarity on the chrome mask must be explicitly aligned with whether positive resist (AZ 1518) or negative lift-off resist (LOR 3A + AZ 5214E) is utilized for the aluminum gate metallization step, preventing emergency mask rebuild cycles and 3-week project turnaround delays.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Series resistance artifact: Lack of backside gold/aluminum metallization or poor backside native oxide stripping causes deep C-V accumulation roll-off and false apparent physical oxide overestimation beyond 3.5 nm.
1. Mechanical puncture & gate rupture: Probe needle overdrive >5 um during high-frequency C-V contact punctures the thin sputtered Al gate and mechanically punches through the 3.5 nm SiO2 dielectric layer.
1. Edge-induced fringe capacitance: Inadequate guard-ring grounding introduces >8% parasitic edge capacitance error on the 200 um diameter circular MOSCAP dot.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-1-01` | **Karl Suss MA6 Hard Contact Photolithographic Pattern Transfer & Dot CD Verification** | Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner (i-line 365 nm, 350 W Hg lamp), Dektak XT Stylus Profilometer, Optical Critical Dimension (CD) Metrology System | 1. Mount mask plate onto MA6 mask holder with chrome side down and initiate WEC (Wedge Error Compensation) against dummy wafer with mechanical spherical air-bearing lock (<1 um parallelism). 2. Load oxidized wafer onto wafer chuck, perform split-field alignment to wafer flat/notches, and set exposure mode to Hard Contact (1.0 bar nitrogen underside chuck pressure). 3. Expose wafer to 365 nm UV at a measured dose of 120 mJ/cm2. 4. Post-exposure bake at 110°C for 60 seconds on vacuum hotplate. 5. Develop in AZ 726 MIF (2.38% TMAH) for 45 seconds at 21°C, followed by 18.2 MOhm-cm DI water quench for 60 seconds and N2 dry. 6. Measure developed circular pattern dot diameters (200 um, 500 um, 1000 um) across 5 wafer sites (center, north, south, east, west) using calibrated optical CD metrology. | `Dot diameter Critical Dimension (CD) within +/-1.0 um of target design across all 5 test sites; edge roughness 3-sigma < 0.15 um; resist sidewall angle >= 85 degrees; zero resist scumming or residual bridge defects in the 5 um guard-ring isolation trenches.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-1-02` | **MOSCAP Sputtered Al Probe Pad Metallization Step-Height and Adhesion Qualification** | DC Magnetron Sputter System, Dektak XT Stylus Profilometer, Automated 4-Point Probe, ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Adhesion Tester | 1. Sputter deposit 300 nm pure aluminum onto the patterned wafer at 400 W DC power, 3.0 mTorr Ar flow, substrate unheated (<80°C). 2. Perform resist lift-off in N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) ultrasonic bath at 60°C for 15 minutes, followed by isopropanol rinse and N2 dry. 3. Measure aluminum dot step height across 9 distributed probe pads via Dektak XT stylus profilometer (5 mg tracking force, 2 um/s scan speed). 4. Measure aluminum sheet resistance (R_sq) using 4-point probe. 5. Perform tape peel adhesion test on dedicated peripheral exclusion zone Al pads. | `Aluminum film thickness = 300 nm +/- 15 nm (step height 285 nm to 315 nm); sheet resistance R_sq <= 0.10 Ohm/sq; ASTM D3359 adhesion rating 5B (0% flaking or pad delamination); surface roughness Ra < 3.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level C Chemical Apron (heavy-duty butyl/neoprene), Nitrile inner gloves (4 mil) and Trionic heavy chemical outer gloves (polybutadiene/neoprene/nitrile, 20 mil), ANSI Z87.1 full-face poly-carbonate shield over safety splash goggles, UV-blocking 365 nm safety spectacles (OD > 5) for mask aligner inspection, Chemical-resistant steel-toe ESD safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH Contact: Fatal via dermal absorption; immediate flush with copious running water for minimum 15 minutes while stripping contaminated clothing; administer immediate emergency oxygen and transport to medical facility noting acute neurotoxin and cholinergic crisis risk. Piranha/Acid Burns: Flush skin with high-flow emergency shower for 15 minutes, apply saturated sodium bicarbonate solution to neutralize residual acid, seek urgent surgical evaluation. Eye Splash: Irrigate eyes in eyewash station holding eyelids open for minimum 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All wet-chemical processing (developer, piranha, solvent lift-off) must occur inside dedicated polypropylene wet chemical benches with face velocity maintained at 0.5 +/- 0.1 m/s (100 FPM) connected to scrubbed acid/base or solvent exhaust. Karl Suss MA6 housing must have continuous ozone exhaust (min 150 CFM) during 350 W Hg lamp operation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate TMAH aqueous developer waste into dedicated basic organic effluent carboys; do not mix with acids (exothermic and toxic off-gassing risk). Neutralize Piranha solutions by slow ice-bath cooling, dilution with 10x volume cold water, and pH titration with 10M NaOH to pH 6.0-9.0 prior to regulated waste intake. Spent NMP solvent collected in sealed, grounded stainless steel flammable waste barrels.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (AZ 726 MIF Developer)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C7) | `2.38% aqueous` |
| **N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP, Lift-off Solvent)** | `872-50-4` | VLSI Grade | `99.5%` |
| **Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS Primer)** | `999-97-3` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C1) | `99.9%` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha Mask Clean)** | `7664-93-9` | MOS Grade | `96.0%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Piranha Mask Clean)** | `7722-84-1` | MOS Grade | `30.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry thermal SiO2 on P-type (100) Si, chemically pristine, free of airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and volatile organic hydrocarbons (VOC), water contact angle < 10 degrees.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned and cured photoresist (or sputtered 300 nm Al gate dots) with clean exposed probe contact apertures, surface free of developer residues, moisture-free under dry N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne organic siloxane/hydrocarbon condensation on the 3.5 nm gate dielectric, creating trap-assisted tunneling states (Dit > 5e11 eV-1 cm-2), catastrophic C-V hysteresis (>50 mV), and premature dielectric soft-breakdown during accumulation stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified GDSII/OASIS layout tape-out and photolithographic chrome mask preparation delivering a complete array of circular Planar MOSCAP structures (200 um, 500 um, 1000 um diameters) with integrated guard rings, 100 um x 100 um Kelvin probe pads, and Karl Suss MA6 alignment verniers, validated for physical 3.5 nm gate oxide C-V and Dit characterization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_GEN1_LAYOUT_TAPE_OUT_V1.0.gds`
- [ ] `MA6_ALIGNMENT_AND_CD_METROLOGY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `MOSCAP_PAD_STEP_HEIGHT_AND_PROFILOMETRY.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Circular gate dot diameter physical dimensional tolerance after photolithography and metallization** | `200.0, 500.0, 1000.0 um` | +/- 1.0 um | Calibrated optical critical dimension (CD) metrology and SEM inspection across 5 wafer sites |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Aluminum gate electrode film thickness and probe pad step height** | `300.0 nm` | +/- 15.0 nm | Dektak XT stylus profilometry across 9 distributed probe pads |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Kelvin 4-point probe gate metallization sheet resistance** | `0.085 Ohm/sq` | <= 0.100 Ohm/sq | Automated 4-point probe electrical resistivity measurement |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% CD acceptance across all 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um MOSCAP dots (+/-1.0 um), zero catastrophic lift-off tear defects or guard-ring bridging, probe pad step height confirmed at 300 nm +/- 15 nm, and tape-adhesion test verified at ASTM 5B with clean electrical ohmic continuity to test probes.

critics.systems_engineer: Layout must integrate guarded nested structures alongside open circular dots (200 um, 500 um, 1000 um) with dedicated Kelvin 4-point probe pad geometry to de-embed series resistance (R_s) and parasitic coaxial cable capacitance during 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V sweeps. Sputter shadow-mask mechanical tolerances (+/-25 um) or photolithographic hard-contact run-out must not clip scribe-line optical verniers or Karl Suss MA6 split-field WEC alignment targets.
critics.domain_expert: At 3.5 nm physical EOT, circular dot edge fringe fields and perimeter-to-area leakage current dominate over ideal bulk accumulation capacitance. The probe pad layout requires ring-dot guard structures with sub-5 um concentric spacing to isolate bulk C_ox from surface inversion channels, and guard against gate-dielectric soft-breakdown during quasi-static voltage ramps up to 2.5 V.
critics.supply_chain: Soda-lime glass mask blanks suffer from high thermal expansion coefficients causing >1.5 um overlay drift across 100 mm wafers under high-intensity i-line/g-line exposure; quartz (fused silica) 5-inch x 5-inch 0.090-inch chrome mask plates with low-reflectivity AR chrome (Cr/CrOx) must be sourced to preserve dimensional fidelity down to the 2.0 um feature limit.
critics.laya_pm: Clear-field versus dark-field tone polarity on the chrome mask must be explicitly aligned with whether positive resist (AZ 1518) or negative lift-off resist (LOR 3A + AZ 5214E) is utilized for the aluminum gate metallization step, preventing emergency mask rebuild cycles and 3-week project turnaround delays.
critical_failure_modes: Series resistance artifact: Lack of backside gold/aluminum metallization or poor backside native oxide stripping causes deep C-V accumulation roll-off and false apparent physical oxide overestimation beyond 3.5 nm.

Mechanical puncture & gate rupture: Probe needle overdrive >5 um during high-frequency C-V contact punctures the thin sputtered Al gate and mechanically punches through the 3.5 nm SiO2 dielectric layer.
Edge-induced fringe capacitance: Inadequate guard-ring grounding introduces >8% parasitic edge capacitance error on the 200 um diameter circular MOSCAP dot.

testcases.title: Karl Suss MA6 Hard Contact Photolithographic Pattern Transfer & Dot CD Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner (i-line 365 nm, 350 W Hg lamp), Dektak XT Stylus Profilometer, Optical Critical Dimension (CD) Metrology System
testcases.pre_conditions: Fused silica chrome test mask cleaned in Piranha (4:1 H2SO4:H2O2) and dried at 120°C; 100 mm P-type Si (100) wafer with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide pre-baked at 150°C for dehydration and primed with HMDS vapor; AZ 1518 positive photoresist spun at 4000 rpm (1.8 um thickness) and soft-baked at 100°C for 60 seconds.
testcases.procedure: 1. Mount mask plate onto MA6 mask holder with chrome side down and initiate WEC (Wedge Error Compensation) against dummy wafer with mechanical spherical air-bearing lock (<1 um parallelism). 2. Load oxidized wafer onto wafer chuck, perform split-field alignment to wafer flat/notches, and set exposure mode to Hard Contact (1.0 bar nitrogen underside chuck pressure). 3. Expose wafer to 365 nm UV at a measured dose of 120 mJ/cm2. 4. Post-exposure bake at 110°C for 60 seconds on vacuum hotplate. 5. Develop in AZ 726 MIF (2.38% TMAH) for 45 seconds at 21°C, followed by 18.2 MOhm-cm DI water quench for 60 seconds and N2 dry. 6. Measure developed circular pattern dot diameters (200 um, 500 um, 1000 um) across 5 wafer sites (center, north, south, east, west) using calibrated optical CD metrology.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Dot diameter Critical Dimension (CD) within +/-1.0 um of target design across all 5 test sites; edge roughness 3-sigma < 0.15 um; resist sidewall angle >= 85 degrees; zero resist scumming or residual bridge defects in the 5 um guard-ring isolation trenches.

testcases.title: MOSCAP Sputtered Al Probe Pad Metallization Step-Height and Adhesion Qualification
testcases.instrumentation: DC Magnetron Sputter System, Dektak XT Stylus Profilometer, Automated 4-Point Probe, ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Adhesion Tester
testcases.pre_conditions: Patterned MOSCAP gate array post-development and soft plasma descum (O2 RIE, 50 W, 60 seconds); load lock base vacuum <= 5.0e-7 Torr; 99.999% pure Al sputtering target installed.
testcases.procedure: 1. Sputter deposit 300 nm pure aluminum onto the patterned wafer at 400 W DC power, 3.0 mTorr Ar flow, substrate unheated (<80°C). 2. Perform resist lift-off in N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) ultrasonic bath at 60°C for 15 minutes, followed by isopropanol rinse and N2 dry. 3. Measure aluminum dot step height across 9 distributed probe pads via Dektak XT stylus profilometer (5 mg tracking force, 2 um/s scan speed). 4. Measure aluminum sheet resistance (R_sq) using 4-point probe. 5. Perform tape peel adhesion test on dedicated peripheral exclusion zone Al pads.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Aluminum film thickness = 300 nm +/- 15 nm (step height 285 nm to 315 nm); sheet resistance R_sq <= 0.10 Ohm/sq; ASTM D3359 adhesion rating 5B (0% flaking or pad delamination); surface roughness Ra < 3.0 nm.

ppe_required: Level C Chemical Apron (heavy-duty butyl/neoprene)
Nitrile inner gloves (4 mil) and Trionic heavy chemical outer gloves (polybutadiene/neoprene/nitrile, 20 mil)
ANSI Z87.1 full-face poly-carbonate shield over safety splash goggles
UV-blocking 365 nm safety spectacles (OD > 5) for mask aligner inspection

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: TMAH Contact: Fatal via dermal absorption; immediate flush with copious running water for minimum 15 minutes while stripping contaminated clothing; administer immediate emergency oxygen and transport to medical facility noting acute neurotoxin and cholinergic crisis risk. quantitative_assertions.assertion: Circular gate dot diameter physical dimensional tolerance after photolithography and metallization
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Calibrated optical critical dimension (CD) metrology and SEM inspection across 5 wafer sites

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Aluminum gate electrode film thickness and probe pad step height
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Dektak XT stylus profilometry across 9 distributed probe pads

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Kelvin 4-point probe gate metallization sheet resistance
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated 4-point probe electrical resistivity measurement

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-SE-3.5NM-001`
**Title:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ Optical Dispersion Recipe Standardization  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology > MOS Capacitor Test Structure Calibration & Ellipsometer Recipe Standardization  
**Node / Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM, 850°C–900°C Dry Gate Dielectric)  
**Action Type:** Make / Standardize  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Start: Calibration &  │
│  Reference Wafer Load  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ellipsometer Optical  │
│   Alignment: 70 deg    │
│          AoI           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│      Polarization      │
│   Acquisition: Psi &   │
│         Delta          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Cauchy/Sellmeier    │
│    Dispersion Model    │
│       Regression       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   9-Point / 49-Point   │
│  Radial Wafer Mapping  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Criteria   │
│     Verification &     │
│      Recipe Lock       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Initialization & Reference Baseline Calibration:**
   - Load certified bare silicon reference substrate onto the automated vacuum chuck.
   - Execute baseline calibration to verify light source stability, polarizer angle offset, and analyzer signal-to-noise ratio across the spectroscopic UV-Vis range.
2. **Substrate Alignment & Angle of Incidence (AoI) Configuration:**
   - Transfer the 180 nm DRAM production qualification wafer with 3.5 nm thermally grown dry gate $\text{SiO}_2$ (grown at 850°C–900°C) into the measurement chamber.
   - Adjust optical beam spot alignment using z-height auto-focus and tilt tilt-goniometers.
   - Set the nominal goniometer angle of incidence (AoI) to $\sim 70^\circ$ (near the Brewster angle for the $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ interface) to maximize sensitivity to polarization phase shifts.
3. **Spectroscopic Polarization Measurement ($\Psi$ and $\Delta$ Acquisition):**
   - Acquire the complex reflectance ratio $\rho$ across the wavelength spectrum:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ denote complex Fresnel reflection coefficients for parallel and perpendicular polarization components.
4. **Optical Dispersion Modeling & Layer Regression:**
   - Build a two-layer optical stack: `Si_substrate / SiO2_dielectric / Ambient (Air)`.
   - Parameterize the $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric layer using a Cauchy or Sellmeier optical dispersion model to fit refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ ($k \approx 0$ for high-quality transparent gate oxide).
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ against modeled curves to extract physical film thickness $t_{ox}$ and optical dispersion coefficients.
5. **Automated Wafer Mapping & Recipe Lock:**
   - Execute automated 9-point or 49-point radial wafer mapping to capture center-to-edge radial film non-uniformity across the furnace growth zone.
   - Verify goodness of fit ($\text{MSE} \to \min$) and save the standardized recipe template as `RECIPE_SE_GATE_OX_3.5NM_REV1` in the factory MES/metrology controller.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ to }4.0 \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Mean Center Fit |
| **Measurement Precision Repeatability** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | 10-run Static Repeatability ($\sigma \le 0.05\text{ nm}$) |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Tracking** | $9\text{-point or }49\text{-point}$ | $\text{measurement sites}$ | Automated Radial Chuck Mapping |
| **Oxide Growth Temperature Baseline** | $850\text{ to }900$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Quartz Tube Furnace Thermal Pyrometer/TC |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source:** *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*
  - Fundamental Equation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical Modeling: Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models for parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Measurement Precision: Sub-Angstrom precision of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide.
  - Wafer Mapping: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial non-uniformity.
- **Source:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
  - Linear-parabolic model: $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$.
  - Dry Oxidation regime: Thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ for 180nm gate dielectric grown in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - Gate dielectric process specification: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) via $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical modeling of ultra-thin 3.5 nm SiO2 on Si substrates exhibits extreme mathematical correlation between film thickness (t_ox) and refractive index (n). At lambda = 632.8 nm, fixing n to bulk thermal SiO2 (1.4570) or using a Sellmeier/Cauchy model with pre-calibrated dispersion parameters is mandatory, as simultaneous unconstrained regression of both n and t causes non-unique fitting minima and thickness drift exceeding ±0.25 nm across tool recalibration cycles.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 3.5 nm dry gate dielectric, the presence of a sub-stoichiometric transition layer (SiOx interface, ~0.5-0.8 nm thick with n ~ 2.4-2.8) and adventitious airborne organic/water contamination (~0.2-0.4 nm optical equivalent) induces systematic thickness overestimation if modeled as an ideal single-layer crystalline Si/bulk SiO2 stack. The spectroscopic ellipsometry recipe must parameterize a fixed EMA (Effective Medium Approximation) interface or establish an optical thickness offset explicitly correlated to high-frequency C-V accumulation capacitance (EOT).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard calibration reference wafers (100 mm/150 mm certified thermal oxide reference standards with NIST-traceable thickness certificates) must be sourced from reputable metrology suppliers (e.g., VLSI Standards or J.A. Woollam). Sourcing delays or degradation of certified 2 nm and 10 nm SiO2 reference artefacts via ambient hydrocarbon adsorption can bottleneck cleanroom tool qualification and halt gate oxidation production lots.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Recipe standardization and Golden Wafer gauge R&R across multiple operational shifts must be executed within 3 working days to prevent upstream 180nm dry oxidation furnace runs from idling without metrology lot release. Measurement throughput must not exceed 90 seconds per wafer for standard 9-point mapping to maintain target fab cycle times.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parameter cross-correlation failure: floating Cauchy dispersion coefficients A_n and B_n simultaneously with film thickness on 3.5 nm oxide, leading to divergence in regression algorithms (MSE > 2.5) and erroneous thickness reports.
1. Organic adsorption skew: queue-time exceeded in ambient cleanroom air prior to measurement, adding 0.3-0.5 nm of airborne adventitious hydrocarbon/moisture layer misidentified as thermal oxide growth.
1. Substrate optical constant mismatch: relying on room-temperature literature c-Si dielectric tables without accounting for native wafer backside roughness or residual lattice stress, skewing Fresnel reflection coefficients r_p and r_s.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-2-01` | **NIST-Traceable Golden Standard Calibration and Gauge R&R for 3.5nm SiO2 Recipe** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer, spectral range 190 nm - 1000 nm, 70° angle of incidence, 30 um microspot) | 1. Perform automated hardware baseline calibration against silicon reference mirror to verify polarimeter alignment and dark noise. 2. Load certified reference wafer and acquire spectroscopic raw data (Psi, Delta) from 250 nm to 850 nm at 70° AOI at wafer center. 3. Execute fixed-index model regression (SiO2 Cauchy dispersion: A_n = 1.4570, B_n = 0.00354 um^2, k = 0) with a 0.6 nm SiOx interface layer. 4. Record extracted thickness t_ox and Mean Squared Error (MSE). 5. Repeat acquisition 30 consecutive times without unchucking to calculate static 1-sigma repeatability. 6. Perform 10 load-unload cycles to quantify dynamic gauge reproducibility. | `Static repeatability 1-sigma <= 0.015 nm (0.15 A); Dynamic reproducibility 3-sigma <= 0.050 nm (0.50 A); Goodness-of-fit MSE <= 1.20; Absolute deviation from certified standard thickness <= ±0.04 nm.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-2-02` | **49-Point Full Wafer Uniformity and Radial Dispersion Mapping of 3.5nm Gate Oxide** | Automated Production Spectroscopic Ellipsometer with motorized r-theta wafer mapping stage and pattern recognition alignment | 1. Load oxidation monitor wafer via automated robotic handler; engage vacuum chuck. 2. Align wafer notch and auto-focus optical beam to surface normal within 0.01°. 3. Execute standardized 49-point polar map recipe covering radial distances from center to 5 mm edge exclusion. 4. Acquire spectroscopic spectra (Psi, Delta) from 300 nm to 800 nm per point. 5. Process fitting using the standardized fixed-dispersion gate oxide model. 6. Generate wafer thickness map, computing mean thickness, standard deviation (sigma), range (max - min), and percentage non-uniformity [(max - min) / (2 * mean) * 100]. | `Mean thickness: 3.50 nm ± 0.10 nm; Wafer radial non-uniformity: <= 1.50% (1-sigma <= 0.035 nm); Maximum fit MSE across all 49 points <= 1.50 with zero unmapped or unconverged points.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, static-dissipative), Polycarbonate UV-filtering laser/optical safety glasses (OD4+ at 190-400 nm for deep UV Xe lamp inspection), Standard ESD-safe cleanroom coverall gown, hood, and boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA skin contact, wash thoroughly with cleanroom DI water for 15 minutes. In case of vapor inhalation or asphyxiation warning from N2 displacement, remove person to fresh air immediately and administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For UV arc lamp flash exposure, irrigate eyes with sterile isotonic saline and seek ophthalmologic evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool enclosure requires constant cleanroom laminar HEPA downflow (0.45 m/s ± 0.05 m/s). Ellipsometer lamp housing must be connected to local equipment exhaust (minimum 50 CFM) to eliminate ozone (O3) generated by deep-UV photolysis of ambient O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA lint-free cleaning wipes must be collected in closed, dedicated solvent waste containers with airtight self-closing lids and disposed of in accordance with hazardous solvent cleanroom protocol. Solid wafer breakage shards collected in dedicated puncture-proof sharps disposal containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, for chuck wipe)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 / Electronic Grade | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge and Chuck Float)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on Si(100), stoichiometric SiO2 terminated with minimal silanol (Si-OH) groups, post-oxidation furnace cool-down completed under high-purity N2 ambient.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Optically characterized, non-contact inspected wafer with pristine, particulate-free dry gate dielectric surface, ready for gate polysilicon deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes ambient volatile organic compound (VOC) and moisture physisorption, introducing an adventitious contamination film that falsely skews ellipsometric optical thickness by +0.2 nm to +0.4 nm and degrades gate oxide C-V Dit characteristics.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Standardized and validated spectroscopic ellipsometry recipe for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide (SiO2) on 150mm Si(100) wafers. The optical model fixes Si substrate optical constants (c-Si 300K library) and employs a calibrated Cauchy dispersion model for SiO2 (A_n = 1.4570, B_n = 0.00354 um^2) with a 0.6 nm SiOx interfacial transition layer, achieving sub-Angstrom measurement precision and full 49-point wafer mapping within 90 seconds.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RECIPE-ELLIP-3P5NM-SIO2-V1.0.recipe`
- [ ] `METROLOGY_GAUGE_RR_REPORT_3P5NM.pdf`
- [ ] `WAFER_49PT_UNIFORMITY_MAP_LOT01.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Static measurement repeatability (1-sigma over 30 consecutive runs)** | `0.010 nm` | <= 0.015 nm | 30 consecutive static spectral acquisitions on central site of 3.5 nm oxide monitor wafer |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Optical model regression goodness-of-fit (MSE)** | `0.95` | <= 1.20 | Marquardt-Levenberg nonlinear regression algorithm fit across 250 nm to 850 nm spectrum |
| `ASSERT-03` | **49-point wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean)** | `0.85%` | <= 1.50% | Automated 49-point polar mapping on 150mm wafer with 5mm edge exclusion |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Recipe qualification passes with Gauge R&R <= 10% of process tolerance window (±0.15 nm), static repeatability 1-sigma <= 0.015 nm, MSE <= 1.20 across all 49 mapping points, and formal joint sign-off by Metrology Lead, Thermal Processing Lead, and QA Manager.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, static-dissipative)
Polycarbonate UV-filtering laser/optical safety glasses (OD4+ at 190-400 nm for deep UV Xe lamp inspection)
Standard ESD-safe cleanroom coverall gown, hood, and boots
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of IPA skin contact, wash thoroughly with cleanroom DI water for 15 minutes. In case of vapor inhalation or asphyxiation warning from N2 displacement, remove person to fresh air immediately and administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For UV arc lamp flash exposure, irrigate eyes with sterile isotonic saline and seek ophthalmologic evaluation.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Tool enclosure requires constant cleanroom laminar HEPA downflow (0.45 m/s ± 0.05 m/s). Ellipsometer lamp housing must be connected to local equipment exhaust (minimum 50 CFM) to eliminate ozone (O3) generated by deep-UV photolysis of ambient O2.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: IPA lint-free cleaning wipes must be collected in closed, dedicated solvent waste containers with airtight self-closing lids and disposed of in accordance with hazardous solvent cleanroom protocol. Solid wafer breakage shards collected in dedicated puncture-proof sharps disposal containers.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on Si(100), stoichiometric SiO2 terminated with minimal silanol (Si-OH) groups, post-oxidation furnace cool-down completed under high-purity N2 ambient.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Optically characterized, non-contact inspected wafer with pristine, particulate-free dry gate dielectric surface, ready for gate polysilicon deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes ambient volatile organic compound (VOC) and moisture physisorption, introducing an adventitious contamination film that falsely skews ellipsometric optical thickness by +0.2 nm to +0.4 nm and degrades gate oxide C-V Dit characteristics.

expected_result.summary: Standardized and validated spectroscopic ellipsometry recipe for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide (SiO2) on 150mm Si(100) wafers. The optical model fixes Si substrate optical constants (c-Si 300K library) and employs a calibrated Cauchy dispersion model for SiO2 (A_n = 1.4570, B_n = 0.00354 um^2) with a 0.6 nm SiOx interfacial transition layer, achieving sub-Angstrom measurement precision and full 49-point wafer mapping within 90 seconds.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Static measurement repeatability (1-sigma over 30 consecutive runs)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 30 consecutive static spectral acquisitions on central site of 3.5 nm oxide monitor wafer

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Optical model regression goodness-of-fit (MSE)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Marquardt-Levenberg nonlinear regression algorithm fit across 250 nm to 850 nm spectrum

quantitative_assertions.assertion: 49-point wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated 49-point polar mapping on 150mm wafer with 5mm edge exclusion

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Recipe qualification passes with Gauge R&R <= 10% of process tolerance window (±0.15 nm), static repeatability 1-sigma <= 0.015 nm, MSE <= 1.20 across all 49 mapping points, and formal joint sign-off by Metrology Lead, Thermal Processing Lead, and QA Manager.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Frequency C-V & Quasi-Static $D_{it}$ Calibration on MOSCAP Structures

- **Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-MOSCAP-001`
- **Council Domain:** Domain Expert (Metrology & Quality Assurance)
- **Node Classification:** Leaf Node | Generation: Gen 2 ($\mu$m / 180nm) | Action Type: Make
- **Parent Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip $\rightarrow$ 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) $\rightarrow$ Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) $\rightarrow$ Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology $\rightarrow$ MOS Capacitor Test Structure Calibration & Ellipsometer Recipe Standardization $\rightarrow$ High-Frequency C-V & Quasi-Static $D_{it}$ Calibration on MOSCAP Structures

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Probe Station &    │
│     MOSCAP Setup     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Open/Short Cable   │
│     De-embedding     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  High-Frequency C-V  │
│    Sweep @ 1 MHz     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Quasi-Static C-V   │
│   Sweep @ 0.1 V/s    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Cox, EOT & Dit    │
│     Calculation      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Acceptance Gate    │
│      Evaluation      │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Test Structure Loading & Environment Stabilization**
   - Mount the test wafer containing planar MOS capacitor (MOSCAP) circular test pads ($A = 1 \times 10^{-4}\text{ cm}^2$ to $5 \times 10^{-4}\text{ cm}^2$, grown on p-type Si substrate with $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$) onto the vacuum chuck of the dark, vibration-isolated analytical probe station.
   - Ground the backside substrate contact (chuck ground) and verify gold-plated vacuum chuck resistance is $< 1\ \Omega$.
   - Maintain ambient chuck temperature at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ in a light-tight Faraday enclosure.

2. **Cable Calibration & Fixture De-embedding**
   - Connect the LCR meter (HF terminal) and electrometer / SMU (Quasi-Static terminal) through a triaxial switching matrix.
   - Execute **Open-Circuit** and **Short-Circuit** compensation routines across the test frequency window ($100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$) to cancel residual cable capacitance ($C_{\text{cable}} < 0.05\text{ pF}$) and series parasitic resistance ($R_s$).

3. **High-Frequency (HF) C-V Acquisition ($1\text{ MHz}$)**
   - Land beryllium-copper or tungsten probe needle centered on the polysilicon/metal gate dot of the MOSCAP pad.
   - Apply a high-frequency AC modulation signal of $V_{\text{ac}} = 15\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$.
   - Sweep DC gate bias $V_g$ from deep accumulation ($-2.5\text{ V}$) through depletion to strong inversion ($+2.0\text{ V}$) at a step rate of $50\text{ mV/step}$. Record high-frequency capacitance curve $C_{\text{HF}}(V_g)$.
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{acc}} \approx C_{\text{ox}}$ to determine physical/equivalent oxide thickness ($\text{EOT} = \varepsilon_{\text{ox}} A / C_{\text{ox}}$).

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Acquisition**
   - Configure electrometer in ramp-voltage mode with linear sweep rate $dV/dt = 0.1\text{ V/s}$ (displacement current $I_{\text{disp}} = C \cdot dV/dt$).
   - Execute DC sweep over identical potential window ($-2.5\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$) under continuous dark conditions to allow inversion minority-carrier thermal equilibrium.
   - Record quasi-static capacitance curve:
     $$C_{\text{QS}}(V_g) = \frac{I_{\text{disp}}(V_g)}{dV/dt}$$

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$) Extraction (Castagné-Vapaille Method)**
   - Correlate $C_{\text{HF}}(V_g)$ and $C_{\text{QS}}(V_g)$ across identical surface potential $\psi_s$ points.
   - Compute interface trap capacitance $C_{\text{it}}$ and interface trap density $D_{\text{it}}$ per unit energy:
     $$C_{\text{it}}(V_g) = \left( \frac{1}{C_{\text{QS}}} - \frac{1}{C_{\text{ox}}} \right)^{-1} - \left( \frac{1}{C_{\text{HF}}} - \frac{1}{C_{\text{ox}}} \right)^{-1}$$
     $$D_{\text{it}} = \frac{C_{\text{it}}}{q \cdot A} \quad \left[\text{cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}\right]$$

6. **Oxide Breakdown Field Testing ($E_{\text{bd}}$)**
   - On adjacent sacrificial MOSCAP pad, ramp gate voltage linearly toward breakdown until catastrophic current jump ($I_{\text{compliance}} = 10\text{ mA}$).
   - Record breakdown voltage $V_{\text{bd}}$ and determine dielectric breakdown field $E_{\text{bd}} = V_{\text{bd}} / t_{\text{ox}}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                                                        
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
                EOT (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
Dit (x10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1)┤▒▒▒▒                          │
                        │▒▒▒▒                          │
            E_bd (MV/cm)┤██████████████████████████████│
                        │██████████████████████████████│
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0.0    2.5     5.0    7.5  10.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | **$3.50$** | **$3.50 \text{ to } 4.00$** | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{ox}}$ at $1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Midgap Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | **$< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$** | Max **$1.0 \times 10^{10}$** | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low / Combined HF ($1\text{ MHz}$) and QS ($0.1\text{ V/s}$) |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | **$> 10.0$** | Min **$10.0$** | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Hard breakdown ramp test on sacrificial MOSCAP dot |
| **Dry Oxidation Growth Temp Window** | **$850 \text{ to } 900$** | $\pm 1.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Upstream quartz tube furnace process condition |

---

### 4. Literature Citations & Physical Reference Alignment

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  > *"Dry Oxidation: Performed at 900°C-1000°C in pure dry O2. Produces dense, high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide ($E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) with minimal interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$). Thickness target for 180nm gate dielectric is 3.5 to 4.0 nm."*
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  > *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  > *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$... Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C."*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Measuring EOT on 3.5 nm physical dry oxide via 1 MHz HF C-V without incorporating a quantum mechanical simulator (e.g., Hauser or Berkeley quantum C-V simulator) or accounting for series resistance (Rs) correction via two-frequency impedance de-embedding will underestimate Cox by 10-15% due to poly/substrate quantum confinement and carrier freeze-out/series degradation. The LCR meter cabling fixture and parasitic probe capacitance must be calibrated with open/short compensation directly at the probe tips before data acquisition.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-Static (QS) C-V combined with High-Frequency (HF) C-V via the High-Low (Castagné-Vapaille) method requires ultra-low leakage gate oxides; at 3.5 nm physical thickness, direct tunneling leakage through SiO2 (approaching 10^-3 to 10^-2 A/cm2 at accumulation) can overwhelm the displacement current during quasi-static ramp rates (dVG/dt < 50 mV/s), yielding artificially inflated Dit values (> 10^12 eV^-1 cm^-2) near the band edges. Conductance method (G-V frequency mapping from 1 kHz to 10 MHz) must be cross-correlated to isolate true interface trap density from tunneling shunt conductance.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Shadow mask fabrication for circular metal gate dots (200 um, 500 um, 1000 um diameters) using electroformed nickel or laser-cut molybdenum foil is prone to edge feathering, aperture clogging, and mechanical scratching of the 3.5 nm oxide during physical contact. Sputtered 99.999% pure Al targets and backside Au/Al contact thermal evaporation sources must adhere to low-sodium (< 1 ppb Na/K) contamination baselines to avoid mobile ion distortion (Q_m) during C-V sweeping.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test execution schedule risks slippage if probe station shielding and dark box thermal stabilization are not established prior to wafer loading; temperature drifts > 1.0 deg C shift carrier generation rates during quasi-static inversion recovery. The calibration cycle must be locked to standard operating procedure runs with immediate automated script parsing to prevent metrology bottlenecks preceding the gate poly deposition gate module sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Direct quantum mechanical tunneling leakage exceeding displacement current during quasi-static voltage sweep, causing runaway non-equilibrium current and failure of the High-Low Dit extraction algorithm.
1. Excessive series resistance (Rs > 50 Ohm) from unannealed backside ohmic contact or substrate bulk spreading resistance, skewing HF accumulation capacitance and producing an erroneous EOT calibration offset > 0.3 nm.
1. Physical micro-scratching or shadow-mask contact damage breaching the ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide during metal dot deposition, causing catastrophic pinhole shorts (I_gate > 1 mA at V_G = 1 V).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-3-01` | **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Accumulation & Physical EOT Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter Module, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automatic Probe Station with Dark Box and Faraday Shielding | 1. Land tungsten probe tip onto the 200 um Al gate dot with contact resistance < 5 Ohm. 2. Configure B1520A LCR meter to 1.0 MHz test frequency, AC oscillation amplitude Vac = 25 mV RMS. 3. Set DC voltage sweep from inversion to deep accumulation (-2.5 V to +2.5 V for P-type substrate) at a step size of 20 mV and hold time of 50 ms. 4. Record parallel capacitance (Cp) and dissipation factor (D) vs V_G. 5. Perform series resistance correction: C_cor = (Cp * (1 + D^2)) / ((1 - Rs_meas * Gp)^2 + (omega * Cp * Rs_meas)^2). 6. Extract C_ox from saturated accumulation capacitance at V_G = +2.0 V and compute EOT = (epsilon_SiO2 * epsilon_0 * Area) / C_cor. | `Extracted physical EOT must measure 3.50 nm ± 0.15 nm across 9 sites per wafer; series resistance Rs must be < 40 Ohm; gate leakage current I_leak at V_G = +1.0 V must remain < 50 pA.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-2-3-3-1-3-02` | **High-Low Frequency Combined Dit Profiling on 500 um MOSCAP** | Keysight B1500A (B1520A LCR Module + B1500A High-Resolution SMU for Quasi-Static C-V), shielded triaxial cabling, Faraday dark enclosure | 1. Measure High-Frequency (HF) C-V curve at 100 kHz from -2.0 V to +2.0 V with 25 mV AC amplitude, recording C_hf(V_G). 2. Configure High-Resolution SMU for Quasi-Static (QS) C-V measurement using linear voltage ramp method: ramp rate dV/dt = 20 mV/s from -2.0 V to +2.0 V. 3. Acquire displacement current I_qs and compute quasi-static capacitance C_qs(V_G) = I_qs / (dV/dt). 4. Calculate interface trap density distribution: D_it(E) = (1 / q) * [ (C_ox * C_qs) / (C_ox - C_qs) - (C_ox * C_hf) / (C_ox - C_hf) ]. 5. Map D_it across bandgap energy (E - E_v) by integrating C_qs curve for surface potential psi_s. | `Midgap interface state density Dit(midgap) must be <= 2.5 x 10^10 eV^-1 cm^-2; flatband voltage shift Delta_Vfb between bidirectional sweeps must be <= 30 mV (indicating minimal mobile ion/hysteresis charge).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (Double-gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 Approved UV/Laser Safety Glasses, Anti-Static Cleanroom Lab Coat / Coverall, ESD Grounding Wrist Strap with 1 MOhm Resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For chemical splash (IPA/Acetone): Flush skin or eyes immediately with copious cleanroom DI water at eye-wash station for >= 15 minutes; seek medical attention if irritation persists. For high-voltage shock exposure from SMU / LCR terminals: Immediately trip emergency power off (EPO), evaluate ABCs (Airway, Breathing, Circulation), initiate CPR if pulse absent, and dispatch emergency medical response.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station local mini-environment must operate under positive N2 purge or laminar flow HEPA hood (Class 10 ISO 4); solvent cleaning station must feature local slotted exhaust velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) connected to VOC scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and rinse IPA/acetone collected in dedicated, grounded flammable waste containers labeled with hazardous waste manifest; no sink disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / SLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |
| **Dry Nitrogen Gas (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly patterned Al gate dots on 3.5 nm SiO2/Si substrate post-forming gas anneal (400 °C, 10% H2 / 90% N2, 30 min), free of organic residue and particulate contamination (zero particles > 0.2 um).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine MOSCAP test structure with quantified EOT and Dit, probe pad contact marks < 15 um diameter, purged under dry N2 in sealed wafer carrier.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption and airborne hydrocarbon condensation on unpassivated 3.5 nm SiO2 creates parasitic surface conduction channels and shifts Vfb by > 100 mV, while oxidizing exposed Al gate dots and artificially degrading extracted Dit.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Metrological validation and electrical parameter sign-off for 180nm open-source DRAM 3.5 nm dry gate oxide via high-frequency C-V, quasi-static C-V, and spectroscopic ellipsometry cross-correlation on planar MOSCAP test vehicles.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_CV_HFLow_Profile_WaferLot_Report.csv`
- [ ] `GateOx_3p5nm_EOT_Dit_Extraction_Summary.pdf`
- [ ] `Ellipsometry_vs_CV_Thickness_Correlation_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Physical Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from quantum-corrected accumulation C-V** | `3.50 nm` | ±0.10 nm | Keysight B1520A 1 MHz C-V accumulation Cox extraction at V_G = +2.0 V cross-validated with J.A. Woollam Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cauchy/Sellmeier model |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Midgap Interface Trap Density (Dit) determined by High-Low C-V Castagné-Vapaille method** | `1.80 x 10^10 eV^-1 cm^-2` | <= 2.50 x 10^10 eV^-1 cm^-2 | High-Low frequency C-V extraction (100 kHz HF and 20 mV/s QS) evaluated at silicon intrinsic midgap energy (Ei ± 0.1 eV) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Gate dielectric breakdown field (E_bd) under ramped voltage stress** | `12.5 MV/cm` | >= 11.0 MV/cm | Linear voltage ramp stress to catastrophic breakdown on 200 um diameter MOSCAP dots (V_bd >= 3.85 V across 3.5 nm oxide) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer pass requires 100% compliance across all 9-point radial map test sites for EOT (3.50 ± 0.10 nm) and midgap Dit (<= 2.5 x 10^10 eV^-1 cm^-2), with zero dielectric pinhole shorts detected under pre-stress 1.0 V leakage screening, validated by signed-off QA summary report.

ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Probe station local mini-environment must operate under positive N2 purge or laminar flow HEPA hood (Class 10 ISO 4); solvent cleaning station must feature local slotted exhaust velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) connected to VOC scrubber.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent solvent wipes and rinse IPA/acetone collected in dedicated, grounded flammable waste containers labeled with hazardous waste manifest; no sink disposal permitted.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly patterned Al gate dots on 3.5 nm SiO2/Si substrate post-forming gas anneal (400 °C, 10% H2 / 90% N2, 30 min), free of organic residue and particulate contamination (zero particles > 0.2 um).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Pristine MOSCAP test structure with quantified EOT and Dit, probe pad contact marks < 15 um diameter, purged under dry N2 in sealed wafer carrier.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Moisture adsorption and airborne hydrocarbon condensation on unpassivated 3.5 nm SiO2 creates parasitic surface conduction channels and shifts Vfb by > 100 mV, while oxidizing exposed Al gate dots and artificially degrading extracted Dit.

expected_result.summary: Metrological validation and electrical parameter sign-off for 180nm open-source DRAM 3.5 nm dry gate oxide via high-frequency C-V, quasi-static C-V, and spectroscopic ellipsometry cross-correlation on planar MOSCAP test vehicles.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Physical Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from quantum-corrected accumulation C-V
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Keysight B1520A 1 MHz C-V accumulation Cox extraction at V_G = +2.0 V cross-validated with J.A. Woollam Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cauchy/Sellmeier model

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Midgap Interface Trap Density (Dit) determined by High-Low C-V Castagné-Vapaille method
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-Low frequency C-V extraction (100 kHz HF and 20 mV/s QS) evaluated at silicon intrinsic midgap energy (Ei ± 0.1 eV)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Gate dielectric breakdown field (E_bd) under ramped voltage stress
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Linear voltage ramp stress to catastrophic breakdown on 200 um diameter MOSCAP dots (V_bd >= 3.85 V across 3.5 nm oxide)

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Wafer pass requires 100% compliance across all 9-point radial map test sites for EOT (3.50 ± 0.10 nm) and midgap Dit (<= 2.5 x 10^10 eV^-1 cm^-2), with zero dielectric pinhole shorts detected under pre-stress 1.0 V leakage screening, validated by signed-off QA summary report.
