nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Shadow Mask Clamping Gap & Gap-induced Penumbra Blur Optical Metrology ```text ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Step 1: Wedge Error │ │ Compensation │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Step 2: Gap │ │ Calibration │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Step 3: Shadow Mask │ │ Alignment │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Step 4: Penumbra │ │ Blur Metrology │ └───────────────────────┘ ``` --- ### 1. Scope & Objective This Standard Operating Procedure defines the mechanical gap leveling, proximity gap setting, and optical metrology workflow for inspecting shadow mask clamping and gap-induced geometric penumbra blur. This procedure qualifies the physical tooling used for metallizing dot arrays in MOS capacitor (MOSCAP) C–V and I–V electrical test structures fabricated on a **3.5 nm dry gate oxide** layer (grown at 850°C–900°C) for the 180nm Open-Source DRAM node. --- ### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure #### Step 1: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) & Planarization 1. Mount the 100mm oxidized silicon substrate (3.5 nm thermal $\text{SiO}_2$) onto the Karl Suss MA6 chuck. 2. Clamp the precision MOSCAP shadow mask into the mask holder tooling. 3. Initiate the **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC)** cycle: - Engage the spherical air bearing assembly to bring the substrate into uniform mechanical contact with the shadow mask tooling. - Verify that spherical leveling locks the chuck parallel to the mask plane with an angular runout ensuring parallelism $< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across the entire 100mm wafer diameter. #### Step 2: Clamping Gap Setting & Mode Selection 1. Depending on substrate sensitivity and mechanical clamping requirements, configure the separation mode: - **Proximity Clamping Gap Mode**: Program the linear Z-drive micro-stepper to establish an intentional proximity gap between $10\ \mu\text{m}$ and $30\ \mu\text{m}$ across the substrate field to eliminate abrasion while bounding the optical diffraction limit to $\sim 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$. - **Soft Contact Clamping Mode**: Apply controlled back-side nitrogen pressure between $0.1\ \text{bar}$ and $0.5\ \text{bar}$ to achieve gentle mechanical contact (nominal optical resolution $\sim 1.5\ \mu\text{m}$). - **Hard Contact Clamping Mode**: Apply back-side nitrogen pressure at $1.0\ \text{bar}$ under the chuck to ensure firm mask-to-substrate clamping (nominal resolution $\sim 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$). #### Step 3: Split-Field Microscopic Inspection & Alignment 1. Position the split-field binocular optical microscope over the fiducials and peripheral capacitor aperture array. 2. Select objective lenses sequentially: - Begin at **$5\times$** objective for macro-alignment and coarse gap visual inspection. - Switch to **$10\times$** and **$20\times$** high-magnification objectives paired with the dual high-resolution CMOS cameras. 3. Measure alignment overlay across split fields: - For proximity gap mode ($10\ \mu\text{m}\text{--}30\ \mu\text{m}$), verify alignment precision remains within $\pm 2\ \mu\text{m}$ to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$. - For contact mode, verify overlay precision meets $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$. #### Step 4: Penumbra Edge Blur & Gap-Induced Profile Optical Metrology 1. Acquire high-contrast digital edge images of the shadow mask aperture edges projected onto the 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ substrate using the calibrated CMOS cameras under $20\times$ optical magnification. 2. Extract the edge intensity profile across the aperture perimeter to measure the penumbra blur transition zone ($10\%\text{--}90\%$ intensity profile). 3. Validate that gap-induced geometric blur conforms to Fresnel diffraction boundaries ($\sim 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$ in proximity mode, $\sim 1.5\ \mu\text{m}$ in soft contact, and $\sim 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ in hard contact) before dispatching the fixture assembly to physical vapor metallization (PVD/evaporation). --- ### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria | Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Instrument / Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **WEC Parallelism Across 100mm Substrate** | $< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100mm wafer | Karl Suss MA6 spherical air bearing WEC system | | **Proximity Clamping Air Gap** | $10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $30\ \mu\text{m}$ | MA6 calibrated optical Z-stepper / micrometer | | **Contact Clamping Nitrogen Back-Pressure** | $0.1\ \text{bar}\text{--}0.5\ \text{bar}$ (Soft Contact)
$1.0\ \text{bar}$ (Hard Contact) | Pneumatic chuck manifold pressure gauge | | **Alignment Overlay Precision** | $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Vacuum/Contact)
$\pm 2\ \mu\text{m}$ to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Proximity Mode) | Split-field microscope with $5\times, 10\times, 20\times$ objectives + CMOS cameras | | **Penumbra Diffraction Blur Boundary** | $\sim 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Proximity)
$\sim 1.5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Soft Contact)
$\sim 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ (Hard Contact) | CMOS camera edge intensity profile analysis ($20\times$ objective) | --- ### 4. Verified Literature Citations - **[Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control]**: - *Parallelism & WEC*: Spherical air bearing leveling achieving parallelism $< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100mm wafers. - *Optical System*: Split-field microscope with $5\times, 10\times, 20\times$ objectives paired with dual CMOS cameras. - *Overlay Tolerances*: $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ in contact mode; $\pm 2\ \mu\text{m}$ to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ in proximity mode. - *Modes & Resolution Limits*: Proximity gap of $10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $30\ \mu\text{m}$ (Fresnel limit $\sim 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$); Soft Contact at $0.1\ \text{bar}$ to $0.5\ \text{bar}$ $\text{N}_2$ ($\sim 1.5\ \mu\text{m}$); Hard Contact at $1.0\ \text{bar}$ $\text{N}_2$ ($\sim 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$). - **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: - *Gate Oxide Baseline*: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness. - **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: - *Transistor & DRAM Node Context*: $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, cell layout target for 180nm node integration. --- ### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA) - **Systems Engineer Critic**: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) mechanics adapted from proximity aligners must account for shadow mask flexure under spring or mechanical clamping loads. If planar clamping creates non-uniform contact across the 100mm/150mm substrate, a wedge-shaped gap profile from 5 um to >50 um develops, severely distorting the penumbra blur function across the wafer diameter and corrupting extracted MOS capacitor gate area geometry by up to 12%. - **Domain Physicist Critic**: Thermal evaporation of aluminum gate electrodes behaves as an extended Knudsen effusion source rather than a geometric point source. With source diameter s ≈ 10 mm and throw distance L ≈ 350 mm, a shadow mask gap g of 25 um produces a theoretical geometric penumbra blur δ = g * (s / L) ≈ 0.71 um, but lateral vapor scattering and mask edge bevel re-emission expand the transition region to >3.5 um. Optical split-field/confocal metrology must quantitatively isolate the optical clamping gap (z-profile) from post-deposition transmission edge blur to prevent false attribution of thickness roll-off to clamping failure. - **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision shadow masks fabricated from electroformed nickel or laser-cut invar/stainless steel foil (thickness 50-100 um) are prone to edge burrs (>5 um burr height) from non-specialized vendors. Sourcing compliant, tensioned frame masks with sub-micron edge roughness and verified flatness (<3 um across die fields) requires certified precision electroforming suppliers, directly impacting Gen 1 tooling lead time and BOM costs. - **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Gen 1 timeline allocations budget 3 working days for fixturing alignment validation prior to the first metallization lot. If gap optical calibration requires repeated manual shimming and iterative profilometer cycles without in-situ split-field optical feedback, the gate oxide queue-time window will expire, forcing redundant oxidation runs and stalling capacitor C-V qualification. **Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**: 1. Localized shadow mask clamping gap excursion (>40 um) causing excessive Al gate penumbra edge taper, resulting in undefined fringe capacitance and systematic overestimation of gate oxide interface trap density (Dit). 1. Mask-to-wafer mechanical abrasion during clamping or thermal expansion in the evaporator chamber, shearing the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide and generating pinhole short circuits across MOS capacitor test arrays. ### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench) | Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-01` | **Dual-Wavelength Optical Reflection/Confocal Gap Profiling Across Clamped Mask-Wafer Stack** | Laser confocal optical displacement sensor / split-field microscope with calibrated motorized Z-stage (0.1 um encoder resolution) and 20x metallurgical objective (NA 0.40). | 1. Position fixture under the optical confocal metrology head. 2. Focus on the upper polished top surface of the shadow mask aperture edge; zero the relative Z-datum. 3. Adjust focal plane through the open aperture down to the reflective wafer gate oxide surface; record physical focal displacement Z_step. 4. Subtract nominal mask foil thickness (calibrated micrometer value t_mask = 50.0 um) to compute local clamping air gap: g = Z_step - t_mask. 5. critics.systems_engineer: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) mechanics adapted from proximity aligners must account for shadow mask flexure under spring or mechanical clamping loads. If planar clamping creates non-uniform contact across the 100mm/150mm substrate, a wedge-shaped gap profile from 5 um to >50 um develops, severely distorting the penumbra blur function across the wafer diameter and corrupting extracted MOS capacitor gate area geometry by up to 12%.
critics.domain_expert: Thermal evaporation of aluminum gate electrodes behaves as an extended Knudsen effusion source rather than a geometric point source. With source diameter s ≈ 10 mm and throw distance L ≈ 350 mm, a shadow mask gap g of 25 um produces a theoretical geometric penumbra blur δ = g * (s / L) ≈ 0.71 um, but lateral vapor scattering and mask edge bevel re-emission expand the transition region to >3.5 um. Optical split-field/confocal metrology must quantitatively isolate the optical clamping gap (z-profile) from post-deposition transmission edge blur to prevent false attribution of thickness roll-off to clamping failure.
critics.supply_chain: Precision shadow masks fabricated from electroformed nickel or laser-cut invar/stainless steel foil (thickness 50-100 um) are prone to edge burrs (>5 um burr height) from non-specialized vendors. Sourcing compliant, tensioned frame masks with sub-micron edge roughness and verified flatness (<3 um across die fields) requires certified precision electroforming suppliers, directly impacting Gen 1 tooling lead time and BOM costs.
critics.laya_pm: Gen 1 timeline allocations budget 3 working days for fixturing alignment validation prior to the first metallization lot. If gap optical calibration requires repeated manual shimming and iterative profilometer cycles without in-situ split-field optical feedback, the gate oxide queue-time window will expire, forcing redundant oxidation runs and stalling capacitor C-V qualification.
critical_failure_modes: Localized shadow mask clamping gap excursion (>40 um) causing excessive Al gate penumbra edge taper, resulting in undefined fringe capacitance and systematic overestimation of gate oxide interface trap density (Dit).

Mask-to-wafer mechanical abrasion during clamping or thermal expansion in the evaporator chamber, shearing the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide and generating pinhole short circuits across MOS capacitor test arrays.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## White-Light Interferometry Clamping Gap Calibration

**Branch:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > Precision Tooling & Fixturing > Shadow Mask Clamping Gap Optical Metrology > White-Light Interferometry Clamping Gap Calibration`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy / Tool Qualification  
**Target Fixture:** Precision shadow mask kinematic clamping stage & vacuum chuck assembly for MOS capacitor test pad metallization.

---

### 1. Objective & Context
To calibrate and map the physical gap between the shadow mask foil and the oxidized silicon substrate (3.5 nm thermally grown dry gate oxide) using non-contact Coherence Scanning Interferometry (White-Light Interferometry, WLI). Precise gap uniformity across the wafer active area prevents mechanical abrasion of the ultrathin 3.5 nm oxide while minimizing vapor transport penumbra blur during subsequent physical vapor deposition (PVD) metallization.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Stage Kinematic Fixture & Wafer"] --> B["Calibrate WLI Mirau Objective Z-Datum"]
    B --> C["Acquire Coherence Envelope Fringe Data"]
    C --> D["Compute Surface Height Profiles (Mask vs Wafer)"]
    D --> E["Differential Gap Extraction & Tilt Correction"]
    E --> F{"Acceptance Criteria Met?"}
    F -- "Yes" --> G["Lock Clamping Actuators & Release to PVD"]
    F -- "No" --> H["Adjust Micrometer Preload & Rescan"]
```

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Reference Standards
1. **White-Light Interferometer / Optical Profiler:** Fitted with a broadband filtered LED/halogen source ($\lambda_0 \approx 550\text{ nm}$), piezoelectric Z-scanner, and $5\times/10\times$ Mirau interference objectives.
2. **Kinematic Shadow Mask Clamping Jig:** Multi-point edge flexure clamping stage with micrometric preload screws for 180nm test structures.
3. **Reference Standard:** Certified step-height calibration standard ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ resolution level for fine Z-axis linearity verification).
4. **Substrate:** P-type Si substrate with thermally grown dry gate oxide ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ target thickness).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Calibration Procedure

#### Step 1: Tool Initialization & Baseline Z-Linearity Check
1. Power on the White-Light Interferometer optical profiling system and stabilize the environmental enclosure ($21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Load the certified step-height calibration standard onto the motorized vacuum stage.
3. Execute a Z-axis scan over the step standard across a $10\,\mu\text{m}$ vertical travel range. Verify scanner linearity and noise floor prior to fixture mounting.

#### Step 2: Fixture & Wafer Substrate Alignment
1. Mount the oxidized silicon wafer ($3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric layer) onto the interferometry vacuum chuck.
2. Position the MOS capacitor shadow mask over the wafer, seating it into the kinematic alignment pin locators.
3. Apply nominal clamping torque to the peripheral retention screws.
4. Align the optical profiler field of view (FOV) centered over the shadow mask aperture edges and test pad arrays.

#### Step 3: Coherence Envelope Fringe Acquisition
1. Lower the Mirau objective until white-light interference fringes (zero optical path difference envelope) are localized at the top surface of the shadow mask foil.
2. Set the initial upper scan limit ($Z_{\text{top}}$) $+5\,\mu\text{m}$ above the mask surface.
3. Set the lower scan limit ($Z_{\text{bottom}}$) $-25\,\mu\text{m}$ beneath the mask into the wafer surface plane to capture the bottom reflection off the oxidized silicon substrate.
4. Trigger automated scanning: translate the objective via closed-loop piezo actuator at $2.0\,\mu\text{m/s}$, recording envelope intensity frames through the camera array.

#### Step 4: Differential Gap Demodulation & Multi-Point Mapping
1. Run the coherence peak-detection algorithm on the acquired fringe packet to reconstruct:
   - Surface profile $Z_1(x, y)$ corresponding to the mask bottom/aperture datum.
   - Surface profile $Z_2(x, y)$ corresponding to the wafer $\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}$ interface.
2. Calculate the local physical separation gap:
   $$\text{Gap}(x, y) = |Z_1(x, y) - Z_2(x, y)|$$
3. Perform automated step-and-repeat measurements across a standardized wafer map (sampling center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zones) to characterize planar tilt and gap variation.

#### Step 5: Fixture Kinematic Adjustment & Release
1. Evaluate whether the measured mean gap and spatial wedge tilt conform to the Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) engineering limits.
2. If tilt or gap is out of specification, adjust differential kinematic leveling screws.
3. Re-scan verified points. Once verified, lock torque retention clamps and release fixture to the MOS capacitor metallization queue.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Criteria | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Clamping Gap Height ($Z_{\text{gap}}$)** | $10.0\,\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 1.5\,\mu\text{m}$ (Gen 2 $\mu\text{m}$ scale) | WLI Dual-Peak Coherence Demodulation |
| **Across-Field Gap Non-Uniformity / Wedge Tilt** | $\le 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ | Max total tilt across $50\text{ mm}$ span | Multi-point differential scan ($9\text{-point}$ grid) |
| **Z-Scanner Measurement Noise Floor** | $\le 0.1\text{ nm}$ | $< 0.1\text{ nm}$ RMS ($1\sigma$) | Static reflection calibration standard |
| **Substrate Surface Integrity (Gate Oxide)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal | Zero mechanical contact / scratch signatures ($\Delta \text{thickness} = 0.00\text{ nm}$) | In-situ WLI height defect map & post-ellipsometry check |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **180nm Gate Dielectric Target:** 
  > *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*  
  — *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
- **Metrology Precision & Mapping Rationale:** 
  > *"Dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) measured with sub-Angstrom precision (±0.05 nm)... Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs."*  
  — *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*
- **MOS Capacitor Storage Cell Performance Requirement:**
  > *"Minimum 28 fF per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance... storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF (femtofarads) per cell to ensure data retention time > 64 ms at 85°C."*  
  — *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology & Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integration of White-Light Interferometry (WLI) for non-contact clamping gap profiling must account for mechanical vibration isolation and fixture thermal expansion drift. In a Gen 1 shadow mask assembly fixture, thermal drift of differential micrometers or kinematic mounts greater than 0.2 µm/°C directly compromises the calibrated gap target (< 15 µm) required to restrict penumbra blur during subsequent physical vapor deposition of MOS capacitor gate electrodes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Coherence scanning interferometry / WLI on high-reflectance shadow masks (e.g., electroformed Ni or stainless steel) versus bare silicon with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide encounters phase-change-on-reflection (PCOR) anomalies. The complex refractive indices (n, k) and Fresnel phase shift mismatch between metal mask land areas and thin dielectric SiO2 interfaces induce apparent optical height offsets up to 30-50 nm if not calibrated with a multi-wavelength Cauchy dispersion model and certified step-height standards.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying a commercial automated vertical scanning WLI benchtop tool (e.g., Zygo NewView or Bruker Wyko series) poses long procurement lead times (16-24 weeks) and high capex. For Gen 1 domestic deployment in Vietnam, we must ensure vendor support or qualify local dual-sourcing for Mirau/Michelson interferometer objective heads and piezoelectric vertical z-stage drivers.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The calibration workflow must fit cleanly into the shadow mask MOSCAP qualification cycle without stalling PVD chamber loading. Fixture loading, five-point gap interferometric scanning, tilt parallelism leveling, and clamp torque locking must achieve takt time under 12 minutes per wafer to maintain queue-time budgets prior to metallization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interferometric fringe washout caused by mechanical vibration or high surface roughness (Ra > 0.08 µm) on the shadow mask bottom contact lands.
1. Mechanical contact touchdown during gap setting causing micro-scratching or particulate pinhole punch-through in the fragile 3.5 nm dry gate oxide.
1. Non-parallelism wedge error (> 3 µm across 100 mm wafer) resulting in asymmetric penumbra electrode enlargement and distorted C-V extraction across peripheral dice.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-1-01` | **WLI Clamping Gap Multi-Point Absolute Height and Parallelism Calibration** | White-Light Interferometer (Coherence Scanning Optical Profilometer) with 10x Mirau objective, closed-loop nanometer-encoded Z-drive, calibrated 10.00 µm silicon step height standard (VLSI Standards certified), and 3-axis kinematic clamp torque fixture. | 1. Position clamping fixture on vibration-isolated WLI vacuum stage. 2. Acquire zero-height reference on top oxide surface through mask aperture. 3. Perform vertical scanning interferometry (VSI) sweep across the shadow mask bottom land boundary at 5 points (Center, North, South, East, West at r = 35 mm). 4. Extract absolute air gap height (Z_mask - Z_wafer) at each coordinate. 5. Adjust three differential micrometer leveling screws until gap variance across all points meets tilt limits. 6. Torque fixture clamp bolts to 0.45 N·m and repeat WLI scan to record locked clamping gap. | `Absolute clamping gap at all 5 points must be within 10.0 µm to 15.0 µm. Maximum gap variation (wedge error) across 100mm field must be ≤ 2.0 µm. Zero physical contact (gap > 0 µm everywhere).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-1-02` | **Post-Clamping Gate Oxide Surface Integrity and Defect Verification** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (wavelength range 240-800 nm, micro-spot 50 µm beam) and High-Resolution Optical Inspection Microscope with darkfield/DIC illumination. | 1. Inspect wafer surface directly beneath mask clamping perimeters using darkfield microscopy at 500x magnification for mechanical scuffs, particulate clusters, or micro-cracks. 2. Align spectroscopic ellipsometer micro-spot inside aperture open areas and clamped land margins. 3. Measure Psi (Ψ) and Delta (Δ) at 70° angle of incidence across 9 radial sites. 4. Fit measured spectra to a Si/SiO2 optical model to determine dielectric thickness and interface roughness. | `Zero visible micro-scratches or mechanical abrasion tracks on gate oxide under 500x darkfield. Gate oxide thickness measured at 3.50 ± 0.15 nm with optical goodness-of-fit R² ≥ 0.992 across all 9 metrology sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/optical laser safety eye protection, Class 100 cleanroom Tyvek gowning hood, suit, and ESD-safe cleanroom booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin exposure: Flush affected skin immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. Eye exposure: Rinse eyes at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation of organic vapors: Evacuate person to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Perform solvent wipe cleaning of shadow masks under certified laminar flow exhaust chemical fume hood with minimum 100 fpm face velocity. Metrology bench must operate with dedicated HEPA laminar downflow hood to prevent particle ingestion.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-saturated cleanroom wipes and rinse effluent in segregated, grounded flammables containment drums labeled 'Hazardous Waste - Flammable Solvents' for off-site hazardous waste incineration. Do not mix solvent waste with aqueous or acid drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.8%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on Si(100), clean, particle-free, and hydrophilically terminated with less than 0.1 nm native organic contamination layer.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated mask-wafer clamping assembly locked at 12 ± 2 µm gap, pre-conditioned and inspected, ready for immediate transfer to PVD load-lock chamber.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in cleanroom air results in airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (volatile hydrocarbons and moisture) on the ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide, shifting flatband voltage (V_fb) and causing premature dielectric breakdown.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful baseline qualification and delivery of the White-Light Interferometry Clamping Gap Calibration work package, confirming uniform 10-15 µm non-contact gap across a 100mm wafer field with zero mechanical scratching of 3.5 nm gate oxide.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WLI_Clamping_Gap_5Pt_Calibration_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Mask_Wafer_Gap_Topography_Matrix.csv`
- [ ] `Interferometric_3D_Surface_Profile_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean vertical air gap between shadow mask contact land and gate oxide surface across 5 measured points** | `12.5 µm` | ± 2.5 µm | White-Light Interferometry vertical scanning coherence fringe optical profilometry |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum gap variation across 100mm active field diameter (wedge tilt error)** | `1.5 µm` | ≤ 2.0 µm maximum spread | Plane-fit subtraction algorithm applied to 5-point WLI gap coordinates |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Gate oxide thickness post-clamping verification within metallization apertures** | `3.50 nm` | ± 0.15 nm | Spectroscopic ellipsometry 9-point wafer mapping fitting Cauchy model |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires WLI calibration protocol completion showing 5-point gaps within 10.0-15.0 µm with wedge error ≤ 2.0 µm, no physical clamp touchdown or gate oxide abrasion verified via 500x darkfield DIC microscopy, and automated signoff by Lead Metrology Researcher and Hardware Systems Engineer.

testcases.title: WLI Clamping Gap Multi-Point Absolute Height and Parallelism Calibration
testcases.instrumentation: White-Light Interferometer (Coherence Scanning Optical Profilometer) with 10x Mirau objective, closed-loop nanometer-encoded Z-drive, calibrated 10.00 µm silicon step height standard (VLSI Standards certified), and 3-axis kinematic clamp torque fixture.
testcases.pre_conditions: Class 100 cleanroom ambient (21.0 ± 0.5 °C, RH 45 ± 5%). 100mm silicon test wafer coated with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide mounted in precision clamping fixture with aligned shadow mask. WLI calibrated using certified 10.00 µm standard.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position clamping fixture on vibration-isolated WLI vacuum stage. 2. Acquire zero-height reference on top oxide surface through mask aperture. 3. Perform vertical scanning interferometry (VSI) sweep across the shadow mask bottom land boundary at 5 points (Center, North, South, East, West at r = 35 mm). 4. Extract absolute air gap height (Z_mask - Z_wafer) at each coordinate. 5. Adjust three differential micrometer leveling screws until gap variance across all points meets tilt limits. 6. Torque fixture clamp bolts to 0.45 N·m and repeat WLI scan to record locked clamping gap.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Absolute clamping gap at all 5 points must be within 10.0 µm to 15.0 µm. Maximum gap variation (wedge error) across 100mm field must be ≤ 2.0 µm. Zero physical contact (gap > 0 µm everywhere).

testcases.title: Post-Clamping Gate Oxide Surface Integrity and Defect Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (wavelength range 240-800 nm, micro-spot 50 µm beam) and High-Resolution Optical Inspection Microscope with darkfield/DIC illumination.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer and mask subjected to full clamping torque cycle as per TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-1-01; clamp released and mask separated in vertical laminar flow hood.
testcases.procedure: 1. Inspect wafer surface directly beneath mask clamping perimeters using darkfield microscopy at 500x magnification for mechanical scuffs, particulate clusters, or micro-cracks. 2. Align spectroscopic ellipsometer micro-spot inside aperture open areas and clamped land margins. 3. Measure Psi (Ψ) and Delta (Δ) at 70° angle of incidence across 9 radial sites. 4. Fit measured spectra to a Si/SiO2 optical model to determine dielectric thickness and interface roughness.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Zero visible micro-scratches or mechanical abrasion tracks on gate oxide under 500x darkfield. Gate oxide thickness measured at 3.50 ± 0.15 nm with optical goodness-of-fit R² ≥ 0.992 across all 9 metrology sites.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/optical laser safety eye protection
Class 100 cleanroom Tyvek gowning hood, suit, and ESD-safe cleanroom booties
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Skin exposure: Flush affected skin immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. Eye exposure: Rinse eyes at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation of organic vapors: Evacuate person to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Perform solvent wipe cleaning of shadow masks under certified laminar flow exhaust chemical fume hood with minimum 100 fpm face velocity. Metrology bench must operate with dedicated HEPA laminar downflow hood to prevent particle ingestion.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Collect spent solvent-saturated cleanroom wipes and rinse effluent in segregated, grounded flammables containment drums labeled 'Hazardous Waste - Flammable Solvents' for off-site hazardous waste incineration. Do not mix solvent waste with aqueous or acid drains.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on Si(100), clean, particle-free, and hydrophilically terminated with less than 0.1 nm native organic contamination layer.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Calibrated mask-wafer clamping assembly locked at 12 ± 2 µm gap, pre-conditioned and inspected, ready for immediate transfer to PVD load-lock chamber.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding queue time in cleanroom air results in airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (volatile hydrocarbons and moisture) on the ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide, shifting flatband voltage (V_fb) and causing premature dielectric breakdown.

expected_result.summary: Successful baseline qualification and delivery of the White-Light Interferometry Clamping Gap Calibration work package, confirming uniform 10-15 µm non-contact gap across a 100mm wafer field with zero mechanical scratching of 3.5 nm gate oxide.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean vertical air gap between shadow mask contact land and gate oxide surface across 5 measured points
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: White-Light Interferometry vertical scanning coherence fringe optical profilometry

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum gap variation across 100mm active field diameter (wedge tilt error)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Plane-fit subtraction algorithm applied to 5-point WLI gap coordinates

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Gate oxide thickness post-clamping verification within metallization apertures
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Spectroscopic ellipsometry 9-point wafer mapping fitting Cauchy model

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shadow Mask PVD Metallization under Calibrated Gap Spacing

### 1. Process Overview & Flowchart

This procedure details the physical vapor deposition (PVD) metallization of metal-oxide-semiconductor (MOS) capacitor test structures for 180nm DRAM gate oxide and storage node characterization. Precise separation between the shadow mask and the wafer is established via closed-loop micro-positioning to prevent mechanical contact damage to the ~3.5 nm thermal gate dielectric while limiting penumbra blur.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Loading & Gate  │
│       Oxide Prep       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Calibrate Shadow    │
│   Mask Proximity Gap   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Vacuum Evacuation &   │
│    PVD Chamber Prep    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   PVD Metallization    │
│       Deposition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Cooldown, Vent &    │
│  Penumbra Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**:
   - Inspect the incoming wafer following dry gate oxidation (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation, physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Place the oxidized silicon substrate onto the precision vacuum chuck in the tooling fixture.

2. **Calibrated Proximity Gap Alignment**:
   - Align the shadow mask fiducial crosshairs with the substrate test structure locations.
   - Adjust the mask elevation above the wafer surface using the three precision differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators having $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ positioning sensitivity.
   - Establish a calibrated non-contact proximity gap set between $10\ \mu\text{m}$ and $20\ \mu\text{m}$ across the substrate area to prevent scratch defects on the $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide while constraining penumbra edge divergence.

3. **Chamber Evacuation & Source Conditioning**:
   - Transfer the clamped fixture into the PVD vacuum chamber.
   - Pump down the vacuum load lock and process chamber to high-vacuum base pressure.
   - Initiate pre-sputter / pre-evaporation soaking to degas and clean the target surface.

4. **PVD Metallization Deposition**:
   - Deposit the conductive electrode metal layer (e.g., Al or refractory gate contact metal) through the shadow mask apertures at the calibrated standoff distance.
   - Monitor deposition rate and accumulated film thickness using in-situ quartz crystal microbalance (QCM).

5. **Post-Deposition Cooldown & Metrology**:
   - Allow the fixture to cool under vacuum to avoid thermal shock and film stress.
   - Vent the chamber with dry nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) gas.
   - Unload the wafer and inspect the fabricated MOS capacitor electrode dots under optical metrology to verify aperture definition, geometric fidelity, and penumbra boundary blur.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                          ┌────────────────────────────┐
                          │██████████                  │
   Storage Cap Budget (fF)┤██████████                  │
                          │░░░░                        │
Piezo Resolution (0.01 um)┤░░░░                        │
   Mask Proximity Gap (um)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
                          │▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
        Oxide Thk (0.1 nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
                          │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
 Thermal Ox Temp (degC/10)┤████████████████████████████│
                          │████████████████████████████│
                          └┬──────┬──────┬─────┬──────┬┘
                          0.0   21.9   43.8  65.6  87.5 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Range | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mask-to-Substrate Proximity Gap** | 15.0 | 10 to 20 | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical displacement / metrology sensor |
| **Gap Actuation Sensitivity** | 0.1 | $\le 0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop piezo / micrometer encoder |
| **Pre-Metallization Gate Oxide Thickness** | 3.5 | $3.5 \pm 0.3$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry |
| **Thermal Gate Oxide Growth Temp** | 875 | 850 to 900 | °C | Pyrometer / thermocouple logger |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

* **Source 1: Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**
  - Proximity gap specification: Separated by a $10\ \mu\text{m}\text{ to }20\ \mu\text{m}$ gap to prevent contact scratch defects.
  - Gap actuation control: Controlled via differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
* **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Gate dielectric baseline: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - Cell capacitor retention baseline: Minimum capacitance requirement of 25 to 30 fF per cell ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C).
* **Source 3: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum 28 fF per cell noise immunity threshold for 180nm cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) leveling between the shadow mask fixture and the 100mm wafer chuck must maintain a strictly calibrated gap <= 15 um without physical clamping contact that could fracture the ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. Any z-axis displacement drift or mechanical tilt across the stage will skew the geometric penumbra blur across the capacitor array, compromising C-V extraction accuracy.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Thermal evaporation or e-beam PVD of aluminum through a shadow mask at finite gap spacing introduces a geometric penumbra delta = g * (s / D), where g is gap spacing, s is vapor source diameter (~10 mm), and D is throw distance (~400 mm). A 15 um gap yields ~0.375 um penumbra edge slope; if the gap balloons to > 50 um due to thermal bowing or particulate contamination, the penumbra width exceeds 1.25 um, creating ill-defined capacitor area boundaries (A_eff) that introduce catastrophic > 10% errors in gate oxide capacitance (Cox) and dielectric constant extraction.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom laser-cut or electroformed beryllium-copper/Invar shadow masks with precision 100 um to 500 um circular aperture arrays have long lead times. Mask distortion from repeated clamping and metallization stress mandates a strict cleaning and inspection cycle to prevent particulate-induced gap widening.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibrating mask-wafer gap on proximity fixturing introduces up to 45 minutes of mechanical leveling and optical verification per batch. We must establish a standardized dial micrometer/optical gap-offset recipe to ensure metallization runs meet the 60-minute Q-time window post-oxide growth.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Mechanical scratch or particle pinch during mask alignment causing catastrophic localized punch-through and pinhole shorts in the 3.5 nm gate dielectric.
1. Excessive shadow mask gap (> 25 um) producing severe penumbra feathering that leads to unacceptable MOS capacitor area uncertainty (> 5%).
1. Radiant thermal expansion and bowing of the shadow mask under e-beam/filament PVD flux, creating a dynamic gap runaway and non-uniform pad deposition across the wafer.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-2-01` | **Calibrated Gap Spacing and Parallelism Verification via Multi-Point Optical Confocal Profilometry** | Chromatic Confocal Optical Profiler / Non-contact Displacement Sensor (STIL/Precitec) integrated with Karl Suss MA6 fixture alignment stage. | 1. Zero the non-contact displacement sensors against the front surface of the shadow mask reference frame. 2. Lower mask to target proximity height (target: 15.0 um). 3. Measure mask-to-wafer physical gap across 5 standard locations (Center, North, South, East, West at r = 35 mm). 4. Record gap spacing values and calculate total tilt/parallelism deviation across the 100mm substrate. | `Mean gap spacing across all 5 points must be 15.0 um +/- 2.5 um; Total non-parallelism (WEC wedge error) across 100mm wafer diameter must be <= 1.5 um.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-2-02` | **Post-PVD Metallization Penumbra Blur and Dot Edge Definition Metrology** | Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM) with calibrated CD measurement tool and Stylus Profilometer (KLA D-600). | 1. Load wafer into SEM under high vacuum. 2. Image edges of 5 representative 200 um diameter circular MOS capacitor pads across center and periphery. 3. Perform 10% to 90% intensity transition profile across pad boundary to calculate geometric penumbra width. 4. Verify pad thickness and step profile using stylus profilometry. | `Total edge penumbra transition width must be <= 0.60 um across all measured pads; nominal pad diameter deviation from mask design must be <= 1.0 um; metallization thickness must be 150 nm +/- 10 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Flame-resistant cleanroom gown and ESD-safe safety shoes, Face shield and thermal-protective gloves during PVD source loading and chamber maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of thermal burn from PVD hot zone, immediately flush affected area with cold running water for at least 15 minutes and seek emergency medical attention. For solvent exposure, flush eyes/skin with copious water for 15 minutes; if inhaled, move to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: PVD chamber roughing and turbomolecular pump exhausts must be directly ducted to certified scrubbed toxic/pyrophoric process exhaust with continuous differential pressure monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent rags and flammables must be sealed in dedicated UL-listed grounded hazardous waste cans; flaked aluminum chamber deposits must be collected in dry, sealed containers to prevent pyrophoric dust ignition.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aluminum (PVD Pellets / Source Material)** | `7429-90-5` | 5N (99.999%) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA mask cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.8%` |
| **Acetone (Degreasing solvent)** | `67-64-1` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pristine dry thermal SiO2 (3.5 nm) on p-type Si (100), free of airborne molecular contamination (AMC), particulates, and organic moisture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned Al MOS capacitor electrodes (150 nm thickness) deposited through calibrated proximity shadow mask onto gate oxide, ready for post-metallization annealing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Adsorption of atmospheric moisture and airborne hydrocarbons onto unpassivated 3.5 nm oxide creates interface trap states (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2) and threshold/flatband voltage instability, invalidating C-V dielectric characterization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful PVD metallization of 150 nm Aluminum circular gate test structures across a 3.5 nm dry gate oxide wafer under verified <= 15 um proximity gap spacing, achieving sharp pad edges with sub-micron penumbra blur for precise C-V dot area definition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-2_gap_leveling_profilometry.csv`
- [ ] `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-2_sem_penumbra_analysis.tiff`
- [ ] `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-2_metallization_run_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Calibrated fixture proximity gap spacing across entire wafer** | `15.0 um` | +/- 2.5 um | 5-point non-contact optical chromatic confocal displacement profilometry prior to deposition |
| `ASSERT-02` | **PVD deposited aluminum gate electrode geometric penumbra blur width** | `0.45 um` | <= 0.60 um | Top-down CD-SEM edge intensity line-scan profile analysis (10%-90% gradient threshold) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Nominal MOS capacitor metal pad thickness** | `150.0 nm` | +/- 10.0 nm | KLA Stylus Profilometer step-height measurement on sacrificial test pad |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Shadow mask gap verified <= 17.5 um across all 5 wafer locations, total Al penumbra blur confirmed <= 0.60 um via CD-SEM, gate oxide dielectric breakdown voltage confirmed > 3.0 V on test capacitors, and full analytical report signed off by Metrology Lead.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Edge-Profile Penumbra Blur Optical & Stylus Profilometry Characterization

**Process ID:** `MET-SOP-180NM-SHADOW-PENUMBRA-001`  
**Classification:** Generation 2 ($\mu$m) Metrology / Quality Inspection  
**Node Target:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Test Vehicle (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Off-The-Shelf Profilometry & Optical Inspection)  
**Upstream Dependencies:** [MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization](docs/context.yaml) & [Shadow Mask Clamping Gap Metrology](docs/context2.yaml)

---

## 1. Process Overview & Visual Flow

Characterizing edge penumbra blur across metal gate dots (aluminum/tungsten/polysilicon) on dry gate oxide ($3.5\,\text{nm}$) ensures accurate active area definition for capacitance-voltage ($C\text{-}V$) extraction, avoiding dielectric boundary distortions or parasitic fringe capacitance.

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Stage 1: Sample Load & Optical Fiducial Alignment     │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Stage 2: Calibrated Optical Reflection Intensity Scan │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Stage 3: Sub-Angstrom Stylus Profilometer Scan Run    │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Stage 4: Penumbra Edge Transition Extraction (10-90%) │
│                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Inspection Verification & Fixture Loading
1. Verify the dry gate oxide substrate has achieved nominal physical thickness of **$3.5\,\text{nm}$** with sub-Angstrom optical thickness verification precision ($\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$) before metal contact evaluation.
2. Transfer the shadow-masked metallized wafer onto the vibration-isolated granite stage of the dual optical/stylus profilometer station under cleanroom Class 100 conditions.
3. Align the substrate using test structure alignment keys or corner capacitor fiducials.

### Step 2: Optical Reflectance & Penumbra Edge Detection
1. Focus the brightfield/darkfield optical objective ($50\times / 100\times$) at the perimeter of the shadow-masked MOS capacitor pad.
2. Acquire spatial optical reflection intensity profiles across the boundary:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
3. Map the gradient transition where reflectivity transitions between bare gate oxide ($\text{physical } t_{ox} = 3.5\,\text{nm}$) and metallized contact pads.
4. Flag potential shadow mask gap-induced geometric blur zones where the optical transition width exceeds baseline tooling clearance.

### Step 3: High-Resolution Stylus Profilometry Profiling
1. Set the diamond-tipped stylus radius ($2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ tip radius) and configure low contact force ($1.0\,\text{mg}$ to $3.0\,\text{mg}$) to prevent scratching or gouging of the $3.5\,\text{nm}$ underlying dielectric layer.
2. Program a scan line orthogonal to the shadow mask edge over a length of $100\,\mu\text{m}$ to $200\,\mu\text{m}$ across the perimeter.
3. Record step height, edge roll-off slope, and transition span between the baseline gate oxide level ($0\,\%$) and plateau metallization height ($100\,\%$).

### Step 4: Penumbra Quantification and Validation
1. Calculate the $10\%\text{--}90\%$ step-height transition distance ($W_{\text{penumbra}}$).
2. Correlate stylus thickness profiles against optical reflectivity transitions to eliminate mask vibration artifacts or micro-particulate anomalies.
3. Log data to wafer run history for correlation against high-frequency $C\text{-}V$ capacitor area estimations.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Machine-Measurable Tolerance | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Underlying Gate Dielectric Thickness** | $3.5\,\text{nm}$ | $\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Cauchy optical dispersion |
| **Stylus Vertical Resolution Precision** | Sub-Angstrom | $< 0.1\,\text{nm}$ ($1\,\text{Å}$) noise floor | Calibrated Contact Stylus Profilometer (Granite stage) |
| **Edge Penumbra Transition Width ($10\%\text{--}90\%$)** | Nominal tooling clearance baseline | $\le 5.0\,\mu\text{m}$ total lateral blur | Dual Optical Intensity & Stylus Profile Gradient Scan |
| **Dielectric Integrity Post-Scan** | No oxide puncture / pitting | $0\,\text{nm}$ scratch depth into $3.5\,\text{nm}$ oxide | Post-scan Darkfield Optical / Stylus Verification |

---

## 4. Context References & Sourced Literature

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell channel scaling ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) and active capacitance area budget ($28\,\text{fF/cell}$) driving precise physical pad area control.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Thermal dry gate oxide growth target physical thickness of $\mathbf{\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Sub-Angstrom precision requirement of $\mathbf{\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}}$ for the $3.5\,\text{nm}$ gate oxide, Fresnel reflection ratio calibration ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$), and multi-point non-uniformity mapping.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Characterizing penumbra blur across metal gate pads deposited through physical shadow masking is critical for parasitic fringe capacitance extraction on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOS capacitors. If penumbra taper length exceeds 15 um, fringe electric fields distort high-frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) C-V accumulation capacitance extraction, confounding EOT calculations by >5%. Furthermore, contact stylus profilometry risks puncturing or scratching the fragile 3.5 nm oxide dielectric layer outside the nominal metallized zone if the stylus drops over the penumbra cliff.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Shadow mask metallization in thermal/e-beam evaporation exhibits a geometric penumbra delta = s * (d_source / L_throw), where s is mask-wafer standoff gap, d_source is crucible/filament melt pool diameter, and L_throw is throw distance. A mechanical clamping gap non-uniformity across a 100 mm wafer creates asymmetric edge slopes. Non-contact optical profilometry (white light interferometry / confocal microscopy) must be cross-calibrated against low-force (<=0.05 mg / 0.5 uN) diamond stylus line scans to delineate the 10% to 90% metal thickness transition without mechanical damage to the underlying gate oxide.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard cleanroom stylus profilometers (e.g., KLA Tencor Alpha-Step / Veeco Dektak) require micro-stylus diamond tips (2.0 um radius) that are prone to chipping and long lead-time replacement (6-10 weeks). Shadow mask alignment and clamping jigs fabricated from laser-cut invar or 304 stainless steel frequently present micro-burrs along aperture perimeters; procurement must mandate electro-polishing or chemical de-burring to prevent localized clamp spacing spikes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput must not bottleneck the gate oxide qualification loop. Running full 2D white light interferometry scans on all 49 capacitor test dots per wafer consumes >4 hours per lot. The inspection protocol must down-sample to a validated 5-point die map (Center, North, South, East, West) with single-pass optical edge-detection, reserving mechanical stylus confirmation for 1 boundary site per wafer to respect Q-time limits before C-V probing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Stylus tip fracture or gouging through the 3.5 nm gate dielectric during profilometer touchdown over the penumbra edge transition, creating direct gate-to-substrate metal short circuits.
1. Excessive mask-to-substrate clamping standoff gap (>50 um) causing catastrophic penumbra blur (>40 um width), leading to dot-to-dot bridging or severe effective area uncertainty in C-V parameter extraction.
1. Organic residue or airborne particulate entrapment along the shadow mask aperture rim, producing localized shadow cast tails and non-axisymmetric metallization tapers.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-3-01` | **Optical Non-Contact Penumbra Blur Transition Width Metrology** | Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (CLSM) / Coherence Scanning Optical Profilometer with 50x Plan-Fluor objective (NA >= 0.80) and 405 nm laser source, calibrated with NIST-traceable step height standard (100 nm ± 2 nm). | 1. Position stage at the primary test capacitor dot (Center die). 2. Focus on top planar aluminum metallization pad and zero the optical height datum. 3. Acquire 3D topographical height map covering a 100 um x 50 um window bisecting the circular dot edge. 4. Extract perpendicular line height profiles across 4 orthogonal quadrants (0, 90, 180, 270 deg). 5. Compute the 10%-to-90% metal thickness penumbra blur transition length (w_penumbra) along each profile. 6. Repeat for North, South, East, and West perimeter test dice. | `Mean penumbra blur transition width (10% to 90% nominal thickness) w_penumbra must be <= 12.0 um across all 5 mapped dice, with quadrant blur asymmetry (max - min) <= 3.0 um per dot.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-1-3-3-02` | **Low-Force Stylus Profilometry Edge Slope & Dielectric Punch-Through Verification** | Stylus Profilometer (KLA Alpha-Step / Bruker Dektak XT) equipped with a 2.0 um radius diamond stylus tip, programmable stylus tracking force set to 0.5 mg (4.9 uN), scan speed 10 um/s, vertical resolution 0.1 nm. | 1. Align stylus scan trajectory across the western edge of the center MOS cap pad, traversing 200 um (100 um on aluminum, 100 um on surrounding gate oxide). 2. Engage stylus at 0.5 mg force and execute a single 10 um/s scan pass. 3. Perform baseline leveling on the outer oxide region (excluding the transition slope). 4. Measure step height from baseline to flat plateau (nominal target 100 nm). 5. Evaluate the baseline profile beyond the transition foot for negative gouge troughs indicating stylus penetration into the 3.5 nm oxide. | `Nominal pad metal thickness must be 100 nm ± 10 nm; edge taper transition slope must be continuous with zero negative baseline gouge deeper than 0.5 nm into the underlying oxide.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser-filtering safety glasses, Conductive ESD cleanroom smock and grounded wrist strap, High-filtration particulate face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of solvent eye contact, flush eyes immediately at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. For skin exposure, wash thoroughly with soap and water and remove contaminated clothing. If solvent vapors cause dizziness, evacuate operator to fresh air immediately and seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Stylus tip and mask cleaning must be performed within a dedicated solvent chemical bench providing laminar face velocity between 0.45 m/s and 0.55 m/s with dedicated organic vapor scrubbed exhaust.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and rinse liquids must be collected in closed, grounded stainless-steel flammables waste containers labeled with CAS numbers; no drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS Grade) | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `>= 99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited aluminum gate metallization on dry 3.5 nm SiO2, free from airborne organosilicon and fluorocarbon contaminants.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-verified MOS capacitor wafer with characterized penumbra dimensions, stored in clean N2 desiccator ready for electrical C-V / I-V probe station characterization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air exposure causes native aluminum oxide (Al2O3) overgrowth (>2 nm) and moisture/organic physisorption along the penumbra taper boundary, altering surface state densities (D_it) and causing false accumulation capacitance roll-off during C-V sweep.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical and topographical verification of shadow-mask induced aluminum gate edge penumbra blur over 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. Guarantees that edge blur transition widths are bounded within <= 12 um and physical stylus profilometry induces zero punch-through damage into the gate dielectric, qualifying MOS capacitor pads for high-precision C-V dielectric thickness extraction.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `EDGE_PENUMBRA_CLSM_3D_SURFACE_MAP.tiff`
- [ ] `STYLUS_STEP_HEIGHT_AND_TAPER_PROFILE.csv`
- [ ] `PENUMBRA_METROLOGY_SIGNOFF_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Aluminum gate electrode 10%-to-90% penumbra edge blur transition width** | `8.5 um` | ± 3.5 um | 50x Confocal Laser Scanning Profilometry orthogonal line profile extraction |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum substrate dielectric gouge depth outside the metallized pad zone** | `0.0 nm` | + 0.5 nm / - 0.0 nm | Low-force (0.5 mg) diamond stylus profilometry baseline trough inspection |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Deposited aluminum plateau film thickness** | `100.0 nm` | ± 10.0 nm | Calibrated step-height averaging over 50 um flat pad plateau |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five-point wafer mapping shows penumbra blur <= 12.0 um at all sites, zero detected oxide puncture or scratch troughs under 0.5 mg stylus line scan, and written validation approved by Lead Metrology Engineer certifying pad geometry for C-V electrical test structure testing.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Process Parameter Benchmarking for MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures

**Discipline / Category**: Process Engineering  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Shadow mask metallization for MOSCAP test structures directly links the 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide process to electrical capacitance-voltage (C-V) metrology. Using a physical shadow mask bypasses full photolithography and wet/dry metal etch loops, drastically compressing turnaround time; however, mechanical shadow masking introduces severe systemic risks: physical contact between the mask and the ultra-thin 3.5 nm SiO2 layer can induce mechanical scratching, point micro-cracks, and particulate contamination, causing catastrophic dielectric punch-through. Alignment tolerance and gap management between the mask foil and wafer surface are critical to prevent vapor penumbra blurring the nominal electrode area.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DC magnetron sputtering of aluminum on an ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxide creates strong energetic particle bombardment (reflected neutral Ar atoms and high-energy secondary electrons), which can generate significant bulk oxide trap charges and interface state densities (Dit > 1e12 eV^-1 cm^-2) if plasma power is too high or target-to-substrate distance is insufficient. Sputtering power must be restricted (<1.5 kW, ideally 500-1000 W) with low DC bias or indirect baffle, or complemented by post-metallization forming gas annealing (95/5 N2/H2 at 400°C for 30 min) to passivate radiation-induced dangling bonds at the Si/SiO2 interface. Additionally, shadowing penumbra creates a non-vertical dot edge profile, causing an effective perimeter capacitance anomaly that distorts area-scaled Cox extraction across 200 um vs 1000 um dots.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision laser-cut or electroformed beryllium-copper, stainless steel, or invar shadow masks with clean aperture sidewalls (diameters 200, 500, and 1000 um) require qualified precision machining vendors capable of burr-free finishing (<2 um burr height). Pure 5N (99.999%) Aluminum targets and ultra-pure Argon gas (99.999% / 5N grade) are standard fab commodities, but frequent mechanical mask handling requires continuous ultrasonic cleaning cycles and replacement stock to prevent aperture clogging, particle generation, and mechanical bending of thin foils.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Shadow mask dot deposition is the primary gatekeeper for Stage 2 Reality Gate sign-off of the 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation module. While avoiding photoresist spinning, baking, exposure, and stripping saves 2 shifts (16 hours) per validation wafer, process parameters must yield deterministic gate electrode geometries and repeatable C-V curves on day one. If dot-edge penumbra or pinhole leakage forces wafer re-runs, the schedule benefit is entirely lost. A clear calibration protocol for sputtering rate, mask clamping pressure, and mask-to-wafer standoff is mandatory.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dielectric punch-through and micro-pinhole rupture in the 3.5 nm SiO2 film caused by localized mechanical abrasion or particulate pressing during shadow mask clamping onto the active wafer surface.
1. Distorted oxide thickness (t_ox) extraction caused by vapor penumbra spreading underneath non-flush mask apertures, increasing physical dot area by >5% over nominal aperture dimensions.
1. Plasma-induced interface degradation and neutral-particle radiation damage causing unpassivated interface trap density Dit > 5x10^11 eV^-1 cm^-2 and C-V stretch-out.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-01` | **MOSCAP Aluminum Dot Geometry & Shadow Mask Penumbra Profilometry** | Optical Profilometer / Contact Stylus Profilometer (KLA D-300 or Bruker ContourX) and Calibrated Optical Metrology Microscope with sub-micron stage encoders | 1. Position wafer on optical microscope stage and locate 5 test dies (Center, North, South, East, West). 2. Measure orthogonal diameters (X and Y) of the 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um circular Al dots at 50x magnification using edge-detection thresholding. 3. Perform 3D optical surface profiling across the dot perimeter to measure penumbra taper width from nominal metal thickness (300 nm) to zero thickness. 4. Record average diameter, geometric area, and penumbra transition width across all measured sites. | `Average dot diameter within nominal aperture diameter ± 2.0% (e.g. 500 um dot between 490 um and 510 um); penumbra edge taper width <= 4.0 um; total metal thickness = 300 nm ± 10% (270 nm to 330 nm).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-02` | **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Accumulation Capacitance and Physical t_ox Extraction** | Keithley 4200-SCS with 4210-CVU Multi-Frequency Capacitance-Voltage Metrology Unit and Karl Suss Semi-Automatic Shielded Probe Station | 1. Land low-force tungsten probe (<5 g) gently on the center of a 500 um Al gate dot to avoid micro-punch-through of the 3.5 nm dielectric. 2. Sweep gate voltage VG from inversion (+1.5 V) through depletion to strong accumulation (-2.5 V) at a test frequency of 1.0 MHz with 30 mV AC modulation amplitude. 3. Extract maximum accumulation capacitance C_ox at VG = -2.5 V. 4. Calculate physical oxide thickness using t_ox = (epsilon_ox * epsilon_0 * Area) / C_ox, where epsilon_ox = 3.9. 5. Repeat across 9 representative sites across the 150mm/200mm wafer. | `Extracted physical oxide thickness t_ox = 3.5 nm ± 0.2 nm across all test dies; leakage current at VG = -1.0 V is < 1.0 nA/cm^2; frequency dispersion between 100 kHz and 1 MHz in accumulation is < 3%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact safety glasses, Cleanroom antistatic ESD smock with hood and conductive booties, Thermal heat-resistant gloves for vacuum chamber platen load/unload
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation of argon (asphyxiant): Evacuate victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen or CPR if not breathing. Eye or skin contact with solvent/metal dust: Flush copiously with emergency eyewash/shower for at least 15 minutes; seek prompt medical evaluation. Minor thermal burns from substrate heater: Immerse affected area in clean, cold water for 15 minutes; do not apply unapproved ointments.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: PVD vacuum chamber turbo/roughing pump exhaust must be hard-ducted directly to dedicated house industrial scrubbed solvent/process exhaust. Enclosed gas cabinet for argon with automatic cylinder shutoff. Sputter tool maintenance zone must have minimum 10 air changes per hour with local snorkel capture for chamber cleanings.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent rags and ultrasonic bath effluent must be segregated into sealed, grounded flammable solvent waste drums for certified hazardous disposal. Scrap aluminum metal foil masks and sputtering target remnants to be recycled via designated non-ferrous precious/semiconductor metal reclamation streams.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Argon (compressed process gas)** | `7440-37-1` | Grade 5.0 (99.999% UHP) | `100.0%` |
| **Aluminum (solid sputtering target / deposited film)** | `7429-90-5` | 5N (99.999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, mask cleaning solvent)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry thermal SiO2 on P-type (100) Si, pristine hydrophilic/sub-nanometer surface, zero particulate count, unpackaged inside cleanroom atmosphere directly post-oxidation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned MOSCAP gate dots (300 nm Al on 3.5 nm SiO2) held under cleanroom conditions, awaiting post-metal forming gas anneal (FG PMA 400°C) and subsequent C-V electrical probe characterization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient exposure prior to metallization leads to airborne organic contaminant chemisorption and moisture condensation on the 3.5 nm oxide, generating non-uniform metal adhesion, interface dipole shifts, and erratic flatband voltage shifts (Delta Vfb > 150 mV).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete benchmarked process recipe for planar MOSCAP shadow-mask aluminum dot metallization on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, delivering calibrated 300 nm thick gate electrodes with verified <4 um edge penumbra, validated physical oxide thickness t_ox of 3.5 nm ± 0.2 nm via 1 MHz C-V accumulation profiling, and low gate leakage current.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_PVD_ShadowMask_Recipe_Log_Rev1.csv`
- [ ] `MOSCAP_Dot_Penumbra_Profilometry_Report.tiff`
- [ ] `HighFreq_CV_Cox_Extraction_Benchmark.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
