
---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Chamber Isolation & Roughing Evacuation:**
   - Verify that the load lock and main deposition chamber isolation gate valves are closed and sealed.
   - Initiate primary roughing evacuation using dry scroll/mechanical pumps until chamber pressure reaches crossover threshold (< $1 \times 10^{-1}\text{ Torr}$).

2. **High-Vacuum Turbo / Cryopump Down:**
   - Open main high-vacuum gate valve to engage turbomolecular or cryogenic high-vacuum pumps.
   - Evacuate until chamber ionization gauge confirms base pressure drops strictly below **$2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$** to suppress background $O_2$ and $H_2O$ partial pressure and eliminate oxygen incorporation.

3. **Process Gas Introduction & Pressure Stabilization:**
   - Set mass flow controllers (MFC) to introduce ultra-high purity Argon process gas (**$\text{Ar } 99.999\%$**).
   - Adjust downstream throttle valve to maintain working pressure strictly between **$3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$**.

4. **Shutter Interlock & Target Pre-Sputtering Conditioning:**
   - Verify that the mechanical substrate shielding shutter is completely closed over the substrate pedestal to prevent cross-contamination onto the wafer stage.
   - Engage target cooling water loop and verify flow interlocks.
   - Ignite the planar DC magnetron plasma supply on the 99.999% (5N) Aluminum target.
   - Ramp DC power to **$1.5\text{ to } 3.0\text{ kW}$**.
   - Maintain pre-sputter conditioning burn-in to strip away surface oxides/adsorbed contaminants and achieve stable plasma impedance prior to opening the substrate shutter.

---

| **Process Working Pressure** | $3.0\text{ to } 5.0$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer (Baratron) |
| **DC Magnetron Pre-Sputter Power** | $1.5\text{ to } 3.0$ | $\text{kW}$ | DC Magnetron Power Supply Interlock |
| **Argon Process Gas Purity** | $\ge 99.999\%$ ($5\text{N}$) | $\%$ purity | Gas Line Certificate / RGA Baseline |

---

### 4. Context References

- **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects:** Base pressure pump-down threshold ($< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$), cryo/turbomolecular pumping requirement, high-purity Argon gas specification ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$), working pressure operating range ($3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$), target composition ($99.999\%\text{ Al}$), and DC magnetron power rating ($1.5\text{ to } 3.0\text{ kW}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Interconnect integration baseline for 180nm 1T1C metallization pitch and thermal budgets.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pump-down kinetics must be monitored with both Pirani/convection gauges and broad-range inverted magnetron cold cathode gauges to avoid sensor filament burnout above 1e-3 Torr. Vacuum interlocks must strictly prohibit high-voltage DC magnetron ignition if chamber base pressure fails to cross below 2.0e-6 Torr, preventing catastrophic nitrogen and moisture plasma cracking that leads to aluminum oxynitride lattice defects at the gate dielectric interface.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Pre-sputter target conditioning is paramount for native oxide (Al2O3) strip-off from the 5N Aluminum target face. Sputtering onto a closed physical shutter at 1.5 kW DC power for a minimum duration of 180 seconds under 3.5 mTorr Ar is required to clear surface passivations; plasma impedance and cathode self-bias must stabilize (delta V_bias < 5 V over 60 seconds) prior to shutter retraction to ensure reproducible 350 nm MOS dot metallization without trace oxygen incorporation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying 99.999% (5N) pure Aluminum planar sputtering targets with certified copper backing plates requires qualified vacuum-brazed thermal bonds. Sourcing certified UHP 5N5 Argon gas bottles (99.9995%) with point-of-use catalytic purifiers (<1 ppb H2O/O2) is mandatory, as trace gas impurities rapidly poison conditioned targets and delay fab cycle time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Pump-down and target conditioning are gating operations preceding MOS capacitor parameter sweeps; chamber turnaround times must be tightly scheduled to prevent queue-time excursions on freshly dry-grown 3.5 nm gate oxide wafers waiting in nitrogen dry boxes, directly mitigating metal-gate flatband voltage shifts.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete target pre-sputter conditioning resulting in native Al2O3 flaking, target micro-arcing, and oxygen contamination of initial deposited metal monolayer.
1. Turbomolecular/cryopump regeneration saturation or roughing pump oil backstreaming causing hydrocarbon film deposition and erratic vacuum crossover.
1. Failure of water-cooling loop interlock on the magnetron cathode causing thermal delamination of the indium/elastomer target backing bond under 2.5 kW DC excitation.

| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-2-1-02` | **DC Magnetron Pre-Sputter Target Conditioning and Plasma Bias Stabilization** | Advanced Energy DC Magnetron Power Supply with integrated Arc-Check, Optical Emission Spectrometer (OES), and Chamber Capacitance Manometer | 1. Strike Ar plasma at 500 W DC power on closed shutter. 2. Ramp DC power at 50 W/sec up to 2.0 kW setpoint. 3. Maintain 2.0 kW pre-sputtering for 300 seconds to strip native Al2O3 from target surface. 4. Continuously log cathode voltage, discharge current, and OES intensity for atomic oxygen (777 nm) and aluminum (396 nm) lines. 5. Verify voltage stabilization over the final 60 seconds of conditioning. | `DC cathode discharge voltage stabilizes between 380 V and 420 V with drift <= 3.0 V over the final 60 seconds; micro-arc rate < 2 arcs/minute; OES oxygen line (777 nm) intensity drops below baseline noise floor.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV/IR laser/plasma safety glasses (OD > 4 for Ar plasma emission), Flame-resistant cleanroom gown, High-vacuum implosion face shield during chamber access, Dielectric safety shoes for high-voltage power supply servicing
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For cryogenic burns from cold-head contact, immediately flush area with lukewarm water (never hot) and seek emergency medical care. In case of Ar asphyxiation risk, rapidly move victim to fresh air, administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored, and initiate artificial respiration if respiration stops. For electrical shock from DC magnetron (up to 1 kV DC), isolate main circuit breaker, apply CPR immediately, and call fab emergency services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chamber roughing pump effluent must be continuously exhausted through dedicated acid/toxic fab house vacuum ducting operating at > 50 Pa negative differential pressure. Cryopump regeneration purge must route directly to an abatement scrubber. Loadlock ambient venting must be equipped with localized continuous O2 oxygen-deficiency monitors (alarm setpoint < 19.5% O2).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent aluminum target flakes and vacuum shield peelings must be collected in grounded conductive dry containers to prevent pyrophoric dust combustion. Target cleaning wipes saturated with IPA must be placed in airtight, FM-approved hazardous solvent disposal cans.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Argon (Compressed Gas, Process Grade 5N5)** | `7440-37-1` | Semiconductor Grade (99.9995%) | `100%` |
| **Aluminum (Solid Sputtering Target)** | `7429-90-5` | 5N (99.999%) | `>99.999%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, chamber wipe cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on p-type Si (100) wafers, surface-cleaned, hydrophobic/hydrophilic stabilized, shadow mask aligned and clamped, zero native moisture condensation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conditioned PVD chamber ready for immediate wafer transfer under base vacuum <= 2.0e-6 Torr with pre-sputtered, cleaned 5N Al target face and stable plasma impedance.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne organic siloxane adsorption and moisture chemisorption on the ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxide, inducing high interface trap density (D_it > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2) and premature dielectric breakdown during subsequent MOS-C C-V qualification.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> PVD chamber successfully pumped down below 2.0e-6 Torr base vacuum with verified outgassing integrity, followed by full 5N pure aluminum target pre-sputter conditioning at 2.0 kW under 3.5 mTorr Ar with closed shutter, achieving stabilized cathode discharge bias and zero oxygen optical emission.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PVD_Base_Vacuum_PumpDown_RGA_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Target_PreSputter_Bias_Stabilization_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `OES_Plasma_Emission_Cleanliness_Spectrum.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Ultimate chamber base pressure prior to process gas injection** | `1.5e-6 Torr` | <= 2.0e-6 Torr maximum | Calibrated cold-cathode ionization gauge continuous data logging |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Pre-sputter DC magnetron cathode discharge voltage stability during the final 60 seconds of conditioning** | `400.0 V` | +/- 5.0 V | High-voltage DC power supply telemetry recorded at 10 Hz sampling rate |
| `ASSERT-03` | **High-vacuum isolation rate of rise outgassing rate over 120 seconds** | `2.5e-7 Torr*L/s` | < 5.0e-7 Torr*L/s | Chamber volume pressure accumulation measurement using capacitance manometer |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Chamber achieves base pressure <= 2.0e-6 Torr, pre-sputter plasma burn completes 300 s at 2.0 kW with cathode delta V_bias <= 3 V over the last 60 s without arc trip, RGA confirms partial pressure of m/z 18 < 1.0e-8 Torr, and systems engineer/process engineer sign off on digital execution runsheet.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-PVD-180-AL01: DC Magnetron Al Sputter Deposition Power and Pressure Parameter Sweep

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Chamber Base      │
│       Evacuation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ar Gas Stabilization  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   DC Magnetron Power   │
│         Sweep          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Al Film Deposition   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   In-Line Metrology    │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chamber Pre-Conditioning & Base Vacuum Verification**:
   - Inspect and verify that a 99.999% (5N) pure Aluminum target is mounted to the planar DC magnetron cathode.
   - Load shadow-masked or patterned test wafers into the load lock and pump down the process vacuum chamber using the turbomolecular / cryopump system.
   - Confirm that the chamber base pressure drops below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ before initiating gas flow to eliminate residual background oxygen and moisture.

2. **Process Gas Introduction & Pressure Sweep Setup**:
   - Introduce ultra-high-purity Argon gas ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$) through the calibrated mass flow controller (MFC).
   - Adjust the downstream throttle valve to stabilize chamber process pressure across the benchmark sweep range of **$3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$**.

3. **Target Pre-Sputter & Power Parameter Sweep Execution**:
   - Close the substrate shutter to shield the test wafers.
   - Ignite the plasma and perform pre-sputtering for 2 minutes to strip native target surface oxides.
   - Stepwise sweep the DC magnetron power supply within the qualified range of **$1.5\text{ kW to }3.0\text{ kW}$** to establish the deposition rate curve across the $3\text{--}5\text{ mTorr}$ working pressure matrix.

4. **Film Deposition Run**:
   - Open the substrate shutter once the plasma and DC cathode discharge current stabilize.
   - Run deposition at the calibrated rate of **$50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$** until the Metal-1 target thickness of **$350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$** ($332.5\text{ nm}$ to $367.5\text{ nm}$) is achieved.
   - Ramp down DC power to zero, isolate Ar gas, and transfer wafers to the unload chamber under dry $\text{N}_2$ purge.

5. **Post-Deposition Anneal & In-Line Metrology**:
   - Subject test monitors to forming gas post-metal anneal ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\text{ }95/5$) at **$400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes**.
   - Measure sheet resistance ($R_s$) using a calibrated 4-point probe across 49 test sites.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text

                        │░                             │
Base Press (x10^-6 Torr)┤░                             │
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
   Annealed Rs (mOhm/sq)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
   Target Thickness (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Deposition Rate (nm/min)┤█████████                     │
                        │█████████                     │
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬───────┘
                        0.0   87.5    175.0  262.5      
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance / Bounds | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Pressure** | $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | Max $2.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Ionization Gauge / Cryopump controller |
| **Process Working Pressure** | $3.0\text{ to }5.0$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer |
| **DC Magnetron Power** | $1.5\text{ to }3.0$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{kW}$ | DC Generator Controller |
| **Deposition Rate** | $50\text{ to }100$ | In-line calibrated | $\text{nm/min}$ | Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) / Profilometry |
| **Deposited Film Thickness** | $350$ | $\pm 5\%\text{ }(332.5 - 367.5)$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Optical Profilometer |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | Upper bound $< 80$ | $\Omega/\Box\text{ (m}\Omega/\Box)$ | 4-Point Probe (post 400°C 30 min forming gas anneal) |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Base Vacuum, Working Gas, Target Purity, & DC Power Range**:
  - *Source*: `Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects`
  - *Context Statement*: *"Vacuum Chamber Parameters: Base pressure must pump down below 2x10^-6 Torr using turbomolecular or cryopump to prevent oxygen incorporation. Sputtering process gas is high-purity Argon (Ar 99.999%) maintained at 3 to 5 mTorr working pressure. Target: 99.999% (5N) Aluminum target driven by DC magnetron power supply at 1.5 to 3.0 kW."*
- **Deposition Rate, Thickness Target, & Sheet Resistance Target**:
  - *Source*: `Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects`
  - *Context Statement*: *"Deposition Rate: Calibrated at 50 to 100 nm/minute. Film thickness target for metal-1 is 350 nm ± 5%. Sheet Resistance: Measured sheet resistance target is R_s < 0.08 Ohm/sq after post-metal anneal (forming gas N2/H2 95/5 at 400°C for 30 minutes)."*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Balancing magnetron discharge power (1.5 to 3.0 kW) against Ar working pressure (3 to 5 mTorr) directly couples plasma electron temperature to substrate thermal budget. Higher power accelerates deposition rate (50-100 nm/min) but increases radiative and energetic neutral bombardment onto ultra-thin (3.5 nm) gate oxide test structures, risking dielectric punchthrough and pinhole generation. Furthermore, excessive argon scattering at higher pressures induces microstructural porosity, degrading step coverage and increasing post-sinter sheet resistance above the 0.08 Ohm/sq budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DC magnetron sputtering parameters govern intrinsic film stress, grain morphology, and hillock formation during subsequent forming gas sinter (400-420°C). Sputtering pure 5N Al at sub-optimal pressure creates tensile or compressive stress exceeding 150 MPa, causing shadow mask edge peeling or shadowing penumbra on MOS capacitor dots. Precise base vacuum below 2x10^-6 Torr is non-negotiable; residual partial pressure of H2O and O2 oxidizes sputtered Al adatoms mid-flight, trapping AlOx at the metal-dielectric interface and shifting MOS flatband voltage (Vfb) unpredictably.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Target erosion kinetics and race-track formation on 99.999% purity (5N) planar Al targets (typically 6-inch to 8-inch diameter) will skew deposition rate calibration over cumulative target life (kWh). Sourcing lead times for certified 5N semiconductor-grade targets in Southeast Asia are 8 to 12 weeks. Sputter parameter sweeps must be clustered efficiently to conserve target life and minimize target burn-in waste while qualifying secondary regional suppliers for high-purity argon (Ar 99.999%).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing a full factorial DOE (Power x Pressure x Substrate Temp x Ar Flow) across multiple shadow-masked monitor wafers risks stalling the thermal gate oxide metrology milestone. We must constrain this package to a 3x3 orthogonal sweep (Power: 1.5, 2.25, 3.0 kW; Pressure: 3.0, 4.0, 5.0 mTorr) executed within two consecutive 8-hour equipment allocations to prevent wafer queue-time drift prior to C-V/I-V electrical parameter characterization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Plasma bombardment-induced gate dielectric breakdown: Energetic secondary electrons and reflected Ar neutrals punch through the vulnerable 3.5 nm dry gate oxide during initial strike, causing catastrophic MOS capacitor gate leakage (Jg > 1 A/cm² at -1 V).
1. Shadow mask penumbra and liftoff bridging: Excessive chamber scattering pressure (> 5 mTorr) broadens the adatom angular arrival distribution, creating diffused feathering edges under the shadow mask apertures and resulting in ill-defined MOS capacitor electrode areas (distortion > 10%).
1. Substrate overheating and shadow mask warping: Operating at 3.0 kW without active backside He or gas-conductive platen cooling causes local mechanical distortion of the thin shadow mask, inducing localized pattern blurring and non-uniform film thickness distribution across the 150mm wafer.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-2-2-01` | **Al Deposition Rate, Thickness Uniformity, and Sheet Resistance Parameter Sweep** | Four-Point Probe (FPP / Sheet Resistance Mapper), Optical Film Thickness Profilometer / Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, Cryo-pumped DC Magnetron Sputter Deposition Cluster System with mass flow controllers. | 1. Load monitor wafers into chamber and maintain platen at 25°C. 2. Establish Ar (99.999%) gas flow to stabilize chamber pressures systematically at 3.0, 4.0, and 5.0 mTorr. 3. Ignite DC magnetron plasma and ramp power setpoints sequentially to 1.5 kW, 2.25 kW, and 3.0 kW across a 9-run matrix, depositing for calibrated times targeting 350 nm nominal thickness. 4. Unload wafers and measure 49-point sheet resistance (Rs) via four-point probe across wafer diameter. 5. Measure step height across patterned liftoff/mask edge using stylus/optical profilometry to extract deposition rate (nm/min) and within-wafer thickness non-uniformity (1-sigma). | `Pass: Deposition rate calibrated between 50.0 and 100.0 nm/min; total film thickness is 350 nm ± 17.5 nm (within ± 5%); thickness non-uniformity < 3.0% (1-sigma, 49 points); as-deposited sheet resistance Rs < 0.095 Ohm/sq (and Rs < 0.080 Ohm/sq post-anneal at 400°C).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-2-2-02` | **MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Electrode Definition and Gate Oxide Integrity Test** | Probe Station with Keithley 4200-SCS Parameter Analyzer, LCR Meter (HP/Keysight 4284A) for high-frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) C-V, Optical Inspection Microscope with calibrated reticle. | 1. Transfer shadow-masked 3.5 nm oxide wafer into PVD chamber. 2. Deposit 350 nm Al at qualified power and pressure condition. 3. Vent load lock with N2 and transfer wafer directly to microscope inspection station to evaluate mask dot circularity and penumbra edge definition. 4. Transfer wafer to post-metal sintering furnace (forming gas 95% N2 / 5% H2 at 400°C for 30 minutes). 5. Mount wafer on probe station chuck, land micromanipulator probe on 100 um, 200 um, and 500 um diameter Al dots, and sweep gate voltage from -2.5 V to +2.5 V to record C-V and gate leakage current density (Jg). | `Pass: Shadow mask dot diameter reproduction within ± 2.0% of nominal aperture with edge penumbra width < 1.5 um; gate oxide leakage current density Jg < 1.0x10^-5 A/cm² at Vg = -1.0 V (indicating no plasma pinhole damage); flatband voltage shift |Delta Vfb| < 50 mV across 10 dies.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved during target handling), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser-rated safety glasses or full face shield during plasma viewport inspection, Flame-resistant cleanroom smock, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) safe footwear, N95 or particulate respirator during chamber shielding cleanout (pyrophoric aluminum dust risk)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation of inert gas (Argon): Immediately remove victim to fresh air. If breathing ceases, apply artificial respiration or administer CPR; supply oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin/Eye Contact with chamber particulate/dust: Flush eyes or skin immediately with copiously flowing deionized water for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Burns from hot cathode/platen: Submerge affected thermal burn area in cool water for 20 minutes; do not apply unapproved salves; seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: PVD dry backing and turbomolecular pump exhaust lines must be continuously ducted to dedicated toxic/inert gas house exhaust maintained at minimum negative pressure of -0.5 in. w.g. Room oxygen deficiency monitoring (ODM) sensors calibrated to alarm at < 19.5% O2 with audible and visual strobe sirens are mandatory in the PVD maintenance chase.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Flake deposits and dust collected from chamber dark-space shields, shutters, and implosion liners contain pyrophoric sub-micron Al particulates. Collect all chamber flakes under non-polar solvent or vacuum with dedicated explosion-proof HEPA vacuum; place in sealed, inerted steel drums labeled hazardous flammable solid waste for specialized pyrometallurgical reclamation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Argon (compressed process gas)** | `7440-37-1` | Grade 5.0 (99.999% UHP) | `100%` |
| **Aluminum (sputtering target / deposited metallization)** | `7429-90-5` | 5N (99.999% purity) | `> 99.999%` |
| **Forming Gas (compressed sintering gas, 95% N2 / 5% H2)** | `7727-37-9 (N2) / 1333-74-0 (H2)` | Electronic Grade | `95% N2 / 5% H2` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Atomically smooth, freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide surface, free of organic contamination (contact angle < 10 deg) and moisture, inspected post-oxidation and pre-aligned to shadow mask in ISO 5 laminar flow environment.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Continuously covered 350 nm Al film on oxide, specular reflective mirror finish without blistering, micro-cracking, or discolored oxidation halos, stored in vacuum load-lock or sealed N2 dry box.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom ambient air exposure (> 30 min) prior to PVD leads to airborne moisture and amine condensation on ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide, which outgasses in the PVD chamber, induces Al target poisoning, degrades adhesion, and causes extreme fixed oxide charge density (Qox > 10^12 cm^-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed 3x3 DC magnetron parameter sweep matrix over power (1.5 - 3.0 kW) and pressure (3.0 - 5.0 mTorr) demonstrating a repeatable deposition regime for 350 nm Al on 3.5 nm gate oxide structures with calibrated deposition rate, sub-0.08 Ohm/sq post-sinter sheet resistance, minimal penumbra distortion, and zero plasma-induced dielectric degradation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DC_Magnetron_Al_Power_Pressure_Sweep_DOE_Matrix.csv`
- [ ] `Al_Metallization_Thickness_Uniformity_SheetResistance_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `MOS_Capacitor_ShadowMask_Penumbra_and_CV_Leakage_Analysis.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Aluminum film thickness across 150mm monitor wafer** | `350 nm` | ± 5% (332.5 nm to 367.5 nm) with within-wafer non-uniformity < 3.0% (1-sigma) | 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry and step-height profilometry verification |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-metal sinter sheet resistance (Rs)** | `0.075 Ohm/sq` | < 0.080 Ohm/sq upper threshold after 400°C 30 min forming gas anneal | Standard 4-point probe (FPP) dual-configuration electrical resistivity map |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Gate leakage current density through 3.5 nm oxide under sputtered Al dot** | `5.0x10^-6 A/cm²` | Jg < 1.0x10^-5 A/cm² at Vg = -1.0 V | Precision I-V semiconductor parameter analyzer sweep on 200 um diameter MOS capacitor pads |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Engineering signoff requires unanimous confirmation from Process Engineering and Metrology that the selected operating setpoint (nominally 2.25 kW DC power, 3.5 mTorr Ar pressure, base vacuum < 1.8x10^-6 Torr) delivers 350 nm Al thickness with Rs < 0.080 Ohm/sq, shadow mask penumbra < 1.5 um, and no dielectric punchthrough (Jg < 10 uA/cm² at -1 V) across 3 consecutive qualification wafers.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-Deposition Al Film Thickness, Sheet Resistance, and Adhesion Metrology **Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-AL-007` **Process Step:** Post-Deposition Al Film Thickness, Sheet Resistance, and Adhesion Metrology **Parent Pipeline:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization > Post-Deposition Metrology **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Procured / Standard Metrology Workcells) --- ## 1. Process Workflow ```text ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Wafer Unload │ │ Post-PVD │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Stylus Profilometry │ │ Step Height │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ 4-Point Probe Sheet │ │ Resistance │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Post-Metal Anneal │ │ 400°C 30min │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Post-Anneal Rs │ │ Verification │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ ASTM D3359 Tape │ │ Adhesion Test │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Metrology │ │ Disposition │ │ Pass/Fail │ └───────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure 1. **Wafer Inspection and Environmental Stabilization:** - Unload the metallized wafer cassette from the PVD vacuum load-lock into the class 100 cleanroom environment. - Allow wafers to stabilize at $22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ and $45\% \pm 5\%$ relative humidity for at least 15 minutes before physical contact metrology. 2. **Step-Height Physical Thickness Metrology (Stylus Profilometer / AFM):** - Place wafer onto the precision vacuum chuck of the stylus profilometer. - Align the diamond stylus across the lithography/shadow mask step edge located at 5 standard wafer sites (Center, North, South, East, West with 5 mm edge exclusion). - Set stylus force to $\le 50\ \mu\text{N}$ and scan speed to $10\ \mu\text{m/s}$ across a $200\ \mu\text{m}$ scan length. - Measure the step height to confirm nominal deposition thickness against target $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$. 3. **Pre-Anneal Sheet Resistance Metrology (Four-Point Probe - 4PP):** - Transfer wafer to the 4-point probe station using non-marring vacuum wands. - Execute a 49-point automated radial map using dual-configuration collinear tungsten carbide pins (pin radius $100\ \mu\text{m}$, probe current $10\text{ mA}$). - Record sheet resistance $R_s$ ($\Omega/\square$) and map film uniformity. 4. **Post-Metal Anneal (PMA) Thermal Cycling:** - Load wafers into the atmospheric quartz tube furnace or rapid thermal processing (RTP) chamber. - Purge and stabilize forming gas mixture of $95\%\ \text{N}_2 / 5\%\ \text{H}_2$. - Execute thermal soak at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for exactly 30 minutes to reduce contact resistance, anneal out sputtering defects, and settle grain structure. - Cool wafers below $100^\circ\text{C}$ in pure $\text{N}_2$ ambient prior to chamber unloading. 5. **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance Verification:** - Re-measure wafer on the 4PP station across the identical 49-point grid pattern. - Confirm post-anneal target $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\square$. 6. **Film Adhesion Metrology (ASTM D3359 / Scotch Tape Peel Test):** - Conduct cross-hatch tape adhesion testing on designated edge-exclusion monitor die or sacrificial control coupon. - Cut a $6 \times 6$ grid with $1.0\text{ mm}$ lattice spacing using a precision micro-cutter perpendicular to the film plane down to the substrate interface. - Apply pressure-sensitive tape (adhesion strength $> 38\ \text{N}/100\text{ mm}$) firmly across the lattice using a rubber roller. - Peel tape smoothly at an angle as close to $180^\circ$ as possible within 90 seconds of application. - Inspect cross-cut area under $10\times$ to $50\times$ optical inspection; verify $0\%$ delamination (Classification 5B). --- ## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria ```text ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │░░░░░░░░░ │ Capacitance (fF/cell)┤░░░░░░░░░ │ │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│ PVD Rate (nm/min)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│ Thickness dev (+/- %)┤▓▓ │ │▓▓ │ Rs Post-Anneal (mOhm/sq)┤████████████████████████ │ │████████████████████████ │ └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘ 0 25 50 75 100 ``` | Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Tolerance / Limit | Exact Unit | Instrument / Verification Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Film Thickness ($t_{\text{Al}}$)** | `350` | $\pm 5\%$ ($332.5\text{ to }367.5\text{ nm}$) | $\text{nm}$ | Stylus Profilometry / Step Height | | **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | `< 0.08` | Upper Spec Limit: $\le 0.080$ | $\Omega/\square$ | Collinear 4-Point Probe (4PP) | | **Post-Metal Anneal Thermal Budget** | `400` / `30` | Temperature: $400 \pm 5^\circ\text{C}$
Duration: $30.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$
$\text{min}$ | Forming Gas Furnace ($95\%\ \text{N}_2 / 5\%\ \text{H}_2$) | | **Cross-Hatch Mechanical Adhesion** | `5B` | Delamination: $0.0\%$ | $\%$ area peeled | Optical Inspection (ASTM D3359 cross-hatch peel) | --- ## 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations 1. **Film Thickness & Target Sheet Resistance:** - *Source:* `Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects` - *Cited Parameters:* Film thickness target for metal-1 is **$350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$**; post-metal anneal performed in forming gas **$\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes**; measured post-anneal sheet resistance target is **$R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\square$**; deposition rate baseline of $50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/minute}$. 2. **Capacitance & Device Budget Context:** - *Source:* `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench` & `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering` - *Cited Parameters:* Unit cell geometry gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$; storage cell minimum capacitance budget **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) with leakage below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$. --- ### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA) - **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-PVD metrology must strictly decouple intrinsic bulk film resistivity (rho = R_s * t) from geometrical step coverage and shadow mask penumbra effects. Micro-puncture of the underlying 3.5 nm dry gate oxide during four-point probe contact caused by excessive stylus loading (>80 gf) or damaged probe tips, resulting in dead-short MOS capacitors and unmeasurable C-V curves. 1. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOS Dot Profile Metrology and Forming Gas Anneal (FGA) Parameter Verification

**Module**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology & Characterization  
**Document ID**: `SOP-MET-MOSCAP-001`  
**Revision**: 1.0  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Aluminum Sputter via  │
│      Shadow Mask       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Stylus Profilometry   │
│     / Dot Geometry     │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Forming Gas Anneal:   │
│   400-450C in N2/H2    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       HF 1MHz &        │
│    Quasi-Static C-V    │
│    Characterization    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│  Verification: Dit &   │
│          Tox           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Anneal Gate Dot Dimensional & Profile Metrology
1. Mount the metallized P-type (100) Si test wafer onto the optical/stylus profilometer stage.
2. Verify gate electrode dot geometries sputtered through shadow masks over thermally grown dry gate oxide ($t_{ox} \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$):
   - Measure dot diameters targeting nominal sizes: **$200\ \mu\text{m}$**, **$500\ \mu\text{m}$**, and **$1000\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Profile the Aluminum thickness step height and edge taper across orthogonal axes to calculate the precise active electrode area $A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}$.

#### Step 2: Forming Gas Anneal (FGA) Passivation
1. Clean wafer backside contact (Ohmic Au or Al layer) and load the substrate into a quartz horizontal anneal furnace / rapid thermal annealer (RTA).
2. Purge the tube with pure $N_2$ ambient for 10 minutes at ambient temperature.
3. Establish Forming Gas ambient ($90\text{--}95\%\ \text{N}_2\ /\ 5\text{--}10\%\ \text{H}_2$ mixture).
4. Ramp temperature to **$400^\circ\text{C}\text{--}450^\circ\text{C}$** at $10^\circ\text{C}/\text{min}$ and soak for **30 minutes** to passivate $P_b$ dangling bonds and reduce interface trap density ($D_{it}$) at the $\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}$ interface.
5. Cool down under forming gas/inert ambient to $< 100^\circ\text{C}$ prior to furnace unloading.

#### Step 3: High-Frequency (HF) and Quasi-Static C-V Acquisition
1. Transfer wafer to a shielded probe station equipped with an LCR meter and electrometer.
2. Probe top Al dot ($200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, or $1000\ \mu\text{m}$) and substrate backside ground.
3. Acquire **High-Frequency (1 MHz)** C-V curve:
   - Sweep gate bias $V_G$ from accumulation ($V_G < V_{fb}$) through depletion to inversion ($V_G > V_T$).
   - Record maximum accumulation capacitance:
     $$C_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{ox} \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{ox}}$$
4. Acquire **Quasi-Static (Low-Frequency)** C-V curve across identical voltage window with slow ramp rate ($< 50\text{ mV/s}$) to measure inversion layer recovery back toward $C_{ox}$.

#### Step 4: Parameter Extraction & Pass/Fail Decision
1. Extract physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ from $C_{ox}$ and verify against target nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$.
2. Extract interface trap density profile $D_{it}(E)$ via the Castagné-Vapaille high/low frequency method:
   $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{lf}}{C_{ox} - C_{lf}} - \frac{C_{hf}}{C_{ox} - C_{hf}} \right)$$
3. Confirm absence of distortion or stretch-out along the depletion slope ($V_{fb} < V_G < V_T$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurable Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dot Diameter** | Optical Metrology / Stylus Profile | $200$, $500$, $1000$ | $\pm 2.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | HF (1 MHz) Accumulation $C_{ox}$ Extraction | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | HF / Quasi-Static C-V Difference at Midgap | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | Post-FGA Limit | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ |
| **Flatband Voltage Shift ($\Delta V_{fb}$)** | 1 MHz $V_{fb}$ Hysteresis Sweep | $< 50$ | Maximum Delta | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources

- **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Al gate circular dot diameters ($200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, $1000\ \mu\text{m}$) sputtered through shadow mask on P-type (100) Si.
  - Backside substrate Au or Al ohmic contact layer.
  - High-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static C-V characterization across accumulation ($V_G < V_{fb}$), depletion ($V_{fb} < V_G < V_T$), and inversion ($V_G > V_T$).
  - Extraction precision of physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ within $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Thermal dry gate oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal budget integration between shadow-mask metallization (Al or Ti/Au dots) and forming gas anneal (FGA) requires rigorous isolation: standard Al-SiO2 post-metallization anneal (PMA) must not exceed 400-425°C to prevent aluminum spiking through the thin 3.5 nm gate dielectric, while ensuring complete reduction of border and interface traps. Profilometry of physical dot dimensions must be cross-calibrated against optical ellipsometry and high-frequency C-V accumulation capacitance to verify effective electrical area vs. geometric footprint.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide, unannealed interface trap density (Dit) typically exceeds 5e11 eV^-1 cm^-2, causing severe stretch-out and frequency dispersion in quasi-static/high-frequency C-V curves. Forming gas (typically 5% to 10% H2 in N2) passivation at 400°C for 30 minutes passivates silicon dangling bonds (Pb centers) to bring Dit down below 2e10 eV^-1 cm^-2. Shadow mask shadow-penumbra artifacts must be quantified via stylus or optical coherence profilometry to prevent underestimating oxide capacitance equivalent thickness (CET).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Pre-mixed semiconductor grade Forming Gas (95% N2 / 5% H2 or 90% N2 / 10% H2, 99.999% purity) cylinders must have dedicated flash-back arrestors, dual-stage stainless steel regulators, and automated toxic/flammable gas monitoring. Laser-cut molybdenum or electroformed nickel shadow masks require tight incoming inspection for burrs and edge-taper wear to preserve dot circularity over repeated metallization runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: To maintain execution cadence within Gen 1 (mm) baseline for DRAM Foundation VN, MOS dot verification must conclude within a 36-hour sprint window. Profilometry metrology and FGA furnace execution must run sequentially with immediate automated export of C-V raw profiles and thickness data to the central wafer database before proceeding to parameter extraction signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Flame-resistant cleanroom lab coat / Nomex suit, ANSI Z87.1 certified impact-resistant UV/chemical safety glasses, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) certified heat-resistant gloves (rated to 150°C handling), High-purity nitrile gloves (double gloving for wafer transfer)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For thermal contact burns: Immediately flush with copious cool water for >= 15 minutes, apply sterile non-adherent dressing, and seek medical attention. For gas inhalation or asphyxiation: Relocate victim immediately to fresh air, administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored, initiate CPR if pulse or respiration ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous dedicated scrubber exhaust on furnace gas box; hydrogen sensor array set to trip interlock and auto-purge with pure N2 at 20% LEL (Lower Explosive Limit: 0.8% absolute H2 concentration in room ambient); minimum air face velocity 100 FPM at furnace loading mouth.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Furnace effluent gas routed through a point-of-use thermal decomposition oxidizer/burn box to oxidize residual unreacted H2 before venting through the main facility acid/house exhaust stack.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Dot Profilometry and Edge Taper Metrology

**Discipline / Category**: Metrology  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Shadow mask thermal evaporation/sputtering introduces penumbral edge taper (geometric shadowing from finite source-to-substrate distance and non-zero mask-wafer standoff gap). Because oxide capacitance C_ox = (epsilon_ox * epsilon_0 * Area) / t_ox is directly proportional to dot area, an uncharacterized edge transition width (delta_r > 5 um on a 200 um dot) skews physical gate oxide thickness extraction by >5%, distorting 3.5 nm Deal-Grove dry oxidation kinetics calibration across the wafer.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical stylus profilometry risks piercing or scratching ultra-thin 3.5 nm thermal gate oxide if stylus force exceeds 1 mg (9.8 uN) when stepping off the 100-300 nm Al dot perimeter. Optical coherence/white-light interferometry (WLI) or low-force contact profilometry must decouple optical phase-shift artifacts at the Al-SiO2 boundary from real physical taper, ensuring accurate determination of the 10%-90% step-height transition and effective electrical diameter.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom laser-cut molybdenum, stainless steel, or invar shadow masks exhibit micro-burrs and thermal warpage over repeated deposition cycles. Laser-etched bi-metal stencil masks with electroformed nickel coatings provide sub-micron aperture circularity tolerance (+/- 1.5 um) but suffer 6-8 week lead times; local cleanroom fabrication using deep reactive-ion etching (DRIE) of silicon shadow masks is recommended for quick Gen 1 prototyping.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput must balance complete topographic mapping against electrical testing queue time. Profilometry across 9 lithographic sites per 150mm wafer must execute within 25 minutes to preserve the 45-minute Q-time window prior to forming gas anneal (FGA) and high-frequency C-V extraction.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Stylus punch-through across the 3.5 nm dry SiO2 dielectric boundary during profilometry line scans, resulting in gate oxide pinhole formation and gate-to-substrate shorting during subsequent C-V electrical probing.
1. Excessive penumbra shadow taper (>15 um lateral transition) caused by mask bowing or standoff gap >25 um, creating an undefined capacitive fringe perimeter and rendering Dit/Cox model fitting non-convergent.
1. Organic residue or particulate entrapment between the shadow mask and pristine 3.5 nm thermal gate oxide during clamp engagement, causing mechanical micro-fractures in the gate dielectric.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-1-01` | **MOSCAP Sputtered Dot Step Height and Topographic Thickness Uniformity** | Stylus Profilometer (Bruker DektakXT or KLA Tencor P-7) with 2 um diamond radius tip, calibrated against VLSI 100 nm step-height standard. | 1. Load wafer onto vacuum chuck and align center dot array (200 um nominal diameter). 2. Set stylus tracking force to <= 0.5 mg (4.9 uN) with a scan speed of 10 um/s and resolution of 0.05 um/sample. 3. Execute 500 um orthogonal diametrical line scans across 5 test dots (Center, North, South, East, West). 4. Extract flat plateau thickness by averaging baseline oxide reference [-100 um to -50 um from edge] and metallization plateau [+50 um to +150 um]. 5. Compute mean film thickness and 1-sigma across-wafer thickness variation. | `Al dot center plateau thickness must be 150 nm +/- 15 nm. Across-wafer thickness standard deviation must be <= 5.0% (1-sigma). Zero mechanical puncture marks observable on adjacent 3.5 nm oxide at 50x optical inspection.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-1-02` | **Penumbral Edge Taper Width and Geometric Effective Diameter Quantification** | Optical Profilometer / White Light Interferometer (Zygo NewView 9000 or Bruker ContourGT-K) in VSI/CSI mode with 50x Mirau objective. | 1. Position WLI field-of-view across the boundary perimeter of 200 um and 500 um nominal diameter Al gate dots. 2. Acquire 3D surface height map across 250 um x 250 um area with vertical resolution < 0.1 nm. 3. Extract 8 radial profile slices at 45-degree increments around each dot perimeter. 4. Determine lateral taper distance defined between the 10% step height (15 nm) and 90% step height (135 nm) points. 5. Calculate effective electrical diameter D_eff = D_50% and circularity ratio (D_min / D_max). | `Lateral penumbra edge taper width (10%-90%) must be <= 8.0 um across all 8 radial axes. Circularity ratio (D_min / D_max) must be >= 0.96. Effective diameter D_eff must match nominal aperture dimension within +/- 2.5%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) safe cleanroom coat and conductive heel straps, Polypropylene cleanroom face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with solvent: Flush with copious deionized water for 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE; seek medical evaluation if irritation persists. Eye exposure: Irrigate eyes immediately at plumbed eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Nitrogen inhalation/asphyxiation risk: Move casualty immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if trained and initiate CPR if pulse absent.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within ISO Class 5 laminar flow cleanroom hood with min 90 FPM vertical laminar air velocity. Solvent wipe cleaning of shadow masks must occur under localized dedicated chemical exhaust duct with >= 100 CFM face velocity.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning wipes and swabs contaminated with IPA/Acetone must be segregated in airtight, UL-listed flammable rag disposal cans with self-closing foot pedals. Do not mix solvent wastes with acid/fluoride drains; collect in designated Halogen-Free Organic Waste Carboys for licensed hazardous disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / MOS Grade (SEMI C12) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | VLSI Grade (SEMI C1) | `99.5%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited Al circular gate dots (150 nm) atop unpassivated 3.5 nm dry thermal SiO2 gate dielectric, post-shadow-mask metallization chamber vacuum release.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dimensionally characterized, non-scratched MOSCAP dot structures ready for Forming Gas Anneal (FGA) furnace loading.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive cleanroom air exposure causes moisture absorption and airborne hydrocarbon condensation on unpassivated Al/SiO2 perimeter interfaces, accelerating galvanic native oxidation of Al (Al2O3) and increasing interface trap density (Dit) beyond 5e11 eV^-1 cm^-2 prior to FGA stabilization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified physical profile, step height, circularity, and edge taper metrology of sputtered Al MOS capacitor dots, establishing validated physical gate areas required for accurate 3.5 nm oxide thickness extraction and C-V Dit profiling.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_DOT_PROFILOMETRY_RUN_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `MOSCAP_EDGE_TAPER_WLI_TOPOGRAPHY_MAPS.tiff`
- [ ] `MOSCAP_METROLOGY_SIGNOFF_CERTIFICATE.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Aluminum gate dot nominal metallization thickness across all measured die locations** | `150.0 nm` | +/- 15.0 nm | Low-force stylus profilometry (TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-1-01) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum allowable 10%-90% penumbral edge taper lateral width along dot perimeter** | `5.0 um` | <= 8.0 um max limit | White Light Interferometry radial slice extraction (TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-1-02) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Circular dot geometrical aspect symmetry ratio (D_min / D_max)** | `0.985` | >= 0.960 | WLI 2D thresholded binary boundary contour analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 wafer sampling sites pass thickness (150 +/- 15 nm), edge taper (<= 8.0 um), and circularity (>= 0.96) specifications with zero stylus-induced punch-through defects detected on 3.5 nm gate oxide; profile metadata populated in DRAM Foundation VN database and wafer transferred to FGA stage within Q-time.

Do not mix solvent wastes with acid/fluoride drains; collect in designated Halogen-Free Organic Waste Carboys for licensed hazardous disposal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Forming Gas Anneal Recipe Sweep and Passivation Processing (400–450°C H₂/N₂)
**Process Step:** Thermal Processing (Post-Metallization / MOS Capacitor Interface Passivation)  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the forming gas anneal (FGA) recipe sweep and thermal passivation protocol for post-metallized MOS capacitor test structures and access transistor gate stacks (3.5 nm dry gate oxide). The process passivates dangling bonds (silicon dangling bonds $P_b$ centers) at the $\text{Si/SiO}_2$ interface via atomic hydrogen diffusion to minimize interface trap density ($D_{it}$) and suppress sub-threshold junction leakage below 1 fA/cell.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           FORMING GAS ANNEAL WORKFLOW                             |
|                                                                                   |
|  [Furnace Load & Purge] ---> [Thermal Ramp & Sweep] ---> [Hydrogen Passivation]  |
|   - Ambient: N2 Purge         - 400°C to 450°C           - 5-10% H2 / 90-95% N2   |
|   - Base idle: 250-300°C      - Ramp: 5-10°C/min         - Soak: 30-45 min        |
|                                                                                   |
|                              [Cooldown & Unload]                                  |
|                               - Post-anneal N2 purge                              |
|                               - Pull temp: < 150°C                                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Quartz Tube Furnace Pre-Check & Idle State Conditioning
1. Verify the quartz tube furnace is operating under clean, non-oxidizing idle conditions at standby temperature ($250^\circ\text{C} \le T \le 300^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Ensure forming gas delivery lines ($5\%\text{--}10\%\ \text{H}_2\ \text{in}\ \text{N}_2$ forming gas mixture, below the 4% lower flammability limit under ambient or certified safety interlocked exhaust) and pure carrier $\text{N}_2$ are certified at grade 6.0 ($99.9999\%$).
3. Purge the quartz process tube with high-purity $\text{N}_2$ at 10–15 SLPM for 15 minutes to displace residual moisture and oxygen ($O_2 < 5\ \text{ppm}$).

#### Step 2: Wafer Loading & Atmosphere Stabilization
1. Load patterned 180nm MOS capacitor test wafers (featuring thermally grown 3.5 nm dry $\text{SiO}_2$ with shadow-mask deposited metallization dots) onto high-purity quartz boats.
2. Transfer the boat into the central flat-zone of the furnace tube at an insertion rate $\le 100\ \text{mm/min}$.
3. Seal tube door/flange and initiate a closed-loop $\text{N}_2$ purge cycle for 10 minutes at standby temperature.

#### Step 3: Temperature Sweep & Forming Gas Anneal Execution
1. Set the forming gas flow to the target process rate (e.g., 5–10 SLPM $\text{H}_2/\text{N}_2$).
2. Execute the temperature sweep recipe to evaluate passivation kinetics across the target process window ($400^\circ\text{C}\ \text{to}\ 450^\circ\text{C}$):
   - Ramp up at a controlled rate of $5^\circ\text{C}\text{--}10^\circ\text{C/min}$ from idle to process setpoint ($400^\circ\text{C}, 425^\circ\text{C},$ or $450^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Allow temperature stabilization across all furnace zones within $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
3. Maintain thermal soak under forming gas ambient for a validated dwell duration of 30 to 45 minutes to drive hydrogen diffusion through the gate electrode to the $\text{Si/SiO}_2$ interface.

#### Step 4: Cooldown, Post-Purge, and Unload
1. Switch gas manifold from forming gas back to pure $\text{N}_2$ purge at 10 SLPM for a minimum of 10 minutes to clear hydrogen from the chamber.
2. Ramp down temperature at $\le 5^\circ\text{C/min}$ to pull temperature ($< 150^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Slowly retract the wafer boat ($\le 100\ \text{mm/min}$) under continuous $\text{N}_2$ curtain into the laminar flow load station.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Anneal Process Temperature** | $400 \text{ to } 450$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ multi-zone thermocouple / pyrometer |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / C-V metrology |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $< 1 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-frequency / Quasistatic C-V or Conductance method |
| **Leakage Current Target** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ (@ 85°C) | Precision Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (pA/fA meter) |

---

### 4. Literature References & Citations
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Establishes dry gate dielectric oxidation kinetics yielding physical oxide thickness target of 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm with $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ and dielectric breakdown $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Establishes unit cell geometry ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), capacitance budget ($\ge 28\ \text{fF/cell}$), and the stringent leakage current threshold ($< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) required to maintain refresh interval specifications.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms gate dielectric physical thickness specification of $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ thermally grown dry $\text{SiO}_2$ and data retention constraints.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Forming gas anneal (FGA) at 400-450°C introduces tight thermal-gas coupling in horizontal quartz tube furnaces: operating at low temperatures (<500°C) reduces radiative transfer efficiency, shifting zone balance predominantly toward convective flow dynamics. The triple-loop PID controller tuned for high-temperature oxidation (>900°C) will experience significant thermal lag and overshoot unless dedicated low-temperature PID sets are calibrated. Gas dynamics must maintain laminar sweep between 2.0 and 4.0 SLPM to ensure complete wafer-load immersion while preventing ambient back-diffusion and hydrogen stratification inside the flat zone.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm gate dielectric node with a 3.5 nm physical SiO2 gate oxide, passivation of dangling silicon bonds (trivalent Si 'Pb' centers) via atomic hydrogen cracking across the aluminum/polysilicon gate edge is paramount to suppress interface trap density (Dit) from >1e12 eV^-1 cm^-2 down to <1e10 eV^-1 cm^-2. However, exceeding 450°C risks aggressive Al-Si spiking and metal hillock formation if metal shadow mask dot metallization has already occurred. The recipe sweep must systematically explore 400°C, 425°C, and 450°C under 5% to 10% H2/N2 with soak durations from 20 to 45 minutes to optimize Dit passivation without inducing thermal stress or dielectric leakage degradation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Forming gas (5% H2 / 95% N2 or 10% H2 / 90% N2) certified at VLSI/electronic grade (99.999% purity) presents hazardous gas storage constraints and supply lead times within local fab infrastructure. Dual-stage flash arrestors, coaxial stainless steel gas lines (electropolished 316L VIM/VAR), and mass flow controllers dedicated strictly to non-oxidizing forming gas mixes are required to avoid pyrophoric and cross-contamination hazards.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal budget milestones dictate that this FGA sweep cannot bottleneck downstream high-frequency C-V and quasi-static I-V characterization lots. Process cycle times must be constrained by pre-programming automated slow boat cantilever insertion (<50 mm/min) and N2 pre-purge cycles to complete each sweep run within 120 minutes total furnace occupancy.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal Al/Si spiking or eutectic intermixing at shadow-mask metal dot contacts if localized furnace overshoot exceeds 455°C.
1. Incomplete dangling bond passivation leading to post-anneal Dit remaining above 3e10 eV^-1 cm^-2, causing severe C-V stretch-out and threshold voltage (Vth) instability.
1. Atmospheric oxygen or moisture back-diffusion during low-velocity gas delivery causing uncontrolled gate metallization oxidation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-2-01` | **High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction Sweep** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter and B1500A-002 High-Resolution SMU, probe station with dark box and thermal chuck. | 1. Place wafer on vacuum chuck and contact gold/aluminum backside substrate pad with ground reference. 2. Land beryllium-copper probe tip on 200 µm diameter Al gate dot. 3. Execute high-frequency C-V sweep from -3.0 V to +2.0 V at 100 kHz (AC oscillation level 25 mV RMS). 4. Execute quasi-static C-V sweep across the identical voltage span at a ramp rate of 50 mV/s. 5. Calculate Dit profile using the Castagné-Vapaille high-low frequency method: Dit = (1/q) * [ (Chf * Cqs) / (Cox - Cqs) - (Chf^2 / (Cox - Chf)) ] / (1 - Chf/Cox). 6. Record peak and midgap Dit values across 5 designated dies (center, top, bottom, left, right). | `Midgap interface trap density Dit <= 1.0e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 across all 5 test sites; C-V hysteresis delta-Vfb <= 15 mV between forward and reverse sweeps.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-2-02` | **Flatband Voltage Shift and Gate Dielectric Leakage Verification Post-FGA** | Keysight B1500A Precision SMU (pA-level resolution) connected to semi-automated wafer prober. | 1. Contact 100 µm x 100 µm MOS capacitor test dots across 9 wafer mapping locations. 2. Extract flatband voltage (Vfb) from 1 MHz C-V characteristics. 3. Apply accumulation gate bias equivalent to Eox = 3.0 MV/cm (Vg = -1.05 V for 3.5 nm oxide) and measure gate leakage current density (Jg) for 10 seconds continuous dwell. 4. Ramp gate bias to breakdown voltage at 0.1 V/s to establish hard breakdown threshold (Ebd). | `Gate leakage current density Jg <= 1.0e-7 A/cm^2 at |Vg - Vfb| = 1.0 V; breakdown field Ebd >= 11.0 MV/cm; flatband voltage uniformity across 9 sites within ±25 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Flame-resistant cleanroom lab coat (Nomex), Chemical splash and mechanical impact rated safety goggles (ANSI Z87.1), High-temperature thermal handling Kevlar gloves (rated to 500°C) for quartz boat handling, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), Face shield when inspecting furnace tube end cap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For thermal burns: Immediately immerse affected area in clean, cold water or apply cold compresses for minimum 15 minutes; do not apply salves; seek immediate medical attention. In case of inert gas (N2) asphyxiation: Move victim to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing has stopped; notify emergency response fab dispatch.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous furnace cabinet extraction at >= 150 CFM with static differential pressure >= 0.25 inches water column. Dedicated toxic/flammable gas monitoring (H2 sensors calibrated to alarm at 25% of LEL, i.e., 1.0% absolute H2). Automated pneumatic emergency shut-off valve (ESV) interlocked to exhaust pressure sensors and hydrogen leak detection.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Furnace exhaust line routed to thermal point-of-use burn box / catalytic oxidizer scrubber to convert residual hydrogen to water vapor prior to facility acid exhaust discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrogen** | `1333-74-0` | Electronic Grade 5N (99.999%) | `5.0% to 10.0% balance in N2` |
| **Nitrogen** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 6N (99.9999%) | `90.0% to 100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized Al MOS capacitor structures via shadow mask evaporation with unpassivated, native dangling bonds at Si/SiO2 interface (Dit >= 1e12 eV^-1 cm^-2); free of organic residue and particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thermally stabilized, hydrogen-passivated Si/SiO2 interface (Dit <= 1e10 eV^-1 cm^-2) with intact Al electrode morphology free of eutectic spiking, blistering, or oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure Q-time allows atmospheric moisture and airborne organic siloxanes to chemisorb onto the metal/oxide edges, causing permanent interface trap pinning, erratic C-V stretch-out, and degraded passivation kinetics during subsequent FGA.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Forming Gas Anneal recipe parameter sweep (400°C, 425°C, 450°C in 5% H2/95% N2) executed on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOS test capacitors, achieving robust Si/SiO2 dangling bond hydrogen passivation with midgap Dit <= 1e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 and zero aluminum-silicon eutectic spiking.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FGA_Recipe_Sweep_Thermal_Profile_RunLog.csv`
- [ ] `MOS_Capacitor_High_Low_Freq_CV_Dit_Extraction_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Al_Dot_Post_Anneal_Morphology_Microscopy.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Si/SiO2 midgap interface trap density (Dit) post-anneal** | `8.0e9 eV^-1 cm^-2` | <= 1.0e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 | Keysight B1500A High-Low Frequency C-V (Castagné-Vapaille method at 100 kHz and quasi-static 50 mV/s) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Flatband voltage hysteresis (delta-Vfb) between forward and reverse sweeps** | `8.0 mV` | <= 15.0 mV | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V bidirectional voltage sweep (-3.0 V to +2.0 V to -3.0 V) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Gate leakage current density (Jg) at 1.0 V oxide accumulation** | `3.5e-8 A/cm^2` | <= 1.0e-7 A/cm^2 | Quasi-static I-V sweep using high-resolution SMU across 9 wafer sites |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 wafer measurement sites demonstrate midgap Dit <= 1.0e10 eV^-1 cm^-2, gate dielectric leakage Jg <= 1.0e-7 A/cm^2 at accumulation, optical inspection confirms zero aluminum contact blistering or spiking under 1000x Nomarski DIC microscopy, and formal signoff is recorded by both the Thermal Processing Domain Expert and Metrology Lead.
