# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Anneal C-V and Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Verification Metrology
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-CV-007`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Buy / External Commercial Metrology Execution (LCR Meter / Automated Prober Suite)  
**Parent Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip $\rightarrow$ 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) $\rightarrow$ MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization $\rightarrow$ Post-Anneal C-V and $D_{it}$ Verification Metrology  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Measurement Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Wafer Infeed: Post-Forming Gas Annealed MOS Dot Wafers"] --> B["Dark Box Vacuum Chuck Loading & Micro-probe Alignment"]
    B --> C["High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweep (100 kHz - 1 MHz, -3V to +3V)"]
    C --> D["Quasi-Static / Low-Frequency (LF) C-V Sweep or Terman Profiling"]
    D --> E["C-V Curve Extraction: EOT, Cox Accumulation, Vfb Shift"]
    E --> F["Hi-Lo Capacitance Extraction for Interface Trap Density (Dit)"]
    F --> G["Dielectric Breakdown Test: Ramp E-Field to Verify E_bd"]
    G --> H{"Acceptance Gate Review"}
    H -- Pass --> I["Release Lot to Access Transistor Gate Patterning"]
    H -- Fail --> J["Quarantine Lot / Rework FGA Thermal Cycle"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Setup and Chuck Grounding:**
   - Mount the post-forming gas anneal (FGA) wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck inside a light-tight, electrically shielded Faraday dark box.
   - Ground the backside p-type / n-type silicon substrate contact; inspect probe tip scrub geometry on the top shadow-masked metal dot (aluminum/gold pad).
2. **High-Frequency (HF) Capacitance-Voltage Acquisition:**
   - Connect the precision impedance analyzer (e.g., Keysight E4980A or equivalent commercial C-V bridge).
   - Configure a DC bias voltage sweep from $-3.0\text{ V}$ to $+3.0\text{ V}$ (accumulation to inversion) with an AC oscillation signal $V_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}$ RMS at $1\text{ MHz}$ (or $100\text{ kHz}$).
   - Extract the maximum accumulation capacitance ($C_{ox}$) and flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$). Calculate equivalent physical oxide thickness:
     $$t_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{SiO_2} \cdot A_{dot}}{C_{ox}}$$
3. **Quasi-Static (LF) Sweep & $D_{it}$ Interface Extraction:**
   - Execute a quasi-static C-V (QSCV) or low-frequency sweep (or apply the Terman method if using solely HF data) across the identical bias window.
   - Calculate interface trap density ($D_{it}$) using the High-Low Capacitance method across the bandgap:
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{LF} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{LF} / C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{HF} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{HF} / C_{ox}} \right) \cdot \frac{1}{A_{dot}}$$
4. **Dielectric Breakdown Verification ($E_{bd}$):**
   - Apply a voltage ramp-to-breakdown stress test on dedicated sacrificial test dots until current compliance ($I_{limit} = 10\text{ mA}$) is reached.
   - Record the breakdown electric field $E_{bd} = V_{breakdown} / t_{ox}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                                                        
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
       Cap/Cell (fF)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                     │
        E_bd (MV/cm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                     │
Dit (1e10 cm-2 eV-1)┤▒▒                                │
                    │▒▒                                │
            EOT (nm)┤█████                             │
                    │█████                             │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0       7       14      21      28 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Tolerance / Upper Limit | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$ / EOT)** | `3.5` | `3.5 to 4.0` | $\text{nm}$ | 1 MHz Accumulation $C_{ox}$ Extraction |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | `< 1.0 \times 10^{10}` | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low (Hi-Lo) C-V / Terman Extraction |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | `> 10.0` | $\ge 10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Voltage Ramp to Dielectric Breakdown |
| **Storage Node Cell Capacitance Budget Reference** | `28.0` | `25.0 to 30.0` | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked Capacitor C-V Confirmation |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - *Context verified:* Dry thermal oxidation grown at 850°C–1000°C produces dense, high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide with physical thickness of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$, dielectric breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Context verified:* 180nm gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (EOT $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$); storage node target maintains $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Context verified:* 180nm unit cell access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum storage capacitance target of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell for soft-error and noise immunity.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-forming gas anneal (FGA) C-V characterization must cross-correlate extracted Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) against non-destructive spectroscopic ellipsometry data (3.5 nm nominal) to isolate quantum mechanical carrier confinement corrections from physical physical thickness drift. Furthermore, series resistance (Rs) from substrate backside grounding and probe contact resistance must be calibrated via multi-frequency de-embedding (10 kHz to 1 MHz) to prevent systematic underestimation of accumulation capacitance (Cox) and false distortion of the high-frequency C-V slope.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Extraction of interface trap density (Dit) across the silicon bandgap using the combined High-Low Frequency (Terman / Castagné-Vapaille) or conductance method requires tight control over parasitic illumination, thermal noise, and probe tip overdrive. Aluminum gate MOS dots formed via shadow mask evaporation frequently exhibit perimeter fringe field capacitances and unpassivated dangling bonds (Pb centers) if the forming gas (4% H2 / 96% N2) anneal thermal budget (typically 400-450°C for 30 min) was insufficient to achieve passivation to < 1E10 cm^-2*eV^-1 at midgap.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Shadow mask-defined MOS capacitors eliminate photolithographic consumables and wet resist strip hazards, but shadow mask mechanical wear, aperture burrs, and particulate buildup cause significant dot area variance (+/- 8%), directly compromising Cox per unit area calculations. Certified calibration targets for probe-tip wear and precision traceable quartz/wafer standard references must be maintained in the metrology lab to avoid false lot rejection.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput must align with the gate module turnaround time. Because low-frequency quasi-static C-V ramps require slow sweep rates (10-50 mV/s) to maintain thermal equilibrium displacement currents without instrument noise truncation, dot measurement sequencing must be optimized across an automated 9-point wafer map within a maximum allocation of 45 minutes per wafer.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Series resistance screening artifact: High backside substrate contact resistance causes severe accumulation capacitance dispersion at 1 MHz, leading to false EOT overestimation and inaccurate Flatband Voltage (Vfb) determination.
1. Leakage current masking: Direct tunneling leakage through thin (3.5 nm) gate oxide under accumulation biases exceeding 1.2 V obscures quasi-static low-frequency capacitance, distorting extracted midgap Dit values.
1. Incomplete Pb center passivation: Forming gas anneal temperature/time undershoot leaving midgap interface trap density Dit > 5.0E10 eV^-1*cm^-2, triggering premature DRAM storage node subthreshold leakage and retention degradation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-3-01` | **Multi-Frequency High-Frequency C-V and Flatband Voltage Shift Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter Module, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automatic Probe Station with dark box shielding and gold-plated vacuum chuck | 1. Load wafer onto gold vacuum chuck and verify backside vacuum seal (> 60 kPa). 2. Contact beryllium-copper (BeCu) probe tip to shadow-mask aluminum MOS dot (nominal diameter 200 um) with 15 um probe overdrive. 3. Perform open/short fixture compensation at 10 kHz, 100 kHz, and 1 MHz. 4. Apply bidirectional DC bias sweep from inversion (-1.5 V for n-type / +1.5 V for p-type) to accumulation (+1.5 V for n-type / -1.5 V for p-type) at a slew rate of 50 mV/s with AC oscillation amplitude of 25 mV RMS. 5. Acquire C-V and G-V profiles across 9 automated sites (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge). 6. Extract Cox, Flatband Capacitance (Cfb), Flatband Voltage (Vfb), and hysteresis across dual sweeps. | `Accumulation capacitance Cox at 100 kHz must yield EOT = 3.50 ± 0.20 nm; bidirectional Vfb hysteresis <= 20 mV; frequency dispersion between 10 kHz and 1 MHz in accumulation <= 3.0%.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-2-3-3-02` | **Quasi-Static & High-Frequency C-V Combined Extraction of Interface Trap Density (Dit)** | Keysight B1500A equipped with High-Resolution SMU (B1517A) for Quasi-Static C-V (QSCV) and B1520A LCR Module, Dark Box Shielded Faraday Cage, Temptronic Chuck Temperature Controller | 1. Position probe tip on target 200 um diameter MOS dot. 2. Measure 100 kHz high-frequency C-V (Chf) curve from -1.2 V to +1.2 V at 30 mV/s. 3. Configure Quasi-Static C-V measurement using linear displacement current method (ramp rate 20 mV/s) from -1.2 V to +1.2 V to obtain Cqs. 4. Apply Castagné-Vapaille formulation: Dit = (1 / q) * [ (Chf^-1 - Cox^-1)^-1 - (Cqs^-1 - Cox^-1)^-1 ] / [ (1 - Cqs/Cox) * (1 - Chf/Cox) ] across the depletion-to-weak inversion bandgap window (Et - Ei between -0.3 eV and +0.3 eV). 5. Repeat across 9 standard test dies on wafer. | `Extracted midgap interface trap density Dit <= 1.0E10 eV^-1*cm^-2 across >= 8 of 9 wafer map sites; gate leakage current density Jg at Vfb ± 0.5 V <= 1.0E-6 A/cm^2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive ESD grounding heel straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA: Remove contaminated gloves and wash skin with copious water and mild soap for 15 minutes. For eye contact with IPA or debris: Irrigate eyes at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical attention if irritation persists. For Ga-In eutectic contact: Wipe off mechanically, wash skin thoroughly with soap and water; non-toxic under normal contact but avoid open wounds.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow hood (Class 100 / ISO 5) over probe station. Local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at min 50 FPM face velocity for solvent tip wipe operations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes sealed in dedicated flammable solid waste containers and disposed of per hazardous waste guidelines. Indium-gallium residue wipes collected in heavy-metal designated solids container.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for probe tip cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Indium-Gallium Eutectic (optional backside contact liquid metal)** | `12057-74-8` | Analytical Grade (99.99% trace metals) | `75.5% Ga / 24.5% In` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-Forming Gas Anneal (425°C 4% H2/N2) cooled down to < 50°C in N2 purged loadlock; aluminum dot metallization clean, unoxidized, and free of moisture or organic condensation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized MOS capacitors with probe tip scrub marks < 15 um length; wafer surface dry and purged, ready for post-metrology scribe dicing or front-end baseline archive.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended air exposure past 120 minutes promotes atmospheric moisture adsorption, native oxidation of thin exposed silicon areas, and organic airborne contamination (adsorbed airborne molecular contaminants / VOCs), shifting surface potential, increasing surface leakage currents, and causing false Dit inflation by up to 3x.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified post-forming gas anneal electrical baseline for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. Full wafer 9-point mapping validates that hydrogen passivation has suppressed Si/SiO2 interface trap density Dit to <= 1.0E10 eV^-1*cm^-2 at midgap and confirmed equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) at 3.50 ± 0.20 nm with negligible Vfb hysteresis, qualifying the thermal oxidation and passivation loop for DRAM access transistor integration.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `POST_FGA_CV_9PT_MAP_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `DIT_BANDGAP_ENERGY_SPECTRUM.pdf`
- [ ] `GATE_LEAKAGE_JG_VS_VOFFSET.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from 100 kHz Cox in accumulation** | `3.50 nm` | ± 0.20 nm | Multi-frequency C-V de-embedded accumulation capacitance using quantum mechanical Hauser-Ahmed model extraction |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Si/SiO2 interface trap density (Dit) at midgap (Et - Ei = 0 eV)** | `8.0E9 eV^-1*cm^-2` | <= 1.0E10 eV^-1*cm^-2 | Castagné-Vapaille high-low frequency (Chf at 100 kHz vs Quasi-Static Cqs) differential capacitance extraction |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Flatband Voltage bidirectional hysteresis (delta Vfb)** | `5 mV` | <= 20 mV | Forward-reverse DC bias high-frequency C-V sweep comparison at 100 kHz |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full wafer 9-point C-V and Dit profile acquired with >= 88.9% (8 of 9) site compliance to EOT, Dit, and hysteresis tolerances; complete data bundle and de-embedding logs signed off by Lead Metrology Researcher and Device Integration Lead.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol for MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures

**Discipline / Category**: Quality Assurance  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Shadow mask physical clamping introduces direct micro-scratch risks on ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide layers and particulate contamination that cause premature dielectric breakdown. The mechanical alignment fixture must maintain an active non-contact proximity or calibrated pneumatic low-force mechanical clamping (<0.05 N/cm^2) to avoid localized mechanical stress fractures across the 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um gate patterns.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Sputter deposition of aluminum gate dots through stencil apertures creates significant geometrical penumbra shadowing (~1-3 um taper edge) and radiation-induced fixed oxide charges/interface traps (Dit) caused by UV/soft X-ray and energetic Ar+ backscatter. The protocol must mandate thermal post-metallization forming gas annealing (FGA at 400°C in 95% N2 / 5% H2) and correct for peripheral fringe capacitance when extracting exact Cox and equivalent physical thickness tox from 1 MHz / Quasi-Static C-V curves.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision laser-cut or electroformed beryllium-copper / stainless steel 304/316 shadow masks with circular apertures down to 200 um (+/-2 um tolerance) require specialized local micro-machining or overseas imports with strict flatness specifications (<5 um deviation). Sputtering targets of 5N purity aluminum (99.999% Al) must be pre-qualified to eliminate heavy metal contamination (Fe, Cu, Na) which ruins MOSCAP leakage profiles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Shadow mask metallization is designed as an interim stage-gate bypass to avoid complete photolithography track processing for rapid thermal oxidation feedback. If mask fabrication turnaround, cleaning cycles, or alignment yield delays exceed standard optical lithography turnarounds, the schedule advantage for Gen 1 (mm) baseline DRAM verification is compromised.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dielectric punch-through and pinhole shorts caused by shadow mask particle abrasion or energetic ion damage during physical vapor deposition onto 3.5 nm dry oxide.
1. Aperture clogging and severe geometric penumbra broadening causing >5% deviation in active gate dot area, skewing Cox and tox extraction.
1. Parasitic series resistance and unpassivated interface trap states (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2) resulting in C-V stretch-out, frequency dispersion, and invalid flatband voltage (Vfb) determination.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-01` | **MOSCAP Dimensional Dot Metrology and Edge Profile Quantification** | Calibrated Optical Metrology Microscope / Automated CD-SEM and White Light Interferometer / Stylus Profilometer | 1. Load wafer onto motorized stage with vacuum chuck. 2. Measure orthogonal diameters (X and Y axes) across 5 distributed dice (Center, North, South, East, West) for each dot geometry (200, 500, 1000 um). 3. Perform edge line-profile scans to determine penumbra blur width (distance between 10% and 90% metal height). 4. Record step height / metal thickness at the center of the 500 um dots. | `Gate dot diameter deviation <= +/-2.0% of nominal design; Circularity ellipticity ratio (D_max / D_min) <= 1.02; Penumbra edge transition width <= 2.5 um; Film thickness = 150 nm +/- 10 nm.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-02` | **High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Accumulation & tox Extraction** | Precision LCR Meter (Keysight E4980A or Keithley 4200A-SCS) with shielded low-noise analytical probe station and triaxial Kelvin probes | 1. Contact probe tip to center of 500 um diameter gate dot with contact force < 15 mN. 2. Sweep gate voltage V_G from inversion (+1.5 V) through depletion to accumulation (-2.5 V) at 1 MHz AC signal (25 mV RMS amplitude). 3. Run synchronized quasi-static sweep (ramp rate 50 mV/s) to capture low-frequency C-V curve. 4. Extract maximum accumulation capacitance C_ox, correct for quantum mechanical confinement, calculate physical oxide thickness t_ox = (epsilon_ox * epsilon_0 * Area) / C_ox, and extract midgap Dit. | `Extracted physical gate oxide thickness t_ox = 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm; Gate leakage current density J_gate < 1.0 mA/cm^2 at V_G = V_fb - 1.0 V; Interface trap density Dit <= 2.0e11 eV^-1 cm^-2 at midgap; Zero observable dielectric breakdown below -2.0 V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-fog safety spectacles with side shields, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD-safe conductive footwear, Thermal protection cryogenic/high-temp gloves for chamber source maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For inert gas (Argon/Nitrogen) asphyxiation risks: Immediately evacuate victim to fresh air; administer supplemental medical oxygen if breathing is labored; initiate CPR if unresponsive. For IPA skin/eye exposure: Irrigate affected eyes or skin with copious tempered water at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes. For physical burns from thermal heaters: Cool immediately with sterile cold water; cover with dry, sterile dressing and seek immediate medical evaluation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-MOS-001
**Title:** MOS Dot Array Shadow Mask Dimensional & Edge Definition Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology & Quality Acceptance  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the metrology protocol for verifying the physical dimensions, circularity, aperture pitch, and edge definition of laser-cut or electroformed shadow (stencil) masks. These shadow masks are used for physical vapor deposition (sputtering/evaporation) of aluminum circular gate dots (nominal diameters: $200\,\mu\text{m}$, $500\,\mu\text{m}$, and $1000\,\mu\text{m}$) directly onto $3.5\,\text{nm}$ dry gate oxide on P-type (100) Si test wafers. Ensuring aperture fidelity is critical for accurate accumulation capacitance ($C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}}\varepsilon_0\text{Area}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$) extraction, physical thickness verification ($\pm 0.1\,\text{nm}$), and interface state density ($D_{\text{it}}$) profiling.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Tooling
- **Automated Optical Metrology System / CNC Vision Measuring System:** Calibrated top-light (coaxial epi-illumination) and bottom-light (diascopic profile illumination), sub-micron resolution stage ($\le 0.1\,\mu\text{m}$).
- **Precision Shadow Mask:** Nickel/Stainless steel foil containing circular dot aperture arrays for diameters: $200\,\mu\text{m}$, $500\,\mu\text{m}$, and $1000\,\mu\text{m}$.
- **Substrate Fixturing:** Vacuum chuck or precision edge clamp ensuring mask flatness without mechanical warping.
- **Surface Profile / Optical Profilometer / Laser Scanning Confocal Microscope:** For edge burr, taper angle, and sidewall roughness characterization.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Mask Handling & Flatness Fixturing (Class 100/ISO 5 cleanroom)        |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Coordinate Alignment & Calibrated Optical Baseline Setup              |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Automated Optical Edge Detection & Diameter Measurement               |
|    - Sample 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um aperture sites across mask array |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Circularity, Edge Roughness & Burr Evaluation                         |
|    - 36-point least-squares radial fit and sidewall profile check        |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 5. Disposition: Pass (Proceed to Sputter Metallization) / Reject         |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 3.1: Cleanroom Preparation and Chuck Loading
1. Conduct inspection under ISO 5 (Class 100) laminar flow bench.
2. Inspect the shadow mask under grazing light for macro-particulates, scratches, or creases.
3. Clean using high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ gas blow-off ($\le 1.5\,\text{bar}$).
4. Mount the shadow mask onto the optical metrology stage with the deposition-facing side up. Verify complete mechanical planarization to eliminate Z-axis focal runout across the array.

#### Step 3.2: Coordinate System & Calibration Alignment
1. Load optical calibration target (certified grid reticle) to verify X-Y scaling.
2. Set bottom-lighting (transmission) to maximize edge contrast at the aperture boundaries.
3. Establish coordinate datum using mask fiducials or origin alignment holes.

#### Step 3.3: Dimensional Metrology Execution
1. Execute multi-point automated measurement across the array inspecting all three design apertures:
   - **Small Dot:** Nominal $\varnothing = 200\,\mu\text{m}$
   - **Medium Dot:** Nominal $\varnothing = 500\,\mu\text{m}$
   - **Large Dot:** Nominal $\varnothing = 1000\,\mu\text{m}$
2. Sample across center, mid-radius, and outer-periphery positions ($N \ge 9$ apertures per diameter class).
3. Capture boundary transitions using sub-pixel thresholding ($50\%$ gray-level inflection method).

#### Step 3.4: Edge Definition and Circularity Metrology
1. For each inspected aperture, extract $\ge 36$ boundary points evenly distributed along the circumference.
2. Calculate the fitted diameter ($D_{\text{fit}}$) using a minimum zone or least-squares circular algorithm.
3. Measure circularity deviation ($\Delta R = R_{\max} - R_{\min}$).
4. Switch to top-light/confocal profilometry to verify edge definition: ensure zero dross, metal burrs, or sidewall flaring that could cause penumbral shadowing during aluminum metallization.

#### Step 3.5: Post-Inspection Disposition
1. Compare measured values against Acceptance Criteria.
2. Masks with out-of-spec dimensions, burrs, or circularity errors must be quarantined to prevent systematic bias in $C\text{-}V$ oxide thickness metrology.
3. Package conforming masks in antistatic cleanroom containers for subsequent PVD chamber loading.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Inspection / Metrology Method | Nominal Design | Acceptance Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aperture Diameter ($200\,\mu\text{m}$ Dot)** | Automated Optical Edge Metrology (Transmission) | $200.0$ | $200.0 \pm 2.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Aperture Diameter ($500\,\mu\text{m}$ Dot)** | Automated Optical Edge Metrology (Transmission) | $500.0$ | $500.0 \pm 3.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Aperture Diameter ($1000\,\mu\text{m}$ Dot)** | Automated Optical Edge Metrology (Transmission) | $1000.0$ | $1000.0 \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Aperture Circularity Deviation ($\Delta R$)** | 36-point Least-Squares Radial Edge Fit | $0.0$ | $\le 2.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Edge Burr / Sidewall Height Deviation** | Optical Confocal Profilometry | $0.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |

---

### 5. Citations & Context Alignment
- **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - *Context:* Test structure specifies aluminum circular gate dots of diameter $200\,\mu\text{m}$, $500\,\mu\text{m}$, and $1000\,\mu\text{m}$ sputtered through shadow masks onto thermally grown gate oxide ($3.5\,\text{nm}$ to $25\,\text{nm}$) on P-type (100) Si. Accurate area definition is required for accumulation capacitance saturation ($C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}}\varepsilon_0\text{Area}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$) to achieve physical thickness extraction with $\pm 0.1\,\text{nm}$ precision.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Context:* Gate dielectric baseline is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) with $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical thickness. Accurate dot shadow mask geometry ensures precise extraction of gate dielectric thickness prior to active transistor processing.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dimensional uncertainty in shadow mask dot diameter directly propagates to gate area (A_gate) determination in C-V profiling, skewing extracted oxide thickness (t_ox = epsilon_ox * A_gate / C_ox) and interface trap density (D_it); optical edge roughness must be bounded within +/-1.5% area error for Gen 1 mm-scale dots.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Shadow mask micromachined aperture beveling and laser heat-affected zone (HAZ) burrs create non-uniform physical stand-off during thermal evaporation; edge acuity must exhibit taper angles >75 degrees and edge scalloping/burr heights <2 um to prevent metal penumbra shadow effects on 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom laser-cut or electroformed stainless steel/nickel/molybdenum shadow masks with Gen 1 aperture pitches (500 um to 2.0 mm diameter) suffer from vendor-to-vendor tensioning variability and chemical deburring etch over-sizing; local stock verification and optical calibration reticle traceability (NIST/VLSI standards) are required prior to metallization acceptance.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Inspection of mask arrays must be integrated directly into incoming QA before releasing masks to vacuum thermal evaporator tooling, avoiding costly chamber downtime and contamination of 3.5 nm gate dielectric runs by defective or contaminated shadow masks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Aperture diameter deviation > 2.0% resulting in systematic error in extracted oxide capacitance per unit area and dielectric constant estimation.
1. Peripheral burrs or warping inducing non-contact gap > 15 um during deposition, causing vapor phase penumbral broadening and fuzzy MOS gate perimeters.
1. Organic particulate or residual chemical machining salts clinging to aperture inner walls, outgassing in high-vacuum E-beam/thermal metallization.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-1-01` | **Automated Optical Metrology of Shadow Mask Aperture Diameter and Circularity** | Calibrated Dual-Camera Split-Field / Coordinate Measuring Optical Microscope (Karl Suss MA6 inspection optics equivalent or Olympus STM7 CMM with 0.1 um glass scale resolution, 20x objective, calibrated NIST optical grid) | 1. Align mask reference fiducials to optical stage Cartesian axes (X-Y). 2. Traverse a 5x5 array of MOS dot shadow apertures across 100mm mask active area. 3. Acquire high-contrast back-illuminated transmitted light images (edge threshold 50% grayscale). 4. Fit 360-point least-squares circle to aperture perimeter to calculate equivalent diameter (D_eq) and circularity (form factor = 4*pi*Area / Perimeter^2). 5. Record mean diameter, standard deviation, and maximum circularity error across all 25 test sites. | `Nominal diameter matches specification (e.g., 1000.0 um +/- 10.0 um, or delta <= 1.0%), circularity >= 0.985 across all sampled sites, and wafer-level diameter variation 3-sigma <= 2.0%.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-1-02` | **Aperture Edge Definition, Burr Height, and Wall Bevel Profilometry** | 3D Optical Confocal Profilometer / White Light Interferometer (Sensofar S neox or Bruker ContourX) with 50x interferometric objective (0.1 nm vertical resolution, 0.2 um lateral resolution) | 1. Focus interferometer on the wafer-facing contact surface of 5 designated corner and center apertures. 2. Scan a 200 um x 200 um region spanning the aperture inner boundary. 3. Extract 3D surface topography map and generate 4 orthogonal cross-sectional line profiles across the aperture perimeter. 4. Measure peak-to-valley burr height (R_z), edge lip protrusion above datum plane, and sidewall bevel angle. 5. Scan aperture perimeter for edge scalloping and roughness (R_a). | `Aperture edge protrusion/burr height above contact datum plane <= 1.5 um, edge roughness R_a <= 0.8 um, and sidewall bevel taper angle >= 75 degrees.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile gloves (double gloved, puncture resistant), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Class 100 cleanroom anti-static polyester hood and lab coat, Vapor-rated half-face respirator with multi-gas/organic cartridge during manual solvent degreasing
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush contaminated skin with copious running water for 15 minutes while removing garments. Eye contact: Irrigate exposed eye at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical instruction; seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Perform solvent pre-cleaning and mask degreasing inside certified stainless-steel laminar wet chemical exhaust hood maintaining continuous face velocity between 0.45 and 0.55 m/s (90-110 fpm). Connect optical metrology chamber to cleanroom recirculation with laminar HEPA downflow.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate spent acetone and isopropanol into labeled, grounded stainless steel organic solvent flammables waste receptacles. Do not mix with halogenated or aqueous acid waste streams. Transport to licensed hazardous chemical waste treatment facility for high-temperature thermal oxidation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS Grade) | `> 99.8%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `> 99.5%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | High Purity Grade 5.0 (Filtered 0.05 um) | `> 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-degreased, dry, particulate-free shadow mask foil in anti-static conductive clamshell box.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dimensionally verified, QA-accepted, particulate-free shadow mask vacuum-bagged or staged under purge ready for evaporator mounting.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Deposition of airborne hydrocarbons and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) onto mask edges, promoting particle shedding, pinhole masking, and vacuum outgassing that contaminates 3.5 nm dry gate oxide during thermal metallization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed dimensional verification and edge definition signoff for Gen 1 MOS dot array shadow masks, providing calibrated aperture area distributions and verifying absence of burrs or bevel deviations to ensure sub-1.5% C-V capacitor area metrology error on 3.5 nm gate oxide.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOS_DOT_MASK_DIMENSIONAL_REPORT_REV1.csv`
- [ ] `SHADOW_MASK_APERTURE_EDGE_PROFILOMETRY.pdf`
- [ ] `APERTURE_OPTICAL_CMM_HIGHRES_IMAGES.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean aperture diameter across 25-point sampling grid within nominal specification** | `1000.0 um` | +/- 10.0 um (+/- 1.0%) | NIST-traceable calibrated optical coordinate measuring microscope with automated circle fit |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum aperture perimeter burr height and protrusion above contact plane** | `0.0 um` | <= 1.5 um | 3D white-light optical interferometric surface profilometry |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Aperture circularity form factor across all inspected sites** | `0.995` | >= 0.985 | Digital boundary tracing (4*pi*Area / Perimeter^2) on high-contrast 20x optical micrograph |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of tested aperture sites pass dimensional assertions ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03, zero visual particulate defects > 5 um detected on aperture perimeters under darkfield optical microscopy, and physical QA signoff logged in MES.

Organic particulate or residual chemical machining salts clinging to aperture inner walls, outgassing in high-vacuum E-beam/thermal metallization.

testcases.title: Automated Optical Metrology of Shadow Mask Aperture Diameter and Circularity
testcases.instrumentation: Calibrated Dual-Camera Split-Field / Coordinate Measuring Optical Microscope (Karl Suss MA6 inspection optics equivalent or Olympus STM7 CMM with 0.1 um glass scale resolution, 20x objective, calibrated NIST optical grid)
testcases.pre_conditions: Shadow mask ultrasonic cleaned in semiconductor-grade IPA, N2 blow-dried, mounted flat on vacuum leveling chuck under transmitted Kohler illumination at 20 +/- 0.5 deg C.
testcases.procedure: 1. Align mask reference fiducials to optical stage Cartesian axes (X-Y). 2. Traverse a 5x5 array of MOS dot shadow apertures across 100mm mask active area. 3. Acquire high-contrast back-illuminated transmitted light images (edge threshold 50% grayscale). 4. Fit 360-point least-squares circle to aperture perimeter to calculate equivalent diameter (D_eq) and circularity (form factor = 4*pi*Area / Perimeter^2). 5. Record mean diameter, standard deviation, and maximum circularity error across all 25 test sites.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Nominal diameter matches specification (e.g., 1000.0 um +/- 10.0 um, or delta <= 1.0%), circularity >= 0.985 across all sampled sites, and wafer-level diameter variation 3-sigma <= 2.0%.

testcases.title: Aperture Edge Definition, Burr Height, and Wall Bevel Profilometry
testcases.instrumentation: 3D Optical Confocal Profilometer / White Light Interferometer (Sensofar S neox or Bruker ContourX) with 50x interferometric objective (0.1 nm vertical resolution, 0.2 um lateral resolution)
testcases.pre_conditions: Mask secured under low vacuum chuck; interferometer calibrated against a 1.0 um step-height silicon transfer standard.
testcases.procedure: 1. Focus interferometer on the wafer-facing contact surface of 5 designated corner and center apertures. 2. Scan a 200 um x 200 um region spanning the aperture inner boundary. 3. Extract 3D surface topography map and generate 4 orthogonal cross-sectional line profiles across the aperture perimeter. 4. Measure peak-to-valley burr height (R_z), edge lip protrusion above datum plane, and sidewall bevel angle. 5. Scan aperture perimeter for edge scalloping and roughness (R_a).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Aperture edge protrusion/burr height above contact datum plane <= 1.5 um, edge roughness R_a <= 0.8 um, and sidewall bevel taper angle >= 75 degrees.

ppe_required: Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile gloves (double gloved, puncture resistant)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields
Class 100 cleanroom anti-static polyester hood and lab coat
Vapor-rated half-face respirator with multi-gas/organic cartridge during manual solvent degreasing
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Skin contact: Immediately flush contaminated skin with copious running water for 15 minutes while removing garments. Eye contact: Irrigate exposed eye at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical instruction; seek immediate medical attention.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Perform solvent pre-cleaning and mask degreasing inside certified stainless-steel laminar wet chemical exhaust hood maintaining continuous face velocity between 0.45 and 0.55 m/s (90-110 fpm). Connect optical metrology chamber to cleanroom recirculation with laminar HEPA downflow.

q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Dimensionally verified, QA-accepted, particulate-free shadow mask vacuum-bagged or staged under purge ready for evaporator mounting.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum aperture perimeter burr height and protrusion above contact plane

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Laser-Cut Invar Shadow Mask Aperture Profilometry & Cleaning Validation

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-MSK-0180-02`  
**Classification:** Semiconductor Metrology & Cleaning Validation — Gen 2 ($\mu$m Scale)  
**Parent Process:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > MOS Dot Array Shadow Mask Dimensional & Edge Definition Inspection  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Incoming Laser-Cut   │
│      Invar Mask       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Solvent & Megasonic  │
│       Cleaning        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Stylus/Optical     │
│     Profilometry      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Edge Taper & Dross   │
│       Analysis        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Particle Counting   │
│      Validation       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Mask Receipt & Pre-Inspection Cleaning**:
   - Transfer laser-cut Invar shadow mask (used for shadow-masking gate metallization over dry thermal gate oxide of physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) into a Class 100 metrology flow bench.
   - Immerse in an ultra-pure electronic-grade isopropyl alcohol (IPA) ultrasonic/megasonic bath maintained at **$55^\circ\text{C}$** for 10 minutes to dissolve laser cutting hydrocarbon residues and dislodge particulate slag.
   - Rinse with deionized (DI) water (resistivity $> 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and blow dry with filtered ionized $\text{N}_2$ gas at $20\text{ psi}$.

2. **Optical & Stylus Profilometry Setup**:
   - Mount the Invar foil flat onto a vacuum chuck calibrated for low thermal expansion materials.
   - Program the automated optical profilometer / non-contact white light interferometer (WLI) to scan the test MOS dot aperture array across designated coordinate fiducials.
   - Perform step-height, aperture diameter, and 3D surface topography mapping around aperture perimeters.

3. **Aperture Edge Taper & Slag/Dross Assessment**:
   - Extract cross-sectional profiles across orthogonal axes ($X$ and $Y$) of representative apertures.
   - Quantify sidewall taper angle and confirm absence of laser ablation recast burrs/slag protruding toward the wafer contact interface.

4. **Surface Particle & Cleaning Validation**:
   - Scan aperture boundaries and foil contact side under darkfield laser surface inspection or calibrated confocal optical microscope.
   - Verify that residual particle counts and contamination densities satisfy test structure cleanroom criteria to prevent scratching the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide during contact deposition.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                          Target Metrics Baseline       
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Cleaning Solv Temp┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                  │▒                                   │
  Particle Density┤▒                                   │
  Slag/Burr Height┤▓                                   │
                  │▓                                   │
  Aperture Pos Tol┤██                                  │
                  │██                                  │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                  0.0     13.8     27.5    41.2    55.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value & Exact Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aperture Edge Slag / Burr Height** | $\le 0.50\,\mu\text{m}$ protrusion above contact plane | High-Resolution Stylus / Optical Profilometer |
| **Aperture Positional / Diameter Tolerance** | $\pm 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ deviation from nominal CAD layout | Automated Vision Coordinate Metrology System |
| **Post-Cleaning Solvent Bath Temperature** | $55.0 \pm 2.0\,^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ Thermocouple / Bath Temperature Controller |
| **Residual Particle Contamination Density** | $\le 0.05\,\text{defects}/\text{mm}^2$ (for particles $> 1.0\,\mu\text{m}$) | Darkfield Automated Optical Defect Inspection |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric Thickness Integrity**:
   - The shadow mask metallization directly deposits MOS test capacitor gates on the thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) layer grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$ with a nominal physical thickness of **$\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$** (equivalent oxide thickness EOT $\sim 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$). Mask burr height must remain strictly below $0.5\,\mu\text{m}$ to prevent physical abrasion or pinhole breakdown of this sub-$4\text{ nm}$ gate dielectric.
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*; *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*.

2. **Electrical Test Metrology Compatibility**:
   - Aperture dimension uniformity preserves target electrode area required for accurate C-V and ellipsometric interface correlation across cell capacitor dielectric stacks (target minimum cell capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Invar-36 shadow masks have an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion (~1.2 ppm/K), making them ideal for heat-tolerant shadow metallization during thermal or e-beam evaporation of MOS dots. However, laser cutting introduces molten burrs, kerf taper, and recast metal dross along aperture perimeters. Without rigorous 3D optical profilometry and burr height qualification, protrusion of dross > 1.5 um will mechanically scratch the sensitive 3.5 nm dry gate dielectric during proximity or soft-contact clamping, causing catastrophic early gate oxide breakdown ($E_{bd} < 2\text{ MV/cm}$).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For MOS capacitor C-V profiling at 180nm nodes, dot electrode area accuracy dictates the precision of extracted equivalent oxide thickness ($t_{ox}$) and interface trap density ($D_{it}$). A nominal 1000 um (1.0 mm) circular aperture with laser cut edge waviness or elliptical eccentricity causes systematic capacitance measurement errors ($C = \epsilon_{ox} A / t_{ox}$). Furthermore, laser cutting leaves carbonaceous residues, organic binder slag, and metal oxide particles. An ultrasonic/megasonic solvent cleaning sequence followed by non-destructive optical profilometry is required to guarantee aperture circularity (> 0.98), kerf taper angle (> 80 deg), and zero particulate shed.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom laser-micromachined Invar foil (typically 50-100 um thick) sourced from precision stencil vendors exhibits vendor-to-vendor variability in laser assist gas (oxygen vs. nitrogen vs. argon). Masks cut with assist oxygen feature heavy surface iron-nickel oxide scales that require hazardous chemical descaling. Procurement specifications must mandate nitrogen-purged fiber laser cutting with electropolished edges, certified flatness (< 15 um over 100mm span), and cleanroom double-vacuum packaging in antistatic bags to eliminate incoming hydrocarbon contamination.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Shadow mask qualification is on the critical gating path for electrical test vehicle wafer runs. If incoming mask inspection fails due to burrs or particulate contamination, the team must not wait on vendor rework cycles. An internal wet bench cleaning and sonication protocol using MOS-grade solvents must be pre-validated to salvage contaminated masks on-site within 2 hours, preserving the run schedule for C-V gate oxide characterization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Micro-burr puncture: Recast Invar metal dross protruding beyond the contact plane physically punctures or micro-scratches the ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide during mask-to-wafer clamping, creating pinhole electrical shorts.
1. Aperture area deviation & edge shadow: Kerf taper angle < 75 degrees causes metal vapor beam shadowing during physical vapor deposition, creating graded-thickness electrode penumbra and inaccurate C-V accumulation capacitance measurements.
1. Particulate shedding: Loosely adhered sub-micron recast nanoparticles dislodge during vacuum pump-down in the evaporator, contaminating the wafer active areas.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-1-1-01` | **Laser-Cut Aperture Dimensional Profilometry & Burr Height Qualification** | White Light Interferometer (WLI) / 3D Coherence Scanning Optical Profilometer (Bruker ContourGT or equivalent) calibrated to VLSI step height standard; Automated Optical Metrology System with sub-micron 2D imaging stage. | 1. Load Invar mask onto optical metrology stage and align 4 corner fiducials. 2. Measure aperture diameter across orthogonal axes (0, 45, 90, 135 deg) for a 5x5 array of 1.0 mm circular dot openings. 3. Switch to 3D White Light Interferometry (20x interferometric objective) over 5 representative apertures (center and 4 corners). 4. Measure aperture perimeter topography, recording peak burr protrusion height ($R_p$) relative to the mask base contact plane. 5. Perform cross-sectional profile analysis across the aperture sidewall to compute the kerf sidewall taper angle. | `Aperture nominal diameter = 1000.0 um +/- 5.0 um; Circularity index >= 0.985; Maximum burr protrusion height ($R_p$) on contact face <= 1.0 um; Kerf sidewall taper angle >= 82.0 degrees.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-1-1-02` | **Shadow Mask Precision Cleaning & Particulate Verification** | Multi-frequency Megasonic Cleaning Bench (40 kHz ultrasonic / 1 MHz megasonic baths); Darkfield Optical Microscope with high-intensity oblique LED illumination; Calibrated Surface Particle Counter / Automated Defect Inspection Station. | 1. Immerse Invar mask in heated semiconductor-grade NMP (N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone) at 65 C for 10 min with 40 kHz ultrasonic agitation (50 W). 2. Cascade transfer to electronic grade Acetone bath with 1 MHz megasonic agitation for 5 min. 3. Transfer to electronic grade Isopropanol (IPA) bath for 5 min with megasonic agitation. 4. Rinse with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm*cm) for 3 min. 5. Marangoni or filtered dry $N_2$ blow dry at 0.2 um filtration until completely moisture-free. 6. Inspect mask under darkfield microscope at 10x/20x magnification across 100% of aperture clear areas and surrounding 500 um perimeter. | `Zero loose particulates >= 1.0 um detected within 500 um of aperture edges; Total residual particle count < 5 counts across entire 100mm mask active area; Contact angle with DI water drop <= 15 degrees indicating organic residue-free surface.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, ASTM D6319 compliant), Chemical splash-resistant safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Polypropylene chemical apron during heated solvent handling, Cleanroom lint-free face mask and ESD-safe cleanroom frock
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush exposed skin with copious water for 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE; wash skin with mild soap and water. Eye contact: Irrigate eyes at eyewash station for >= 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmic evaluation. Inhalation: Move victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; drink 2 glasses of water; seek immediate medical attention with SDS.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All solvent ultrasonic cleaning, heated NMP immersion, and solvent baths must be operated inside a dedicated Class 100 laminar flow wet bench equipped with volatile organic compound (VOC) dedicated chemical exhaust ducting delivering face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) across sash opening.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent Acetone, IPA, and NMP must not be drained to cleanroom acid/base neutralization scrubbers or sewer. Segregate spent solvents into grounded, conductive Stainless Steel or fluoropolymer solvent waste carboys labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'; store in a fire-rated solvent locker under negative exhaust.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP)** | `872-50-4` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (>= 99.8%) | `100%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | VLSI / Semiconductor Grade | `>= 99.5%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `>= 99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Raw laser-cut Invar mask in antistatic packaging with potential micro-burrs, cutting spatter, and residual laser assist hydrocarbons.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: De-burred, megasonically cleaned, organic-free Invar shadow mask validated with < 1.0 um contact plane burr height and zero particulates >= 1.0 um, ready for vacuum evaporator loading.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time (> 45 min) before wafer loading allows airborne organic siloxanes and cleanroom particulates to settle onto aperture perimeters, degrading dot metallization adhesion and causing localized dielectric breakdown or false $D_{it}$ traps.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full dimensional metrology, optical profilometry, and precision solvent cleaning validation completed for Gen 1 (1.0 mm) laser-cut Invar MOS capacitor shadow masks, ensuring scratch-free contact to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide and high-fidelity dot metallization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `INVAR_MASK_GEN1_APERTURE_PROFILOMETRY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `INVAR_MASK_BURR_HEIGHT_AND_KERF_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `INVAR_MASK_POST_CLEAN_DARKFIELD_DEFECT_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum burr protrusion height on the wafer-facing contact surface of the Invar mask** | `0.5 um` | <= 1.0 um maximum | 3D White Light Interferometry (WLI) surface profile mapping along aperture perimeter |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Mean aperture diameter across 5x5 MOS capacitor circular array** | `1000.0 um` | +/- 5.0 um | Automated 2D Optical Metrology Stage calibrated against optical reticle standard |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Kerf sidewall taper angle relative to mask surface normal** | `85.0 deg` | >= 82.0 deg | Cross-sectional optical profilometry depth-slope analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 25 MOS capacitor apertures across the 100mm Invar shadow mask pass 2D dimensional diameter tolerance (+/- 5.0 um), demonstrate max burr protrusion <= 1.0 um, and exhibit zero particulate contaminants >= 1.0 um under darkfield inspection, with signed metrology report approved by Metrology Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Optical & Confocal Edge Roughness & Taper Angle Inspection

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-MSK-007`  
**Level:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m) / Make Action  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol for MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > MOS Dot Array Shadow Mask Dimensional & Edge Definition Inspection > Automated Optical & Confocal Edge Roughness & Taper Angle Inspection

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum Load &   │
│     Mask Alignment     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Brightfield       │
│  Telecentric Optical   │
│        Overview        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Laser Confocal 3D    │
│    Topography Scan     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Edge Roughness     │
│   LER/LWR Extraction   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Confocal Taper Angle  │
│   & Shadow Penumbra    │
│        Profile         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Acceptance Gate &    │
│        C-V Mask        │
│     Qualification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Purpose & Physical Scope
This SOP specifies the automated dual-optical and laser confocal protocol for inspecting shadow mask apertures and deposited MOS capacitor dot arrays over dry gate oxide test structures ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$). Precise edge roughness (Line Edge Roughness - LER / Line Width Roughness - LWR) and aperture sidewall taper angle verification prevent metal shadowing penumbra, electric field fringing, and premature dielectric breakdown during high-frequency $C$-$V$ and Fowler-Nordheim leakage characterization.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Stage Setup & Substrate Alignment**
   - Place the shadow mask / metallized monitor wafer on the motorized precision vacuum chuck ($X$-$Y$ repeatability $\le 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Run fiducial auto-alignment using pattern recognition over 3 global alignment markers to null theta skew ($\Delta\theta \le 0.005^\circ$).

2. **Automated Multi-Point Brightfield Inspection**
   - Execute a 9-point or 49-point automated inspection map across the substrate to capture global dot pitch, aperture circularity, and macro-flaws (burrs, contamination).
   - Capture high-contrast images under telecentric illumination at $20\times$ and $50\times$ optical magnification.

3. **Laser Confocal 3D Height-Stack Acquisition**
   - Switch to the violet laser confocal objective ($100\times$, $\text{NA} \ge 0.95$, $\lambda = 405\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform automated $Z$-piezo scanning through the aperture edge profile with a $Z$-pitch step size of $\le 10\text{ nm}$ across the full mask thickness profile (Gen 2: $\mu\text{m}$ regime).
   - Reconstruct the 3D surface topography map of the aperture rim and transition boundary.

4. **Edge Roughness ($3\sigma$ LER / LWR) Computation**
   - Extract thresholded edge-contour lines along a defined inspection window of $L \ge 10\ \mu\text{m}$ along the perimeter.
   - Calculate Line Edge Roughness ($\text{LER}_{3\sigma}$) and Line Width Roughness ($\text{LWR}_{3\sigma}$) to verify boundary uniformity and edge scalloping.

5. **Aperture Taper Angle ($\theta_{\text{taper}}$) & Penumbra Cross-Section Profiling**
   - Extract orthogonal cross-sectional line profiles ($X$-$Z$ and $Y$-$Z$) across four cardinal quadrants ($0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ$).
   - Fit the linear transition slope between 10% and 90% step height to determine the sidewall taper angle $\theta_{\text{taper}}$.
   - Confirm sidewall slope eliminates knife-edge shadow distortion on the underlying 3.5 nm dry gate oxide.

6. **Disposition & Automated Lot Logging**
   - Compare measured edge metrics against acceptance thresholds.
   - If acceptance criteria pass, sign off the mask/wafer lot for downstream high-frequency $C$-$V$ and interface trap state metrology.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Inspection Parameter | Target Metric & Tolerance | Verification Method | Pass/Fail Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aperture Sidewall Taper Angle ($\theta_{\text{taper}}$)** | **$55^\circ \pm 5^\circ$** (Knife-edge relief angle) | 3D Laser Confocal Step Height Profiling ($100\times$, $\lambda = 405\text{ nm}$) | Rework/Reject mask if $\theta_{\text{taper}} > 65^\circ$ (risk of deposition penumbra) |
| **Aperture Line Edge Roughness ($\text{LER}_{3\sigma}$)** | **$\le 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$** ($3\sigma$ over $10\ \mu\text{m}$ evaluation baseline) | Automated confocal edge-detection algorithm | Reject if $\text{LER}_{3\sigma} > 0.20\ \mu\text{m}$ (irregular capacitor area) |
| **Stage Travel & Positioning Precision** | **$\le \pm 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$** lateral travel accuracy | Automated laser encoder stage closed-loop readout | Re-calibrate stage encoders prior to continuing run |
| **Wafer Area Inspection Coverage** | **Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping** | Macro-telecentric brightfield mapping | Map failure flags lot for manual engineer review |

---

### 5. Context & Source Citations
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology](docs/context.yaml):** Informs the gate dielectric baseline of dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ at 3.5 nm physical thickness and mandates automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial variations.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml):** Validates the thermally grown gate oxide thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation for which these MOS capacitor test arrays serve as critical qualification monitors.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml):** Defines the structural integration requirements, leakage criteria, and cell dimensions constraining electric field fringing and capacitance evaluation.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated optical and confocal edge metrology on Gen 1 shadow-masked aluminum/gate-oxide test structures must directly interface with wafer coordinate registration algorithms to differentiate aperture sidewall burrs from true deposited dot edge taper. Vibration coupling between the motorized XY stage and the 3D laser confocal scanning head can artificially inflate Line Edge Roughness (LER 3-sigma) readings if sampling frequencies match building ambient vibrations (10-50 Hz). A rigid granite-isolated optical breadboard and synchronous optical encoder gating are mandatory.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide regime, shadow mask perimeter taper angle directly determines the local electric field fringing across the perimeter of the evaporated MOS capacitor dot. If the shadow mask taper angle is less than 65 degrees or exhibits significant knife-edge scalloping (edge roughness Rq > 250 nm), aluminum metallization will produce an extended sub-threshold shadow penumbra (<10 nm Al thickness) leading to localized premature dielectric breakdown during high-frequency C-V accumulation and pseudo-interface trap (Dit) smearing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring precision-cut bimetallic or electroformed nickel/molybdenum shadow masks with laser-milled 1.0 mm dot apertures incurs severe lead-time risks in Southeast Asia. We must standardize on locally laser-machined 304/316 stainless steel foils (50-100 um thickness) coupled with off-the-shelf industrial optical microscope objectives (10x-50x Plan Fluor / NA 0.40) and blue-laser (405 nm) confocal sensors to prevent reliance on single-source proprietary European metrology stages.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Shadow mask qualification must be executed prior to committing wafers to high-vacuum thermal evaporation. Rejection of masks at incoming QC via automated 5-point dot roughness profiling prevents wasting 2-hour evaporation chamber pump-down runs and precious 3.5 nm gate oxide test wafers, securing the Gen 1 milestone delivery schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Penumbra-induced perimeter leakage caused by shallow shadow mask aperture taper angle (<60°), producing non-uniform capacitive fringe fields during C-V sweep.
1. Aperture burr-induced oxide puncture where micro-burrs along the laser-cut shadow mask contact and mechanically scratch or fracture the ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxide during mask clamping.
1. Confocal height mapping artifact caused by high optical reflectivity contrast between specular Al dots and bare 3.5 nm SiO2/Si substrate, saturating PMT/APD sensors and miscalculating true 3D edge taper.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-1-2-01` | **Confocal 3D Aperture Taper Angle & Sidewall Profile Verification** | 3D Laser Scanning Confocal Microscope (405 nm laser diode, 50x Plan Apo objective, NA 0.95, 0.5 nm Z-piezo resolution) | 1. Position confocal scan field across 4 orthogonal quadrants of five 1.0 mm dot apertures (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right). 2. Acquire a 3D topographic Z-stack across a 120 um vertical scan range at 50 nm Z-step increments. 3. Extract 20 extracted orthogonal cross-sectional profiles per aperture. 4. Calculate the taper angle theta from the foil baseline plane to the aperture knife-edge sidewall using ISO 4287/25178 curve fitting. | `Aperture sidewall taper angle must be >= 70.0° and <= 85.0° across all 5 sampled apertures; zero detected inward-protruding burrs exceeding 2.0 um height from foil surface.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-1-2-02` | **Automated Optical Line Edge Roughness (LER) & Radial Roundness Analysis** | Automated High-Resolution Optical Inspection System (Telecentric lens, 20x magnification, 5.0 MP monochrome CMOS, 470 nm ring illumination, automated sub-micron XY stage) | 1. Auto-focus and capture top-down high-contrast brightfield images of all 9 array dot shadow apertures. 2. Apply Canny edge detection algorithm with sub-pixel thresholding along perimeter. 3. Measure circularity ratio (4*pi*Area / Perimeter^2). 4. Calculate root-mean-square Line Edge Roughness (Rq / 3-sigma LER) over a 200 um sliding window along the entire circular circumference. | `Circularity ratio >= 0.985; Line Edge Roughness (3-sigma LER) <= 180 nm; maximum radial deviation from nominal 1.00 mm diameter <= ±15 um.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 3B/4 certified laser safety goggles matching 405 nm wavelength (OD > 6.0), ESD-safe cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, double gloved), Cleanroom lint-free Tyvek gown with face mask and particulate hood
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvents, wash immediately with copious DI water for 15 minutes. In case of accidental laser eye exposure, immediately power off optical system, shield patient eyes from ambient light, and transfer immediately to ophthalmologist emergency care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate optical cleaning station under dedicated chemical laminar fume hood with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s. Enclose laser confocal illumination path within Class 1 certified interlocked enclosure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent wipes and rinse liquid collected in dedicated UN-rated flammable solvent waste drums; zero drain discharge permitted. Dispose via licensed hazardous solvent incinerator.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Dry Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on Si wafer (pre-metallization) and solvent-cleaned, dry N2-blown shadow mask foil.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Inspected, verified, and certified shadow mask clamped or aligned ready for high-vacuum thermal evaporator load-lock entry.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive airborne particulate and organic hydrocarbon condensation on the shadow mask and 3.5 nm oxide creates interface states, pinhole punch-throughs, and invalidates C-V flatband voltage (Vfb) extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Automated confocal and optical metrology dataset fully validating aperture taper angle, edge roughness (LER), circularity, and particle-free status for 1.0 mm dot array shadow masks deployed in Gen 1 MOS capacitor metallization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOS_DOT_SHADOWMASK_LER_METROLOGY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `APERTURE_3D_CONFOCAL_TAPER_CONTOURS.csv`
- [ ] `EDGE_ROUGHNESS_TOPOGRAPHIC_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Aperture sidewall knife-edge taper angle** | `78.0` | ±6.0 deg | 50x 405nm Laser Scanning Confocal Z-profile cross-sectional fitting |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Perimeter 3-sigma Line Edge Roughness (LER)** | `120.0` | <= 180.0 nm | High-resolution sub-pixel optical contour analysis over 200 um window |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Aperture nominal dot diameter** | `1.000` | ±0.015 mm | Calibrated telecentric 2D optical machine vision edge-detection |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 dot apertures achieve 3-sigma LER <= 180 nm, taper angle between 72° and 84°, zero detected particulate contamination >= 0.5 um, and QA engineering signoff recorded in traveler.
