nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Top Electrode Optical Dimension Metrology and Shadow Mask Edge Run-Out Profilometry  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol > Electrode Geometry Verification & High-Frequency C-V Acceptance Metrology  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Inspection Protocol  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum Chuck &  │
│         Align          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Calibrated Optical   │
│     Image Capture      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Edge-Detection &    │
│     Area Metrology     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Stylus / Optical    │
│  Profilometry Run-Out  │
│          Scan          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Penumbra Width &    │
│      Step Height       │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Statistical       │
│       Pass/Fail        │
│     Qualification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chuck Loading:**
   - Transfer the post-shadow-mask metallized test wafer onto the anti-vibration optical metrology vacuum chuck.
   - Initiate automatic vacuum hold-down ($P < 20\text{ kPa}$) and align the wafer notch/flat to the system reference axis.

2. **Optical Calibration & Electrode Image Acquisition:**
   - Calibrate the optical imaging system using an ultra-precision certified grid reticle ($0.05\,\mu\text{m}$ certified pitch).
   - Position the camera over the designated MOS capacitor test sites across a standardized automated wafer mapping routine (e.g., 9-point or 49-point grid inspection).
   - Capture high-contrast brightfield/darkfield images of the circular/rectangular top electrode metallization boundaries.

3. **Automated Dimension & Effective Area Metrology:**
   - Execute sub-pixel boundary thresholding (Sobel/Canny gradient extraction) to define the perimeter coordinates $(x_i, y_i)$.
   - Calculate nominal diameter ($D$), orthogonal major/minor axis spread, and integrated physical area ($A = \int y \, dx$).
   - Flag any shadow-mask contact shadowing, aperture clogging, or elliptical distortion exceeding geometric tolerance.

4. **Shadow Mask Edge Run-Out (Penumbra) Profilometry Scan:**
   - Transfer coordinates to the high-resolution profilometer (optical coherence profilometer or ultra-low force stylus profilometer).
   - Perform a transverse line scan orthogonal to the electrode periphery:
     - Scan length: $50\,\mu\text{m}$ (spanning $25\,\mu\text{m}$ bare oxide to $25\,\mu\text{m}$ metal plateau).
     - Stylus force: $\le 0.05\text{ mg}$ (to prevent mechanical deformation of the metal pad or scratching the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide).

5. **Penumbra Slope & Step Height Extraction:**
   - Extract the physical step height ($h$) representing top metal electrode thickness.
   - Measure the edge run-out transition width ($W_{\text{penumbra}}$) defined between $10\%$ and $90\%$ of the steady-state plateau height.
   - Verify that shadow mask standoff distance during PVD did not produce excessive vapor penumbra or edge tailing.

6. **Acceptance Disposition & Data Logging:**
   - Record metrology logs into the factory SPC database.
   - Correlate quantified electrode surface area ($A_{\text{meas}}$) to subsequent High-Frequency C-V capacitance extraction ($C_{\text{ox}} = \kappa \varepsilon_0 A / t_{\text{ox}}$) ensuring oxide thickness verification ($t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) is uncorrupted by boundary errors.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    Acceptance Threshold Budget Limits
                    ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░                              │
      Roughness (Ra)┤░░                              │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
     Profile Step Ht┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Edge Run-Out (W_pen)┤▓▓                              │
                    │▓▓                              │
    Area Bias (dA/A)┤█                               │
                    │█                               │
                    └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                     0      25      50     75     100 
```

1. **Top Electrode Area Precision ($\Delta A / A_{\text{nom}}$):** $\le \pm 1.5\%$ deviation from nominal layout area across all 9-point/49-point wafer mapping inspection sites.
2. **Shadow Mask Edge Run-Out Transition Width ($W_{\text{penumbra}, 10\%\text{--}90\%}$):** $\le 3.5\,\mu\text{m}$ total lateral penumbra run-out width.
3. **Top Electrode Metallization Step Height ($h_{\text{metal}}$):** $100.0\text{ nm} \pm 5.0\text{ nm}$ nominal target with profile edge roughness $R_a \le 2.0\text{ nm}$.
4. **Underlying Gate Dielectric Integrity Preservation:** Substrate surface recession / scratch depth into underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal gate oxide: $< 0.1\text{ nm}$ (below instrument detection limit; no stylus puncture).

---

### 4. Context References & Traceability

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**  
  *Directly informs the baseline gate oxide thickness target ($3.5\text{ nm}$ with $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ sub-Ångström precision tracking) and the implementation of automated 9-point or 49-point radial wafer mapping for thin film verification.*
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**  
  *Supplies the baseline physical oxide parameters ($3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation) and capacitor retention constraints ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ budget).*
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**  
  *Contextualizes dielectric stacks and capacitance budgets ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) requiring accurate test structure electrode area calculation to prevent systematic errors during C-V MOS parameter extraction.*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In Gen 1 (mm-scale shadow-mask metallization), any penumbral edge run-out or lateral divergence from finite source-to-substrate distance during physical vapor deposition directly alters the effective capacitive area A_eff. Because the MOS capacitor high-frequency C-V extraction models oxide thickness via C_ox = (epsilon_ox * A_eff) / t_ox, an uncharacterized 5% area enlargement due to shadow mask standoff/tapering introduces an identical systematic error into dielectric capacitance metrics and flatband/interface state density (D_it) extractions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Shadow masks formed by laser cutting or chemical etching in thin stainless steel, molybdenum, or nickel foils inherently possess burrs and non-vertical sidewall tapers. Combined with inevitable clamping bow, this produces a physical standoff gap (>10 um) leading to a diffuse penumbra (edge run-out). Stylus or optical coherence profilometry across the metal dot edge must decouple the true metal plateau from the sub-micron gradient tail (edge slope) to set an unambiguous diameter cutoff threshold.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision shadow masks with laser-micromachined circular apertures down to 1.0 mm require strict burr-free polishing and high thermal conductivity fixturing. Sourcing calibration standards (NIST-traceable lateral stage micrometers and certified 100 nm step-height standards) is essential within the domestic supply chain to maintain tool traceability without recurring vendor delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Shadow mask geometry verification must be non-destructive and rapid (<15 minutes per test coupon) to prevent gate oxide exposure to ambient air exceeding critical Q-times before high-frequency C-V probing. A standardized optical inspection template combined with automated edge-detection algorithms ensures reproducible sign-off without creating an operator bottleneck.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal expansion mismatch between shadow mask and silicon wafer during thermal evaporation causing mask slip, smeared metal edges, and elliptical electrode profiles.
1. Excessive mask-to-substrate mechanical gap causing extensive metal vapor penumbra, resulting in undefined electrode boundaries and erroneous capacitance calculations.
1. Stylus tip crash or excessive tracking force during contact profilometry scratching through the 3.5 nm gate oxide and causing capacitor dielectric shorting.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-3-1-01` | **Top Electrode Optical Diameter and Circularity Metrology** | Calibrated optical microscope with motorized stage, sub-micron digital camera (0.1 um/pixel calibrated resolution), and automated edge-detection thresholding software. | 1. Mount coupon on microscope vacuum chuck; 2. Align automated optical inspection to measure orthogonal diameters (D_x and D_y) across 9 distinct top electrode capacitor dots; 3. Fit intensity profile gradient (FWHM) at the boundary to compute effective diameter and calculate circularity ratio (D_min / D_max). | `Mean effective diameter must be 1.000 mm ± 0.020 mm (1000 um ± 20 um); circularity ratio (D_min / D_max) must be >= 0.98 for all 9 test dots.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-3-1-02` | **Shadow Mask Edge Penumbra and Run-Out Profilometry** | High-resolution non-contact optical profilometer (white light interferometry / confocal) or stylus profilometer operated in low-force mode (<0.5 mg). | 1. Position measurement scan perpendicular to the electrode perimeter spanning 100 um outside to 100 um inside the metallized electrode; 2. Acquire topographic line profile with lateral step size <= 0.2 um; 3. Extract baseline metal plateau thickness and compute lateral distance between 10% and 90% metal height (penumbral run-out width delta_W). | `Total lateral edge run-out width (10% to 90% step transition) must be <= 15.0 um; peak metallization thickness plateau must measure 150.0 nm ± 15.0 nm with zero pinholes.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, and ESD conductive shoe covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with sterile eyewash station for 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash immediately with soap and excess water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim to clean air environment.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow bench (ISO Class 5) with active local exhaust canopy for solvent wipe dispensing.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of IPA-saturated cleanroom lint-free wipes in dedicated, grounded, fire-rated solvent waste cans. Spent liquid solvents segregated into certified non-halogenated organic waste drums.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Dry Nitrogen Gas (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited thermal evaporated aluminum top electrode dots on intact 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, unannealed, cleanroom environment.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dimensionally verified top electrode capacitors, dry-nitrogen cleared, ready for High-Frequency C-V electrical probe testing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended air exposure causes progressive native aluminum oxidation and moisture adsorption onto thin oxide perimeter, introducing spurious surface leakage, frequency dispersion, and drift in C-V flatband voltage.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified dimensional metrics of shadow-masked top electrode capacitors on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, quantifying electrode diameter, circularity, thickness, and edge run-out penumbra to establish rigorous geometric area benchmarks for C-V electrical modeling.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `electrode_optical_dimension_map.csv`
- [ ] `shadow_mask_edge_runout_profilometry.tiff`
- [ ] `top_electrode_acceptance_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Electrode Mean Planar Diameter** | `1000.0 um` | ± 20.0 um | Automated calibrated optical microscopy edge detection across 9 points per wafer coupon |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Shadow Mask Penumbral Edge Run-Out Width (10%-90%)** | `8.0 um` | <= 15.0 um | Non-contact white light interferometry profile across perimeter step transition |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Electrode Circularity Factor (D_min / D_max)** | `0.995` | >= 0.980 | Orthogonal chord analysis from binary thresholded optical micrograph |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 monitored capacitor dots satisfy diameter (1000 ± 20 um), circularity (>= 0.98), and edge run-out (<= 15 um) thresholds with zero oxide pinhole punch-through; profilometry artifacts successfully exported and tagged for C-V area normalizations.

critics.laya_pm: Shadow mask geometry verification must be non-destructive and rapid (<15 minutes per test coupon) to prevent gate oxide exposure to ambient air exceeding critical Q-times before high-frequency C-V probing. A standardized optical inspection template combined with automated edge-detection algorithms ensures reproducible sign-off without creating an operator bottleneck.
critical_failure_modes: Thermal expansion mismatch between shadow mask and silicon wafer during thermal evaporation causing mask slip, smeared metal edges, and elliptical electrode profiles.
Excessive mask-to-substrate mechanical gap causing extensive metal vapor penumbra, resulting in undefined electrode boundaries and erroneous capacitance calculations.
Stylus tip crash or excessive tracking force during contact profilometry scratching through the 3.5 nm gate oxide and causing capacitor dielectric shorting.

testcases.title: Top Electrode Optical Diameter and Circularity Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Calibrated optical microscope with motorized stage, sub-micron digital camera (0.1 um/pixel calibrated resolution), and automated edge-detection thresholding software.
testcases.pre_conditions: Coupon metallized with shadow-masked aluminum dots (1.0 mm nominal diameter) on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. Stage calibrated against NIST-traceable lateral micrometer standard.
testcases.procedure: 1. Mount coupon on microscope vacuum chuck; 2. Align automated optical inspection to measure orthogonal diameters (D_x and D_y) across 9 distinct top electrode capacitor dots; 3. Fit intensity profile gradient (FWHM) at the boundary to compute effective diameter and calculate circularity ratio (D_min / D_max).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Mean effective diameter must be 1.000 mm ± 0.020 mm (1000 um ± 20 um); circularity ratio (D_min / D_max) must be >= 0.98 for all 9 test dots.

testcases.title: Shadow Mask Edge Penumbra and Run-Out Profilometry
testcases.instrumentation: High-resolution non-contact optical profilometer (white light interferometry / confocal) or stylus profilometer operated in low-force mode (<0.5 mg).
testcases.pre_conditions: Microscope inspection completed; coupon free from particulate contamination; zero baseline calibrated against bare dry oxide field adjacent to metallized pad.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position measurement scan perpendicular to the electrode perimeter spanning 100 um outside to 100 um inside the metallized electrode; 2. Acquire topographic line profile with lateral step size <= 0.2 um; 3. Extract baseline metal plateau thickness and compute lateral distance between 10% and 90% metal height (penumbral run-out width delta_W).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total lateral edge run-out width (10% to 90% step transition) must be <= 15.0 um; peak metallization thickness plateau must measure 150.0 nm ± 15.0 nm with zero pinholes.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses
Static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, and ESD conductive shoe covers
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Eye contact: Flush with sterile eyewash station for 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash immediately with soap and excess water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim to clean air environment.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Standard cleanroom laminar flow bench (ISO Class 5) with active local exhaust canopy for solvent wipe dispensing.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Dispose of IPA-saturated cleanroom lint-free wipes in dedicated, grounded, fire-rated solvent waste cans. Spent liquid solvents segregated into certified non-halogenated organic waste drums.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited thermal evaporated aluminum top electrode dots on intact 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, unannealed, cleanroom environment.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Dimensionally verified top electrode capacitors, dry-nitrogen cleared, ready for High-Frequency C-V electrical probe testing.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Extended air exposure causes progressive native aluminum oxidation and moisture adsorption onto thin oxide perimeter, introducing spurious surface leakage, frequency dispersion, and drift in C-V flatband voltage.

expected_result.summary: Verified dimensional metrics of shadow-masked top electrode capacitors on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, quantifying electrode diameter, circularity, thickness, and edge run-out penumbra to establish rigorous geometric area benchmarks for C-V electrical modeling.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Electrode Mean Planar Diameter
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated calibrated optical microscopy edge detection across 9 points per wafer coupon

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Shadow Mask Penumbral Edge Run-Out Width (10%-90%)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Non-contact white light interferometry profile across perimeter step transition

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Electrode Circularity Factor (D_min / D_max)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Orthogonal chord analysis from binary thresholded optical micrograph

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 9 monitored capacitor dots satisfy diameter (1000 ± 20 um), circularity (>= 0.98), and edge run-out (<= 15 um) thresholds with zero oxide pinhole punch-through; profilometry artifacts successfully exported and tagged for C-V area normalizations.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-CV01`
**Title:** 1 MHz High-Frequency C-V Sweep and Flatband Voltage Metrology on MOS Test Dot Array  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol for MOS Capacitor Shadow Mask Metallization for Electrical Test Structures > Electrode Geometry Verification & High-Frequency C-V Acceptance Metrology  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180 nm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure outlines the execution of high-frequency (1 MHz) Capacitance-Voltage ($C\text{–}V$) sweeps and flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$) extraction on circular MOS capacitor test dot arrays fabricated on p-type silicon substrates. The metrology qualifies the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide dielectric layer and metal-gate electrode integration prior to full DRAM cell array patterning.

---

### 2. Equipment, Tooling & Test Structures
- **LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer:** Keysight E4980A or Keithley 4200A-SCS with CVU (Capacitance-Voltage Unit).
- **Analytical Probe Station:** Shielded dark box with triaxial guarding, vacuum chuck, and micro-positioners.
- **Probe Tips:** Tungsten or beryllium-copper tips (tip radius $\le 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Test Structures:** Shadow-mask evaporated circular aluminum/polysilicon MOS test dots fabricated on thermally grown gate oxide ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\ \text{nm}$) on Si substrate with back-side ohmic contact.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | 1. Wafer Loading & Chuck Contact Fixturing  |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | 2. Open/Short Cable Calibration (1 MHz)     |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | 3. Micro-probing Dot Array & Dark Enclosure |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | 4. High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep         |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | 5. C_ox, V_fb, and EOT Parameter Extraction |
       +---------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Chuck Mounting & Grounding:**
   - Mount the wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck ensuring uniform contact with the wafer back-side ohmic metallization.
   - Verify chuck vacuum level is held at $\le -70\ \text{kPa}$ gauge pressure.

2. **Instrument Zero / Cable Compensation:**
   - Configure the LCR meter to $1\ \text{MHz}$ test frequency with an AC oscillation signal amplitude of $15\ \text{mV}$ RMS.
   - Perform standard Open-Circuit and Short-Circuit cable compensation with probe tips lifted in the dark box to cancel parasitic coaxial lead capacitance ($C_{\text{cable}}$) and series resistance ($R_s$).

3. **Micro-probing under Microscope:**
   - Position the probe tip gently onto the center of a designated circular MOS capacitor dot (e.g., $100\ \mu\text{m}$ to $200\ \mu\text{m}$ nominal diameter).
   - Ensure probe touchdown overdrive is limited to $< 10\ \mu\text{m}$ vertical travel to prevent punch-through or micro-cracking of the $3.5\ \text{nm}$ dielectric layer.
   - Close and seal the dark Faraday shielding enclosure to eliminate photo-generation and electromagnetic interference.

4. **Bias Sweep Execution:**
   - Set DC sweep range from accumulation to strong inversion:
     - For p-type substrate: Sweep gate bias $V_G$ from $-2.5\ \text{V}$ (accumulation) to $+2.0\ \text{V}$ (inversion) at a sweep rate of $50\ \text{mV/s}$.
   - Acquire bidirectional sweeps (forward and reverse) to record capacitance $C$ vs. $V_G$ and detect charge trapping hysteresis.

5. **Data Extraction & Metrology Computation:**
   - **Oxide Capacitance ($C_{ox}$):** Extract maximum capacitance in strong accumulation ($V_G = -2.5\ \text{V}$).
   - **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):** Compute $t_{ox} = \frac{\kappa_{SiO2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{ox}}$ (where $\kappa_{SiO2} = 3.9$).
   - **Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$):** Determine flatband capacitance $C_{fb}$ using the Debye length formulation:
     $$C_{fb} = \frac{C_{ox} \cdot C_{s,fb}}{C_{ox} + C_{s,fb}}, \quad C_{s,fb} = \frac{\varepsilon_{Si} \cdot A}{L_D}$$
     Locate $V_G$ corresponding to $C_{fb}$ on the $1\ \text{MHz}$ curve.
   - **Interface State Density Estimate ($D_{it}$):** Compare against theoretical high-frequency curve stretch-out across the depletion region.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Engineering Units | Source / Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$ / EOT)** | `3.5` | `3.0 to 4.0` | $\text{nm}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |
| **Measurement AC Signal Frequency** | `1.0` | $\pm 0.01$ | $\text{MHz}$ | Process Title / Standard HF Protocol |
| **C-V Hysteresis Window ($\Delta V_{fb}$)** | `< 25` | $\le 50$ | $\text{mV}$ | Qualification criteria for $3.5\ \text{nm}$ dry oxide interface trap density |
| **Max Accumulation Gate Leakage Current Density ($J_g$ at $-2.0\ \text{V}$)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{-2}$ | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{-1}$ | $\text{A/cm}^2$ | Direct tunneling ceiling for $3.5\ \text{nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ |

---

### 5. Context & Literature Citations
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*
  - *"In 180nm nodes, stacked capacitors (Crown or Cylinder type) utilize silicon nitride (Si3N4) or tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) high-k dielectrics with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around 3 to 4 nm."*
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - Specifies the $180\ \text{nm}$ generation scaling benchmarks, access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), and minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\ \text{fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Measuring 1 MHz high-frequency C-V on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide risks significant direct tunneling leakage currents exceeding displacement currents if dot diameters (200 um to 1000 um) are not impedance-matched to the LCR meter's parallel equivalent circuit model (Cp-Gp). System-level open/short calibration at the probe tips and cable parasitic compensation up to 1 MHz must be enforced to prevent apparent phase angle collapse and negative capacitance artifacts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm t_ox on P-type (100) Si, quantum mechanical carrier confinement and polysilicon/gate depletion effects shift the apparent flatband voltage V_fb and reduce accumulation capacitance below classical C_ox. A strict quasi-static correction or high-frequency dual-sweep (inversion-to-accumulation and return) is mandatory to separate mobile ion drift (hysteresis delta-V_fb) from fixed oxide charge (Q_f) and interface state density (D_it).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Shadow mask fabrication tolerances for 200, 500, and 1000 um dot arrays must maintain edge roughness under +/- 2 um. Sputter deposition targets (Al 99.999% purity) and gold/aluminum backside contact metallurgy require domestic semiconductor supplier qualification with certified lead times under 3 weeks to prevent line stops during metallization acceptance testing.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing 1 MHz C-V sweeps across multiple dot arrays directly governs gate oxide thickness acceptance (3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm) before lot advancement into poly-Si gate patterning. Cycle time must not exceed 25 minutes per wafer, and wafer handling protocols must mitigate mechanical probe pin puncturing through ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide layers.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dielectric soft breakdown / puncturing caused by excessive mechanical probe contact force or DC sweep bias > 2.5 V across the 3.5 nm oxide.
1. Distorted accumulation capacitance and gross flatband voltage shift caused by large series resistance (R_s > 50 Ohm) from poor backside ohmic contact.
1. Excessive gate leakage current (I_gate > 1 mA/cm^2) masquerading as high dielectric conductance (G_p / omega), invalidating extraction of true C_ox and flatband capacitance C_fb.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-3-2-01` | **High-Frequency 1 MHz C-V Sweep and Flatband Voltage (V_fb) Extraction on 200 um Al/SiO2/Si MOSCAP** | Keysight B1505A / B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech manual analytical probe station with dark box and Faraday cage, beryllium-copper micro-positioner probes (radius 5 um). | 1. Position micro-probe gently on top of a 200 um diameter circular Al gate dot using microscope inspection (contact overdrive < 5 um). 2. Connect chuck back contact to low-force and probe to high-force of MFCMU. 3. Set AC oscillator amplitude to 25 mV RMS at 1.000 MHz. 4. Sweep DC gate voltage V_G from +1.5 V (inversion) down to -2.0 V (accumulation) in 25 mV steps with 100 ms hold time, then sweep reverse (-2.0 V back to +1.5 V) in parallel mode (Cp-Gp). 5. Extract C_ox at V_G = -2.0 V, calculate flatband capacitance C_fb using substrate doping N_A = 1e16 to 1e17 cm^-3, and identify V_fb from the C-V curve. 6. Compute hysteresis Delta-V_fb between forward and reverse traces. | `Physical oxide thickness t_ox extracted from C_ox must equal 3.50 nm +/- 0.20 nm (accounting for quantum mechanical correction); Flatband voltage V_fb must lie within -0.85 V to -1.05 V; C-V sweep hysteresis Delta-V_fb <= 30 mV (indicating mobile charge Q_m < 2e10 cm^-2); gate leakage conductance G_p / omega at V_G = -2.0 V must satisfy (G_p / omega) / C_ox < 0.05.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-3-2-02` | **MOS Test Dot Array Multi-Area Scaling and Interface Trap Density (D_it) Screening** | Keysight B1500A MFCMU and High-Resolution SMU (B1517A) on vibration-isolated shielded probe station. | 1. Sequentially land probe on 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um adjacent dot test structures. 2. Execute dual 1 MHz C-V sweeps (-2.0 V to +1.5 V) at each geometry with identical cable compensation. 3. Plot measured C_ox versus physical geometric area A (pi * r^2) to verify linear scaling through the origin. 4. Apply Terman method against ideal theoretical C-V profile to determine interface trap density D_it across the silicon bandgap. 5. Record series resistance R_s using Nicollian-Goetzberger conductance method across the depletion-accumulation transition. | `Linear regression of C_ox vs Dot Area must yield R^2 >= 0.998 with perimeter capacitance offset < 2%; Mid-gap interface trap density D_it <= 5.0e10 eV^-1 cm^-2; Extracted series resistance R_s <= 25 Ohm across all tested dots.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom clean-room nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-glare safety glasses, Static-dissipative ESD lab coat and conductive ESD heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Wash immediately with copious water for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: Flush eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation. Nitrogen asphyxiation hazard: Move subject to fresh air immediately; administer CPR/oxygen if breathing ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted inside Class 100 / ISO 5 cleanroom laminar airflow bench with localized mini-environment exhaust; probe station enclosure purge with dry nitrogen exhaust routed to non-hazardous chemical scrubbed exhaust.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent wipes soaked with IPA collected in dedicated, grounded, self-closing metal hazardous waste cans for hazardous solvent incineration; zero direct drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 6.0 | `>= 99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly sputtered Al gate dot test structures over 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide with intact backside ohmic contact metallization; free of organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized MOSCAP wafer with mechanically validated dot pads; intact 3.5 nm dielectric integrity verified under soft breakdown thresholds, stored in sealed purged N2 FOUP/carrier.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to atmospheric moisture and ambient hydrocarbons causes native moisture adsorption at dot perimeters and uncontrolled mobile sodium/potassium ion penetration, distorting flatband voltage shifts (> 100 mV) and inflating false interface state density D_it.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful 1 MHz high-frequency C-V sweep characterization across 200, 500, and 1000 um MOS capacitor dot arrays confirming physical oxide thickness t_ox of 3.5 nm (+/- 0.2 nm), flatband voltage V_fb within -0.85 V to -1.05 V, and interface trap density D_it <= 5e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 for 180nm open-source DRAM peripheral gate oxide acceptance.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WP_MET_CV_1MHZ_MOSCAP_RAW_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `WP_MET_CV_FLATBAND_DIT_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `WP_MET_MOSCAP_DOT_PROBE_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Physical oxide thickness t_ox extracted from 1 MHz accumulation capacitance C_ox** | `3.50 nm` | +/- 0.20 nm | High-frequency parallel capacitance (Cp) extraction at V_G = -2.0 V with quantum mechanical Hauser-Ahmed correction. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Flatband voltage V_fb on standard P-type substrate MOS test dots** | `-0.95 V` | +/- 0.10 V | Numerical derivation of inflection point and flatband capacitance matching C_fb/C_ox on 1 MHz dual sweep. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **C-V bidirectional sweep hysteresis Delta-V_fb** | `0.0 mV` | <= 30.0 mV | Voltage shift measurement between forward (-2.0V to +1.5V) and reverse (+1.5V to -2.0V) sweeps at flatband capacitance level. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires R^2 >= 0.998 area scaling across 200/500/1000 um dots, t_ox confirmed within 3.30 nm - 3.70 nm, D_it <= 5.0e10 eV^-1 cm^-2, and signoff approval by both Lead Metrology Engineer and Thermal Oxidation Domain Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180NM-042
**Title:** Dielectric EOT, Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$), and Oxide Charge Metrology Acceptance Analysis  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the acceptance analysis protocol for evaluating gate dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT), interface trap density ($D_{it}$), flatband voltage shift ($\Delta V_{FB}$), and fixed oxide charge density ($Q_{ox}$) on MOS capacitor test structures fabricated via shadow mask metallization on 180nm thermal dry gate oxide ($t_{ox} \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Metrology Workflow & Execution Steps

```
[ Wafer Pre-Test Prep ] 
          │
          ▼
[ Multi-Frequency C-V Characterization (10 kHz - 1 MHz) ]
          │
          ▼
[ High-Frequency EOT & Accumulation Extraction (Cox) ]
          │
          ▼
[ Low-High Frequency Dit Extraction (Terman / Castagné-Vapaille) ]
          │
          ▼
[ Flatband & Hysteresis Analysis (Vfb, Qox, Delta Vfb) ]
          │
          ▼
[ Acceptance Decision & Run Disposition ]
```

1. **Test Structure Setup & Contact Calibration:**
   - Mount the test wafer on a temperature-controlled chuck stabilized at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ in a light-shielded, electrically shielded probe station (triaxial grounding).
   - Position micro-manipulator tungsten/beryllium-copper probe tips onto shadow-masked aluminum/polysilicon circular gate dots ($A \sim 1.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ cm}^2$ to $5.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ cm}^2$). Ground the p-type substrate via back-side chuck contact.

2. **High-Frequency & Multi-Frequency C-V Acquisition:**
   - Sweep DC bias voltage ($V_G$) from deep inversion to strong accumulation (e.g., $-2.5\text{ V}$ to $+2.5\text{ V}$) and back to measure hysteresis.
   - Apply an AC test signal oscillation level of $15\text{ mV}_\text{rms}$ across test frequencies: $10\text{ kHz}$ (quasi-static/low-frequency approximation) and $1\text{ MHz}$ (high-frequency).
   - Record differential capacitance ($C$) and conductance ($G$).

3. **EOT Extraction via Accumulation Capacitance ($C_{ox}$):**
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance ($C_{max}$) at $1\text{ MHz}$ in strong accumulation ($V_G \gg V_{FB}$).
   - Correct for series resistance ($R_s$) using two-frequency or conductance correction:
     $$C_{ox} = \frac{(G^2 + \omega^2 C^2)C}{\omega^2 C^2 + G^2 (1 - \omega^2 R_s C)}$$
   - Compute Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$):
     $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\epsilon_0 \kappa_{SiO_2} A}{C_{ox}}$$
     where $\kappa_{SiO_2} = 3.9$, $\epsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}$, and $A$ is the verified electrode optical area.

4. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Analysis:**
   - Execute the High-Low Frequency (Castagné-Vapaille) method or Conductance method ($G_p/\omega$ peak):
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q}\left( \frac{C_{LF}/C_{ox}}{1 - C_{LF}/C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{HF}/C_{ox}}{1 - C_{HF}/C_{ox}} \right)$$
   - Extract $D_{it}$ across the midgap potential window ($E_i \pm 0.2\text{ eV}$).

5. **Flatband Voltage ($V_{FB}$) and Oxide Charge Density ($Q_{ox}$):**
   - Calculate theoretical flatband capacitance ($C_{FB}$) from substrate doping concentration ($N_A$) and Debye length ($\lambda_D$).
   - Determine experimental $V_{FB}$ from the $1\text{ MHz}$ forward sweep curve.
   - Compute effective oxide charge density:
     $$N_{ox} = \frac{Q_{ox}}{q} = \frac{C_{ox} (\Phi_{ms} - V_{FB})}{q A}$$
   - Calculate bidirectional C-V hysteresis shift ($\Delta V_{FB} = |V_{FB,\text{reverse}} - V_{FB,\text{forward}}|$).

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Lower / Upper Limits | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.5$ | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | $1\text{ MHz}$ $C_{ox}$ Extraction (Corrected) |
| **Midgap Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{11}$ | Max $1.5 \times 10^{11}$ | $\text{eV}^{-1}\cdot\text{cm}^{-2}$ | High-Low ($10\text{ kHz} - 1\text{ MHz}$) C-V / Conductance |
| **Effective Oxide Charge Density ($N_{ox}$)** | $\le 2.0 \times 10^{10}$ | Max $5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}$ | Flatband voltage shift ($\Phi_{ms} - V_{FB}$) |
| **C-V Sweep Hysteresis ($\Delta V_{FB}$)** | $\le 15$ | Max $25$ | $\text{mV}$ | Bidirectional $1\text{ MHz}$ voltage sweep |

---

### 4. Context Source Citations
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Establishes the thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric physical thickness target of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation, setting the EOT nominal baseline between $3\text{ and }4\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Defines unit access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and subthreshold/junction leakage targets requiring high dielectric interface integrity and minimal defect-assisted trap densities.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting electrical oxide thickness (EOT), Dit, and Qf on a thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide via shadow-mask MOS capacitor structures introduces significant parasitic risks, including edge fringe capacitance, series resistance (Rs) from substrate bulk contact, and quantum confinement shifts. The metrology pipeline must integrate a robust two-frequency or three-element equivalent circuit model (Levenberg-Marquardt impedance fitting) to decouple accumulation gate leakage currents (quantum tunneling at EOT ~3.5 nm) from true oxide capacitance Cox. Failure to calibrate probe contact resistance and back-side wafer ohmic contact will induce severe distortion in flatband voltage (Vfb) determination.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm physical thickness, high-frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) and quasi-static/low-frequency C-V profiling suffer from direct tunneling leakage (Jg > 10^-2 A/cm^2 near accumulation), which corrupts quasi-static low-frequency capacitance CLF and introduces artificial Dit peaks. The extraction protocol must prioritize the conductance method (Gp/omega vs. frequency mapping across 1 kHz to 10 MHz) or Terman's method backed by high-precision optical spectroscopic ellipsometry (n, k modeling with Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz parameterization) to cross-verify physical vs. electrical thickness. Fixed charge Qf/q must be derived strictly after correcting for metal-semiconductor work function difference (Phi_ms) using back-side metallized Al/p-Si or Al/n-Si reference wafers.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Shadow mask thermal evaporation sets tight geometric constraints: aperture edge feathering from stencil standoff variability directly alters capacitor area A by up to 8%, propagating quadratic error into Cox (F/cm^2) and extracted EOT. Calibration coupons and certified quartz shadow masks with laser-micromachined round orifices must be tracked per lot. In addition, high-frequency LCR meters (Keysight E4980A or Keithley 4200-SCS) require quarterly traceable capacitive standard calibration kits (NIST-traceable 1 pF - 100 pF standards) to maintain Gen 1 metrology compliance.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: MOSCAP wafer qualification sits on the critical path between thermal dry oxidation gate dielectric growth and active transistor front-end-of-line integration. A failure in oxide charge (Qf > 5e10 cm^-2) or interface trap density (Dit > 1e11 cm^-2 eV^-1) indicates furnace contamination or improper post-oxidation annealing (POA in N2/forming gas H2-N2). Turnaround time from metallization to electrical sign-off must not exceed 2 hours to avoid mobile ion absorption (Na+, K+) and moisture uptake in unpassivated cleanroom air.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Direct quantum tunneling leakage corrupting accumulation capacitance, resulting in severe overestimation of EOT and erroneous Dit extraction.
1. Variable stencil shadow-mask taper/edge penumbra causing uncharacterized capacitor area variation exceeding +/- 5%, invalidating normalized per-unit-area capacitance (Cox).
1. Backside un-annealed native oxide contact resistance generating large series resistance Rs, causing artificial dispersion in high-frequency C-V curves and false flatband shifts.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-3-3-01` | **High-Frequency C-V and Conductance Profiling for EOT and Dit Determination** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter coupled with Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automatic Probe Station with dark/shielded Faraday cage, and NIST-traceable calibrated standard capacitor fixture | 1. Position tungsten-carbide probe tip (radius 5 um) onto top aluminum shadow-mask dot (nominal diameter 200 um, calibrated via optical profilometry).\n2. Execute dual-sweep high-frequency C-V from inversion (+1.5 V) through depletion to accumulation (-2.5 V for p-substrate) at frequencies 10 kHz, 100 kHz, and 1 MHz with 15 mV RMS AC oscillation.\n3. Measure parallel conductance Gp/omega across bias steps of 25 mV across the bandgap range.\n4. Apply 3-element series resistance correction to obtain true Cox at -2.5 V accumulation.\n5. Compute EOT = (epsilon_SiO2 * epsilon_0 * Area) / Cox_corrected, where epsilon_SiO2 = 3.9.\n6. Extract midgap Dit from peak normalized conductance (Gp/omega)_max using Dit = (2.5 / q) * (Gp / omega)_max / Area. | `EOT must be within 3.50 +/- 0.25 nm (3.25 nm <= EOT <= 3.75 nm); midgap Dit must be <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1; bidirectional C-V hysteresis Delta Vfb <= 25 mV.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-2-3-3-3-02` | **Flatband Voltage Shift and Fixed Oxide Charge (Qf) Extraction** | Keithley 4200A-SCS with 4210-CVU Capacitance-Voltage Unit, calibrated against high-resolution Woollam M-2000 Spectroscopic Ellipsometer physical thickness data | 1. Perform high-frequency (100 kHz) C-V sweep from deep depletion to strong accumulation on 5 discrete MOSCAP dots across wafer center and edge zones.\n2. Calculate ideal theoretical flatband capacitance Cfb_ideal = Area * (Cox_meas / (1 + (epsilon_SiO2 * LD / (epsilon_Si * tox)))), where LD is the semiconductor Debye length.\n3. Determine experimental Vfb_meas from measured C-V curve at C = Cfb_ideal.\n4. Calculate theoretical work function difference Phi_ms for Al/SiO2/Si (p-type, Na = 1.5e17 cm^-3, Phi_ms ~ -0.90 V).\n5. Compute flatband voltage shift: Delta Vfb = Vfb_meas - Phi_ms.\n6. Extract fixed oxide charge density: Qf/q = (-Delta Vfb * Cox_meas) / (q * Area). | `Extracted fixed oxide charge density Qf/q must be < 5.0 x 10^10 cm^-2; wafer-scale 5-point Vfb standard deviation sigma(Vfb) <= 30 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive footwear, Full face shield and chemical apron during solvent wipe and residue clean
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvent cleaning agents: immediately flush exposed skin with copious flowing water for a minimum of 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. In case of vapor inhalation: move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if respiration becomes difficult. In case of eye splash: immediately rinse eyes at cleanroom plumbed eyewash station for >= 15 minutes holding eyelids retracted, and seek immediate ophthalmological attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station enclosure and solvent pre-clean bench must maintain constant localized mechanical exhaust ventilation with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous VOC monitoring interlocked with ambient gas extraction ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning wipes and waste effluents collected in dedicated, grounded flammable solvent waste carboys labeled strictly for Non-Halogenated Organic Solvents; do not mix with acidic or oxidizer drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / MOS Grade (SEMICHEM) | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | VLSI Grade | `>= 99.5%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Compressed)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.5 | `>= 99.9995%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly evaporated aluminum MOS capacitor dots on 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide with backside aluminum sintering completed, dry cleanroom air exposure < 15 minutes, zero particulate debris.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized gate dielectric coupon with non-destructive tungsten probe witness marks (< 5 um indentation), nitrogen-purged and vacuum-sealed for secondary physical analysis.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption, atmospheric airborne hydrocarbon condensation, and mobile alkali metal ion (Na+, K+) diffusion induce flatband voltage hysteresis, artificial Dit interface states, and severe threshold instability.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Formal electrical qualification and metrology sign-off of 3.5 nm Gen 1 dry thermal gate oxide MOS capacitors. Successful extraction verifies EOT within 3.50 +/- 0.25 nm, midgap interface trap density Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1, and fixed oxide charge Qf/q < 5.0 x 10^10 cm^-2 with complete series resistance and quantum-mechanical confinement corrections.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_3.5NM_GATE_CV_EOT_PROFILING_RUN01.csv`
- [ ] `INTERFACE_TRAP_DIT_CONDUCTANCE_SPECTRUM_MAP.pdf`
- [ ] `OXIDE_CHARGE_QF_AND_SERIES_RESISTANCE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Electrical Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted at accumulation bias (-2.5 V) with series resistance correction** | `3.50 nm` | +/- 0.25 nm | High-frequency (100 kHz) C-V accumulation capacitance extraction on 200 um diameter circular shadow-mask dots corrected via 3-element equivalent circuit modeling |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Silicon-dielectric interface trap density (Dit) at midgap energy** | `5.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1` | <= 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1 | Parallel conductance method (Gp/omega versus frequency from 1 kHz to 1 MHz across depletion voltages) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Net fixed oxide charge density (Qf/q) derived from flatband voltage shift** | `2.5e10 cm^-2` | < 5.0e10 cm^-2 | Flatband voltage extraction comparing ideal theoretical Cfb against experimental 100 kHz C-V curve, accounting for Al-Si work function difference |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 tested MOSCAP test structures across center and edge fields achieve EOT between 3.25 nm and 3.75 nm, Dit at midgap <= 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1, Qf/q < 5.0e10 cm^-2, and bidirectional C-V hysteresis <= 25 mV, formally signed off by Metrology Lead and DRAM Device Integration Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology [Metrology] > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Oxide Thickness Tox: 3.5 nm (Gate) / 350 nm (Field).
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / C-V Profiler.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm 1T1C DRAM architecture, sub-threshold leakage of the access transistor directly degrades storage node retention time. A high midgap interface trap density (Dit > 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1) increases the subthreshold swing (SS = ln(10)*(kT/q)*(1 + (Cdep + q*Dit)/Cox)), which suppresses the I_on/I_off ratio and accelerates charge bleed off the 28 fF storage cell node. Furthermore, parasitic trap-assisted tunneling and surface recombination at the SiO2/Si interface degrade read signal margins when transferring charge onto the 150-250 fF bitline. Precision high-frequency (HF, 100 kHz - 1 MHz) combined with quasi-static (QS, ramp rate dV/dt ~ 10-50 mV/s) C-V extraction on dedicated large-area MOS capacitors (100 um x 100 um to 300 um x 300 um) is required to resolve trap densities without masking by series resistance or dielectric leakage.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static C-V on ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide faces severe gate leakage currents (direct and Fowler-Nordheim tunneling), where the displacement current I_disp = C * (dV/dt) can be swamped by static DC leakage I_leak. A displacement current of ~10-50 pA requires an electrometer resolution down to 0.1 pA with triaxial guarding and strict compensation for parasitic leakage. The High-Low Frequency method (Castagné-Vapaille) extracts Dit = (Cox/q) * [ (C_LF/(Cox - C_LF)) - (C_HF/(Cox - C_HF)) ]. Care must be taken during the post-metallization anneal (forming gas anneal, 10% H2 in N2 at 400-450°C) to passivate dangling silicon bonds (Pb centers) prior to metrology, ensuring that residual Dit reflects fundamental interface quality rather than unpassivated fabrication damage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology throughput hinges on automated analytical probe stations equipped with Keysight B1500A/B1505A parameter analyzers (or Keithley 4200A-SCS with CVU and low-current pre-amps). High lead times (16-24 weeks) on high-purity triaxial cabling, tungsten Kelvin probe needles (tip radius 1-2 um), and gold-plated hot chuck stages represent a critical supply risk. Standardizing MOS test structures across multi-project wafer (MPW) drop-in test chips is imperative to avoid bespoke probe card designs and minimize equipment down-time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Interface trap extraction serves as the primary gating milestone between dry thermal gate oxidation (3.5 nm target) and poly-Si gate deposition / source-drain implantation. If Dit exceeds the 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1 threshold or flatband shifts indicate uncontrolled fixed oxide charge (Qf/q > 5.0e10 cm^-2), gate oxidation lots must be placed on engineering hold immediately. Testing must be completed within 120 minutes of forming gas anneal to prevent ambient room air aging effects and moisture adsorption on bare test pads from skewing C-V hysteresis.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DC tunneling leakage exceeding displacement current during quasi-static ramp on 3.5 nm oxide, distorting the low-frequency capacitance curve and yielding unphysical or negative Dit values.
1. Inadequate forming gas passivation (H2/N2 anneal under-temperature or insufficient time) leaving dangling Si trivalent Pb centers, causing Dit to breach the 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1 threshold.
1. Chuck parasitic capacitance and series resistance (Rs) from unoptimized back-side substrate contact skewing accumulation C_ox values during 1 MHz high-frequency measurement.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-01` | **High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Dit Extraction at Midgap** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer equipped with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Measurement Unit (MFCMU) and B1517A High-Resolution SMU with HRSMU Pre-Amp, triaxial guarded probe tips on Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 probe station inside a dark, electrically shielded Faraday cage. | 1. Connect high-side triaxial probe to MOS capacitor gate (200 um x 200 um pad) and low-side probe/chuck to p-type substrate. 2. Perform open/short cable compensation on MFCMU from 1 kHz to 1 MHz. 3. Measure High-Frequency (HF) C-V at 1 MHz with 15 mV RMS AC amplitude, sweeping gate bias from accumulation (-2.5 V) to strong inversion (+2.0 V) at 50 mV steps. 4. Measure Quasi-Static (QS) C-V using B1517A linear voltage ramp from -2.5 V to +2.0 V at dV/dt = 20 mV/s, logging displacement current I_disp to calculate C_LF = I_disp / (dV/dt). 5. Correct for DC leakage by averaging forward and reverse ramp baselines. 6. Compute midgap Dit using Castagné-Vapaille formula: Dit = (Cox/q) * [ (C_LF / (Cox - C_LF)) - (C_HF / (Cox - C_HF)) ]. | `Midgap interface trap density Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1; Oxide capacitance Cox corresponds to physical equivalent thickness Tox = 3.5 ± 0.2 nm; C-V hysteresis Delta V_fb between forward and reverse sweep <= 15 mV.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-02` | **Flatband Voltage Shift and Fixed Oxide Charge (Qf) Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Parameter Analyzer with B1520A MFCMU, low-noise chuck triaxial backplane, and temperature-controlled stage. | 1. Calculate theoretical flatband capacitance C_fb using Debye length lambda_D = sqrt((k*T*eps_si)/(q^2*Na)) and C_fb = (Cox * eps_si / lambda_D) / (Cox + eps_si / lambda_D). 2. Locate experimental flatband voltage V_fb(meas) on 1 MHz HF C-V curve corresponding to C = C_fb. 3. Calculate ideal flatband voltage V_fb(ideal) from metal-semiconductor work function difference Phi_ms (Al gate on p-Si ~ -0.90 V). 4. Calculate flatband voltage shift Delta V_fb = V_fb(ideal) - V_fb(meas). 5. Compute fixed oxide charge density Qf / q = - (Delta V_fb * Cox) / (q * Area). | `Fixed oxide charge density Qf / q < 5.0 x 10^10 cm^-2; Flatband shift |Delta V_fb| <= 50 mV relative to theoretical ideal.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-donned), UVEX polycarbonate safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Cleanroom antistatic polyester-carbon filament bunny suit with ESD booties and grounding strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye exposure to IPA: Flush eyes at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash affected area with soap and water, remove contaminated gloves. Inhalation of solvent fumes: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. Nitrogen displacement: In case of low O2 alarm (<19.5%), evacuate enclosure room immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station enclosed in laminar flow hood with local exhaust ventilation maintaining air flow velocity >= 100 FPM (0.5 m/s); room equipped with continuous ambient O2 depletion monitors connected to fab building management interlock.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipe tissues and cleaning swabs collected in dedicated flame-resistant, grounded stainless steel solvent waste bins; no chemical drain disposal permitted.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly completed forming gas anneal (420°C, 30 min, H2/N2) with passivated Si-SiO2 interface, clean Al/poly probe pads, and back-side metallization free of native oxide regrowth.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized MOS capacitor test pads with minimal scrub mark indentation (< 20% pad area consumed) ready for immediate passivation layer deposition or lot disposition.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: In a 180nm 1T1C DRAM architecture, sub-threshold leakage of the access transistor directly degrades storage node retention time. A high midgap interface trap density (Dit > 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1) increases the subthreshold swing (SS = ln(10)*(kT/q)*(1 + (Cdep + q*Dit)/Cox)), which suppresses the I_on/I_off ratio and accelerates charge bleed off the 28 fF storage cell node. Furthermore, parasitic trap-assisted tunneling and surface recombination at the SiO2/Si interface degrade read signal margins when transferring charge onto the 150-250 fF bitline. Precision high-frequency (HF, 100 kHz - 1 MHz) combined with quasi-static (QS, ramp rate dV/dt ~ 10-50 mV/s) C-V extraction on dedicated large-area MOS capacitors (100 um x 100 um to 300 um x 300 um) is required to resolve trap densities without masking by series resistance or dielectric leakage.

A displacement current of ~10-50 pA requires an electrometer resolution down to 0.1 pA with triaxial guarding and strict compensation for parasitic leakage. The High-Low Frequency method (Castagné-Vapaille) extracts Dit = (Cox/q) * [ (C_LF/(Cox - C_LF)) - (C_HF/(Cox - C_HF)) ]. nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Setup and Contact Verification

**Discipline / Category**: Metrology  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Optical Inspection / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Probe card and needle contact mechanics must enforce strict compliance force controls (< 15 mN per probe needle) to prevent micro-fracturing or puncture through the ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide dielectric layer during touchdown on the 200/500/1000 um Al dots. Furthermore, parasitic chuck-to-ground capacitance and series probe cable inductances must be de-embedded using open/short calibration substrates up to 1 MHz to preserve measurement integrity for High-Frequency C-V profiling.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Achieving true ohmic back-contact to the P-type (100) Si substrate is critical; any residual Schottky barrier or native oxide on the wafer backside acts as a series back-diode/capacitance that severely distorts the quasi-static C-V curve, suppressing inversion recovery and falsifying interface trap density (Dit) calculations. A scratch-brush Ga-In eutectic application or sintered Al/Au backside metallization with contact resistivity Rc < 1e-3 ohm*cm2 is mandatory before acquiring accumulation capacitance values.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten and beryllium-copper probe tips with 25-50 um tip radii, shadow masks for circular Al dot deposition, and high-purity gallium-indium liquid metal eutectic (or e-beam targets) are single-sourced or subject to localized inventory bottlenecks. Routine probe tip cleaning pads (alumina ceramic) and shadow mask ultrasonic solvent clean cycles must be staged to prevent particulate transfers across runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: MOSCAP contact verification serves as the critical gatekeeper prior to committing the high-frequency and quasi-static C-V test benches. Unverified backside contact or needle punching immediately ruins downstream Dit extraction milestones, causing 8-12 hour test loop delays and scrap of the 3.5 nm thermal oxidation run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Mechanical puncture of the 3.5 nm gate oxide during excessive probe overtravel (> 10 um), causing irreversible gate-to-substrate ohmic shorts.
1. Backside non-ohmic rectifying contact formation due to native SiO2 re-growth or inadequate Ga-In eutectic wetting, resulting in erroneous frequency dispersion and series resistance distortion.
1. Probe-induced scrubbing damage and lateral smearing of sputtered 200 um Al gate metallization, altering effective gate area by > 5% and skewing oxide capacitance (Cox) extraction.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-1-01` | **Substrate Backside Ohmic Contact Linearity & Series Resistance Verification** | Keithley 4200-SCS Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Shielded Probe Station, Triaxial Cables | 1. Land Probe Tip 1 onto a large 1000 um Al dot and Probe Tip 2 onto an adjacent 1000 um dot or secondary substrate tap. 2. Sweep DC voltage between chuck back-contact and substrate tap from -1.0 V to +1.0 V in 20 mV increments. 3. Record I-V characteristic curve and extract differential resistance dV/dI across the zero-crossing region (-0.1 V to +0.1 V). | `Back-contact I-V curve must demonstrate strictly linear (symmetric ohmic) behavior with correlation coefficient R^2 >= 0.998 and total back-contact series resistance R_series <= 10.0 Ohms across the 100 mm wafer chuck interface.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-1-02` | **MOSCAP Gate Oxide Contact Touchdown & Leakage Current Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer (B1505A/HR-SMU), Mitutoyo Optical Microscope, Micro-Positioner with 25 um radius W-tip | 1. Approach probe tip to 500 um Al dot under 20x magnification until initial electrical contact is sensed (Z-zero). 2. Apply precisely 5 um overtravel (contact force ~10 mN). 3. Apply gate voltage V_G = -0.5 V (accumulation regime for P-type substrate) for 5 seconds and record steady-state gate leakage current I_leak. 4. Step V_G to -1.0 V and record I_leak. | `Gate leakage current I_leak at V_G = -0.5 V must remain <= 1.0 pA (or <= 5.1e-10 A/cm2 for 500 um dot) without dielectric breakdown, and visual inspection after tip release must show probe scrub mark diameter <= 15 um with zero substrate gouging.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved for chemical contact), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles, Antistatic ESD cleanroom lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Flush affected area immediately with copious water for 2 minutes, then massage Calcium Gluconate 2.5% gel continuously into skin until medical help arrives. For EGaIn skin contact: Wipe with dry lint-free wipe, wash thoroughly with soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chemical preparation and HF backside dipping must occur inside a dedicated laminar flow wet chemical fume hood with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM). Probe station requires class 100 localized mini-environment with dry nitrogen purge capabilities.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous HF waste must be drained into dedicated fluoride waste carboys for calcium hydroxide precipitation. Ga-In residue wipes must be treated as solid hazardous heavy metal waste and disposed of via hazardous material management.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gallium-Indium Eutectic (EGaIn)** | `12610-58-7` | Analytical Grade (>= 99.99% trace metals basis) | `75.5 wt% Ga, 24.5 wt% In` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Backside de-ox strip)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade | `1.0% aqueous solution` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Probe cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized circular Al gate dots (via shadow mask sputtering) on 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide with backside freshly etched and metallized/wetted with Ga-In.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically validated, probe-contact-verified MOSCAP wafer mounted on chuck ready for 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V parameter extraction.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 30 minutes promotes moisture condensation, atmospheric hydrocarbon adsorption on Al dots, and backside oxide re-growth, increasing contact resistance by > 300% and invalidating Dit quasi-static extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful probe setup and non-destructive electrical contact verification for MOSCAP dot structures on 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide, establishing reproducible < 10 Ohm substrate ohmic back-contact and sub-picoamp gate leakage prior to C-V sweeps.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_BackContact_IV_Linearity_Report.csv`
- [ ] `Probe_Touchdown_Gate_Leakage_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Contact_Verification_and_Scrub_Optical_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Backside Substrate Contact Linearity Coefficient (R^2)** | `0.999` | +/- 0.001 (minimum 0.998) | Linear regression analysis of Keithley 4200-SCS I-V sweep from -1.0 V to +1.0 V. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Pre-sweep Accumulation Gate Leakage Current at V_G = -0.5 V** | `0.5 pA` | <= 1.0 pA absolute | Keysight B1500A High-Resolution SMU dark-current measurement. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum Probe Tip Scrub Footprint Diameter** | `10.0 um` | <= 15.0 um | Split-field high-resolution optical microscope post-touchdown review. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher sign-off requires: (1) Back-contact series resistance <= 10.0 Ohms across at least 3 distinct wafer locations, (2) Gate leakage < 1.0 pA at -0.5 V across five 500 um dots without oxide punch-through, and (3) Verification that queue time in ambient air remained < 30 minutes from backside strip to probe placement.

Furthermore, parasitic chuck-to-ground capacitance and series probe cable inductances must be de-embedded using open/short calibration substrates up to 1 MHz to preserve measurement integrity for High-Frequency C-V profiling.
critics.domain_expert: Achieving true ohmic back-contact to the P-type (100) Si substrate is critical; any residual Schottky barrier or native oxide on the wafer backside acts as a series back-diode/capacitance that severely distorts the quasi-static C-V curve, suppressing inversion recovery and falsifying interface trap density (Dit) calculations. A scratch-brush Ga-In eutectic application or sintered Al/Au backside metallization with contact resistivity Rc < 1e-3 ohm*cm2 is mandatory before acquiring accumulation capacitance values.
critics.supply_chain: Tungsten and beryllium-copper probe tips with 25-50 um tip radii, shadow masks for circular Al dot deposition, and high-purity gallium-indium liquid metal eutectic (or e-beam targets) are single-sourced or subject to localized inventory bottlenecks. Routine probe tip cleaning pads (alumina ceramic) and shadow mask ultrasonic solvent clean cycles must be staged to prevent particulate transfers across runs.
critics.laya_pm: MOSCAP contact verification serves as the critical gatekeeper prior to committing the high-frequency and quasi-static C-V test benches. Unverified backside contact or needle punching immediately ruins downstream Dit extraction milestones, causing 8-12 hour test loop delays and scrap of the 3.5 nm thermal oxidation run.
critical_failure_modes: Mechanical puncture of the 3.5 nm gate oxide during excessive probe overtravel (> 10 um), causing irreversible gate-to-substrate ohmic shorts.
Backside non-ohmic rectifying contact formation due to native SiO2 re-growth or inadequate Ga-In eutectic wetting, resulting in erroneous frequency dispersion and series resistance distortion.
Probe-induced scrubbing damage and lateral smearing of sputtered 200 um Al gate metallization, altering effective gate area by > 5% and skewing oxide capacitance (Cox) extraction.

testcases.title: Substrate Backside Ohmic Contact Linearity & Series Resistance Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keithley 4200-SCS Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Shielded Probe Station, Triaxial Cables
testcases.pre_conditions: P-type wafer backside wiped with 1% dilute HF to remove native oxide, followed by Ga-In eutectic application or sintered Al metallization; wafer placed onto gold-plated vacuum chuck at 25 deg C with dark shield engaged.
testcases.procedure: 1. Land Probe Tip 1 onto a large 1000 um Al dot and Probe Tip 2 onto an adjacent 1000 um dot or secondary substrate tap. 2. Sweep DC voltage between chuck back-contact and substrate tap from -1.0 V to +1.0 V in 20 mV increments. 3. Record I-V characteristic curve and extract differential resistance dV/dI across the zero-crossing region (-0.1 V to +0.1 V).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Back-contact I-V curve must demonstrate strictly linear (symmetric ohmic) behavior with correlation coefficient R^2 >= 0.998 and total back-contact series resistance R_series <= 10.0 Ohms across the 100 mm wafer chuck interface.

testcases.title: MOSCAP Gate Oxide Contact Touchdown & Leakage Current Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer (B1505A/HR-SMU), Mitutoyo Optical Microscope, Micro-Positioner with 25 um radius W-tip
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer held under vacuum; microscope aligned on 500 um diameter circular Al gate dot; dark enclosure closed; triaxial lines calibrated (open/short de-embedding executed).
testcases.procedure: 1. Approach probe tip to 500 um Al dot under 20x magnification until initial electrical contact is sensed (Z-zero). 2. Apply precisely 5 um overtravel (contact force ~10 mN). 3. Apply gate voltage V_G = -0.5 V (accumulation regime for P-type substrate) for 5 seconds and record steady-state gate leakage current I_leak. 4. Step V_G to -1.0 V and record I_leak.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Gate leakage current I_leak at V_G = -0.5 V must remain <= 1.0 pA (or <= 5.1e-10 A/cm2 for 500 um dot) without dielectric breakdown, and visual inspection after tip release must show probe scrub mark diameter <= 15 um with zero substrate gouging.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved for chemical contact)
ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles
Antistatic ESD cleanroom lab coat
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For HF exposure: Flush affected area immediately with copious water for 2 minutes, then massage Calcium Gluconate 2.5% gel continuously into skin until medical help arrives. For EGaIn skin contact: Wipe with dry lint-free wipe, wash thoroughly with soap and water.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Chemical preparation and HF backside dipping must occur inside a dedicated laminar flow wet chemical fume hood with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM). Probe station requires class 100 localized mini-environment with dry nitrogen purge capabilities.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Aqueous HF waste must be drained into dedicated fluoride waste carboys for calcium hydroxide precipitation. Ga-In residue wipes must be treated as solid hazardous heavy metal waste and disposed of via hazardous material management.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly metallized circular Al gate dots (via shadow mask sputtering) on 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide with backside freshly etched and metallized/wetted with Ga-In.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Electrically validated, probe-contact-verified MOSCAP wafer mounted on chuck ready for 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V parameter extraction.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Air exposure exceeding 30 minutes promotes moisture condensation, atmospheric hydrocarbon adsorption on Al dots, and backside oxide re-growth, increasing contact resistance by > 300% and invalidating Dit quasi-static extraction.

expected_result.summary: Successful probe setup and non-destructive electrical contact verification for MOSCAP dot structures on 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide, establishing reproducible < 10 Ohm substrate ohmic back-contact and sub-picoamp gate leakage prior to C-V sweeps.
