# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180-CV01
**Title:** High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Process Step Context:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & C-V Metrology $\rightarrow$ High-Frequency & Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the dual-sweep Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) metrology protocol for characterizing 3.5 nm thermally grown dry gate oxide test structures (MOSCAPs) on 180 nm DRAM production lots. The dual-sweep data acquisition combines high-frequency (HF, 1 MHz) and quasi-static (QS) capacitance profiling to extract interface trap density ($D_{it}$), flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$), and validate dielectric integrity across access transistor gate stacks.

---

### 2. Workflow & Metrology Architecture

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  Wafer Loading & Shielded Chuck Thermal Stabilization (25°C / 85°C)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Open/Short Calibration & Parasitic Compensation (LCR Meter / SMU)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep (-2.5 V to +2.5 V, Accum. -> Inv.)  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Quasi-Static (QS) Linear Ramp Acquisition (dV/dt <= 50 mV/s)        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Automated $D_{it}$ Extraction, Gate Leakage Screening (< 1 fA limit)|
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Environmental Stabilization:**
   - Mount the test wafer on the prober chuck inside a light-tight, electrically shielded Faraday enclosure to prevent photogeneration artifacts.
   - For standard ambient screening, verify chuck temperature is stabilized at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$. For thermal leakage correlation, ramp chuck to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Fixture Open/Short De-embedding:**
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit calibration on the LCR meter / precision impedance analyzer at the probe tips across the full measurement frequency spectrum (up to 1 MHz) to remove coaxial cable parasitics and chuck stray capacitance.

3. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Acquisition:**
   - Land Kelvin tungsten/beryllium-copper probe tips onto the designated MOS capacitor test pad (gate contact) and substrate/well tap.
   - Configure AC probe signal: $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$, $V_{osc} = 15\text{ mV}_{\text{RMS}}$.
   - Apply DC bias dual sweep: Sweep gate bias from accumulation ($-2.5\text{ V}$) to strong inversion ($+2.5\text{ V}$) and back to accumulation at a standard step rate ($\Delta V = 20\text{ mV}$, hold time $= 50\text{ ms}$).
   - Record high-frequency capacitance ($C_{HF}$) and conductance ($G_{HF}$) versus DC bias ($V_G$).

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Acquisition:**
   - Switch instrument configuration to precision electrometer / Source Measure Unit (SMU) mode.
   - Ensure the structure is held in equilibrium hold bias for $10\text{ s}$ prior to ramping.
   - Execute a linear ramp quasi-static acquisition with a slow slew rate ($dV/dt \le 50\text{ mV/s}$) from accumulation to inversion.
   - Measure displacement current $I_{QS}$ and compute quasi-static capacitance:
     $$C_{QS} = \frac{I_{QS}}{dV/dt}$$
   - Verify leakage current limit does not distort $I_{QS}$.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction & Data Export:**
   - Compute interface trap capacitance across the bandgap using the High-Low frequency method:
     $$C_{it}(V_G) = \left(\frac{1}{C_{QS}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1} - \left(\frac{1}{C_{HF}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1}$$
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{it}}{q \cdot A}$$
     *(where $q$ is elementary charge and $A$ is MOSCAP pad area).*
   - Automatically log data into the fab manufacturing execution and yield tracking system.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Measurement Limits |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Dielectric Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | nm | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ (extracted via $C_{ox}$ in strong accumulation) |
| **Test Frequency (High-Frequency Mode)** | `1.0` | MHz | $\pm 0.01\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Elevated Temperature Stability Benchmark** | `85` | °C | $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ (for thermal retention screening) |
| **MOSCAP Dielectric / Leakage Screening Floor** | `< 1.0` | fA | Upper bound screening threshold at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**: Defines the gate dielectric physical target as thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) via $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; establishes elevated operational retention temperature benchmarking at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**: Dictates the ultra-low leakage requirement where sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain cell refresh intervals, providing the leakage floor bound during metrology characterization.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-sweep high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static (QS) capacitance-voltage measurement requires strict synchronicity and ultra-low noise shielding. Stray cable capacitance and triaxial fixture parasitics can exceed the accumulation capacitance of small MOS test dots (e.g. 50-100 um diameter on 3.5 nm oxide), leading to substantial apparent phase distortion and erroneous Dit extraction if open/short de-embedding is omitted.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm physical gate oxide, direct quantum mechanical tunneling leakage (Ig) causes significant shunt conductance in accumulation and inversion. In quasi-static ramp measurement, displacement current (Idisp = C * dV/dt) must heavily dominate tunneling leakage; otherwise, the quasi-static curve diverges exponentially, rendering the Castagné-Vapaille high-low frequency method invalid without numerical conductance correction.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires calibrated high-frequency LCR meters (Keysight E4980A or B1500A with MFCMU and HRSMU units), low-noise triaxial feedthroughs, dark Faraday cage probe stations, and ultra-sharp tungsten/beryllium-copper probe needles. Sourcing precision probe tips and low-leakage triax assemblies under regional embargo or lead-time constraints creates bottlenecks for Gen 1 inline metrology.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-sweep ramp rates must be thoroughly balanced: QS sweep ramp rates cannot exceed 10-50 mV/s without inducing non-equilibrium deep depletion, but excessively slow ramps increase total probe dwell time and exacerbate air exposure/moisture re-adsorption. The schedule must allocate dedicated wafer probe windows immediately post-metallization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Excessive dielectric gate leakage current exceeding quasi-static displacement current, leading to non-physical negative or infinite extracted Dit across the midgap.
1. Mechanical probe punch-through or micro-scratching through the ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide during needle landing on unpassivated test pads, causing instantaneous gate-to-substrate short circuits.
1. Parasitic ambient optical generation and 50/60 Hz electromagnetic induction corrupting minority carrier response during high-frequency reverse inversion sweeps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-01` | **High-Frequency 1 MHz C-V Bidirectional Hysteresis and Flatband Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A MFCMU, Faraday light-tight probe station with gold-plated chuck, triaxial cabling, vibration isolation table (<5 um Abbe compliance). | 1. Position beryllium-copper probe needle on 100 um x 100 um MOS capacitor gate metal pad with contact resistance < 5 ohms. 2. Configure DC bias sweep from accumulation (-1.8 V for p-type Si) to inversion (+1.8 V) and immediately reverse back to accumulation at 100 mV step with 0.1 s hold time. 3. Acquire parallel capacitance (Cp) and conductance (Gp) at 1 MHz continuously across forward and reverse sweeps. 4. Extract flatband voltage (Vfb) and hysteresis delta-Vfb. | `Accumulation capacitance Cox matches theoretical value within +/- 6% (approx. 9.87 pF for 100 um x 100 um dot at tox = 3.5 nm); bidirectional hysteresis delta-Vfb <= 25 mV; equivalent parallel conductance Gp / (omega * Cox) < 0.05 at accumulation.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-02` | **Quasi-Static Displacement Ramp & High-Low Frequency Dit Profiling** | Keysight B1500A with High-Resolution SMU (B1517A) configured for Quasi-Static C-V ramp mode, triax ground guarding, Faraday cage. | 1. Apply linear voltage ramp dV/dt = 20 mV/s from -1.5 V (accumulation) to +1.5 V (strong inversion). 2. Measure quasi-static displacement current Cqs = I / (dV/dt) with active cable leakage subtraction. 3. Align 1 MHz high-frequency Cp curve and quasi-static Cqs curve on identical voltage grids. 4. Compute interface trap density Dit(V) = (Cox / q) * [ (Cqs / (Cox - Cqs)) - (Chf / (Cox - Chf)) ]. | `Extracted midgap interface trap density Dit_midgap <= 3.0E+10 cm^-2*eV^-1; quasi-static displacement current signal-to-noise ratio > 20 dB in depletion; gate leakage current Ig at +/- 1.0 V must remain below 10% of total quasi-static displacement current.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative ESD cleanroom coat, ESD grounding wrist strap with 1 MOhm protective resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with solvent, flush immediately with copious potable water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. In case of vapor inhalation or asphyxiation hazard in confined N2 purge areas, relocate personnel to open ventilated fresh air immediately and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station must operate under minimum 30 air changes per hour cleanroom laminar flow bench with local solvent exhaust extraction (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s) when servicing the chuck.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA lint-free wipes must be deposited into sealed, grounded, fire-rated hazardous solvent waste bins for proper incineration according to industrial cleanroom protocol.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Wafer chuck cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge and pneumatic isolation)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `> 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized gate dots (Al/poly-Si on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide) post-forming gas anneal (400 C H2/N2), free of particulate debris, native oxide re-growth, and moisture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized MOS test structures with verified needle landing scrub marks, free of excessive gate punch-through, stored in dry N2 purged FOUP/desiccator.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure queue time causes uncontrolled atmospheric moisture chemisorption and mobile ionic sodium/potassium contamination, creating artificial flatband shifts (> 100 mV) and spurious interface state peaks that mask true gate oxide interface quality.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> High-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static (QS) dual-sweep C-V data successfully acquired across designated wafer coordinates on 3.5 nm gate oxide structures, enabling quantitative extraction of oxide capacitance (Cox), equivalent oxide thickness (EOT), flatband voltage (Vfb), and interface trap density distribution (Dit) across the silicon bandgap without tunneling breakdown.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CV_DUAL_SWEEP_1MHZ_QS_RAW_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `INTERFACE_TRAP_DENSITY_DIT_EXTRACTION_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `GATE_PROBE_LANDING_OPTICAL_INSPECTION.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from 1 MHz strong accumulation Cox** | `3.5 nm` | +/- 0.2 nm | Quantum-corrected C-V simulator extraction using standard MOS capacitance formulations at -1.8 V bias. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Midgap Interface Trap Density (Dit) from combined HF-QS differential analysis** | `2.5E+10 cm^-2*eV^-1` | <= 5.0E+10 cm^-2*eV^-1 | Castagné-Vapaille high-low frequency differential formulation evaluated at intrinsic Fermi level (Ei). |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Bidirectional 1 MHz High-Frequency Voltage Sweep Hysteresis (Delta-Vfb)** | `10 mV` | <= 25 mV | Difference in flatband voltage between forward (-1.8V to +1.8V) and reverse (+1.8V to -1.8V) 1 MHz sweeps. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All specified MOS capacitor test dots exhibit valid accumulation Cox within 6% of target, midgap Dit does not exceed 5.0E+10 cm^-2*eV^-1 across 9 site wafer map, and no probe-induced physical breakdown is detected under post-measurement optical metrology.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Card Alignment and Open/Short Parasitic Calibration

Document stored in: [sop_moscap_probe_alignment_calibration.md](docs/sop_moscap_probe_alignment_calibration.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Probe Card / Chuck  │
│       Loading        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│       Optical        │
│   Planarization &    │
│      Alignment       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Open Parasitic    │
│     Calibration      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Short Parasitic    │
│     Calibration      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Acceptance      │
│    Verification &    │
│   Dual-Sweep Ready   │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Chuck Loading & Backside Ohmic Grounding**:
   - Secure the P-type (100) silicon wafer (with sputtered Au or Al backside metallization) onto the gold-plated vacuum stage.
   - Draw vacuum lock ($> 75\text{ kPa}$) and verify substrate backside contact resistance is $< 1.0\ \Omega$.
2. **Optical Alignment & Planar Touchdown**:
   - Under microscope optics ($10\times$ to $50\times$), locate the circular Al gate dot array (diameters: $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Align probe needles over the dot center. Lower the probe card until initial contact touch is detected, then apply a precise vertical overdrive of **$35 \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$** (scrubs surface native aluminum oxide without puncturing the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal oxide).
3. **Open Parasitic Calibration (Admittance De-embedding)**:
   - Elevate probe needles exactly **$250\ \mu\text{m}$** above the surface in air; close the dark shield box.
   - Execute open calibration at measurement frequency $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ ($V_{ac} = 15\text{ to }30\text{ mV RMS}$) to measure and null out fixture stray admittance $Y_{open} = G_{open} + j\omega C_{open}$.
4. **Short Parasitic Calibration (Impedance De-embedding)**:
   - Lower probe needles onto the gold/aluminum shorting reference pad with standard $35\ \mu\text{m}$ overdrive.
   - Run short calibration at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ to extract residual series impedance $Z_{short} = R_{short} + j\omega L_{short}$.
   - Store correction factors in the LCR firmware to enable two-port de-embedding:
     $$Z_{DUT} = \frac{Z_{meas} - Z_{short}}{1 - (Z_{meas} - Z_{short})Y_{open}}$$

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Calibration Target Windows & Tolerances:
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░                              │
   Oxide Precision (nm)┤░                              │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
 Contact Overdrive (um)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
Short Residual R (mOhm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   Open Residual C (fF)┤███████                        │
                       │███████                        │
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                        0      20     40      60     80 
```

| Parameter | Unit | Target Specification | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Open Capacitance ($C_{open}$)** | $\text{fF}$ | **$< 20\text{ fF}$** (typical $\le 15\text{ fF}$) | $1.0\text{ MHz}$ open sweep at $250\ \mu\text{m}$ elevation |
| **Residual Short Resistance ($R_{short}$)** | $\text{m}\Omega$ | **$< 100\ \text{m}\Omega$** (typical $\le 80\ \text{m}\Omega$) | $1.0\text{ MHz}$ short test on Au/Al contact pad |
| **Probe Needle Overdrive** | $\mu\text{m}$ | **$35 \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$** | Z-axis encoder micrometer displacement |
| **Accumulation Oxide Precision ($t_{ox}$)** | $\text{nm}$ | **$3.5 \pm 0.1\text{ nm}$** | Extracted from $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Test Structure: Aluminum circular gate dots ($200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter) sputtered on thermally grown gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $25\text{ nm}$) on P-type (100) Si; backside substrate Au/Al ohmic contact.
  - High-Frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) accumulation capacitance saturation $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ resolves physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Failure to perform full vector Open/Short/Load calibration on the triaxial/coaxial cabling and probe card causes parasitic parallel stray capacitance (typically 2-15 pF) and series lead resistance (0.5-3.0 ohms) to dominate the high-frequency 1 MHz C-V signal. For a 200 um diameter circular gate dot with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, theoretical Cox is ~310 pF, meaning an uncalibrated 5 pF stray offset injects an intolerable ~1.6% systematic metrology error directly distorting extracted physical tox and Dit.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static low-frequency C-V extraction via displacement current integration (dQ/dt = I) is exquisitely vulnerable to probe station micro-vibrations, thermal EMF drifts, and sub-picoampere triaxial cable leakage. Open-circuit de-embedding must establish an instrumentation noise floor below 10 fA/V at room temperature; otherwise, the quasi-static inversion capacitance fails to match Cox, producing unphysical negative or divergent Dit distributions near the silicon midgap.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten and beryllium-copper probe tips degrade rapidly via mechanical scrub-wear and surface oxidation during repeated direct landings on thin (100-300 nm) sputtered aluminum gate dots. Sourcing precision BeCu or Au-plated kelvin probe tips with controlled tip radius (10-25 um) is essential to prevent pad punch-through while maintaining repeatable low contact resistance (<0.2 ohms).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration protocols must be fully automated into instrument firmware before the dual-sweep C-V campaign commences. Manual probe alignment and uncalibrated zeroing routines across multiple wafer locations balloon test times by >45 minutes per die and introduce operator variance that invalidates statistical process control (SPC) across the 180nm dry oxidation gate lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Probe over-travel scrubbing punctures through the thin 3.5 nm gate oxide during alignment on the Al gate dot, causing catastrophic gate dielectric pinhole shorting directly to the P-substrate.
1. Uncompensated cable stray inductance and parallel conductance at 1 MHz induce resonance peaking and phase angle distortion, leading to false dissipation factor (D > 0.05) readings in the accumulation regime.
1. Substrate backside vacuum chuck non-planarity or native oxide on backside Al/Au contact creates an uncontrolled parasitic series resistance (>10 ohms) that flattens high-frequency accumulation C-V curves.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-01` | **High-Frequency 1 MHz Open/Short Parasitic Compensation and Residual Stray Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech EPS150 Coaxial/Triaxial Manual Probe Station, Impedance Standard Substrate (ISS) or Open/Short Reference Wafer | 1. Position probe tips 250 um above chuck surface in air and execute instrument OPEN calibration routine across 1 kHz to 5 MHz sweep. 2. Land probe tips onto a gold shorting bar standard with 20 um overdrive; execute SHORT calibration routine across 1 kHz to 5 MHz sweep. 3. Return tips to 250 um open-air position; execute 1 MHz continuous C-G measurement for 60 seconds at V_bias = 0.0 V, measuring residual stray capacitance (C_open) and parallel conductance (G_open). 4. Re-land onto gold shorting bar; measure residual series resistance (R_short) and series inductance (L_short) at 1 MHz. | `Residual C_open <= 20.0 fF, residual G_open <= 10.0 nS, residual R_short <= 0.15 ohms, and residual L_short <= 1.0 nH at 1 MHz. Dissipation factor of open measurement D < 0.001.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-02` | **Quasi-Static Triaxial Leakage Floor and MOSCAP Micro-Scrub Alignment Verification** | Keysight B1500A with B1500A-HR-SMU (High Resolution SMU with 1 fA resolution), Mitutoyo Optical Microscope with 20x/50x long-working-distance objectives, Cascade Microtech 4-point Triaxial Probe Chuck | 1. Set HR-SMU to voltage step mode with stair ramp dV/dt = 50 mV/s from -2.0 V to +2.0 V with probe lifted (open circuit); record baseline leakage current. 2. Use optical microscope to align 15 um radius probe tip concentric to 200 um Al gate dot test structure. 3. Lower Z-axis until visual touch-down occurs; apply exactly 15 um scrub overdrive. 4. Measure DC gate leakage current at V_gate = -0.5 V for 30 seconds to verify intact gate dielectric before AC drive application. | `Open-circuit baseline leakage current magnitude |I_leak| <= 50 fA across [-2.0 V, +2.0 V]; DC gate leakage on 200 um dot at V_gate = -0.5 V must be <= 500 fA (indicating non-ruptured 3.5 nm oxide with zero scrub punch-through).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100/ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ESD-safe), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom gowning with conductive grounding heel straps, Anti-static ESD wrist strap connected to 1 MOhm workstation ground
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush immediately with clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air. Skin contact: Wash affected dermal areas with mild soap and deionized water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow hood (ISO Class 5) maintaining vertical downflow at 0.45 m/s +/- 20%; local solvent exhaust snorkel operating during manual probe tip ultrasonic swab cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA cleanroom swabs and wipe wipes in dedicated flammable hazardous solvent disposal bins; no direct drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA) for probe tip cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade (>= 99.9%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly sputtered circular Aluminum gate dots on 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide with backside ohmic Au/Al metallization; clean, unprobed pads free of native oxidation and moisture adsorption.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated probe-card seated with verified micro-scrub mark (<5% of dot pad area) on MOSCAP test structure ready for immediate 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V acquisition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air leads to native Al2O3 growth on the top gate pad causing erratic contact resistance (>50 ohms), and ambient moisture/hydrocarbon condensation on the pad periphery introducing anomalous surface states that distort the extraction of interface trap density (Dit).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful electrical de-embedding and micro-mechanical alignment of the probe system to the 200 um / 500 um MOSCAP test structures, reducing residual fixture capacitance below 20 fF, contact resistance below 0.15 ohms, and open leakage floor below 50 fA, enabling high-fidelity dual-sweep C-V characterization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MOSCAP_ProbeCard_OpenShort_Deembedding_Report.csv`
- [ ] `Probe_Alignment_ScrubMark_Inspection.tiff`
- [ ] `Calibration_Validation_NoiseFloor_Signoff.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual fixture stray capacitance post 1 MHz OPEN de-embedding across probe cables and tips** | `0.0` | +/- 20.0 fF | Keysight B1520A MFCMU continuous impedance parameter C-G measurement at 1 MHz with tips raised 250 um |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Quasi-static SMU measurement loop open-circuit leakage current across -2.0 V to +2.0 V sweep** | `0.0` | +/- 50.0 fA | Keysight HR-SMU displacement current staircase ramp at 50 mV/s in light-tight triaxial Faraday dark box |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Contact resistance between tungsten/BeCu probe tip and sputtered Al gate dot pad** | `0.10` | <= 0.15 ohms | Four-wire Kelvin DC resistance measurement on calibrated gold short test structure at 15 um scrub overdrive |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions (ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03) verified within numerical tolerance, visual probe scrub witness mark diameter <= 20 um on 200 um Al pad with zero dielectric punch-through, and calibration file successfully loaded into the automated dual-sweep C-V acquisition script.

critics.systems_engineer: Failure to perform full vector Open/Short/Load calibration on the triaxial/coaxial cabling and probe card causes parasitic parallel stray capacitance (typically 2-15 pF) and series lead resistance (0.5-3.0 ohms) to dominate the high-frequency 1 MHz C-V signal. For a 200 um diameter circular gate dot with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, theoretical Cox is ~310 pF, meaning an uncalibrated 5 pF stray offset injects an intolerable ~1.6% systematic metrology error directly distorting extracted physical tox and Dit.
critics.domain_expert: Quasi-static low-frequency C-V extraction via displacement current integration (dQ/dt = I) is exquisitely vulnerable to probe station micro-vibrations, thermal EMF drifts, and sub-picoampere triaxial cable leakage. Open-circuit de-embedding must establish an instrumentation noise floor below 10 fA/V at room temperature; otherwise, the quasi-static inversion capacitance fails to match Cox, producing unphysical negative or divergent Dit distributions near the silicon midgap.
critics.supply_chain: Tungsten and beryllium-copper probe tips degrade rapidly via mechanical scrub-wear and surface oxidation during repeated direct landings on thin (100-300 nm) sputtered aluminum gate dots. Sourcing precision BeCu or Au-plated kelvin probe tips with controlled tip radius (10-25 um) is essential to prevent pad punch-through while maintaining repeatable low contact resistance (<0.2 ohms).
critics.laya_pm: Calibration protocols must be fully automated into instrument firmware before the dual-sweep C-V campaign commences. Manual probe alignment and uncalibrated zeroing routines across multiple wafer locations balloon test times by >45 minutes per die and introduce operator variance that invalidates statistical process control (SPC) across the 180nm dry oxidation gate lot.
critical_failure_modes: Probe over-travel scrubbing punctures through the thin 3.5 nm gate oxide during alignment on the Al gate dot, causing catastrophic gate dielectric pinhole shorting directly to the P-substrate.

Uncompensated cable stray inductance and parallel conductance at 1 MHz induce resonance peaking and phase angle distortion, leading to false dissipation factor (D > 0.05) readings in the accumulation regime.

Substrate backside vacuum chuck non-planarity or native oxide on backside Al/Au contact creates an uncontrolled parasitic series resistance (>10 ohms) that flattens high-frequency accumulation C-V curves.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Manual and Optical Probe Tip Planarization and Contact Alignment

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-PROBE-001`  
**Classification:** Metrology & Electrical Test (MOSCAP / C-V Characterization)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Node  
**Process Step:** Probe Card Tip Planarization, Touchdown, & Contact Alignment for MOSCAP Gate Dielectric ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) Characterization

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Overview

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: Load Wafer & Vacuum Verification   │
│  - Secure 180nm wafer on gold-plated chuck   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Coaxial Optical Focus & Platen Tilt│
│  - Adjust Theta & Roll to align tip plane    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Micro-Z Contact Touchdown Detect   │
│  - Monitor reflective split-image & contact  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 4: Controlled Overdrive & Scrub Check │
│  - Verify scrub mark within pad boundaries   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Substrate Loading & Chuck Conditioning
1. Mount the 180nm wafer (featuring 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide MOSCAP test structures) onto the probe station chuck.
2. Engage chuck vacuum (> 65 kPa differential) and ensure back-side substrate electrical continuity for C-V quasi-static/high-frequency dual sweep grounding.
3. Position the microscope turret over the reference contact pads (pitch $\sim 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ array periphery or MOSCAP test frame).

#### Step 2: Optical Planarity Co-Focusing
1. Focus high-magnification coaxial optics on the MOSCAP aluminum/tungsten probe pad surface.
2. Lower the probe card or manipulator arms until the probe needle tips are within the field of view ($\sim 50\ \mu\text{m}$ above the surface).
3. Observe the vertical clearance of all probe tips simultaneously using optical split-focus or depth-of-field monitoring:
   - Adjust the probe card holder planarization leveling screws (pitch and roll axes) until all tips come into focus within the same optical focal plane.

#### Step 3: Tip Alignment to MOSCAP Pad Target
1. Align probe tips along the $X$-$Y$ axes to center each tip on its respective test pad target.
2. Inspect tip tips for mechanical contamination or tungsten/beryllium-copper wear; perform ceramic abrasive cleaning pad contact if oxidation or residual particulate is detected.

#### Step 4: Touchdown Detection and Overdrive Application
1. Advance the micrometer Z-axis drive slowly toward the pad surface at $< 5\ \mu\text{m/s}$ while monitoring the tip and reflection image convergence.
2. Identify zero-contact touchdown ($Z_0$) upon first mechanical deflection or optical ground contact.
3. Apply standard mechanical overdrive ($Z_{OD} = 25\ \mu\text{m} \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$) to displace the surface native oxide and ensure low series contact resistance without puncturing or cracking the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ thin gate oxide layer.
4. Verify lateral scrub length under optical inspection to confirm stable contact.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Tip Planarity Deviation ($\Delta Z_{tip}$)** | $\le 5$ | Max | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical depth-of-field focal micrometer differential across probe array |
| **Controlled Overdrive Travel ($Z_{OD}$)** | $25$ | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Z-axis digital linear micrometer encoder / stage readout |
| **Contact Scrub Mark Length** | $8$ | $\pm 2$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Calibrated optical microscope graticule / automated image metrology |
| **Gate Oxide Structural Integrity** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry baseline check / zero pre-breakdown leakage |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Dielectric Layer & Gate Oxide Thickness:**  
  - Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
  - Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) metrology precision capability verified at $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (*Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*).
* **Test Structure & Bitline/Transistor Dimensions:**  
  - Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Probe tip planarization across multi-pin MOSCAP test arrays directly dictates parasitic inductances and series contact resistance (Rs). At 3.5 nm physical gate oxide thicknesses, non-planar probe touchdown causes acute contact force non-uniformity; excess force on leading pins punctures the ultra-thin SiO2 dielectric via mechanical shear or localized stress-induced leakage current (SILC), whereas lagging pins exhibit high series resistance that corrupts subsequent 1 MHz C-V accumulation and Dit extraction.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V dual-sweep profiling, manual optical planarization using microscope focal-depth reflection or contact skate marks must limit scrub depth to < 100 nm on aluminum-metallized gate pads. The mechanical scrub mark must maintain uniform contact area without tearing gate pad edges or generating metallic micro-debris that short-circuits adjacent guard rings or creates peripheral leakage paths across scribe lines.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying tungsten or beryllium-copper (BeCu) manual manipulator probe tips with 10–25 µm tip radii requires standardized off-the-shelf catalog sourcing (e.g., standard Signatone or GGB Picoprobe compatible tips). Relying on specialized micro-machined multi-contact wedge cards introduces lead-time risks and custom tooling fees inconsistent with an open-source Gen 1 garage/foundry model; individual triaxial micro-positioners must be favored for procurement flexibility.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Planarization and contact alignment represent high-touch operator steps vulnerable to human variance. Without an automated contact skate metric or a standardized micrometer dial-tick protocol, alignment reproducibility varies significantly across shifts, directly expanding metrology cycle times and risking structural damage to limited-run Gen 1 180nm MOSCAP test dies.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Mechanical puncture of the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide beneath the gate electrode caused by excessive probe overdrive during manual Z-axis approach, inducing irreversible dielectric breakdown.
1. Probe skate-induced metal shearing and peeling of the aluminum/polysilicon pad, creating conductive micro-particulates that bridge the gate pad to surrounding substrate or guard rings.
1. Unequal contact resistance across Kelvin or open/short reference test structures due to tilt misalignment, introducing spurious phase-angle errors in 1 MHz C-V dual-sweep data.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-1-01` | **Optical Microscope Focal Planarity and Contact Skate Measurement** | Stereo optical microscope with 10x-50x long working distance objectives, calibrated ocular reticle (1 um resolution) or digital CCD camera with spatial calibration software, manual 3-axis probe positioners with 10 TPI/differential micrometers. | 1. Lower microscope focus onto the metallization surface and zero the focus stage. 2. Position probe tip 20 um above the target pad in the field of view. 3. Adjust planar tilt using goniometer/theta adjustment until the probe tip and its optical reflection on the polished metal pad converge simultaneously into sharp focus. 4. Slowly lower probe tip in Z-axis until initial visual contact is made (reflection touches tip). 5. Apply an overdrive displacement of exactly 5 um along the Z-micrometer. 6. Measure horizontal skate mark length using the calibrated digital imaging crosshair. | `Total contact scrub skate mark length on the metal pad must be between 3.0 um and 8.0 um across all probe pins. Zero skate marks exceeding 10.0 um. No visible cracking, delamination, or metal pile-up extending outside the pad boundary.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-1-02` | **Probe Contact Resistance Uniformity and Dielectric Integrity Pre-Screen** | Digital Multimeter / Source Measure Unit (SMU) connected via triaxial cabling to probe tips, probe station shielded dark box. | 1. Apply a four-wire Kelvin contact resistance measurement across two adjacent planarized probe tips on shorted aluminum metal test pads using a test current of 1.0 mA. 2. Record contact resistance (Rc). 3. Reposition probes to a 100 um x 100 um MOSCAP capacitor with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. 4. Apply a conservative non-stressing pre-bias of 0.1 V across gate and substrate for 5 seconds. 5. Measure DC leakage current. | `Four-wire probe contact resistance Rc must be <= 1.5 Ohms per pin with pin-to-pin variance <= 0.3 Ohms. Initial pre-bias DC gate leakage current at 0.1 V must not exceed 100 pA/cm^2 (<= 10 pA absolute for 100 um x 100 um capacitor).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100/1000 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe anti-static lab coat, Grounded ESD heel and wrist straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with cleaning solvent (IPA), flush eyes immediately with emergency eyewash water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh air. In case of minor skin contact or sharp probe puncture, wash wound thoroughly with mild soap and clean water, apply sterile dressing, and verify anti-tetanus status.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted in a certified Class 1000 or mini-environment clean hood with localized point-of-use laminar airflow (> 90 FPM face velocity). IPA wipe cleaning performed under local exhaust extraction sniffer.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA-impregnated cleanroom wipes must be disposed of in a dedicated, grounded, self-closing hazardous flammable waste receptacle. Contaminated or damaged tungsten probe needles must be collected in an approved puncture-resistant sharps disposal container.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly fabricated MOSCAP wafers post-aluminum gate pad metallization and 400 deg C forming gas anneal (FGA), clean, dry, free of organic or fluoride residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Planarized and aligned probe tips parked in contact with target MOSCAP test pads within shielded dark box, ready for immediate parasitic de-embedding and 1 MHz dual-sweep C-V acquisition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure queue time causes native aluminum oxide (Al2O3) thickening and airborne moisture/molecular organic contamination on unpassivated test pads, resulting in unstable contact resistance, false Dit extraction artifacts, and erratic high-frequency phase drift.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable manual and optical probe tip planarization and contact alignment achieving uniform, repeatable mechanical contact on MOSCAP test pads without puncturing the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide or introducing spurious contact resistance.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `probe_planarization_alignment_log.csv`
- [ ] `probe_skate_optical_inspection.tiff`
- [ ] `contact_resistance_uniformity_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical probe skate length under 5 um Z-overdrive displacement** | `5.0 um` | +/- 2.5 um | Calibrated optical microscope digital crosshair reticle inspection |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Kelvin probe contact resistance per pin on standard aluminum test pads** | `0.8 Ohms` | +/- 0.4 Ohms | 4-wire DC resistance measurement via source measure unit |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Pre-measurement DC gate dielectric leakage at 0.1 V bias across 3.5 nm SiO2** | `5.0 pA` | <= 10.0 pA absolute | Pre-stress SMU dark-box current integration |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All active probe tips exhibit simultaneous contact with skate marks within 3.0 to 7.5 um, pin-to-pin contact resistance deviation is below 0.3 Ohms, and zero pre-measurement gate oxide breakdown events are recorded across all measured MOSCAP die sites.

ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields
ESD-safe anti-static lab coat
Grounded ESD heel and wrist straps

In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh air. In case of minor skin contact or sharp probe puncture, wash wound thoroughly with mild soap and clean water, apply sterile dressing, and verify anti-tetanus status.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-DEEMBED-001`
**Title:** On-Wafer Open-Short Calibration Standard Sweep and Fixture De-embedding  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology [Metrology] > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction [Metrology] > High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition [Metrology] > MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Card Alignment and Open/Short Parasitic Calibration [Metrology] > On-Wafer Open-Short Calibration Standard Sweep and Fixture De-embedding [Metrology]  
**Technology Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Turnkey Semi-Automated Wafer Prober / Dual LCR & Quasi-Static Fixture De-embedding Module)

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the rigorous protocol for executing on-wafer open and short calibration sweeps to isolate and remove residual cable, probe card tip, and pad parasitics (shunt admittance $Y_{open}$ and series impedance $Z_{short}$) from high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V characterization setups targeting dry gate oxide MOSCAP structures (physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Equipment, Fixtures & Standards
- **Automated Cryogenic/Thermal Prober Station:** Shielded dark box with low-noise triaxial chuck.
- **Impedance / LCR Meter:** Calibrated at 1 MHz HF test frequency with four-terminal pair (4TP) architecture.
- **Quasi-Static / Sub-pA Electrometer:** Low-leakage dual-sweep source-measure unit (SMU).
- **On-Wafer Calibration Structures (Scribe-Line Test Chip):**
  - *Open Standard:* Layout identical to the MOSCAP device under test (DUT) with top metal and probe pad intact, but gate dielectric active area omitted (unconnected open circuit).
  - *Short Standard:* Layout identical to DUT pad layout with probe landing pad metal directly strapped to bottom substrate/well contact metal via tungsten plugs (zero intentional oxide gap).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Physical Alignment & Prober Zeroing (Dark box, chuck temp, optical alignment)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. On-Wafer "Open" Calibration Sweep (G_open, C_open residual admittance sweep)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. On-Wafer "Short" Calibration Sweep (R_short, L_short residual impedance sweep) |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Dual-Network De-embedding & DUT Raw Admittance Correction                      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Probe Card Contact and Environmental Stabilization
1. Place the 180nm process control monitor (PCM) wafer onto the vacuum chuck inside the shielded, light-tight probe station.
2. Set chuck temperature to baseline measurement condition: **$25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** (or qualification temperature point up to **$85^\circ\text{C}$** for leakage evaluation per specification).
3. Align probe card tips with the dedicated scribe-line open/short calibration pads using pattern recognition. Set probe contact skate/overtravel within specified limits.

#### Step 2: On-Wafer Open Standard Sweep Acquisition
1. Land probe tips onto the **Open Calibration Standard** pads.
2. Initiate frequency sweep at $f = 1\text{ MHz}$ and record measured parallel conductance $G_{open}$ and parallel capacitance $C_{open}$.
3. Calculate residual shunt admittance:
   $$Y_{open} = G_{open} + j\omega C_{open}$$
4. Measure quasi-static baseline current across the voltage operating window to ensure open-structure residual leakage is below instrument noise floor.

#### Step 3: On-Wafer Short Standard Sweep Acquisition
1. Step the chuck to the adjacent **Short Calibration Standard** pads.
2. Land probe tips under identical overtravel pressure and skate length as Step 2.
3. Perform measurement at $f = 1\text{ MHz}$ to record series resistance $R_{short}$ and series reactance $\omega L_{short}$.
4. Calculate residual series impedance:
   $$Z_{short} = R_{short} + j\omega L_{short}$$

#### Step 4: Real-Time Fixture De-embedding Transformation
1. Step probe tips to the active 180nm gate dielectric MOSCAP test structure ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide).
2. Measure raw device complex admittance:
   $$Y_{raw} = G_{meas} + j\omega C_{meas}$$
3. Execute standard two-port de-embedding formula to strip out pad/probe parallel shunt and series line parasitics:
   $$Y_{int} = Y_{raw} - Y_{open}$$
   $$Z_{int} = \frac{1}{Y_{int}}$$
   $$Z_{DUT} = Z_{int} - Z_{short}$$
   $$Y_{DUT} = \frac{1}{Z_{DUT}} = G_{DUT} + j\omega C_{DUT}$$
4. Stream de-embedded capacitance $C_{DUT}(V)$ and conductance $G_{DUT}(V)$ directly to the $D_{it}$ extraction workflow.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **High-Frequency Sweep Frequency** | `1.0` | Exact ($\pm 0.1\%$) | $\text{MHz}$ | LCR internal oscillator counter |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Context** | `3.5` | Baseline nominal | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry baseline |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature** | `25.0` (or `85.0`) | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Embedded PT100 chuck sensor |
| **Open Calibration Residual Conductance ($G_{open}$)** | $< 10$ | Max $\le 50$ | $\text{nS}$ | 1 MHz 4TP LCR Meter measurement |

---

### 5. Verified Source Citations
- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Confirms gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) physical thickness target: **$\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness** (grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).
  - Confirms high-temperature qualification regime at **$85^\circ\text{C}$**.
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Confirms thermal/leakage qualification baseline at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** and sub-threshold/junction leakage floor targets.
- **Workflow Hierarchy:** *High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition*  
  - Dictates the test frequency baseline of **$1\text{ MHz}$** for high-frequency MOSCAP de-embedding.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Fixture de-embedding relies on a lumped two-port or single-port open-short calibration approximation. At 1 MHz C-V dual-sweep, residual cable inductance (L_cable ~ 200 nH) and chuck-to-probe stray capacitive coupling (~ 15 pF) introduce significant phase distortion and apparent negative capacitance in accumulation if the open standard pad geometry does not rigorously match the fringing field footprint of the MOSCAP device pads.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static and high-frequency Dit extraction requires precise subtraction of probe pad shunt admittance (Y_pad = G_pad + j*omega*C_pad) and probe needle series resistance (Z_series = R_probe + j*omega*L_probe). For ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide MOSCAPs with high gate capacitance density (~ 9.8 fF/um^2), failing to de-embed contact resistance (R_contact > 500 mOhm) will severely distort the conductance peak (G_p/omega), leading to an overestimation of interface trap density by greater than 30%.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten/beryllium-copper probe tips and gold-plated on-wafer calibration impedance standards degrade after repeated probe touchdowns (> 200 landings). Lead times for micro-machined impedance calibration substrate (ISS) and custom 180nm open-short test coupon reticles exceed 8 to 12 weeks from regional specialty foundries.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration sweep and de-embedding verification must not exceed a 15-minute operational overhead window prior to running 49-point wafer C-V sweeps. Delaying probe calibration runs past the ambient Q-time window risks oxide surface moisture absorption and drift on non-passivated test structures.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Open calibration standard substrate leakage due to airborne moisture condensation, causing an artificially inflated G_open baseline (> 50 pS) and corrupted dissipation factor.
1. Probe tip scrub-induced aluminum metallization smearing on short calibration pads, altering nominal pad series resistance and inducing false negative capacitance artifacts at 1 MHz.
1. Improper chuck ground isolation loop inducing 50/60 Hz mains harmonic coupling into the quasi-static femto-ammeter channel during dual-sweep measurement.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-2-01` | **On-Wafer Open Standard Shunt Admittance Calibration and Residual Capacitance Baseline** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Meter and B1505A/B1530A High-Resolution SMU, Cascade Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with Faraday Cage and Dry Air Purge | 1. Position probe tips above dedicated on-wafer open calibration standard pads (identical layout to MOSCAP pads but with gate oxide and electrode omitted down to field isolation). 2. Lower probe needles with 10 um overdrive to make contact. 3. Configure B1520A for 1 MHz measurement frequency, 30 mV AC oscillation amplitude, medium integration time. 4. Execute a frequency sweep from 1 kHz to 5 MHz at 0 V DC bias. 5. Measure and record open conductance G_open and open capacitance C_open. 6. Lift probes and repeat at 5 separate open standards across center, mid-radius, and edge die. | `C_open at 1 MHz must be <= 120.0 fF with site-to-site standard deviation sigma <= 5.0 fF; shunt conductance G_open must be <= 10.0 pS across all test sites.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-2-02` | **On-Wafer Short Standard Series Impedance De-embedding and Contact Resistance Verification** | Keysight B1500A (B1520A C-V Module and B1500A HRSMU), FormFactor ACP40-GSG Microprobes (or triaxial tungsten probe needles), Cascade Semi-Automated Prober with micrometer positioning | 1. Align probe needles to on-wafer short standard pad structure. 2. Touch down with controlled 12 um skate/overdrive. 3. Perform 4-wire DC resistance measurement using HRSMU sweeping current from -10 mA to +10 mA. 4. Extract series resistance R_short = dV/dI. 5. Switch to B1520A AC impedance mode, apply 30 mV AC signal at 1 MHz, 0 V DC bias, and measure series inductance L_short and series resistance R_series_ac. 6. Compute de-embedded series impedance matrix Z_DUT = Z_raw - Z_short. | `DC series resistance R_short must be <= 1.20 Ohm; AC series resistance at 1 MHz must be <= 1.50 Ohm; residual series inductance L_short must be <= 15.0 nH.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV-blocking side-shield safety glasses, Electrostatic dissipative (ESD) lab coat and ESD heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with sterile eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash immediately with soap and copious cleanroom DI water. Inhalation of nitrogen vapors (asphyxiation risk): Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen or CPR if unconscious; seek immediate emergency medical care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station enclosed within dedicated laminar flow canopy operating at 0.45 m/s face velocity; local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on solvent wipe station providing minimum 100 FPM capture velocity; continuous ambient O2 deficiency monitoring with alarm threshold at 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes must be deposited into dedicated flammable hazardous waste cans lined with conductive, grounded anti-static poly bags. No liquid solvent discharge to cleanroom drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / SLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 5.5 | `99.9995%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered/evaporated Aluminum-Silicon (Al-Si 1%) or Ti/Al gate electrode pads patterned and annealed in forming gas (N2/H2 95%/5% at 425 °C); native oxide-free pad surface post-dilute acid de-ox.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated, de-embedded wafer baseline established; probe contact areas intact with minimal scrub marks (< 15% pad area); dry nitrogen blanketed in sealed FOUP/cassette.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and ambient hydrocarbon adsorption onto bare 3.5 nm oxide peripheral regions shift the baseline surface potential, distorting flatband voltage (Vfb) by > 50 mV and inducing false interface state generation peaks (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verification and generation of complete on-wafer open-short de-embedding calibration correction coefficients across 1 kHz to 5 MHz, validating parasitic pad capacitance subtraction down to sub-10 fF uncertainty for accurate 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOSCAP C-V and Dit profiling.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CAL_OPEN_SHORT_DEEMBED_MATRIX_GEN1.csv`
- [ ] `FIXTURE_PARASITICS_VERIFICATION_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `PROBE_TOUCHDOWN_SCRUB_ANALYSIS.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual de-embedded open capacitance across calibration standard structures** | `115.0 fF` | ± 5.0 fF | Multi-frequency C-V extraction on Keysight B1520A at 1 MHz, 0V DC bias across 5 wafer test dies |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total probe-to-pad contact and fixture series resistance after short de-embedding** | `0.95 Ohm` | + 0.25 / - 0.20 Ohm | Kelvin 4-terminal DC I-V sweep from -10 mA to +10 mA on on-wafer short standard structure |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Apparent dielectric loss tangent (tan delta) of de-embedded open standard baseline** | `0.0010` | <= 0.0025 | Conductance-to-susceptance ratio G/(omega*C) measured at 1 MHz under dry N2 purge |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All five verification die locations satisfy ASSERT-01, ASSERT-02, and ASSERT-03; open-short S-parameter/impedance correction tables successfully loaded and validated in B1500A EasyEXPERT software without negative capacitance or conductance convergence warnings; lead metrology researcher signs off calibration log.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Baseline Stray Capacitance and Residual Lead Inductance Verification

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Init Open/Short     │
│      Calibration       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Measure Baseline    │
│       Stray Open       │
│       Admittance       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Verify Stray      │
│  Capacitance C_stray   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│        Measure         │
│     Short-Circuit      │
│       Impedance        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Extract Residual    │
│    Lead Inductance     │
│  L_res and Resistance  │
│         R_res          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Pass/Fail Acceptance  │
│      Verification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

### 1. Scope & Objectives
This SOP defines the verification protocol for baseline stray capacitance ($C_{\text{stray}}$) and residual lead inductance ($L_{\text{res}}$) across the probe card, triaxial/coaxial cabling, and LCR/impedance analyzer front-end. Accurate de-embedding is strictly required prior to dual-sweep high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V acquisition on 180nm MOSCAP and DRAM storage capacitor test structures, where target cell capacitance is on the order of 25 fF to 30 fF ($C_{\text{min}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$) and bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System & Environmental Stabilization**:
   - Power on the LCR/impedance analyzer, probe station thermal chuck, and shield enclosure.
   - Allow a minimum 45-minute warm-up period to stabilize thermal drift at cleanroom ambient ($21.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$, $< 45\%\text{ RH}$).
   - Set signal frequency to test grid: $f = 100\text{ kHz}$ to $1.0\text{ MHz}$, AC oscillation level $V_{\text{AC}} = 20\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ to $30\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$.

2. **Open Calibration & Stray Capacitance Verification**:
   - Retract probe needles/card vertically $100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $250\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ above the wafer chuck or dedicated calibration substrate (open circuit condition).
   - Execute an open-circuit admittance measurement ($Y_{\text{open}} = G_{\text{open}} + j\omega C_{\text{open}}$).
   - Verify uncompensated stray capacitance ($C_{\text{stray}} = C_{\text{open}}$) across all active signal-to-shield/ground pins.
   - Store open-compensation vectors into the analyzer de-embedding engine.

3. **Short Calibration & Residual Impedance/Inductance Extraction**:
   - Contact probe tips onto a gold calibration standard shorting bar or dedicated test-die short test structure.
   - Apply standard probe overdrive ($25\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $40\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) to guarantee stable contact resistance.
   - Perform a short-circuit impedance sweep ($Z_{\text{short}} = R_{\text{short}} + j\omega L_{\text{short}}$) from $100\text{ kHz}$ to $1.0\text{ MHz}$.
   - Extract residual series lead resistance ($R_{\text{res}} = \text{Re}(Z_{\text{short}})$) and residual lead inductance ($L_{\text{res}} = \frac{\text{Im}(Z_{\text{short}})}{2\pi f}$).
   - Store short-compensation vectors into the measurement instrument.

4. **De-Embedding Verification (Baseline Check)**:
   - Re-measure the open fixture with compensation applied; confirm residual compensated capacitance flattens within baseline noise limits.
   - Re-measure the short fixture with compensation applied; confirm residual series impedance is zeroed within measurement tolerance.
   - Lock calibration profile for subsequent high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V acquisition on 3.5 nm gate oxide MOSCAP test structures.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Evaluation Condition / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Compensated Stray Capacitance ($C_{\text{stray, comp}}$)** | $< 1.0$ (or $< 5.0$ uncompensated raw lead margin relative to $25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$ cell budget) | $\text{fF}$ | Open fixture verification after compensation @ $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Residual Lead Inductance ($L_{\text{res}}$)** | $< 15.0$ | $\text{nH}$ | Short fixture extraction @ $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ across probe card and cable leads |
| **Residual Series Lead Resistance ($R_{\text{res}}$)** | $< 0.50$ | $\Omega$ | Short fixture extraction across contact pin pair |
| **AC Test Frequency Calibration Benchmark** | $1.0$ | $\text{MHz}$ | Measurement stimulus frequency for high-frequency C-V calibration |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Context applied*: Defines the stacked capacitor capacitance budget with a minimum threshold of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell (requiring sub-femtofarad parasitic calibration) and physical transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Context applied*: Confirms cell storage capacitance targets between $25\text{ fF}$ and $30\text{ fF}$ per cell to sustain retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, and establishes the 180nm gate dielectric baseline ($3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide physical thickness grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - *Context applied*: Confirms typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding differential signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$, underscoring the necessity of strict lead parasitic calibration to avoid masking femtofarad-scale capacitive responses.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Parasitic stray capacitance (C_stray) and residual lead inductance (L_lead) within probe card needles, triaxial cabling, and switch matrix paths distort 1 MHz high-frequency MOSCAP impedance vectors. Uncompensated L_lead creates an artificial resonance peaking above 800 kHz that falsely inflates extracted oxide capacitance (C_ox), introducing systematic errors into the extracted 3.5 nm physical thickness and misrepresenting Dit profiles across the bandgap.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 3.5 nm ultra-thin gate oxides, accumulation capacitance reaches ~9.86 fF/um2 (~309.8 pF for a 200 um diameter circular gate pad). An uncalibrated residual fixture stray capacitance above 50 fF or a residual series inductance above 15 nH skews the complex admittance Y = G + j*omega*C by introducing phase angle deviations exceeding 0.05 degrees at 1 MHz, severely corrupting Wheeler/Nicollian conductance and high-low Dit extraction.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom low-leakage ceramic probe cards with beryllium copper (BeCu) or tungsten-rhenium (WRe) needles require dedicated gold-plated impedance calibration substrates (CSR-8 or ISS-005). Lead times for high-frequency low-noise probe assemblies currently extend to 12-16 weeks; failure to maintain physical planarization pins and gold contact surfaces forces costly emergency refurbishments and halts wafer-level lot release.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration and residual lead baseline verification must execute within a strict 15-minute timebox prior to each dual-sweep C-V production run. Failure to establish stable open/short residual baselines causes lot-level aborts, triggering extensive re-probing that induces gate oxide dielectric punch-through on 3.5 nm MOSCAP witness structures.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Open-circuit capacitive overcompensation resulting in negative baseline capacitance extraction across accumulation frequencies (100 kHz - 1 MHz).
1. Short-circuit residual inductance undercompensation inducing high-frequency LC resonance peaking, leading to a severe underestimation of equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) below 3.5 nm physical limits.
1. Probe needle tip oxidation and gold scrub particulate buildup causing contact resistance variance (delta-R_c > 1.5 Ohm), distorting real admittance G_m and corrupting conductance-derived Dit peaks.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-3-01` | **Open-Circuit Residual Stray Capacitance and Admittance Baseline Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Module (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automatic Probe Station with triaxial guarded shielding, and Impedance Standard Substrate (ISS). | 1. Configure B1520A MFCMU in high-frequency C-V mode with oscillator level set to 30 mV RMS, AC frequency set to 1.0 MHz, and integration time set to Medium. 2. Position probe card tips at nominal measurement height (Z = 200 um above substrate surface, zero contact). 3. Execute open-circuit baseline admittance acquisition sweeping frequency from 10 kHz to 1.0 MHz in 25 logarithmic steps with triaxial guards active. 4. Record raw residual stray capacitance (C_open) and parallel conductance (G_open). | `Residual open capacitance C_open must be <= 50.0 fF across all frequencies up to 1.0 MHz; parallel loss conductance G_open must be <= 10.0 nS at 1.0 MHz.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-1-3-02` | **Short-Circuit Residual Lead Inductance and Series Resistance Verification** | Keysight B1500A Analyzer with B1520A MFCMU, Cascade Microtech Microchamber probe station with vibration isolation, and certified Alumina Gold Short Calibration Standard. | 1. Lower probe tips onto certified gold shorting bar with nominal overtravel of 35 um to penetrate surface native films. 2. Configure B1520A MFCMU in Series Z-Theta mode at 1.0 MHz, AC excitation 30 mV RMS. 3. Acquire short-circuit impedance Z_short = R_short + j*omega*L_lead from 100 kHz to 5.0 MHz. 4. Calculate residual lead inductance L_lead = Im(Z_short) / (2 * pi * f) and residual series resistance R_series = Re(Z_short). | `Residual lead inductance L_lead must be <= 20.0 nH at 1.0 MHz; residual loop series resistance R_series must be <= 0.85 Ohm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV/laser and optical safety glasses (ANSI Z87.1), ESD-safe cleanroom frock and conductive footwear grounding straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Flush skin immediately with copious water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated apparel. Inhalation of IPA vapors or N2 asphyxiation risk: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is difficult. Eye contact: Rinse eyes thoroughly with eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station micro-chamber requires continuous localized laminar air flow exhaust (exhaust flow rate 35-50 CFM) during tip wipe solvent procedures; ambient cleanroom nitrogen monitoring equipped with audible O2 deficiency alarm (< 19.5% O2).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked wipe materials in dedicated, grounded, airtight solvent waste receptacles for hazardous volatile organic compound (VOC) incineration; no liquid disposal into municipal drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C4) | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered aluminum gate dots (200, 500, 1000 um) on 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide with backside Au/Al ohmic contact, free of organic residues and moisture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probed witness MOSCAP pads with minimal mechanical scrub mark (< 10% pad area deformation), preserved under purged N2 enclosure.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure limits causes atmospheric moisture absorption and airborne hydrocarbon condensation on unpassivated 3.5 nm gate oxide margins, creating extrinsic surface leakage channels that distort quasi-static C-V recovery and falsely escalate extracted Dit by > 2e10 cm-2*eV-1.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Demonstrated open/short parasitic compensation baseline validation for the B1520A/probe-card system, guaranteeing sub-50 fF stray capacitance and sub-20 nH lead inductance to ensure rigorous 1.0 MHz C-V acquisition on 3.5 nm MOSCAP witness structures.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CAL_OPEN_SHORT_PARASITIC_BASELINE_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `PROBE_CARD_S_PARAMETER_RAW_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `RESIDUAL_INDUCTANCE_STRAY_CAPACITANCE_VERIFICATION_LOG.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum uncompensated fixture stray capacitance C_stray across open terminals at 1.0 MHz** | `35.0 fF` | +/- 15.0 fF | Frequency-swept B1520A MFCMU open-circuit admittance metrology (10 kHz - 1.0 MHz) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum residual probe needle and cable lead inductance L_lead at 1.0 MHz** | `12.5 nH` | +/- 7.5 nH | Contact impedance measurement on certified gold shorting standard in Series Z-Theta mode |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Both ASSERT-01 and ASSERT-02 verified within specified tolerance bands across 3 consecutive open/short measurement cycles; baseline calibration vectors loaded and locked into Keysight B1500A fixture compensation register prior to MOSCAP dual-sweep execution.
