nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 1 MHz High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Measurement Automation

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Probe Card & Chuck   │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Open/Short       │
│      Calibration       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  1 MHz High-Frequency  │
│       C-V Sweep        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Quasi-Static Ramp    │
│       C-V Sweep        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Interface Trap     │
│   Density Extraction   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the automated test execution protocol for dual-sweep Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) metrology—combining 1 MHz High-Frequency (HF) and Quasi-Static (QS) sweeps on test MOS capacitors (MOSCAP) fabricated alongside 180nm dry thermal gate oxides ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) for the DRAM access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$). The automated routine extracts interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$) and equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) without inducing soft dielectric breakdown.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Power on the automated wafer prober, precision LCR meter (1 MHz capable), and electrometer/picoammeter unit.
   - Set the thermal vacuum chuck to $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for retention qualification).
   - Ensure triaxial cable shields are grounded to eliminate parasitic noise.

2. **Fixture Compensation (Open/Short Calibration)**
   - Perform probe-tip open-circuit compensation at $1.0\text{ MHz}$ with probe pins lifted $50\ \mu\text{m}$ above contact pads.
   - Perform short-circuit compensation on a gold/aluminum calibration substrate to zero residual series resistance ($R_s$) and cable inductance ($L$).

3. **Wafer Loading & Pad Alignment**
   - Vacuum-clamp the 180nm process wafer onto the chuck.
   - Perform automated pattern recognition to align tungsten probe tips onto test MOSCAP pads (gate dielectric: dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$, $t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).

4. **1 MHz High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweep Acquisition**
   - Configure the LCR meter in $C_p - G_p$ parallel mode with an AC oscillator amplitude of $v_{\text{ac}} = 15\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$.
   - Apply a dual-directional DC bias sweep:
     - **Forward:** $-2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow +2.0\text{ V}$ in $20\text{ mV}$ steps with an integration delay of $50\text{ ms}$ per point.
     - **Reverse:** $+2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow -2.0\text{ V}$ to capture mobile ionic charge hysteresis ($\Delta V_{\text{fb}}$).
   - Record accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{ox,HF}}$, flatband capacitance $C_{\text{fb}}$, and inversion minimum $C_{\text{min,HF}}$.

5. **Quasi-Static (QS) Linear Ramp C-V Acquisition**
   - Switch matrix connection to the picoammeter/high-impedance electrometer.
   - Configure a linear voltage ramp: ramp rate $\frac{dV}{dt} = 50\text{ mV/s}$ over the range $-2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow +2.0\text{ V}$.
   - Measure displacement current $I_{\text{disp}}(V)$ via:
     $$C_{\text{QS}}(V) = \frac{I_{\text{disp}}(V)}{dV/dt}$$
   - Confirm leakage current does not saturate the electrometer range.

6. **Automated $D_{\text{it}}$ Extraction & Data Archival**
   - Run the high-low frequency interface trap density extraction algorithm (Castagné-Vapaille method):
     $$D_{\text{it}}(V) = \frac{C_{\text{ox}}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{\text{QS}}}{C_{\text{ox}} - C_{\text{QS}}} - \frac{C_{\text{HF}}}{C_{\text{ox}} - C_{\text{HF}}} \right)$$
   - Calculate physical oxide thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$ / EOT) from strong accumulation capacitance ($C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot A}{t_{\text{ox}}}$).
   - Export CSV curves and metric summaries to the yield metrology server.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Condition / Method | Lower Limit | Nominal Target | Upper Limit | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | Strong accumulation capacitance ($V_g = -2.0\text{ V}$) | $3.3$ | $3.5$ | $3.7$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | HF C-V accumulation model extraction | $3.0$ | $3.5$ | $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$ at midgap)** | Dual-sweep High-Low extraction ($f_{\text{HF}} = 1\text{ MHz}$) | — | $< 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $1.0 \times 10^{11}$ | $\text{eV}^{-1}\cdot\text{cm}^{-2}$ |
| **High-Frequency C-V Hysteresis ($\Delta V_{\text{fb}}$)** | Forward vs. reverse sweep difference at flatband | — | $< 10$ | $25$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 4. Context & Literature Citations
- **Dielectric & Thickness Specifications**: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation targeting $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness with EOT around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
- **Access Transistor Constraints**: Target access transistor dimensions of channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ on 180nm process flow (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
- **Leakage & Retention Requirements**: Refresh interval qualification requires sub-threshold and junction leakage below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with capacitor retention budget $> 64\text{ ms}$ (*Sources: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automation software coordinating the 1 MHz LCR meter (Keysight E4980A / HP 4284A) and Quasi-Static electrometer (Keithley 6517B) via GPIB/VISA must enforce strict settle times and triaxial cable shielding to suppress parasitic stray capacitance (<0.05 pF) and ground-loop noise across the shielded probe station chuck.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static ramp rates must be constrained between 10 mV/s and 50 mV/s to avoid non-equilibrium deep depletion while maintaining displacement current well above the picoampere leakage floor. High-frequency dual sweep (inversion to accumulation and reverse) must precisely align with quasi-static curves to enable accurate Castagné-Vapaille Dit extraction across the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide without false interface state peaks caused by quantum mechanical tunneling leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires sourcing gold-plated or tungsten low-leakage probe tips (radius 5-10 um), low-noise triaxial cables (Keysight 16048A or Keithley 7078-TRX), and calibration open/short/load verification standards compatible with local supply constraints in Vietnam.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated data parsing scripts must output standardized CSV and schema-compliant HDF5 files to feed downstream statistical process control (SPC) dashboards within the 4-hour post-metallization queue window to prevent gate oxide lot holds.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tunneling current leakage through 3.5 nm ultra-thin dry oxide masking the true quasi-static displacement current, leading to divergent Dit extraction.
1. Excessive mechanical probe scrub damaging the thin aluminum/polysilicon MOS dot gate electrode, causing localized short circuits or unstable contact resistance.
1. Parasitic cable and probe-to-chuck stray capacitance exceeding calibration limits due to uncompensated coaxial/triaxial cable movement during stage indexing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-01` | **High-Frequency 1 MHz Dual-Sweep C-V Hysteresis and Flatband Voltage Verification** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (1 MHz, 15 mV RMS AC oscillation), FormFactor Summit Shielded Semi-Automatic Probe Station with triaxial Kelvin feedthroughs, dark Faraday cage. | 1. Move probe to MOS capacitor dot; lower tungsten probe tip with contact force < 10 g. 2. Enclose dark box and purge chuck cavity with dry N2. 3. Configure DC bias sweep from -2.5 V (inversion) to +2.0 V (accumulation) at 50 mV steps with 200 ms dwell time. 4. Record forward C-V curve at 1 MHz. 5. Immediately reverse bias sweep from +2.0 V back to -2.5 V and record reverse C-V curve. 6. Extract Cox, Vfb (flatband voltage), and delta-Vfb hysteresis. | `Accumulation capacitance Cox must match 9.87 nF (+/- 5%) for 100 um dot (EOT = 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm); bidirectional hysteresis delta-Vfb <= 15 mV.` |

- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Wash thoroughly with deionized water and soap for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: Flush with sterile saline eye wash for 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation. nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: Kelvin Four-Point Probe Station and LCR/SMU Instrumentation Interconnect Calibration
- **Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > Gate Dielectric & C-V Metrology Pipeline
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node
- **Action Type**: Make / Calibration SOP

---

## 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Kelvin Interconnect  │
│         Setup         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cable Length Delay   │
│     Compensation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Open De-embedding   │
│     Stray G and C     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Short De-embedding   │
│   Residual R and L    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Load Reference     │
│      Calibration      │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Calibration      │
│    Validation Pass    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Calibration Procedure

### Step 1: Physical Interconnect & Shielding Setup
1. Route triaxial and low-noise coaxial cables from the precision LCR meter / SMU (Force High, Sense High, Sense Low, Force Low) to the shielded analytical probe station.
2. Terminate the outer shields to the common instrument guard ground; ensure probe station dark box/Faraday cage enclosure is secured with continuous grounding.
3. Align micro-positioner probe arms equipped with Kelvin-sensing tungsten probe tips over the calibration substrate (ISS / gold-plated standard).

### Step 2: Cable Length & Phase Delay Compensation
1. Configure instrument cable length setting on the LCR meter (select exact electrical length: `1.0 m` or `2.0 m` based on physical harness).
2. Execute phase offset compensation across the target test spectrum (including 1 kHz to 1 MHz test frequencies).

### Step 3: Open-Circuit De-embedding (Stray Admittance Cancellation)
1. Lift all 4 probe tips to a separation of $100\ \mu\text{m}$ above the substrate surface in air (or over non-conductive open calibration pads).
2. Execute the instrument **Open Calibration** routine over the frequency span ($1\ \text{kHz}$ to $1\ \text{MHz}$).
3. The instrument measures and nulls residual parallel stray conductance ($G_o$) and stray capacitance ($C_o$).

### Step 4: Short-Circuit De-embedding (Residual Impedance Cancellation)
1. Lower Force and Sense probe tips onto a common gold shorting pad on the calibration substrate.
2. Execute the instrument **Short Calibration** routine across the frequency sweep.
3. The instrument measures and zeroes series residual lead resistance ($R_s$) and parasitic inductance ($L_s$).

### Step 5: Load Standard Verification & Leakage Floor Baseline
1. Place probe tips across a certified reference calibration standard ($50.0\ \Omega$ load standard or precision low-loss capacitor).
2. Verify that high-frequency series resistance ($R$) and capacitance ($C$) match certified values within specification limits.
3. Perform quasi-static DC leakage zeroing to establish the triaxial noise and leakage baseline prior to wafer C-V sweeps.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Open Stray Capacitance ($C_o$)** | $\le 10$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | LCR Open Measurement at $1\ \text{MHz}$ post-compensation |
| **Residual Short Lead Resistance ($R_s$)** | $\le 50$ | $\text{m}\Omega$ (milliohms) | Kelvin 4-point Short Measurement on gold standard |
| **DC Noise & Leakage Current Floor** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA}$ (femtoamperes) | Triaxial SMU zero-bias current acquisition at $25^\circ\text{C}$ / shielded dark box |
| **Impedance Phase Error at High Frequency** | $\pm 0.05$ | ${^\circ}$ (degrees) | Verification against $50.0\ \Omega$ standard at $1\ \text{MHz}$ |

---

## 4. Context & Source Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric Integration & Thickness Context**:
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - C-V metrology operates on dry gate oxide with physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ (thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$). Precise open/short calibration eliminates cabling parasitics so interface trap density ($D_{it}$) and thin-oxide accumulation capacitance are accurately measured without series resistance attenuation.
2. **Capacitance Resolution Constraints**:
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
   - DRAM cell capacitance target budget is $\ge 28\ \text{fF}$ (with subthreshold and junction leakage target $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$). De-embedding stray capacitance below $10\ \text{fF}$ and noise floor below $1\ \text{fA}$ ensures probe interconnects do not swamp cell-scale and micro-dielectric features.
3. **Signal Calibration Scale Context**:
   - *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
   - Sensing dynamics evaluate cell charge across $C_s \approx 25\ \text{fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} \approx 250\ \text{fF}$, confirming the critical need for femtofarad-accurate interconnect calibration during metrology extraction.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Triaxial cabling, Kelvin sense junctions, and LCR/SMU switch matrices present residual parasitic capacitance (>1.5 pF/m) and cable series inductance that distort 1 MHz C-V dual-sweep curves and quasi-static displacement current. Open/Short/Load calibration at the wafer probe tips is mandatory to de-embed fixturing parasitics down to the sub-femtofarad regime.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating Kelvin four-point tungsten carbide probe contacts directly against thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide risks mechanical punch-through and micro-cracking under >100 g tip loading. Sheet resistance and substrate contact potential calibration must distinguish between back-surface chuck ohmic contact resistance (<0.5 Ohm) and top-gate probe contact resistance without degrading the ultra-thin dielectric.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of specialized radius 50-100 um tungsten carbide four-point probe heads (spacing s = 1.0 mm) and high-purity gold/indium wafer chuck contact foils depends on niche metrology vendors with 12 to 16 week lead times. Secondary qualified suppliers for triaxial Low-Noise cables (Keithley/Keysight compatible) are required to avoid single-point line stoppages.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Interconnect calibration milestones gate the downstream C-V oxide thickness and interface trap density (Dit) characterization. Delay in establishing automated cable nulling and contact verification will stall thermal gate oxidation qualification for Gen 1 180nm DRAM prototypes.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip radius wear or contamination leading to contact resistance fluctuations >5% and local surface punch-through of 3.5 nm oxide
1. Inadequate open/short compensation yielding >50 fF residual offset capacitance, invalidating 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance extraction
1. Triboelectric and dielectric absorption noise in non-low-noise triaxial lines corrupting low-leakage quasi-static pA current sweeps

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-1-01` | **Kelvin 4-Point Probe Open/Short Residual Compensation and Contact Resistance Verification** | Semi-automated Kelvin Four-Point Probe Station, Keysight B1500A / Keithley 4200A-SCS SMU with High-Resolution Triaxial Fixtures, NIST-traceable calibrated standard resistor substrate (10.00 Ohm) | 1. Position probe tips in open air (lifted >5 mm above chuck) and execute Open Compensation calibration on SMU/LCR across 1 kHz - 1 MHz. 2. Contact tips to NIST gold-plated shorting block with 60 g probe loading force and execute Short Compensation. 3. Engage 4-point probe tips onto NIST 10.00 Ohm reference standard using collinear geometry (spacing s = 1.0 mm). 4. Force DC current I = 1.000 mA between outer tips (1 and 4) and measure floating differential potential V between inner tips (2 and 3). 5. Compute measured resistance R = V / I and sheet resistance R_s = 4.5324 * (V / I). | `Open residual admittance < 100 nS, short residual series resistance < 0.05 Ohm, and measured NIST reference resistance error <= +/- 0.20% (9.980 Ohm <= R <= 10.020 Ohm).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-1-02` | **1 MHz High-Frequency LCR Interconnect Residual Parasitic Capacitance Nulling Verification** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (or 4200A-CVU), Low-Noise Triaxial Interconnect Assembly, 1.000 pF NIST-Traceable Standard Ceramic Capacitor Fixture | 1. Connect high-force/high-sense and low-force/low-sense triaxial cables to probe station manipulator head. 2. Perform open-circuit nulling sweep from 10 kHz to 1 MHz at probe tips elevated above chuck. 3. Connect 1.000 pF calibrated standard capacitor across Kelvin high and low terminals. 4. Acquire 1 MHz C-V dual-sweep baseline at 30 mV RMS test signal with 0 V DC bias. 5. Record equivalent parallel capacitance (Cp) and dissipation factor (D). | `Residual open capacitance at 1 MHz < 15 fF after nulling; standard capacitor measurement Cp = 1.000 pF +/- 0.005 pF (error <= +/- 0.50%) with dissipation factor D < 0.001.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D6319), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Class 100 cleanroom gown, bouffant cap, and conductive ESD heel straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA, rinse thoroughly with copious deionized water for 15 minutes. In case of eye contact, irrigate eye at emergency eye wash station for 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation. For tip mechanical puncture, wash puncture area with sterile saline and apply antiseptic bandage.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar airflow bench (ISO Class 5 / Class 100) with local solvent extraction exhaust (>50 FPM face velocity) for probe tip cleaning wipes.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free wipes in dedicated sealed flammable solvent waste receptacles per RCRA regulations. No liquid chemical effluent discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C4) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide on 180nm wafer, particle count < 0.05/cm^2 at 0.18 um, free of organic film residues
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated probe stage ready for C-V acquisition; wafer surface contact sites intact without micro-fracture or metal smear
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption and native moisture/hydrocarbon uptake shifting oxide flatband voltage Vfb by >40 mV and distorting Dit extraction by >2e10 cm^-2*eV^-1.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full Kelvin 4-point probe and LCR/SMU interconnect calibration completed, achieving verified residual open parasitic capacitance < 15 fF at 1 MHz, short contact resistance < 50 mOhm, and measurement error <= 0.20% against NIST-traceable standards, establishing a validated test bench for 180nm 3.5 nm gate oxide C-V dual-sweep metrology.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CAL_REPORT_TC_DEAL_GROVE_DRY_OX_3_3_2_2_1_INTERCONNECT.pdf`
- [ ] `DEEMBEDDING_PARASITIC_CALIBRATION_COEFFICIENTS.csv`
- [ ] `NIST_REFERENCE_STANDARD_VERIFICATION_LOG.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual open-circuit fixture parasitic capacitance at 1 MHz test frequency** | `10.0 fF` | <= 15.0 fF | Frequency-swept LCR impedance nulling acquisition with probe tips suspended 5 mm above chuck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Kelvin 4-point probe measurement accuracy on NIST 10.00 Ohm standard** | `10.000 Ohm` | +/- 0.020 Ohm | 4-wire DC current reversal technique (I = +/- 1.000 mA) with SMU voltage sense |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Both quantitative assertions verified across three consecutive trials, residual calibration coefficients updated in test automation executive, and formal signoff by Lead Metrology Researcher and Systems Integration Engineer.

testcases.instrumentation: Semi-automated Kelvin Four-Point Probe Station, Keysight B1500A / Keithley 4200A-SCS SMU with High-Resolution Triaxial Fixtures, NIST-traceable calibrated standard resistor substrate (10.00 Ohm)
testcases.pre_conditions: Probe station enclosed in light-tight Faraday cage at 22.0 +/- 0.5 deg C and RH < 45%. Probe tips cleaned with anhydrous isopropyl alcohol. Chuck grounded.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position probe tips in open air (lifted >5 mm above chuck) and execute Open Compensation calibration on SMU/LCR across 1 kHz - 1 MHz. 2. Contact tips to NIST gold-plated shorting block with 60 g probe loading force and execute Short Compensation. 3. Engage 4-point probe tips onto NIST 10.00 Ohm reference standard using collinear geometry (spacing s = 1.0 mm). 4. Force DC current I = 1.000 mA between outer tips (1 and 4) and measure floating differential potential V between inner tips (2 and 3). 5. Compute measured resistance R = V / I and sheet resistance R_s = 4.5324 * (V / I).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Open residual admittance < 100 nS, short residual series resistance < 0.05 Ohm, and measured NIST reference resistance error <= +/- 0.20% (9.980 Ohm <= R <= 10.020 Ohm).

testcases.title: 1 MHz High-Frequency LCR Interconnect Residual Parasitic Capacitance Nulling Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (or 4200A-CVU), Low-Noise Triaxial Interconnect Assembly, 1.000 pF NIST-Traceable Standard Ceramic Capacitor Fixture
testcases.pre_conditions: Instrumentation powered on and warmed up for >= 60 minutes. Cable shield guards properly bonded to Faraday enclosure chassis.
testcases.procedure: 1. Connect high-force/high-sense and low-force/low-sense triaxial cables to probe station manipulator head. 2. Perform open-circuit nulling sweep from 10 kHz to 1 MHz at probe tips elevated above chuck. 3. Connect 1.000 pF calibrated standard capacitor across Kelvin high and low terminals. 4. Acquire 1 MHz C-V dual-sweep baseline at 30 mV RMS test signal with 0 V DC bias. 5. Record equivalent parallel capacitance (Cp) and dissipation factor (D).

ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: 1 MHz High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep PyVISA Automation Script Development
- **Process Line**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)
- **Hierarchy**: Thermal Processing (180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth ~3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & C-V Metrology > Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Metrology > Dual-Sweep PyVISA Automation
- **Action Type**: Make

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Init PyVISA Session  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Configure 1 MHz HF   │
│          C-V          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│        Execute        │
│  High-Frequency Dual  │
│         Sweep         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Configure       │
│     Quasi-Static      │
│   Electrometer Ramp   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Execute QS Ramp    │
│         Sweep         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Extract Dit and    │
│  Validate EOT 3.5 nm  │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **PyVISA Environment & Instrument Initialization**:
   - Establish VISA communications over GPIB/TCPIP via `pyvisa.ResourceManager('@py')` interfacing with the LCR meter (e.g., Keysight E4980A/HP 4284A) and the Quasi-Static Electrometer/SMU (e.g., Keithley 6517B / 4200-SCS).
   - Send `*RST` and `*CLS` SCPI commands to place both instruments into known reset states.

2. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) Dual-Sweep Configuration**:
   - Program the LCR meter to AC frequency $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ with an AC oscillator amplitude of $V_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$ (to maintain small-signal linearity across the thin oxide).
   - Define a dual staircase sweep across gate bias $V_G$:
     - Forward Sweep: $-2.5\text{ V} \rightarrow +2.5\text{ V}$ with step size $\Delta V = 50\text{ mV}$, hold time $t_\text{hold} = 1.0\text{ s}$, delay $t_\text{delay} = 100\text{ ms}$.
     - Reverse Sweep: $+2.5\text{ V} \rightarrow -2.5\text{ V}$ with matching step parameters to detect mobile ion or charge trapping hysteresis.
   - Configure instrument measurement mode to parallel capacitance–conductance ($C_p - G_p$).

3. **High-Frequency Dual-Sweep Acquisition & Cabling Correction**:
   - Execute open/short calibration (`CORR:OPEN`, `CORR:SHOR`) at 1 MHz using the automated switching matrix to zero out probe parasitic capacitance ($C_{cable} \ll 1\text{ pF}$).
   - Trigger the dual-sweep sequence via SCPI `:INIT:CONT` and query array buffer (`:FETC?`), buffering $V_G$, $C_{HF}$, and $G_p$.

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) Linear Ramp Acquisition**:
   - Switch matrix connection to electrometer/high-precision picoammeter.
   - Configure linear voltage ramp mode with slew rate $\frac{dV}{dt} = 20\text{ mV/s}$ to maintain thermal equilibrium without deep depletion displacement current artifacts.
   - Measure quasi-static displacement current:
     $$I_{QS}(V) = C_{QS}(V) \cdot \frac{dV}{dt}$$
   - Derive quasi-static capacitance:
     $$C_{QS}(V) = \frac{I_{QS}(V)}{\frac{dV}{dt}} - I_{leak}(V)$$
     where $I_{leak}(V)$ is the steady-state DC leakage current baseline.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) & Oxide Metric Extraction (Castagné & Vapaille Method)**:
   - Synchronize and interpolate $C_{HF}(V_G)$ and $C_{QS}(V_G)$ curves on an identical bias grid.
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance $C_{ox}$ to verify equivalent oxide thickness:
     $$T_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{SiO2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A_{gate}}{C_{ox}}$$
   - Calculate interface trap density across the depletion/weak inversion regime using:
     $$D_{it}(V) = \frac{C_{ox}}{q \cdot A_{gate}} \left( \frac{C_{QS}/C_{ox}}{1 - C_{QS}/C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{HF}/C_{ox}}{1 - C_{HF}/C_{ox}} \right) = \frac{C_{ox}}{q \cdot A_{gate}} \left( \frac{1}{\frac{C_{ox}}{C_{QS}} - 1} - \frac{1}{\frac{C_{ox}}{C_{HF}} - 1} \right)$$
   - Export CSV report and plot curves inside the automated run folder.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Measurement Technique |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **High-Frequency AC Signal** | $1.0\text{ MHz}$ | $\pm 0.01\text{ MHz}$ ($10\text{ kHz}$ limit) | LCR internal oscillator frequency counter |
| **Quasi-Static Ramp Slew Rate ($\frac{dV}{dt}$)** | $20\text{ mV/s}$ | $\pm 1.0\text{ mV/s}$ | SMU/Electrometer linear ramp monitor |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ ($3.3\text{ nm}$ to $3.7\text{ nm}$) | Extracted from $C_{ox}$ accumulation capacitance |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) at Midgap** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ eV}^{-1}\text{cm}^{-2}$ | Upper ceiling $< 2.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ eV}^{-1}\text{cm}^{-2}$ | High-Frequency / Quasi-Static combined extraction |
| **Dual-Sweep Hysteresis Flatband Shift ($\Delta V_{FB}$)** | $0\text{ mV}$ | $|\Delta V_{FB}| \le 15\text{ mV}$ | Forward vs. reverse sweep $V_{FB}$ delta |

---

## 4. Cited Literature Sources

1. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) dry gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
   - Storage capacitor equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), cell capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage constraints $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Readout charge development $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ and signal margins ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: PyVISA instrumentation bus latency over USB/GPIB (NI-488.2 or Prologix controllers) can introduce unpredictable jitter during high-speed dual-sweep handshakes between the Keysight E4980A LCR meter (1 MHz HF) and Keithley 6517B Electrometer (Quasi-Static displacement current mode). The software architecture must decouple instrument polling into an asynchronous, timestamp-synchronized queue with hardware trigger bus (BNC rear-panel trigger lines) rather than relying on software-timed SCPI commands, which skew quasi-static ramp rates (dV/dt) and distort displacement current I = C * (dV/dt).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on 180nm DRAM test MOS capacitors, quantum mechanical tunneling (direct tunneling leakage) at accumulation biases (-1.5V to -1.8V for p-type Si) heavily corrupts Quasi-Static C-V measurements, manifesting as false Dit peaks or non-closing sweep hysteresis. The PyVISA automation routine must implement leakage current compensation (Ziegler or Castagné-Vapaille method) and verify that the quasi-static ramp rate is maintained within 10-50 mV/s to avoid deep depletion while keeping leakage current below 5% of displacement current across the depletion-to-inversion regime.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standardizing PyVISA drivers exclusively on proprietary National Instruments NI-VISA runtime engines introduces commercial license and operating system lockdown. The PyVISA stack must be built on PyVISA-py backend with open-source libusb and linux-gpib drivers, ensuring drop-in hardware interchangeability across secondary-market GPIB-USB-B adapters, Keysight 4284A/E4980A LCR meters, and Keithley 2450/6517B electrometer alternatives without code refactoring.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The deliverable script must strictly adhere to the Gen 1 modular architecture, integrating automated self-test calibration loops with open/short cable compensation prior to wafer touching. Failure to enforce pre-flight instrument handshakes and automated data formatting into parquet/CSV pipelines creates testing bottlenecks that will delay gate oxide qualification milestones by weeks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Quasi-static displacement current corruption caused by software-induced dV/dt slew rate instability and pyvisa polling timeouts, leading to unphysical negative interface trap density (Dit) calculations near midgap.
1. Direct tunneling leakage saturation across ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide during quasi-static ramp, overwhelming the electrometer front-end and permanently shifting flatband voltage (Vfb) via hot-carrier dielectric trapping.
1. Ground loop interference and triaxial cable shield float between the 1 MHz HF LCR meter and low-noise electrometer, yielding 50/60 Hz line-hum spikes that obscure true accumulation capacitance (Cox).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-2-01` | **Automated 1 MHz High-Frequency C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition and Hysteresis Verification** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (1 MHz, 10-30 mV RMS AC oscillation), FormFactor Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with dark/Faraday box, low-noise triaxial probe arms, IEEE-488.2 GPIB bus with PyVISA controller. | 1. Initialize PyVISA instrument session with 5000 ms timeout and set E4980A to Cp-G measurement mode at f = 1.000 MHz with 25 mV RMS test signal. 2. Configure DC bias staircase dual sweep from -1.800 V (accumulation) to +1.200 V (inversion) and reverse back to -1.800 V with 25 mV step size and 100 ms hold time per step. 3. PyVISA script triggers sweep, records bias (V_dc), equivalent parallel capacitance (Cp), and parallel conductance (Gp) into memory buffer, and queries error register (:SYST:ERR?). 4. Compute maximum accumulation capacitance Cox and extract flatband voltage shift (Delta_Vfb = |Vfb_forward - Vfb_reverse|). | `Max accumulation capacitance Cp at -1.8 V must correspond to physical oxide thickness tox = 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm (Cox = 9.87 pF +/- 0.6 pF for 100x100 um pad); dual-sweep flatband voltage hysteresis Delta_Vfb must be <= 15 mV; instrument error register returns 0, 'No error'.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-2-02` | **Quasi-Static Displacement Current Dual-Sweep and High-Low Dit Extraction Verification** | Keithley 6517B High-Resistance Electrometer / Source Meter, Keysight E4980A LCR Meter, BNC switching matrix with triaxial guard routing, controlled via Python/PyVISA automated pipeline. | 1. PyVISA script commands Keithley 6517B to linear ramp mode with linear dV/dt = 20.0 mV/s from -1.500 V to +1.000 V and back to -1.500 V. 2. Measure displacement current I_qs with 10 fA resolution, calculating C_qs = I_qs / (dV/dt) while continuously subtracting gate leakage offset I_leak. 3. Merge 1 MHz HF capacitance C_hf(V) and Quasi-Static C_qs(V) curves onto matched potential grid. 4. Compute interface trap capacitance Cit(V) = (1/C_qs - 1/Cox)^(-1) - (1/C_hf - 1/Cox)^(-1) and derive Dit(E) = Cit / (q * A) across the silicon bandgap from midgap to Ec - 0.2 eV. | `Quasi-static sweep closed-loop ramp linearity R^2 >= 0.9998; background leakage current I_leak <= 100 fA at 0 V; extracted midgap interface trap density Dit <= 3.0E+10 cm^-2 * eV^-1 with no unphysical negative Dit values across the depletion region.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100 compatible, powder-free, minimum 6 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative ESD lab coat (surface resistivity 10^6 - 10^9 ohms/sq), ESD grounding wrist strap with 1 megohm series safety resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of tempered water at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation. Skin contact: Wash affected skin thoroughly with mild soap and water. Inhalation of inert N2: Move victim immediately to fresh air; if breathing is labored or unconscious, administer oxygen or artificial respiration by trained personnel; call emergency response immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station dark enclosure must be purged with dry N2 at 2-5 SLPM with continuous ambient room exhaust maintaining minimum 10-15 room air changes per hour (ACH); room O2 deficiency monitor must be active with acoustic alarm threshold set at 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes used for chuck or probe tip de-metallization cleaning must be collected in closed, dedicated, flame-resistant stainless steel solvent disposal cans and transferred to hazardous solvent waste stream according to local environmental regulations; no liquid solvent disposal down standard drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade (>= 99.9%) | `100%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2 gas purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized MOS capacitor pads (Al or TiN top dot electrodes on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide) following post-metal anneal (forming gas anneal 400C, 10% H2 / 90% N2), pristine and un-probed with surface hydrocarbon contact angle < 15 deg.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized MOS capacitor test die with calibrated probe mark witness marks (scrub diameter <= 15 um), stored in desiccated vacuum purge box ready for dicing or transistor parametric validation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes ambient airborne moisture and organosiloxane adsorption onto top dot oxide boundaries, inducing spurious surface leakage paths and mobile ion drift (Na+/K+) that artificially inflate measured Dit by > 1.5E+11 cm^-2 * eV^-1 and shift flatband voltage by > 50 mV.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivered and verified high-performance Python/PyVISA automated dual-sweep metrology package executing simultaneous 1 MHz HF C-V and quasi-static C-V on 3.5 nm gate oxide MOS structures. The package features hardware-synchronized instrument handshakes, automated open/short fixture de-embedding, Ziegler leakage compensation, and mathematically rigorous extraction of flatband voltage, oxide thickness, and interface state density (Dit) across the silicon bandgap.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `cv_dual_sweep_automation.py`
- [ ] `TC_DEAL_GROVE_DRY_OX_3_3_2_2_2_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `moscap_1mhz_qs_processed_dit_data.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **PyVISA automated instrument acquisition execution time and jitter for a 120-point dual-sweep high-frequency curve** | `18.5 s` | +/- 1.5 s | High-resolution monotonic timer logging during end-to-end PyVISA SCPI acquisition loop on Keysight E4980A. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Extracted physical gate oxide thickness (tox_phys) from 1 MHz HF accumulation capacitance after quantum correction** | `3.50 nm` | +/- 0.15 nm | Comparison of PyVISA C-V extracted tox against multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry reference on adjacent wafer monitor dot. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Interface trap density (Dit) extracted at silicon midgap (E - Ev = 0.56 eV) under dark ambient** | `2.5E+10 cm^-2 * eV^-1` | <= 3.0E+10 cm^-2 * eV^-1 | High-low C-V Castagné-Vapaille analysis script calculation verified across 5 site-replicate MOS capacitors on test coupon. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> The PyVISA automation script completes 5 consecutive automated dual-sweep cycles on 100 um x 100 um test capacitors without VISA communication timeout or hardware bus errors, extracts tox within 3.5 nm +/- 0.15 nm and midgap Dit <= 3.0E+10 cm^-2 * eV^-1, generates complete CSV raw/processed datasets along with calibrated PDF graphics, and receives formal verification signoff from both Lead Metrology Engineer and Thermal Processing Specialist.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-MOSCAP-001`
**Title:** MOS Capacitor Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) and Flat-Band Voltage ($V_{fb}$) Extraction Verification  
**Module:** Metrology & Characterization  
**Node/Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Parent Process:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)  

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Load MOSCAP Wafer   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Dual-Sweep C-V: 1   │
│       MHz HF &        │
│     Quasi-Static      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Extract Flat-Band   │
│   Capacitance Cfb &   │
│          Vfb          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Compute Interface   │
│  Trap Density Dit(E)  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Acceptance Criteria  │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Structure Loading & Shielding**:
   - Transfer the 180nm test coupon/wafer featuring test MOS capacitor structures (matching the access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric target $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) onto the temperature-controlled probe station chuck.
   - Enclose the probe station in a light-tight, electrically shielded Faraday dark box. Ensure chuck temperature stabilizes at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (with secondary qualification at $85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for DRAM retention environment characterization).

2. **Instrument Zeroing and Cable Compensation**:
   - Connect the High-Frequency (HF) LCR meter (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static (QS) electrometer via low-noise triaxial cabling.
   - Execute open-circuit and short-circuit capacitance/conductance compensation routines at 1 MHz test frequency to null stray parasitic capacitance down to $< 10\text{ fF}$.

3. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) Dual-Sweep Measurement**:
   - Apply a small AC oscillation signal ($v_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}$ to $25\text{ mV}_\text{rms}$ at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$).
   - Sweep the DC gate bias $V_G$ from accumulation (e.g., $-2.0\text{ V}$) through depletion to strong inversion (e.g., $+2.0\text{ V}$) and back to accumulation at a slew rate of $50\text{ mV/s}$. Record $C_{HF}(V_G)$.

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) Low-Frequency C-V Acquisition**:
   - Initialize the QS electrometer in slow-ramp mode ($dV/dt = 10\text{ mV/s}$ to $20\text{ mV/s}$) with integration delay to allow equilibrium inversion layer generation.
   - Measure the displacement current $I(V_G)$ to calculate low-frequency capacitance $C_{LF} = I / (dV/dt)$.

5. **Flat-Band Voltage ($V_{fb}$) Extraction**:
   - Determine maximum accumulation oxide capacitance $C_{ox}$ from strong accumulation HF data.
   - Compute the flat-band capacitance $C_{fb}$ using the Debye length formulation:
     $$C_{fb} = \frac{C_{ox} \cdot \frac{\varepsilon_{Si}}{L_D}}{C_{ox} + \frac{\varepsilon_{Si}}{L_D}}$$
   - Locate $V_{fb}$ on the $C_{HF}(V_G)$ curve corresponding to $C_{fb}$. Calculate hysteresis $\Delta V_{fb} = |V_{fb,\text{forward}} - V_{fb,\text{reverse}}|$.

6. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction (High-Low C-V Method)**:
   - Calculate interface trap capacitance $C_{it}(V_G)$ across the bandgap:
     $$C_{it}(V_G) = \left( \frac{1}{C_{LF}(V_G)} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}} \right)^{-1} - \left( \frac{1}{C_{HF}(V_G)} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}} \right)^{-1}$$
   - Derive midgap trap density:
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{it}}{q \cdot A}$$
     where $q = 1.602 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}$ and $A$ is the capacitor area.

7. **Data Logging and Automated Pass/Fail Check**:
   - Export extracted parameters ($V_{fb}$, $\Delta V_{fb}$, midgap $D_{it}$, extracted $t_{ox}$) into the fab SPC database.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Target / Threshold | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Accumulation $C_{ox}$ at $1\text{ MHz}$ ($C_{ox} = \varepsilon_{ox} A / t_{ox}$) |
| **Midgap Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ (nominal target $\le 5.0 \times 10^{10}$) | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Combined HF (1 MHz) & Quasi-Static High-Low method |
| **Flat-Band Voltage Hysteresis ($\Delta V_{fb}$)** | $\le 15$ | $\text{mV}$ | Dual-sweep forward-reverse $C_{HF}$ shift at $50\text{ mV/s}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Leakage Current Density ($J_g$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{-7}$ (at $V_G = 1.0\text{ V}$) | $\text{A/cm}^2$ | DC Electrometer current ramp before breakdown |

---

### 4. Citations & Context Traceability

- **180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth & Physical Thickness**:
  - *Context:* "Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness." — Sourced from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.
- **Device Geometry & Channel Baseline**:
  - *Context:* "Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$." — Sourced from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*.
- **Operating Temperature Reference**:
  - *Context:* Target leakage criteria evaluated at $85^\circ\text{C}$ operating condition. — Sourced from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-sweep high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V profiling on ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxides is severely vulnerable to gate tunneling leakage currents, which distort the quasi-static displacement current measurement (I_leak >> I_disp = C * dV/dt). The automated test instrumentation must incorporate series resistance (R_s) correction, parasitic cable de-embedding via open/short calibration at the probe tips, and a ramp-rate compensation algorithm (e.g., 10 mV/s to 50 mV/s) to isolate genuine displacement capacitance from direct Fowler-Nordheim or trap-assisted tunneling backgrounds.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct extraction of Dit using the High-Low frequency method on 3.5 nm oxide faces severe quantum mechanical carrier confinement and polysilicon/metal gate depletion artifacts in strong accumulation, skewing true Cox extraction. Extracting Flatband Voltage (V_fb) strictly via the flatband capacitance (C_fb) method requires precise substrate active doping concentration (N_A) extracted from deep depletion 1/C^2 slopes; otherwise, fixed oxide charge density (Q_f/q) will propagate an error > 30%. In addition, slow state response at 1 MHz can artificially underestimate midgap Dit if conductance profiling (G-w method) is not cross-benchmarked.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Shadow mask-sputtered circular aluminum gate dots (200 um to 1000 um diameter) introduce significant edge-field fringing capacitance and mask-shadow edge tapering if the contact shadow mask is worn, bowed, or poorly clamped against the 150mm/200mm Si wafer. Sourcing precision laser-cut molybdenum or silicon shadow masks and ensuring traceable micro-calibrated optical area metrology for each dot diameter is critical to avoid systematic errors in normalized capacitance per unit area (F/cm^2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-sweep C-V automation at 1 MHz combined with low-noise quasi-static sweeps (< 1 pA measurement floor) represents a major measurement throughput bottleneck across wafer maps (49 sites per wafer taking > 90 minutes). The metrology sequence must implement adaptive voltage steps (coarse steps in accumulation/inversion, fine 10 mV steps across the depletion-to-weak inversion zone) to maintain cycle time within 15 minutes per test coupon while strictly upholding Q-time compliance before environmental moisture intake degrades Dit.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Gate oxide dielectric tunneling leakage exceeding 10 uA/cm^2 under quasi-static voltage bias, corrupting the displacement current and yielding non-physical or negative Dit values across midgap.
1. Moisture and airborne organic contamination adsorption on unpassivated Al dot surfaces causing surface charge accumulation and hysteresis > 150 mV during dual-direction bias sweeps.
1. Backside ohmic contact high series resistance (> 50 ohms) causing artificial high-frequency capacitance roll-off in accumulation, resulting in overestimation of physical oxide thickness (t_ox) and erroneous flatband extraction.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-3-01` | **High-Frequency (1 MHz) Dual-Sweep C-V and Flat-Band Voltage (Vfb) Extraction Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifunction Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with dark/EMI shielding box, Agilent 16494A triaxial cabling, vacuum chuck with Au/In-Ga backside ohmic contact. | 1. Land beryllium-copper probe tip on 500 um Al gate dot with contact resistance < 2 ohms verified. 2. Configure B1520A for 1 MHz test frequency, 15 mV AC oscillation amplitude, medium integration time. 3. Execute dual-sweep gate voltage from accumulation (-2.5 V) through depletion to inversion (+1.5 V) and reverse back to -2.5 V with 25 mV step voltage. 4. Record high-frequency C-V curve, extract maximum accumulation capacitance C_ox, calculate physical oxide thickness t_ox. 5. Extract active substrate doping N_A from 1/C^2 vs V_G slope in depletion. 6. Calculate ideal flatband capacitance C_fb and extract measured V_fb from the HF C-V curve; compute fixed oxide charge Q_f = - (V_fb_meas - V_fb_ideal) * C_ox / Area. 7. Evaluate hysteresis window Delta V_hys between forward and reverse sweeps at V_fb. | `Accumulation capacitance Cox corresponds to physical t_ox = 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm; Fixed oxide charge density |Q_f/q| <= 5.0 x 10^10 cm^-2; Dual-sweep flatband hysteresis Delta V_hys <= 25 mV.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-2-3-02` | **Combined High-Low Frequency (1 MHz / Quasi-Static) Midgap Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction** | Keysight B1500A with B1500A-015 High-Resolution SMU (HRSMU) and B1520A MFCMU, low-noise triaxial probe heads, nitrogen-purged Faraday shielded probe enclosure. | 1. Land triaxial probe tip on 200 um Al circular dot. 2. Acquire high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V curve from -2.0 V to +1.0 V at 20 mV steps. 3. Configure HRSMU for Quasi-Static C-V ramp using linear staircase ramp method with ramp rate dV/dt = 20 mV/s, measuring quasi-static displacement current I_QS to yield C_QS = I_QS / (dV/dt). 4. Interpolate and align HF and QS capacitance curves on identical gate voltage grid. 5. Calculate energy-resolved interface trap density across bandgap using High-Low frequency formula: D_it = (C_ox / q) * [ (C_QS / (C_ox - C_QS)) - (C_HF / (C_ox - C_HF)) ] / Area. 6. Determine midgap potential (phi_s = 0) and extract D_it at midgap. | `Midgap interface trap density Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1; Leakage current baseline I_leak < 5% of displacement current I_disp across the depletion region; Zero negative Dit artifacts throughout bandgap from E_v + 0.2 eV to E_c - 0.2 eV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Anti-static ESD lab coat / cleanroom bunny suit, ESD grounding wrist strap with 1 Mohm safety series resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Remove contaminated gloves, wash skin thoroughly with cleanroom DI water for 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent fumes or N2 asphyxiation hazard: Immediately move affected individual to fresh air outdoor environment, provide oxygen if breathing is labored, and summon emergency medical services. Eye exposure: Flush eyes immediately at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at >= 100 FPM face velocity for solvent wiping operations. Ambient cleanroom air exchange rate >= 60 ACH with continuous O2 depletion sensors (alarm set at <= 19.5% O2) in the N2-purged test enclosure area.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA cleanroom wipes collected in dedicated FM-approved grounded flameproof solvent disposal bins with self-closing lids. Liquid IPA solvent residue drained into designated flammable solvent carboys for hazardous chemical waste reclamation.

| **Compressed Gaseous Nitrogen (Dry N2 Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.5 (99.9995%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized (sputtered Al gate dots and backside ohmic contact) dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) on Si substrate, post-forming gas anneal (FGA: 400 deg C, 10% H2 / 90% N2, 30 min) completed.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested and verified MOSCAP coupon with probe scrub marks <= 5 um diameter on metal dots, dry N2 desiccator packed.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption, ambient airborne molecular contamination (boron, hydrocarbons, Na+ ions), and uncontrolled native oxide growth on exposed metal interfaces cause flatband voltage shifts (|Delta V_fb| > 100 mV) and artifactual increases in interface trap density (Dit exceeding 2.5 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1), invalidating process qualification.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full electrical verification of the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOSCAP test vehicle demonstrating acceptable fixed oxide charge (Qf/q < 5.0e10 cm^-2) and midgap interface trap density (Dit <= 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1) via automated 1 MHz dual-sweep and quasi-static C-V profiling, confirming thermal oxidation gate quality readiness for 180nm open-source DRAM peripheral and array access transistors.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Dual-Sweep C-V Curve Validation, Leakage Compensation, and Data Archival

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology [Metrology] > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction [Metrology] > High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition [Metrology] > Dual-Sweep C-V Curve Validation, Leakage Compensation, and Data Archival [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Oxide Thickness Tox: 3.5 nm (Gate) / 350 nm (Field).
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / C-V Profiler.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-sweep high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V profiling on ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide faces severe direct tunneling leakage current (J_g > 1e-2 A/cm^2 at accumulation). Without algorithmic series resistance (R_s) and shunt conductance (G_p) correction using a 3-element or 5-element circuit model, extraction of oxide capacitance (C_ox) and interface trap density (D_it) will yield unphysical distortions and false hysteresis. Data ingestion pipelines must standardize raw vector formats (bias, raw C, conductance G, leakage I_leak) before running archival scripts to prevent schema drift across metrology clusters.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static ramp rates must be strictly constrained (typically 10-50 mV/s) to ensure displacement current dominates while maintaining quasi-equilibrium without triggering deep depletion or catastrophic soft dielectric breakdown. Dual-sweep hysteresis (inversion-to-accumulation and return) must be quantified at room temperature and under slight thermal excitation to distinguish mobile ionic charge drift (Delta V_fb shift direction) from fast interface trap charging/discharging. Leakage compensation via high-resolution pA/fA ammeters is non-negotiable for 3.5 nm tox.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology probe tips (beryllium copper vs. tungsten-rhenium) and shielded triaxial cabling are subject to finite contact-fatigue lifespans and lead times of 12-16 weeks. Automated probe station chucks require certified low-noise gold-plated platens to ensure backside wafer contact resistance remains below 0.5 ohms. Sourcing calibrated MOS capacitor standard calibration wafers (NIST-traceable 100 pF/10 pF standards) is critical to verify LCR meter phase accuracy at 1 MHz.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-sweep acquisition, compensation, and archival represents a pacing metrology gate between oxidation furnace runs and poly-Si gate patterning. If the automated leakage subtraction code crashes or yields high rerun rates (>5% re-probes), overall module cycle time will breach the 30-minute cleanroom queue time, forcing oxide stripping and refurnacing. Clear automated sign-off criteria and automated JSON/CSV ingestion into the Fab MES must execute in under 90 seconds per test die.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Direct tunneling gate leakage exceeding displacement current limits during quasi-static ramp, corrupting D_it extraction by masking the true minimum capacitance (C_min).
1. Prober micro-scrub punch-through or localized electric field breakdown across the 3.5 nm oxide during repeated dual-sweep voltage excursions (-2.5 V to +2.5 V).
1. Backside chuck contact oxidation or poor ohmic contact causing series resistance R_s > 50 ohms, suppressing accumulation capacitance and skewing flatband voltage (V_fb).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-01` | **Dual-Sweep High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Hysteresis and Series Resistance Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter Module, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Shielded Probe Station, Triaxial Kelvin Probes. | 1. Land triaxial Kelvin probes on gate pad and wafer chuck ground reference with contact force <= 5 grams. 2. Apply 1 MHz AC signal with 15 mV RMS oscillation amplitude. 3. Sweep DC gate voltage from -2.0 V to +2.0 V (forward sweep) at step size of 20 mV and hold time of 50 ms. 4. Immediately sweep DC gate voltage from +2.0 V back to -2.0 V (reverse sweep) at identical step and hold parameters. 5. Acquire impedance vector (capacitance C_m, conductance G_m) at each bias point. 6. Execute automated dual-frequency/conductance series resistance correction algorithm to calculate corrected C_ox and flatband voltage shift (Delta V_fb). | `Accumulation capacitance C_ox must equate to 9.87 fF/um^2 +/- 5% (corresponding to tox = 3.5 nm +/- 0.18 nm); flatband voltage hysteresis |Delta V_fb| must be <= 15 mV across dual sweep; series resistance R_s must be < 25 ohms.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-02` | **Quasi-Static C-V Leakage Current Compensation and Midgap D_it Extraction** | Keysight B1500A with B1500A-HRSMU (High Resolution SMU with 1 fA resolution) or Keithley 4200A-SCS with 4200-PA Remote Preamplifier, Faraday Dark Box. | 1. Contact gate pad and substrate ground via guarded triaxial leads. 2. Apply linear ramp voltage from -1.5 V to +1.5 V at a precise ramp rate dV/dt = 20 mV/s. 3. Measure total gate current I_tot = I_disp + I_leak continuously with sample interval of 25 ms. 4. Measure static DC leakage current I_leak(V) independently using stepped-voltage DC bias mode over the same voltage range. 5. Subtract I_leak from I_tot to obtain true displacement current: I_disp(V) = I_tot(V) - I_leak(V). 6. Compute quasi-static capacitance C_qs(V) = I_disp(V) / (dV/dt). 7. Cross-correlate C_qs(V) with 1 MHz C_hf(V) to extract midgap interface trap density: D_it = (C_ox / q) * [ (C_qs / (C_ox - C_qs)) - (C_hf / (C_ox - C_hf)) ]. 8. Export raw and compensated vectors into archival archive bundle. | `Compensated quasi-static displacement current I_disp must remain positive throughout inversion-to-accumulation transition; extracted midgap interface trap density D_it must be <= 2.5e10 eV^-1 cm^-2; gate leakage current density J_g at V_gate = 1.0 V must not exceed 5.0e-3 A/cm^2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic dissipative (ESD) cleanroom smock and conductive ESD footwear, Face shield when handling chuck cleaning solvents
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Remove contaminated gloves and flush skin with copius deionized water for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: Irrigate eyes at nearest eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation of nitrogen purge causing asphyxiation risk: Immediately move exposed person to fresh air; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing has stopped; summon cleanroom emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Prober chamber and enclosure must operate under laminar downflow cleanroom air with localized low-velocity exhaust (minimum 50 CFM) for solvent vapor clearing during chuck wipe-down; ambient oxygen deficiency monitors installed adjacent to prober with alarm threshold set at 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent-soaked cleanroom wipes must be disposed of in dedicated, grounded, self-closing hazardous flammable waste cans; spent IPA liquid container sealed and routed to the central fab solvent waste drainage collection system.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly grown 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide on Si (100) with sacrificial polysilicon/metal gate test dot electrodes patterned, post-forming-gas annealed (FGA, 400 deg C, 10% H2/90% N2), unpassivated surface free of organic contaminants.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically probed MOS capacitor array with micro-scrub marks verified under optical inspection (< 10% pad area consumed); moisture-free, ready for automated transfer to FOUP and polysilicon gate lithography.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption and airborne organic/siloxane contamination causing uncontrolled flatband voltage shifts (> 50 mV), uncompensated gate dielectric interface degradation, and erroneous D_it extraction exceeding 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful dual-sweep 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V metrology execution across 9 standard wafer sites on 3.5 nm gate oxide structures, verifying low hysteresis, low gate leakage, verified oxide thickness, and low interface state density with all raw and corrected data archived.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `cv_dual_sweep_corrected_waf01.csv`
- [ ] `dit_extraction_leakage_compensated_report.pdf`
- [ ] `wafer_map_hysteresis_and_tox_distribution.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Equivalent oxide physical thickness (EOT) extracted from accumulation capacitance C_ox** | `3.50 nm` | +/- 0.15 nm | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance extraction at V_gate = -2.0 V after quantum-mechanical and series resistance correction |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Dual-sweep flatband voltage hysteresis window |Delta V_fb|** | `8.0 mV` | <= 15.0 mV | Inflection point tracking between forward (-2.0 V to +2.0 V) and reverse (+2.0 V to -2.0 V) 1 MHz C-V sweeps |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Midgap interface trap density (D_it)** | `1.8e10 eV^-1 cm^-2` | <= 2.5e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 | High-low frequency method combining 1 MHz C_hf and leakage-compensated quasi-static C_qs evaluated at midgap potential |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 mapped die sites pass tox, hysteresis, and D_it assertions without dielectric breakdown events (leakage J_g < 5e-3 A/cm^2); compensated dataset successfully committed and checksum-verified in the Fab MES data repository.
