# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-CV-0180-007
**Title**: Dual-Sweep C-V Curve Anomaly Screening and Hysteresis Validation  
**Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction > High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition > Dual-Sweep C-V Curve Validation, Leakage Compensation, and Data Archival > Dual-Sweep C-V Curve Anomaly Screening and Hysteresis Validation  
**Technology Node**: 180nm CMOS DRAM (Gen 2 µm architecture)  
**Process Action**: Make / Metrology & Quality Assurance  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the protocol for screening anomalies, validating bidirectional hysteresis windows ($\Delta V_{FB}$ / $\Delta V_{th}$), detecting mobile ionic contamination ($Q_m$), and qualifying slow border/interface traps ($N_{bt}$) in the 3.5 nm thermally grown dry gate dielectric of access transistors and MOS test structures for the 180nm DRAM process.

---

### 2. Equipment & Test Vehicle Setup
- **Wafer Chuck & Probe Station**: Triaxial-shielded dark box wafer probe station with thermal chuck set to $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (baseline) and $85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (retention qualification test).
- **Instrumentation**: Precision LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer (High-Frequency: 1.0 MHz, small-signal $V_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}_\text{rms}$) coupled with a High-Resolution Source-Measure Unit (SMU) / Electrometer for Quasi-Static acquisition.
- **Test Structures**: 
  - Standard MOS capacitor array ($A = 100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ and $200\,\mu\text{m} \times 200\,\mu\text{m}$) over $p$-type substrate/well.
  - Access transistor channel test arrays ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                    C-V DUAL-SWEEP WORKFLOW                                         |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  [Step 1: Calibration] ---> [Step 2: Dual Sweep] ---> [Step 3: Screening] ---> [Step 4: Pass/Fail]
   Open/Short Correction      Forward (-2V -> +2V)      Dispersion Check         Retention & EOT
   Leakage < 1 fA Check       Reverse (+2V -> -2V)      Hysteresis Extract       Delta V_FB <= 15 mV
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Tool Initialization and Parasitic De-embedding
1. Load the patterned 180nm monitor wafer onto the triaxial chuck inside the light-tight Faraday cage.
2. Execute Open-Circuit and Short-Circuit calibration on the 1 MHz high-frequency LCR meter up to probe tips to eliminate residual cable capacitance ($C_{cable}$) and series lead resistance ($R_s$).
3. Perform pre-sweep leakage current verification at $85^\circ\text{C}$ using the electrometer; ensure baseline leakage prior to small-signal sweep complies with cell sub-threshold/junction targets ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).

#### Step 2: Bidirectional Dual-Sweep Acquisition
1. Apply the **Forward Sweep**: Bias gate electrode from inversion into strong accumulation ($V_G = -2.0\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$ in increments of $20\text{ mV}$, hold time: $100\text{ ms}$).
2. Simultaneously acquire:
   - High-Frequency capacitance ($C_{HF}$) and conductance ($G_p$) at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$.
   - Quasi-Static displacement current ($I_{QS}$) to derive Quasi-Static capacitance ($C_{QS}$).
3. Immediately trigger the **Reverse Sweep**: Bias gate electrode from $+2.0\text{ V}$ back to $-2.0\text{ V}$ at identical slew rate and step hold times.

#### Step 3: Anomaly Screening & Hysteresis Extraction
1. **Accumulation Dispersion Screening**: Verify maximum accumulation capacitance ($C_{ox}$) across forward and reverse sweeps. Confirm physical gate oxide thickness corresponds to $T_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ (per dry oxidation targets).
2. **Leakage & Distortion Filtering**: Flag and discard curves exhibiting steep conductance spikes ($G_p / \omega > 10^{-11}\text{ F}\cdot\text{cm}^{-2}$) or current runaway exceeding the 1 fA threshold.
3. **Flatband Voltage Shift ($\Delta V_{FB}$) & Hysteresis Calculation**:
   - Extract flatband capacitance:
     $$C_{FB} = \frac{C_{ox} \cdot C_{Debye}}{C_{ox} + C_{Debye}}$$
   - Determine forward flatband voltage $V_{FB,fwd}$ and reverse flatband voltage $V_{FB,rev}$.
   - Calculate hysteresis shift:
     $$\Delta V_{FB} = |V_{FB,fwd} - V_{FB,rev}|$$
   - Assess direction of shift: Clockwise hysteresis indicates mobile ion drift ($Q_m$); counter-clockwise indicates slow border trap capture/emission ($N_{bt}$).

#### Step 4: Data Archival & Pass/Fail Disposition
1. Calculate effective interface trap density ($D_{it}$) via the high-low frequency method:
   $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{QS}}{C_{ox} - C_{QS}} - \frac{C_{HF}}{C_{ox} - C_{HF}} \right)$$
2. Log wafer ID, site coordinates, $C_{ox}$, $\Delta V_{FB}$, and extracted trap densities to the Fab Metrology Database.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Target / Limit | Engineering Tolerance | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Frequency |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / C-V Accumulation (100% test sites) |
| **Hysteresis Shift Window ($\Delta V_{FB}$)** | $\le 15$ | Upper bound | $\text{mV}$ | Dual-Sweep 1 MHz C-V ($V_G = \pm 2\text{ V}$) |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | $< 1.0$ | Upper limit | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SMU Electrometer ($85.0^\circ\text{C}$ chuck) |
| **Storage Node Cap Equivalent Baseline** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | Pass window | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked Capacitor C-V Array Reference |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Technical Justification
- **Gate Dielectric Thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$)**: Derived from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*, defining dry oxidation at 850°C–900°C yielding $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $T_{ox}$ (EOT 3–4 nm).
- **Cell Leakage Boundary ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C)**: Derived from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*, mandating sub-threshold and junction leakage remain below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh retention requirements.
- **Reference Cell Storage Capacitance ($25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$)**: Directly cited from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* and *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design*, ensuring signal development ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{ to } 150\text{ mV}$) across bitline capacitance ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-sweep high-frequency C-V screening is the primary diagnostic gate verifying gate dielectric charge integrity before entering full CMOS inverter ring-oscillator integration. The 3.5 nm physical dry gate oxide operates under high electric fields (>5 MV/cm at 1.8 V); any uncompensated cable parasitic inductance or residual series resistance (Rs > 20 Ohm) distorts the apparent accumulation capacitance C_ox, causing artificial skew in extracted EOT and false-positive hysteresis loops. Integration scripts must implement dual-frequency or three-element equivalent circuit correction (parallel G_p and series R_s) before evaluating hysteresis deltas against the 180nm process design kit (PDK) threshold budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In ultra-thin 3.5 nm SiO2 on P-type (100) Si, hysteresis during bidirectional voltage sweeps (-1.8 V -> +1.8 V -> -1.8 V) originates from two distinct physical mechanisms with opposite signs: mobile ionic contamination (Na+, K+) causing negative flatband voltage shift (Delta V_fb < 0) on the reverse sweep, and border/slow oxide trap charge injection causing positive flatband shift (Delta V_fb > 0). Furthermore, at 3.5 nm, direct quantum mechanical tunneling leakage can introduce substantial conductance loss; if phase-sensitive detection in the LCR meter (Keysight E4980A / B1500A) drops below Q = 5 (D = tan delta > 0.2), capacitive extraction collapses. Ramp rates must be constrained to 50-100 mV/s with hold times at inversion to avoid non-equilibrium deep depletion while preventing soft breakdown.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standardizing analytical MOSCAP test pads across 200 um, 500 um, and 1000 um dot diameters requires ultra-high-purity (5N5) aluminum sputtering targets and certified shadow masks with sharp aperture edge profiles (<2 um roughness). Low-noise triaxial probe needles (tungsten-rhenium or beryllium-copper, tip radius 5-10 um) and gold-plated chuck assemblies are critical consumable failure points; micro-scratches on backside ohmic contacts induce erratic contact resistance, confounding wafer-level yield tracking between Vietnam pilot lines and outsourced foundry reality checks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-sweep C-V anomaly screening sits on the critical path between thermal gate oxidation/FGA (Forming Gas Anneal) and poly-Si deposition. Delaying automated screening beyond the 120-minute Q-time window allows airborne organic moisture condensation and ambient boron deactivation, skewing baseline Dit metrics. This metrology step must execute automated pass/fail binning in under 180 seconds per die across a 9-point wafer map to maintain a throughput of >= 15 wafer lots per shift without creating cleanroom WIP stagnation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tunneling leakage-induced phase angle degradation (dissipation factor D > 0.2) in 3.5 nm oxide during strong accumulation causing false C_ox saturation readings and mathematical divergence in Dit extraction.
1. Mobile sodium/potassium ion contamination (> 5e10 cm^-2) resulting in wide counter-clockwise C-V hysteresis (Delta V_fb > 25 mV) across forward and reverse sweeps.
1. Backside ohmic contact series resistance spike (> 50 Ohm) due to native oxide regrowth prior to backside Au/Al deposition, inducing apparent dispersion and distortion in depletion slope.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-1-01` | **Dual-Sweep High-Frequency (1 MHz) Flatband Voltage Hysteresis and Mobile Ion Screening** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Shielded Probe Station, low-noise triaxial cabling with open/short/load calibration substrate. | 1. Perform open and short cable calibration on the MFCMU up to probe tips at 1 MHz, AC oscillation level 25 mV RMS. 2. Land triaxial probe on 500 um diameter circular Al gate dot with contact force <= 5 g to avoid dielectric micro-cracking. 3. Configure dual-sweep DC bias profile: Hold at -1.8 V for 5.0 s (accumulation equilibrium), sweep forward to +1.8 V at 50 mV/s step rate (step size 20 mV), hold at +1.8 V for 2.0 s, then sweep reverse back to -1.8 V at 50 mV/s. 4. Record high-frequency capacitance (C_p), parallel conductance (G_p), and dissipation factor (D) at each bias point. 5. Compute flatband capacitance C_fb using Debye length calculation from substrate doping (N_A approx 1e17 cm^-3). 6. Extract flatband voltage on forward sweep (V_fb,fwd) and reverse sweep (V_fb,rev); calculate hysteresis Delta V_fb = |V_fb,rev - V_fb,fwd|. | `Delta V_fb must be <= 15.0 mV across all measured sites. Dissipation factor D in accumulation (at V_G = -1.8 V) must satisfy D <= 0.15. Mobile ionic charge density Q_m = (C_ox * Delta V_fb) / (q * Area) must be < 1.0e10 cm^-2.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-1-02` | **Bidirectional Leakage-Compensated C-V Anomaly and Series Resistance (Rs) Validation** | Keysight B1500A with dual B1517A High-Resolution SMUs and B1520A MFCMU, switching matrix B2200A, dark probe chamber with dry nitrogen purge (RH < 5%). | 1. Measure quasi-static DC gate leakage current I_G vs V_G from -1.8 V to +1.8 V using HR-SMU to verify dielectric integrity (I_leak < 1.0 A/cm^2 at -1.8 V). 2. Apply dual-frequency dual-sweep measurement at 100 kHz and 1 MHz between -1.8 V and +1.8 V. 3. Apply Nicollian-Goetzberger two-frequency series resistance compensation algorithm: R_s = (G_m1 * f1^2 - G_m2 * f2^2) / ((C_m2 - C_m1) * (2*pi*f1*f2)^2), correcting measured C_m and G_m to intrinsic C_c and G_c. 4. Check for ledge distortion or non-monotonic slope reversals (dC/dV < 0 in accumulation-to-depletion transition). 5. Compare corrected C_c curve against ideal theoretical Poisson-Boltzmann MOSCAP model. | `Corrected series resistance R_s must be < 15.0 Ohm across the structure. Dielectric leakage current density J_G at V_G = -1.0 V must be < 1.0e-3 A/cm^2. Dual-sweep curves must show zero abnormal 'bump' or ledge features (d2C/dV2 inflection anomalies indicating localized border traps must exhibit trap peak density N_bt <= 2.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloved, ESD-safe), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative antistatic cleanroom smock and hood, Conductive ESD heel straps / cleanroom safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For IPA skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and flush skin with copious running water for >= 15 minutes. For IPA eye splash: Rinse cautiously with sterile eye-wash saline for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. For gaseous N2 asphyxiation risk: Immediately remove victim to fresh uncontaminated air; if breathing is labored, administer medical oxygen under certified supervision; if breathing ceases, initiate cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station must operate under local cleanroom exhaust plenum with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) to evacuate IPA solvent vapors from tip cleaning. Ambient nitrogen line purge enclosures must feature active O2 depletion sensor alarms calibrated to trip at < 19.5% O2 concentration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA cleanroom wipes must be sealed in airtight, dedicated polyethylene hazardous solvent waste containers grounded to prevent static spark ignition. Flammable liquid waste must be collected in closed SEMI-approved safety carboys for licensed off-site high-temperature solvent incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 6N (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly completed post-metal forming gas anneal (400 deg C, H2/N2) with bare patterned Al dots on 3.5 nm dry thermal SiO2; backside ohmic metal contact fully metallized; free of fluorinated degreasing residues or native oxide re-oxidation on pads.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probed Al dot pads with probe pin marks < 15 um diameter and penetration depth < 20% metal thickness; intact 3.5 nm dielectric layer devoid of electrical breakdown punch-through; stored in sealed FOUP purged with 99.9999% N2.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive queue time exposure to ambient moisture and cleanroom airborne organics (> 60 min) causes surface hydroxyl group chemisorption (-OH), increasing surface leakage paths, skewing apparent flatband voltage by > 40 mV, and contaminating C-V hysteresis readings with ambient moisture dipole polarization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete wafer-level dual-sweep high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V parameterization on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOSCAP diagnostic dots, demonstrating negligible mobile charge hysteresis (Delta V_fb <= 15 mV), verified low series resistance (Rs < 15 Ohm), and low border trap density, qualifying the gate dielectric lot for subsequent poly-silicon gate electrode stack integration.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `LOT_OX35_CV_ANOMALY_LEAKAGE_COMP_REPORT.pdf`

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Quasi-Static Leakage Current Compensation and Series Resistance Correction
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — Metrology & Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Process Action:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Raw Dual-Sweep &    │
│      Leakage Data      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Leakage Current     │
│  Baseline Subtraction  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Quasi-Static      │
│      Capacitance       │
│       Derivation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Series Resistance Rs  │
│      De-embedding      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Corrected Dual-Sweep  │
│   Curves & Archival    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Hardware & Chuck Thermal Stabilization**
   - Load the wafer onto the guarded metrology probe station chuck.
   - Maintain chuck temperature at nominal testing conditions (monitor at $85^\circ\text{C}$ for thermal stress characterization or $25^\circ\text{C}$ room ambient).
   - Ensure triaxial cable shields and dark box enclosure are secured to suppress parasitic leakage and optical carrier generation.

2. **Quasi-Static Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$) Baseline Extraction**
   - Measure the DC current-voltage ($I\text{-}V$) leakage baseline across the gate oxide ($t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) and storage node test structures across the voltage range of interest.
   - Calculate static leakage current per cell structure; verify that junction and sub-threshold leakage components stay well below the operational allowance ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

3. **Quasi-Static Capacitance ($C_{\text{QS}}$) Derivation and Leakage Compensation**
   - Apply slow linear voltage ramp ($dV/dt$) for quasi-static sweep acquisition.
   - Deduct the baseline DC leakage from total quasi-static displacement current:
     $$I_{\text{disp}}(V) = I_{\text{meas}}(V) - I_{\text{leak}}(V)$$
   - Extract the leakage-compensated quasi-static capacitance curve:
     $$C_{\text{QS}}(V) = \frac{I_{\text{disp}}(V)}{dV/dt}$$

4. **High-Frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) Series Resistance ($R_s$) De-Embedding**
   - Measure high-frequency parallel capacitance $C_m$ and conductance $G_m$ at $1\text{ MHz}$ across the dual-sweep voltage regime.
   - Determine substrate and contact series resistance $R_s$ in strong accumulation:
     $$R_s = \frac{G_{ma}}{G_{ma}^2 + \omega^2 C_{ma}^2} \quad (\text{where } \omega = 2\pi \times 1\text{ MHz})$$
   - Correct the measured high-frequency capacitance ($C_{\text{corr}}$) and conductance ($G_{\text{corr}}$) using Nicollian-Brews two-element series-to-parallel conversion:
     $$C_{\text{corr}} = \frac{(G_m^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2) C_m}{[G_m - (G_m^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2) R_s]^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2}$$

5. **Validation and Dual-Sweep Curve Alignment**
   - Verify that corrected high-frequency accumulation capacitance aligns with equivalent oxide thickness targets (nominal physical gate oxide $3.5\text{ nm}$, dielectric constant $\kappa \approx 3.9$ for $\text{SiO}_2$ or equivalent $\text{EOT} \approx 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$).
   - Superimpose forward and reverse $C\text{-}V$ dual sweeps to check hysteresis loop suppression and archive corrected arrays into the metrology database.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Method | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Leakage Current Density** | Guarded pA-meter DC sweep at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | Strong accumulation $C_{\text{corr}}$ extraction | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance Target ($C_s$)** | Corrected low-frequency / QS capacitance | $25\text{ to } 30$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature Stability** | Integrated thermal chuck sensor | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - Leakage current upper threshold: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ (within the $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ nominal window).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Thermally grown dry gate oxide physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window: $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage capacitor target: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - Typical cell capacitance baseline: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ with complementary bitline load $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-sweep quasi-static (QS) and 1 MHz high-frequency (HF) C-V metrology for ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide faces severe distortion from direct tunneling leakage current (J_leak > 1 mA/cm^2) and series resistance (R_series). If the leakage compensation algorithm (e.g., Castagne-Vapaille or Ziegler-Kuhn integration method) is not mathematically decoupled from cable parasitic inductance and chuck contact resistance, extracted interface trap density (Dit) will exhibit artificial midgap peaks exceeding 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2. Furthermore, automated dual-sweep hysteresis tracking must maintain strict time-step synchronization (dV/dt <= 20 mV/s) to prevent displacement current miscalculation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At tox = 3.5 nm, quantum-mechanical confinement effects shift the inversion centroid away from the Si/SiO2 interface, while gate tunneling causes significant leakage in accumulation. Correcting series resistance via Nicollian-Goetzberger or dual-frequency impedance de-embedding (Z_corr = Z_meas - R_s) is non-negotiable before executing quasi-static leakage subtraction. In dual-sweep mode, slow-state electron trapping in the 3.5 nm dry oxide creates an apparent displacement offset; failure to subtract pure DC leakage via an independently acquired static I-V baseline across identical MOS capacitor test structures will distort the quasi-static capacitance curve C_qs(V) in depletion.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology throughput is bottlenecked by the low ramp-rate requirement of quasi-static electrometer measurements (Keithley 595 / Keysight B1500A with HRSMU and ASU units). Sourcing high-purity gold-plated chucks and low-noise triaxial cables rated for sub-femtoamp leakage is prone to long lead times (16-24 weeks). Ensuring second-source qualification for specialized 100 um micro-manipulator triaxial probe tips (e.g., BeCu or W-tip with < 10 fA parasitic leakage floor) is critical to prevent fab floor metrology stoppages during 180nm lot qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The queue-time envelope between forming gas anneal (FGA) and dual-sweep C-V metrology must be tightly bounded to avoid uncontrolled interface states re-passivation or ambient moisture adsorption. The metrology SOP must enforce fully automated batch data extraction scripts with built-in R_s and leakage sanity boundaries. If extraction runtime exceeds 6 minutes per site across a 9-point wafer map, metrology cycle time will breach the thermal processing gate module SLA.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tunneling leakage over-compensation causing non-physical negative quasi-static capacitance C_qs values in strong accumulation/inversion.
1. Inaccurate series resistance (R_s) de-embedding leading to apparent frequency dispersion and artificially suppressed high-frequency accumulation capacitance C_acc.
1. Excessive ramp rate (> 50 mV/s) causing deep depletion non-equilibrium behavior during quasi-static sweep, invalidating Dit extraction across midgap.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-2-01` | **Quasi-Static Direct Tunneling Leakage Compensation and Equilibrium Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer equipped with High-Resolution SMU (HRSMU) and Atto-Sense and Switch Unit (ASU), triaxial dark shielding probe station with temperature-controlled chuck at 25.0 +/- 0.5 deg C. | 1. Land triaxial probe tips on the 100 um x 100 um MOS capacitor gate pad with backside contact grounded to the chuck. 2. Execute static I-V sweep from -1.5 V to +1.5 V at 10 mV increments with 500 ms hold time to capture DC leakage current profile I_leak(V). 3. Perform dual-sweep quasi-static C-V from -1.5 V to +1.5 V and back to -1.5 V with a linear ramp rate dV/dt = 15 mV/s using Q-t feedback electrometer mode. 4. Apply digital point-by-point subtraction: I_disp(V) = I_meas(V) - I_leak(V). 5. Compute corrected quasi-static capacitance C_qs(V) = I_disp(V) / (dV/dt). | `Corrected quasi-static capacitance C_qs in strong accumulation (-1.5 V) matches high-frequency accumulation capacitance within +/- 2.5%, no negative capacitance artifacts observed, and dual-sweep hysteresis delta-V_FB is <= 15 mV.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-2-02` | **High-Frequency Series Resistance (R_s) Correction via Dual-Frequency Impedance Metrology** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (20 Hz to 2 MHz) with 16048A four-terminal pair test leads and triaxial guarding probe station, calibrated with open/short/load de-embedding at chuck plane. | 1. Apply 100 kHz AC test signal (V_ac = 15 mV RMS) and bias from -1.5 V to +1.5 V; measure parallel capacitance C_m1 and conductance G_m1. 2. Repeat sweep at 1.0 MHz; measure parallel capacitance C_m2 and conductance G_m2. 3. Extract series resistance R_s from strong accumulation impedance: R_s = G_ma / (G_ma^2 + (omega * C_ma)^2). 4. Calculate series-resistance-corrected high-frequency capacitance C_cor and conductance G_cor using Nicollian-Goetzberger formulation: C_cor = (G_m^2 + omega^2 * C_m^2) * C_m / (omega^2 * C_m^2 * R_s^2 * (G_m - 1/R_s)^2 + omega^2 * C_m^2). | `Extracted R_s <= 12.0 Ohm across all 9 standard test sites; corrected C_cor in accumulation at 1 MHz aligns with 100 kHz C_cor within <= 1.0% deviation, verifying complete series resistance cancellation.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Antistatic cleanroom bunny suit with ESD-dissipative conductive booties and grounded wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious cleanroom emergency eyewash water for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash affected skin thoroughly with soap and DI water; remove contaminated garments. Inhalation: If nitrogen displacement causes dizziness or asphyxiation symptoms, immediately move personnel to open, ventilated fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station enclosed in certified laminar flow hood with local exhaust ventilation maintaining face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.5 m/s); low-oxygen ambient alert sensors interlocked to lab N2 purge manifold.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free probe cleaning wipes must be collected in closed, dedicated solvent waste containers labeled with hazardous waste codes and transferred to the chemical solvent collection facility.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic grade (VLSI / SEMI Tier C) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 6.0 Grade (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) on p-type Si (100) with n+ polysilicon top gates and aluminum metallization pads, freshly processed through post-metallization forming gas anneal (H2/N2 10% H2 at 400 deg C for 30 min) to passivate dangling bonds.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically probed MOS capacitor structures with undamaged contact pads (probe scrub marks < 15% of pad area), free of organic carbon contamination or triboelectric charge, ready for high-temperature gate oxide integrity (TDDB) stress testing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exposure to ambient humidity beyond 30 minutes induces moisture chemisorption and native oxide/dangling bond re-oxidation at pad boundaries, driving artificial interface trap density (Dit) drift > 2e10 eV^-1 cm^-2 and degrading CV repeatability.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full dual-sweep C-V metrology package providing leakage-compensated quasi-static capacitance and series-resistance-corrected 1 MHz high-frequency curves across 9 points on 200 mm wafer. Enables precise extraction of Si/SiO2 interface trap density (Dit) across the bandgap for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide in 180nm DRAM access transistors.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CV_METROLOGY_3P5NM_OXIDE_CORRECTED_DUAL_SWEEP.csv`
- [ ] `INTERFACE_TRAP_DENSITY_DIT_BANDGAP_PROFILE.pdf`
- [ ] `WAFER_9PT_SERIES_RESISTANCE_AND_LEAKAGE_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum Si/SiO2 midgap interface trap density (Dit) extracted from corrected quasi-static and HF C-V curves** | `3.5e10` | +/- 5.0e9 eV^-1 cm^-2 | High-Low C-V method comparison (Castagne-Vapaille: Dit = (C_ox / q) * (C_qs / (C_ox - C_qs) - C_hf / (C_ox - C_hf))) calculated at midgap potential (E - Ev = 0.56 eV). |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Corrected accumulation capacitance C_acc equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) extraction for 3.5 nm target oxide** | `3.48` | +/- 0.08 nm | Quantum-mechanical NCSU Hauser C-V fitting model applied to R_s-de-embedded 1 MHz accumulation curve at V_gate = -1.5 V. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **9-point wafer mapping Gauge R&R measurement coefficient of variation (CV) for corrected accumulation capacitance** | `0.65` | <= 1.0% | Statistical repeatability analysis of 9-point wafer map executed over 10 consecutive repeat passes on test structure arrays. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful execution of dual-sweep C-V across all 9 wafer sites with zero negative C_qs artifacts, midgap Dit verified <= 4.0e10 eV^-1 cm^-2, series resistance R_s <= 12 Ohm, and automated signoff approval by Systems Metrology and Thermal Processing Module Leads.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Standardized Metrology Data Formatting, Schema Validation, and Vault Archival  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction > High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition > Dual-Sweep C-V Curve Validation, Leakage Compensation, and Data Archival > Standardized Metrology Data Formatting, Schema Validation, and Vault Archival  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Procure/Implement standard commercial semiconductor yield management and vaulting software integration)

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the protocol for parsing, formatting, schema validation, and secure cryptographic archival of dual-sweep high-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) metrology datasets acquired from test structures across the 180nm DRAM dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) and capacitor dielectric modules.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| FLOWCHART: METROLOGY DATA VAULT ARCHIVAL                                    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   [ Raw Tool Ingestion ] 
              │
              ▼
   [ CSV/JSON Schema Validation (EOT, Sweep Rates, Leakage) ]
              │
              ▼
   [ Boundary & Physical Limits Check: tox=3.5 nm, T=85°C ]
              │
              ▼
   [ Checksum Generation & WORM Secure Vault Commit ]
```

1. **Raw Ingestion & Normalization**:
   - Ingest raw dual-sweep $1\text{ MHz}$ high-frequency and quasi-static C-V curve raw files directly from the prober/parameter analyzer workstation.
   - Parse curves into standard machine-readable format (JSON/SEMI E134 compliant EDA/MDX schema) indexing parameters: bias sweep voltage ($V$), measured high-frequency capacitance ($C_{HF}$), quasi-static capacitance ($C_{QS}$), probe frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$), and substrate temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

2. **Schema & Physical Range Validation**:
   - Validate metadata against the DRAM 180nm process schema:
     - Verify physical gate oxide target thickness normalization is tagged to nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$ (dry oxidation grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$).
     - Verify access transistor reference dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Check capacitor dielectric parameters for equivalent oxide thickness ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ EOT) and cell capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$, nominal $\ge 28\text{ fF}$).
     - Reject datasets where measured leakage exceeds the target of $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Cryptographic Checksum & Vault Ingestion**:
   - Compute a SHA-256 integrity hash for each parsed record and attached raw sweep trace.
   - Transmit payload to the secure local WORM (Write Once, Read Many) engineering metrology vault via TLS-encrypted API.
   - Verify transaction receipt from the repository ledger; flag any unindexed or mismatched records for automated re-parsing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness Baseline** | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated schema validation against physical dry $\text{SiO}_2$ growth baseline |
| **Cell Capacitance Validation Threshold ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0$ (Budget: $28.0 - 30.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated rule evaluation from extracted dual-sweep C-V data |
| **Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage Upper Bound** | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Inline parametric compliance filter prior to vault commit |
| **Access Transistor Dimension Metadata Tagging** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated JSON schema boundary validator |

---

### 4. Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; Sub-threshold/junction leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation; Storage capacitor target $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$; Capacitor dielectric EOT around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated data ingestion from dual-sweep C-V instrumentation (LCR meter and electrometer/SMU) into the Open-Source DRAM Foundation VN data vault requires strict deterministic serialization. The schema must enforce JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 compliance or standardized HDF5/parquet schema constraints, capturing hardware timestamps, sweep frequencies (1 MHz HF vs quasi-static ramp rates), temperature drift, and probe contact resistance. Without cryptographic SHA-256 checksumming upon ingest, corrupted measurement records could propagate downstream to erroneous compact SPICE model parameter extraction for the 180nm cell transistor.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dual-sweep C-V data format must preserve both raw voltage-capacitance (V-C) and voltage-current (V-I) time-series data along with compensated curves (correcting for parasitic cable capacitance and parallel conductance leakage). Storing only extracted oxide thickness (tox_eq ~3.5 nm) and interface trap density (Dit) without the raw dual-sweep hysteresis data strips vital physical indicators of slow oxide trap charging, mobile ionic contamination (Na+/K+), and gate leakage across ultrathin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The archival pipeline must avoid vendor-locked binary proprietary formats (such as Keysight .dat, Keithley proprietary binary streams, or LabVIEW non-standard clusters). All vault data structures must leverage platform-agnostic, open-source storage specifications (e.g., JSON/HDF5/Parquet) backed by standardized POSIX or S3-compatible cold storage pools, ensuring multi-decade readability for the open-source semiconductor ecosystem without recurring license overhead.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Data schema validation and vault ingestion must complete within automated CI/CD metrology test pipelines with minimal latency (<5 seconds per wafer lot). Metrology operators require instantaneous linting errors if metadata fields (wafer_id, die_coordinate, gate_area_cm2, measurement_operator) are missing or out-of-range, blocking unverified wafers from advancing to source/drain implantation or metallization work packages.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Schema validation bypass resulting in ingestion of uncompensated dual-sweep C-V curves, causing corrupted interface trap density (Dit) benchmarks across the 180nm process node.
1. Omission of probe station thermal and chuck grounding metadata, preventing accurate correction of temperature-dependent flatband voltage (Vfb) shifts and mobile ion drift.
1. Checksum mismatch or data truncation during automated network vault archival, leading to permanent loss of baseline metrology traces for physical lot tracking.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-3-01` | **Automated JSON Schema & Metrology Record Compliance Verification** | Automated Metrology Vault CI/CD Ingestion Engine (Python jsonschema validator, libgit2 / S3 checksum verifier) | 1. Ingest raw dual-sweep data package into validation parser. 2. Execute schema validation against DRAM-VN-CV-METROLOGY-v1.0.json schema checking required fields: wafer_id, die_id, tox_cv_nm, dit_midgap_cm2ev, hf_capacitance_pf, qs_capacitance_pf, leakage_current_pa, timestamp_utc. 3. Validate physical value range boundaries: tox_cv_nm within [3.0, 4.2], dit_midgap_cm2ev within [1.0e10, 1.0e12], gate_leakage_current < 100 nA. 4. Compute SHA-256 payload checksum and compare against ingest manifest hash. 5. Log validation report and generate vault transaction token. | `Schema validation status == PASS (0 schema errors, 0 warnings); physical boundary check violations == 0; SHA-256 ingest manifest hash matches computed file hash exactly.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-2-3-3-02` | **Dual-Sweep C-V Vault Ingestion, HDF5 Archival, and Round-Trip Lossless Retrieval Test** | DRAM Foundation VN Git/S3 Vault Storage Cluster, HDF5 verification tools (h5diff, h5check) | 1. Commit packaged dual-sweep C-V dataset (containing 1 MHz sweep forward/reverse, QS sweep, and calculated Dit profile) to DRAM Foundation VN immutable vault. 2. critics.systems_engineer: Automated data ingestion from dual-sweep C-V instrumentation (LCR meter and electrometer/SMU) into the Open-Source DRAM Foundation VN data vault requires strict deterministic serialization. The schema must enforce JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 compliance or standardized HDF5/parquet schema constraints, capturing hardware timestamps, sweep frequencies (1 MHz HF vs quasi-static ramp rates), temperature drift, and probe contact resistance. Without cryptographic SHA-256 checksumming upon ingest, corrupted measurement records could propagate downstream to erroneous compact SPICE model parameter extraction for the 180nm cell transistor.
critics.domain_expert: Dual-sweep C-V data format must preserve both raw voltage-capacitance (V-C) and voltage-current (V-I) time-series data along with compensated curves (correcting for parasitic cable capacitance and parallel conductance leakage). Storing only extracted oxide thickness (tox_eq ~3.5 nm) and interface trap density (Dit) without the raw dual-sweep hysteresis data strips vital physical indicators of slow oxide trap charging, mobile ionic contamination (Na+/K+), and gate leakage across ultrathin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide.
critics.supply_chain: The archival pipeline must avoid vendor-locked binary proprietary formats (such as Keysight .dat, Keithley proprietary binary streams, or LabVIEW non-standard clusters). All vault data structures must leverage platform-agnostic, open-source storage specifications (e.g., JSON/HDF5/Parquet) backed by standardized POSIX or S3-compatible cold storage pools, ensuring multi-decade readability for the open-source semiconductor ecosystem without recurring license overhead.
critics.laya_pm: Data schema validation and vault ingestion must complete within automated CI/CD metrology test pipelines with minimal latency (<5 seconds per wafer lot). Metrology operators require instantaneous linting errors if metadata fields (wafer_id, die_coordinate, gate_area_cm2, measurement_operator) are missing or out-of-range, blocking unverified wafers from advancing to source/drain implantation or metallization work packages.
critical_failure_modes: Schema validation bypass resulting in ingestion of uncompensated dual-sweep C-V curves, causing corrupted interface trap density (Dit) benchmarks across the 180nm process node.
Omission of probe station thermal and chuck grounding metadata, preventing accurate correction of temperature-dependent flatband voltage (Vfb) shifts and mobile ion drift.
Checksum mismatch or data truncation during automated network vault archival, leading to permanent loss of baseline metrology traces for physical lot tracking.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): High-Low Frequency Method Dit Extraction and Bandgap Profiling Analysis

**Discipline / Category**: Metrology  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Optical Inspection / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting interface trap density (Dit) across the silicon bandgap for an ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide requires rigorous decoupling of parasitic series resistance (Rs) and quantum mechanical gate leakage currents. At 3.5 nm, direct tunneling currents corrupt standard quasi-static low-frequency displacement current measurements (dQ/dt = C_LF * dV/dt), causing apparent non-physical Dit divergence near band edges unless automated dual-frequency or corrected high-low impedance vector calibration (e.g., Nicollian-Goetzberger network correction) is integrated into the automated prober pipeline.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The high-low frequency method relies on Dit = (Cox / q) * [(C_LF / (Cox - C_LF)) - (C_HF / (Cox - C_HF))]. For Gen 1 planar MOS capacitors on p-type Si (100) (Na ~ 1e17 cm^-3), the high-frequency measurement must be executed at 1 MHz (well above the interface trap response cutoff frequency omega * tau >> 1) while quasi-static C_LF ramp rates must remain below 50 mV/s to ensure steady-state equilibrium without triggering displacement distortion. Midgap Dit extraction must resolve below 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1 with an energetic resolution across E_v + 0.2 eV to E_c - 0.2 eV.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology throughput is gated by precision analytical probe station availability (e.g., Cascade Summit or MPI TS2000-SE with dark/EMI shield box) coupled to Keysight B1500A (B1520A MFCMU + B1500A-HRSMU). Domestic supply chain in Vietnam must secure ultra-low noise triaxial cables (Keysight 16493J) and high-purity dry nitrogen purge gas to mitigate humidity-induced surface state hysteresis without recurring import bottlenecks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: High-low C-V Dit profiling is on the critical path between thermal furnace gate oxidation/FGA (Forming Gas Anneal) and Stage 2 Reality Gate signoff. Delays in prober chuck calibration or open/short fixture de-embedding risk stalling lot progression past the 30-minute queue-time window. Immediate automated data logging to the open-source repository database is required to validate pass/fail status per wafer lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Quasi-static leakage current saturation: Direct quantum tunneling across 3.5 nm SiO2 exceeds displacement current during quasi-static C-V ramp, causing artificial runaway of extracted low-frequency capacitance and Dit blowup.
1. Series resistance (Rs) induced dispersion: Inadequate back-contact ohmic sintering or high substrate bulk resistivity distorts the 1 MHz accumulation capacitance, underestimating Cox and shifting the extracted flatband voltage (Vfb).
1. Surface moisture and organic recontamination: Excessive queue time in atmospheric cleanroom air introduces ambient water molecules, causing dipole shifts, C-V hysteresis, and anomalous fast surface trap generation exceeding 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-01` | **High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer equipped with B1520A MFCMU and B1500A-HRSMU, triaxial Kelvin connections, Temptronic temperature-controlled chuck set to 298.15 K inside an EMI-shielded light-tight probe station with N2 purge. | 1. Load 150mm wafer onto prober chuck with 5 psi vacuum and continuous dry N2 purge (flow rate > 5 SLPM) under light-tight enclosure. 2. Contact 100 um x 100 um poly-Si/SiO2/Si MOS capacitor pad with beryllium-copper microprobe. 3. Execute 1 MHz HF C-V sweep from inversion (-1.5 V) to accumulation (+1.5 V for p-type) at 25 mV AC amplitude. 4. De-embed parasitic series resistance Rs and extract Cox in deep accumulation (+1.5 V). 5. Execute quasi-static low-frequency (QS C-V) sweep over identical bias range with voltage step ramp rate dV/dt = 20 mV/s while measuring displacement current I_QS. 6. Log raw HF and LF capacitance profiles C_HF(V) and C_LF(V) to disk. | `Gate dielectric breakdown voltage Vbd > 3.8 V (Ebd > 10.8 MV/cm); gate leakage current density J_gate < 1.0 x 10^-3 A/cm^2 at Vg = -1.0 V; accumulation Cox within 3.5 nm equivalent oxide thickness nominal range (0.95 uF/cm^2 to 1.05 uF/cm^2).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-02` | **Interface Trap Density (Dit) Bandgap Profile & Midgap Extraction** | Automated Python analytical extraction pipeline (metrology_dit_extractor.py) linked to Keysight B1500A raw data export, plotting Dit versus surface potential (Psi_s) across bandgap. | 1. Ingest C_HF and C_LF arrays and calculate surface potential Psi_s(V) by Berglund integration: Psi_s(V) = Integral [1 - (C_LF(V) / Cox)] dV from V_inversion to V. 2. Compute interface trap capacitance: C_it(V) = [ (1/C_LF - 1/Cox)^-1 - (1/C_HF - 1/Cox)^-1 ]. 3. Calculate interface trap density Dit(Psi_s) = C_it / q. 4. Locate midgap energy level (E_trap - E_v = 0.56 eV corresponding to intrinsic Fermi level). 5. Extract Dit value at midgap and integrate trap density profile from E_v + 0.25 eV to E_c - 0.25 eV across 9 standard wafer map dies. | `Midgap interface trap density Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1 across >= 8 of 9 wafer map sites; within-wafer Dit standard deviation <= 15%; flatband voltage shift |Delta V_fb| <= 0.05 V indicating Q_f / q < 5.0 x 10^10 cm^-2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom smock and hood, Conductive ESD heel straps and grounded wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Nitrogen asphyxiation: Evacuate exposed personnel to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is labored; alert emergency response. IPA exposure: For eye contact, flush with emergency eyewash for 15 minutes; for dermal contact, wash thoroughly with soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station enclosed in laminar flow hood maintaining positive Class 100 HEPA air velocity (0.45 m/s ± 20%); ambient nitrogen asphyxiation sensor installed in room with automated audio/visual alarm triggered at O2 < 19.5% by volume.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA cleaning wipes sealed in dedicated flammable solvent waste containers and disposed per hazardous solvent protocol. Exhausted nitrogen vented to exterior scrubber exhaust system.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Semiconductor Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Chuck Surface Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade VLSI | `99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Sintered aluminum or doped poly-Si gate electrode atop 3.5 nm dry thermal SiO2 after forming gas anneal (H2/N2 5%/95% at 400°C), pristine and hydrophobic/uncontaminated.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized MOS test structures with verified pad probe scrub marks (< 15% pad area deformation), immediately staged for subsequent dielectric breakdown reliability testing or dicing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption and atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (boron/organics) infiltrate unpassivated pad perimeters, neutralizing post-FGA hydrogen passivation of dangling Si bonds, artificially increasing measured Dit above 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full quantitative extraction of interface trap density (Dit) across the silicon bandgap and fixed oxide charge (Qf) from 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOS capacitors using dual-frequency High-Low C-V methodology, demonstrating compliant passivation and gate integrity for 180nm DRAM Stage 2 Reality Gate.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CV_RAW_DATA_1MHZ_QS_WAFERMAP.csv`
- [ ] `DIT_BANDGAP_PROFILE_ANALYSIS_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `MOSCAP_C_V_CURVE_OVERLAY_PLOT.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Extracted midgap interface trap density (Dit at E_midgap)** | `8.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1` | <= 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1 | Automated High-Low C-V extraction formula applied to 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V curves on 100x100 um test structures |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Fixed oxide charge density (Qf / q) derived from flatband voltage shift** | `3.5e10 cm^-2` | <= 5.0e10 cm^-2 | Comparison between theoretical ideal flatband voltage and measured HF C-V Vfb extracted via inflection point / second derivative analysis |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted in strong accumulation** | `3.50 nm` | ± 0.15 nm | Quantum mechanically corrected C-V extraction from Cox measured at 1 MHz, +1.5 V bias |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Nine-point wafer mapping yields midgap Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1 and Qf / q < 5.0 x 10^10 cm^-2 across >= 88.8% of tested dice, with zero evidence of tunneling-induced quasi-static divergence, formally certified by the Metrology Lead and Architecture & Integration Council for DRAM Foundation VN Stage 2 Reality Gate.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** MOS Capacitor Multi-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Instrumentation Setup
- **Module:** Metrology & Characterization / 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology [Metrology] > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction [Metrology] > High-Low Frequency Method $D_{it}$ Extraction and Bandgap Profiling Analysis [Metrology] > MOS Capacitor Multi-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Instrumentation Setup [Metrology]
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Calibration &      │
│        Zeroing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum & Chuck  │
│      Bias Contact      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Shielded Triax Probe  │
│        Contact         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Multi-Frequency HFCV  │
│  Sweep: 1 kHz - 1 MHz  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Quasi-Static QSCV    │
│   Ramp: 10 - 50 mV/s   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Interface Trap     │
│   Extraction (D_it)    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

### 1.1 Equipment Pre-Check, Cabling & Triaxial Shielding
1. Power on the Impedance Analyzer / LCR Meter (e.g., Keysight 4284A / 4294A / B1500A) and Electrometer / SMU for quasi-static characterization 60 minutes prior to measurement to establish thermal equilibrium.
2. Connect four-terminal pair (4TP) driven-guard triaxial cables from the high/low force and sense terminals to the probe station manipulator heads.
3. Close the probe station light-tight Faraday cage to eliminate stray ambient illumination and external electromagnetic interference.

### 1.2 Open / Short / Load Calibration & Fixture De-embedding
1. Lift probe needles $\ge 500\ \mu\text{m}$ above the wafer surface inside the shielded enclosure; execute the instrument **Open Calibration** across the full frequency span ($1\ \text{kHz}$ to $1\ \text{MHz}$) to compensate for residual stray fixture capacitance ($C_{residual} < 10\ \text{fF}$).
2. Drop probe tips onto a dedicated gold contact pad / calibration short substrate; execute **Short Calibration** to cancel series resistance and lead inductance ($R_{series} < 0.5\ \Omega$).

### 1.3 Wafer Loading, Substrate Contact & Temperature Stabilization
1. Load the 180nm processed test wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum thermal chuck.
2. Engage chuck vacuum ($> 60\ \text{kPa}$) to ensure uniform backside contact resistance.
3. Set the thermal chuck temperature controller to nominal room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) or targeted stress temperature ($85^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$).

### 1.4 Test Structure Micro-probing
1. Using microscope guidance, align beryllium-copper or tungsten probe needles to the gate electrode of the test MOS capacitor (fabricated over the dry thermal gate oxide with physical thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\ \text{nm}$).
2. Land the probe with controlled overdrive ($\le 5\ \mu\text{m}$ travel) to avoid punching through the thin $3.5\ \text{nm}$ dielectric stack.

### 1.5 Multi-Frequency High-Frequency C-V (HFCV) Measurement
1. Configure AC oscillation test signal amplitude to $v_{ac} = 15\ \text{mV}_{\text{RMS}}$ (small-signal condition: $v_{ac} < k_B T / q$).
2. Configure DC gate bias sweep from deep inversion/depletion to strong accumulation (e.g., $-1.8\ \text{V}$ to $+1.8\ \text{V}$ in $20\ \text{mV}$ step increments).
3. Execute discrete frequency sweeps across standard stepped nodes: $1\ \text{kHz}$, $10\ \text{kHz}$, $100\ \text{kHz}$, and $1\ \text{MHz}$. Record parallel capacitance ($C_p$) and conductance ($G_p / \omega$).

### 1.6 Quasi-Static C-V (QSCV) Ramp Measurement
1. Switch instrument to the High-Resolution Electrometer / Leakage unit in ramp or feedback charge integration mode.
2. Verify probe and fixture displacement leakage current under open contact is $< 1\ \text{fA}$.
3. Apply a linear, ultra-slow DC voltage ramp rate $dV/dt = 10\ \text{to}\ 50\ \text{mV/s}$ from inversion to accumulation. Measure displacement current $I_{meas}$ to extract quasi-static low-frequency capacitance:
   $$C_{QS} = \frac{I_{meas}}{dV/dt}$$
4. Abort sweep if dielectric leakage current $I_{leak} > 1\ \text{pA}$ to prevent distortion of the quasi-static capacitance curve.

### 1.7 Data Extraction & Archiving
1. Extract interface trap density profile $D_{it}(E)$ via the High-Low frequency method:
   $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{QS}}{C_{ox} - C_{QS}} - \frac{C_{HF}}{C_{ox} - C_{HF}} \right)$$
   using maximum accumulation oxide capacitance $C_{ox}$ calibrated for $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\ \text{nm}$.
2. Archive raw $C(V)$ and $I(V)$ datasets into the metrology datastore.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Instrument / Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5\ \text{nm}$ | $\pm 0.1\ \text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Accumulation $C_{ox}$ ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Electrometer Residual Leakage Floor** | $< 1.0\ \text{fA}$ | Max $1.0\ \text{fA}$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | High-Resolution Triaxial Electrometer / SMU ($\text{fA}$) |
| **HFCV Multi-Frequency Test Grid** | $1\ \text{kHz}$ to $1\ \text{MHz}$ | $1\ \text{kHz}$, $10\ \text{kHz}$, $100\ \text{kHz}$, $1\ \text{MHz}$ ($\pm 1\%$) | Precision Impedance / LCR Meter ($\text{kHz}$ / $\text{MHz}$) |
| **QSCV Voltage Ramp Rate ($dV/dt$)** | $20\ \text{mV/s}$ | $10\ \text{mV/s}$ to $50\ \text{mV/s}$ | Linear Ramp Function Generator / Electrometer ($\text{mV/s}$) |

---

## 3. Literature Citations & Local Context Mapping

1. **Gate Dielectric Thickness ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\ \text{nm}$)**:
   - *Source:* `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`
   - *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."* Used to establish the baseline oxide capacitance target $C_{ox} = \varepsilon_{ox} / t_{ox}$ for de-embedding and accumulation extraction.
2. **Leakage Current Ceiling ($< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)**:
   - *Source:* `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`
   - *"Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval..."* Defines the required instrumentation sensitivity floor ($< 1\ \text{fA}$) for quasi-static displacement current accuracy without parasitic leakage corruption.
3. **Capacitor Sizing & Charge Sensing Benchmark**:
   - *Source:* `Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`
   - *"For typical cell capacitance C_s = 25 fF and bitline capacitance C_BL = 250 fF..."* Provides context for parasitic fixture capacitance isolation and sub-femtofarad zeroing thresholds.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The integration between the high-frequency LCR meter (10 kHz - 1 MHz) and the high-resolution electrometer/SMU (<1 fA resolution) for quasi-static C-V requires rigorous 4-terminal pair coaxial guarding right up to the shielded probe station chuck. Stray cable capacitance (>100 pF/m) and parasitic chuck-to-ground admittance will completely swamp quasi-static displacement currents (typically 10 fA to 1 pA at 10-100 mV/s sweep rates) unless dry-run open/short de-embedding calibration protocols and Triax guarding are strictly maintained.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxides, direct quantum mechanical tunneling leakage current (J_g > 1 mA/cm² at accumulation biases) severely distorts standard 1 MHz parallel capacitance measurements (C_p - G_p model breakdown). The instrument setup must support multi-frequency two-frequency/three-element correction models (accounting for oxide capacitance C_ox, series resistance R_s, and tunneling conductance G_ox) and slow quasi-static ramping (dI = C * dV/dt) to extract accurate Dit profiles without tunneling-induced phase shift errors.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying turnkey integrated multi-frequency and quasi-static C-V meter systems (such as Keysight B1500A/B1505A with MFCMU and HR-SMUs, or Keithley 4200A-SCS with 4210-CVU and 4200-PA) under an 'Action Type: Buy' entails long lead times (16-24 weeks) and high capex. We must verify whether local Vietnamese university consortiums (e.g., VNU-HCM or HUST) or regional foundry hubs have underutilized refurbished Agilent 4284A/4294A LCR meters and Keithley 6517B electrometers that can be procured or leased immediately to unblock Gen 1 mm prototyping.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement and factory acceptance testing (FAT) for this instrumentation package is on the critical path for Stage 2 Reality Gate sign-off. Site preparation milestones—including Class 100 cleanroom vibration-isolated pneumatic tables, dedicated RF-shielded Faraday dark enclosures, and uninterruptible clean power grids—must precede equipment delivery; otherwise, tool unboxing delays will stall subsequent 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thickness and Dit qualification runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Chuck leakage and parasitic coaxial cable capacitance exceeding 50 fF, completely swamping low-frequency quasi-static displacement current and causing negative or infinite extracted Dit across the silicon bandgap.
1. High gate oxide tunneling leakage (>10 uA on a 500 um dot) at accumulation causing loss-factor tan(delta) > 0.1, leading to false C_ox saturation readings and erroneous physical thickness t_ox extractions.
1. Triboelectric and piezoelectric noise induced by HVAC airflow or mechanical vibrations on unanchored Triax probe cables during slow (10-50 mV/s) quasi-static voltage sweeps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-1-01` | **High-Frequency C-V Baseline Calibration & Accumulation C_ox Extraction** | Keysight B1500A with B1520A MFCMU (or Keysight 4294A Precision Impedance Analyzer), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Shielded Semi-Automatic Probe Station, BNC/Triax low-noise cables, and Agilent 16048A 4-terminal pair test fixture | 1. Land beryllium-copper probe tip (radius 5 um) onto a 500 um diameter circular Aluminum gate dot. 2. Configure MFCMU in parallel mode (Cp-Gp) with 25 mV RMS AC oscillator amplitude at 1 MHz. 3. Sweep DC gate bias from inversion (+1.5 V) through depletion to deep accumulation (-2.5 V) in steps of 25 mV with 100 ms hold time per step. 4. Record Cp and Gp versus V_G. 5. Apply two-frequency series resistance correction: C_ox = (f1^2*Cp1*(1+D1^2) - f2^2*Cp2*(1+D2^2)) / (f1^2*(1+D1^2) - f2^2*(1+D2^2)) where D = Gp / (omega*Cp). | `Accumulation capacitance C_ox at V_G = -2.0 V must yield physical t_ox = 3.5 nm +/- 0.1 nm (calculated as t_ox = eps_ox * eps_0 * Area / C_ox, with eps_ox = 3.9); parallel conductance dissipation factor tan(delta) = Gp / (omega * Cp) < 0.05 across accumulation; zero open-circuit chuck offset drift (< 5 fF).` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-1-02` | **Quasi-Static C-V Displacement Profiling & High-Low Dit Extraction** | Keithley 4200A-SCS with 4200-PA High-Resolution PreAmp / Keysight B1500A HRSMU, triaxial guarding enclosure, dark box, and calibrated 10 pF quartz reference standard capacitor | 1. Contact 500 um diameter Aluminum gate dot with Triax guard driven to gate potential. 2. Compute interface trap density across bandgap: D_it = (1 / q) * ( (C_qs * C_ox / (C_ox - C_qs)) - (C_hf * C_ox / (C_ox - C_hf)) ) / Area. | `Midgap interface trap density D_it <= 2.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1; quasi-static displacement current I_qs clean without spikes (SNR > 40 dB); C_qs in strong inversion recovers to within +/- 3% of C_ox; leakage current offset |I_leak| < 5 fA at depletion.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-static safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe conductive lab coat / smock with wrist grounding strap, Cleanroom electrostatic dissipative (ESD) footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: IPA exposure: For skin contact, wash thoroughly with soap and water; for eye contact, flush eyes immediately with copious clean water at the emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes; for inhalation of solvent vapors, immediately move personnel to fresh air. In case of localized electrical shock from high-voltage bias supplies (>40 V), disconnect mains power, assess ABCs (Airway, Breathing, Circulation), and call emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station enclosure must have local exhaust mini-snorkel (face velocity >= 100 FPM / 0.5 m/s) active during solvent wipe-down of chuck. Continuous cleanroom laminar flow (Class 100 / ISO 5) with positive dry nitrogen purge (1-3 SLM) inside the sealed dark box.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA lint-free wipes must be deposited into designated sealed, flame-resistant solvent waste cans with spring-loaded self-closing lids. No chemical sewer discharge permitted; all solvent wipe containers disposed via certified hazardous waste management contractor.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Dry N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 (UHP) | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized (sputtered Al dot gate electrodes on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide with forming gas anneal: 400 deg C, 10% H2 / 90% N2 for 30 min; backside ohmic contact intact), stored in sealed antistatic wafer box.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized MOSCAP wafer with mechanically non-destructive probe scrub marks (scrub diameter < 10 um) on Al gate dots, cleaned and dried in UHP N2, ready for discrete MOSFET test vehicle correlation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exposure to ambient humidity beyond 30 minutes leads to moisture and organic hydrocarbon chemisorption onto Al dot perimeters and exposed thin oxide edges, increasing surface leakage current by 3-5 orders of magnitude and causing false hysteretic D_it spikes (>1e11 cm^-2 eV^-1).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Turnkey MOS capacitor multi-frequency and quasi-static C-V test bench successfully procured, installed, calibrated, and qualified. Verified capability to extract 3.5 nm oxide capacitance, physical thickness (t_ox = 3.5 +/- 0.1 nm), and interface trap density (D_it <= 2.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1) on 180nm DRAM test vehicles.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-02` | **Midgap interface trap density (Dit) extracted via High-Low Frequency method conforms to 180nm foundry gate requirements.** | `2.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1` | <= 3.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1 | Comparison of 1 MHz HF C-V curve and 20 mV/s Quasi-Static C-V curve across Si bandgap (E_t - E_i from -0.3 eV to +0.3 eV) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Probe station and instrumentation baseline residual leakage under dark condition.** | `1.0 fA` | <= 5.0 fA at +/- 2.0 V | HR-SMU dry open-circuit triaxial chuck and probe tip baseline sweep |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
