# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-CV-180NM-001`
**Title:** High-Frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Characterization Sweep  
**Node Generation:** Gen 1 (180nm Open-Source DRAM)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Interface Characterization ($D_{it}$) / Leaf SOP  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the setup, measurement parameters, and execution procedure for dual High-Frequency (HF: 100 kHz – 1 MHz) and Quasi-Static (QS) Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) profiling on planar diagnostic MOS capacitor (MOSCAP) test structures. The sweep validates gate oxide physical thickness ($t_{ox} \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$), flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$), accumulation capacitance ($C_{ox}$), and supplies low-high frequency differential capacitance data for interface trap density ($D_{it}$) extraction across the Si bandgap.

---

### 2. Test Structure & Hardware Setup
* **MOSCAP Test Structure:**
  * Substrate: P-type (100) Silicon wafer.
  * Gate Dielectric: Thermally grown dry $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
  * Top Gate Electrode: Sputtered Aluminum circular gate dots with diameters of $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, or $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ defined via shadow mask.
  * Backside Substrate Contact: Sputtered Gold (Au) or Aluminum (Al) forming an ohmic ground plane.
* **Instrumentation:**
  * Precision LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer (capable of 100 kHz – 1 MHz, AC signal $15\text{–}30\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$).
  * Quasi-Static Electrometer / High-Resolution SMU (linear voltage ramp $\Delta V/\Delta t$ mode, fA-level displacement current resolution).
  * Light-tight, electromagnetically shielded probe station (Dark Box) with thermal chuck at 25°C (room temperature) and 85°C (thermal stress / retention baseline).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

#### Step 1: Probe Station Loading & Dark Shielding
1. Mount the MOSCAP wafer onto the gold/aluminum vacuum chuck. Verify backside ohmic contact resistance $R_{contact} < 10\ \Omega$.
2. Lower the micromanipulator tungsten probe tip onto the selected circular Al gate dot (nominally $200\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter to minimize series resistance and leakage on 3.5 nm oxide).
3. Close and seal the dark enclosure. Ensure ambient light is completely eliminated to prevent photo-generation in the depletion/inversion regions.

#### Step 2: High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweep (100 kHz – 1 MHz)
1. Configure LCR Meter to $C_p - G_p$ (parallel capacitance and conductance) mode.
2. Set AC excitation oscillation voltage: $V_{osc} = 25\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$.
3. Select probe frequencies: Primary sweep at $1\text{ MHz}$; secondary comparison sweep at $100\text{ kHz}$.
4. Set DC bias sweep range: Start in strong accumulation at $V_G = -2.5\text{ V}$ and sweep toward inversion at $V_G = +2.0\text{ V}$ with a step size of $\Delta V = 20\text{ mV}$ and hold time of $100\text{ ms}$ per step.
5. Record $C_{HF}(V_G)$ and loss conductance $G(V_G)$. Confirm saturation at maximum accumulation capacitance:
   $$C_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{ox} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{ox}}$$

#### Step 3: Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Sweep
1. Switch matrix to the electrometer / QS unit.
2. Select linear voltage ramp rate: $dV/dt = 10\text{–}50\text{ mV/s}$ to ensure the inversion minority carrier generation-recombination reaches equilibrium.
3. Apply DC bias ramp from $-2.5\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$.
4. Measure charging displacement current $I_{QS}(V_G)$ and calculate quasi-static capacitance:
   $$C_{QS}(V_G) = \frac{I_{QS}(V_G)}{dV/dt}$$
5. Confirm that in strong inversion ($V_G > V_T$), $C_{QS}$ recovers back toward $C_{ox}$, whereas $C_{HF}$ remains clamped at $C_{min}$.

#### Step 4: Data Export & Sanitization
1. Export unified data arrays: $[V_G, C_{HF}(1\text{MHz}), C_{HF}(100\text{kHz}), C_{QS}, G_p]$.
2. Verify absence of excessive gate oxide leakage ($I_{leak} < 1\text{ fA}$ regime per equivalent cell area).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from strong accumulation $C_{ox}$ ($V_G < V_{fb}$) |
| **HF AC Test Frequency** | $1.0$ (Primary) / $0.1$ (Secondary) | Nominal ($\pm 1\%$) | $\text{MHz}$ | LCR meter oscillator setting |
| **MOSCAP Dot Diameter** | $200$ (Alt: $500$, $1000$) | $\pm 2$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical profilometry / shadow mask aperture |
| **Inversion Recovery Ratio ($C_{QS}/C_{ox}$)** | $> 0.95$ | In deep inversion ($V_G > V_T$) | ratio | Quasi-Static vs. Accumulation HF Capacitance |

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Context Alignment
* **Test Structure & MOSCAP Physics:** Sourced directly from *Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction* (Aluminum gate dots $200\ \mu\text{m}, 500\ \mu\text{m}, 1000\ \mu\text{m}$; backside Au/Al ohmic contact; accumulation $C_{ox}$ yielding $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision; HF clamped at $C_{min}$ while QS recovers to $C_{ox}$).
* **Oxide Thickness & Growth Conditions:** Sourced from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Gate dielectric physically grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness).
* **Leakage & Retention Reference:** Sourced from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Sub-threshold and leakage constraints governing the dielectric integrity at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: For 3.5 nm dry gate oxide (EOT ~3.5 nm), the gate leakage current is dominated by direct tunneling (J_g ~ 10^-2 to 10^-1 A/cm^2 at V_dd = 1.8V). This relatively high parallel conductive branch severely depresses the quality factor Q = omega * C_p / G_p at both 100 kHz and 1 MHz during high-frequency C-V sweeps, while inducing unacceptable displacement current distortion in linear-ramp quasi-static C-V (QSCV). A rigorous dual-frequency or three-element impedance correction model (accounting for series resistance R_s and parallel conductance G_p) must be embedded in the automated extraction pipeline, and ramp rates for QSCV must be throttled below 50 mV/s with active leakage subtraction to prevent false apparent accumulation capacitance spikes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate extraction of interface trap density (D_it) via the High-Low (Castagné-Vapaille) method requires establishing true equilibrium at quasi-static sweep rates without deep depletion artifacts, while simultaneously ensuring that at 1 MHz minority carriers and majority interface states remain fully un responsive. For p-type substrate MOS capacitors (MOSCAPs), illumination must be zero to suppress photo-assisted generation, and probe chuck temperature must be held at 300.0 K ± 0.1 K. If D_it exceeds 2.5e10 cm^-2 eV^-1 around midgap, subthreshold swing S will drift beyond the 75-85 mV/dec target specified for the 180nm core CMOS inverter chain, directly corrupting switching threshold V_M symmetry (0.90 V ± 50 mV).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision LCR meters (Keysight E4980A / B1500A with high-resolution SMU modules) and triaxial low-noise probe arms (such as FormFactor/Cascade Microtech DCM-210) require specialized triaxial calibration substrates and low-loss beryllium-copper or tungsten probe needles with radius < 5 um. Replacement lead times for triax low-noise cables (semi-rigid with PTFE dielectric) currently sit at 12 to 16 weeks; sparing 2 extra calibrated cable assemblies and automated calibration open/short/load standards on-site is mandatory to avoid halting the Gen 1 physical validation lot.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: C-V extraction sits on the critical path between dry oxidation/forming gas anneal and polysilicon gate patterning. The characterization schedule allocates exactly 120 minutes per 8-inch wafer across a 9-point radial map. Running overly conservative QSCV integration delay steps (>100 ms per step across 100 points) will blow the cycle time budget by 300%. We must standardize on a dual-sweep ramp algorithm with adaptive hold times: fast sweep across accumulation/inversion and dense multi-integration sampling exclusively across weak depletion/flatband (0.1 V to -0.6 V).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic Series Resistance (R_s) Roll-Off: Inadequate wafer backside ohmic contact or high substrate bulk resistivity distorts the 1 MHz accumulation capacitance (C_ma), leading to severe artificial D_it peaks near band edges when subtracting low-frequency capacitance.
1. Direct Tunneling Leakage Blindness: At 3.5 nm physical thickness, parasitic DC conduction (I_leak > 10 nA) floods the quasi-static electrometer integrator, producing fictitious negative capacitance or unbounded divergence of C_qs across the entire flatband region.
1. Moisture and Mobile Ion Drift Hysteresis: Ambient humidity contamination during transfer causing positive mobile ion (Na+/K+) or slow state hysteresis (>30 mV shift between forward and reverse HF C-V sweeps), obscuring true D_it signature.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-01` | **Dual-Frequency (100 kHz & 1 MHz) Multi-Element Corrected High-Frequency C-V Sweep** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifunction Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), shielded triaxial cabling, Cascade Summit 12000B semi-automated probe station inside dark EMI/light-tight enclosure, Chuck Temperature Controller set to 300.0 K ± 0.1 K. | 1. Position triaxial probe tip on gate pad with contact force <= 10 mN inside dark enclosure (ambient lux < 0.01). 2. Apply AC excitation of 15 mV_rms at 100 kHz and 1 MHz simultaneously using dual-frequency mode. 3. Sweep DC gate bias V_g from -2.0 V (accumulation) to +1.5 V (inversion) with step size of 20 mV and hold time of 50 ms. 4. Record parallel capacitance C_p and parallel conductance G_p. 5. Perform automated series resistance correction: C_cor = (G_p^2 + omega^2 * C_p^2) * C_p / [ (G_p - (G_p^2 + omega^2 * C_p^2)*R_s)^2 + omega^2 * C_p^2 ] where R_s = G_ma / (G_ma^2 + omega^2 * C_ma^2) measured in heavy accumulation (V_g = -2.0 V). 6. Repeat sweep in reverse direction (+1.5 V to -2.0 V) to quantify flatband voltage hysteresis Delta V_fb. | `Corrected accumulation capacitance C_ox = 9.87 pF ± 0.49 pF (yielding physical t_ox = 3.50 nm ± 0.18 nm assuming epsilon_ox = 3.9); flatband voltage V_fb = -0.85 V ± 0.05 V; sweep hysteresis Delta V_fb <= 15 mV; dissipation factor D = G_p / (omega * C_p) <= 0.05 in accumulation at 100 kHz.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-02` | **Quasi-Static C-V Sweep and Castagné-Vapaille High-Low D_it Energy Distribution Extraction** | Keysight B1500A with B1500A-HR (High Resolution SMU) electrometer integrator module, triaxial low-noise triaxial probe heads (< 10 fA baseline noise floor), Faraday cage dark box (< 0.001 lux), nitrogen-purged chuck enclosure (RH < 5%). | 1. Set electrometer to linear ramp quasi-static mode with slew rate dV/dt = 30 mV/s. 2. Sweep V_g from -1.5 V (accumulation) to +1.0 V (inversion) recording displacement current I_qs(V_g) and extracting quasi-static capacitance C_qs = I_qs / (dV/dt). 3. Apply baseline leakage current compensation I_meas(V) - I_leak(V). 4. Interpolate high-frequency capacitance C_hf (100 kHz corrected) and align bias axes via flatband matching. 5. Calculate interface trap density per unit area and energy: D_it(E) = (C_ox / q) * [ (C_qs / (C_ox - C_qs)) - (C_hf / (C_ox - C_hf)) ]. 6. Map surface potential psi_s across gate bias using Berglund integration: psi_s(V_g) = Integral from V_fb to V_g of [ 1 - (C_qs / C_ox) ] dV_g to index D_it against bandgap position (E - E_v). | `Midgap interface trap density D_it(midgap) <= 2.5e10 cm^-2 eV^-1; near-band-edge trap density at E_c - 0.2 eV <= 8.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1; quasi-static inversion capacitance C_qs(inv) recovers to within 95% of accumulation capacitance C_ox at 30 mV/s without sign of deep depletion or thermal runaway leakage.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile gloves (double-gloved, ESD-dissipative), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom smock and hood with grounded conductive ESD wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistor), Conductive ESD cleanroom booties with heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact (IPA): Immediately flush eyes with clean eyewash saline solution for at least 15 minutes while retracting eyelids; seek medical attention. Skin Contact (IPA): Wash thoroughly with soap and water; remove contaminated nitrile gloves. Inhalation (N2 Asphyxiant hazard): Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is difficult; initiate CPR if breathing halts. Electrical Shock: Turn off emergency master power switch before touching casualty; call emergency medical services immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probing station dark box must be equipped with active local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at >= 50 CFM to sweep out solvent vapors from tip cleaning operations; room-level continuous O2 depletion sensors set to alarm at < 19.5% O2 due to continuous N2 purge of wafer chuck.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA cleaning wipes and cotton swabs must be segregated into dedicated sealed, flame-resistant, grounded stainless steel solvent waste bins; spent liquid IPA collected into fluoropolymer carboys and handed over to hazardous chemical waste management. No drain disposal allowed.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly annealed polysilicon gate MOSCAP pads post-Forming Gas Anneal (FGA 400C H2/N2 30 min), pristine, unoxidized contact pads, zero particulate contamination (PWP < 0.05 particles/cm^2 at >= 0.18 um).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized gate contact pads with microscopic needle scrub marks <= 2 um depth; wafers immediately blow-cleaned with ionized UHP N2, vacuum packaged or loaded into front opening unified pod (FOUP) with continuous N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne organic siloxane/hydrocarbon condensation and moisture uptake on the unpassivated 3.5 nm oxide edge periphery, inducing parasitic surface leakage currents (> 1 nA) and uncontrolled flatband voltage drift (> 50 mV), which fatally invalidates the high-low D_it extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full wafer radial multi-frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V profiling of 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on 180nm MOSCAPs, delivering series-resistance-corrected C-V/G-V curves, Berglund surface potential mapping, and validated interface trap density (D_it) profiling across the silicon bandgap confirming compatibility with subthreshold swing target (S <= 85 mV/dec).

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CV_MEAS_HF_QS_RAW_PROFILES_LOT01_W08.csv`
- [ ] `DIT_BANDGAP_DISTRIBUTION_BERGLUND_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `WAFER_9PT_RADIAL_TOX_DIT_CORRELATION_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Extracted Physical Oxide Thickness (t_ox) from Accumulation Capacitance C_ox** | `3.50 nm` | ±0.15 nm | High-frequency (1 MHz) series-resistance-corrected accumulation capacitance C_cor measured at V_g = -2.0 V on 100 um x 100 um MOSCAP, applying quantum-mechanical correction model. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Midgap Interface State Density (D_it_midgap)** | `1.8e10 cm^-2 eV^-1` | <= 2.5e10 cm^-2 eV^-1 | Castagné-Vapaille High-Low extraction method comparing 100 kHz HF-CV with 30 mV/s Quasi-Static C-V at surface potential psi_s = 0.56 V (midgap relative to valence band edge). |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Flatband Voltage Hysteresis (Delta V_fb)** | `5.0 mV` | <= 15.0 mV | Bi-directional high-frequency (100 kHz) voltage sweep (-2.0 V to +1.5 V and return) evaluated at flatband capacitance level C_fb. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 radial wafer measurement sites exhibit midgap D_it <= 2.5e10 cm^-2 eV^-1, electrical t_ox within 3.50 nm ± 0.15 nm with zero series resistance roll-off flag (Q >= 15 across depletion), Delta V_fb <= 15 mV, and complete cross-correlation sign-off against Stage 3 inverter subthreshold swing verification requirements.

Static-dissipative cleanroom smock and hood with grounded conductive ESD wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistor)
Conductive ESD cleanroom booties with heel grounders
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Eye Contact (IPA): Immediately flush eyes with clean eyewash saline solution for at least 15 minutes while retracting eyelids; seek medical attention. Skin Contact (IPA): Wash thoroughly with soap and water; remove contaminated nitrile gloves. Inhalation (N2 Asphyxiant hazard): Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is difficult; initiate CPR if breathing halts. Electrical Shock: Turn off emergency master power switch before touching casualty; call emergency medical services immediately.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Probing station dark box must be equipped with active local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at >= 50 CFM to sweep out solvent vapors from tip cleaning operations; room-level continuous O2 depletion sensors set to alarm at < 19.5% O2 due to continuous N2 purge of wafer chuck.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: IPA cleaning wipes and cotton swabs must be segregated into dedicated sealed, flame-resistant, grounded stainless steel solvent waste bins; spent liquid IPA collected into fluoropolymer carboys and handed over to hazardous chemical waste management. No drain disposal allowed.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly annealed polysilicon gate MOSCAP pads post-Forming Gas Anneal (FGA 400C H2/N2 30 min), pristine, unoxidized contact pads, zero particulate contamination (PWP < 0.05 particles/cm^2 at >= 0.18 um).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Electrically characterized gate contact pads with microscopic needle scrub marks <= 2 um depth; wafers immediately blow-cleaned with ionized UHP N2, vacuum packaged or loaded into front opening unified pod (FOUP) with continuous N2 purge.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne organic siloxane/hydrocarbon condensation and moisture uptake on the unpassivated 3.5 nm oxide edge periphery, inducing parasitic surface leakage currents (> 1 nA) and uncontrolled flatband voltage drift (> 50 mV), which fatally invalidates the high-low D_it extraction.

expected_result.summary: Full wafer radial multi-frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V profiling of 3.5 nm dry gate oxide on 180nm MOSCAPs, delivering series-resistance-corrected C-V/G-V curves, Berglund surface potential mapping, and validated interface trap density (D_it) profiling across the silicon bandgap confirming compatibility with subthreshold swing target (S <= 85 mV/dec).

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Extracted Physical Oxide Thickness (t_ox) from Accumulation Capacitance C_ox
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-frequency (1 MHz) series-resistance-corrected accumulation capacitance C_cor measured at V_g = -2.0 V on 100 um x 100 um MOSCAP, applying quantum-mechanical correction model.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Midgap Interface State Density (D_it_midgap)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Castagné-Vapaille High-Low extraction method comparing 100 kHz HF-CV with 30 mV/s Quasi-Static C-V at surface potential psi_s = 0.56 V (midgap relative to valence band edge).

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Flatband Voltage Hysteresis (Delta V_fb)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Bi-directional high-frequency (100 kHz) voltage sweep (-2.0 V to +1.5 V and return) evaluated at flatband capacitance level C_fb.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 9 radial wafer measurement sites exhibit midgap D_it <= 2.5e10 cm^-2 eV^-1, electrical t_ox within 3.50 nm ± 0.15 nm with zero series resistance roll-off flag (Q >= 15 across depletion), Delta V_fb <= 15 mV, and complete cross-correlation sign-off against Stage 3 inverter subthreshold swing verification requirements.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Setup and Open/Short Fixture Calibration

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Vacuum Chuck   │
│    Load & Alignment    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Micro-positioner    │
│  Needle Planarization  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Open De-Embedding at  │
│   Measurement Height   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Short Calibration on  │
│   Gold Reference Pad   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    LCR Meter / SMU     │
│    Residual Matrix     │
│      Verification      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated MOSCAP C-V  │
│      Probe Ready       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Purpose
This procedure defines the physical landing, probe planarization, triaxial cable de-embedding, and dual-frequency Open/Short fixture calibration required prior to performing High-Frequency (100 kHz – 1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V characterization on 180nm dry gate oxide ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) MOSCAP test structures. Calibration eliminates parasitic cable capacitance ($C_{\text{cable}}$), stray chuck conductance ($G_{\text{chuck}}$), and contact lead resistance ($R_{\text{series}}$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Ensure the probe station environmental dark box is sealed with dry $N_2$ purge active (dew point $\le -40^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Set and verify chuck temperature stability at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (or $85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for high-temperature retention/leakage validation runs).
   - Allow 30 minutes of instrument warm-up time for the Precision LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer and High-Resolution SMU.

2. **Wafer & Calibration Substrate Loading**
   - Place the standard calibration substrate (ISS / gold shorting standard) alongside the 180nm DRAM test vehicle wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck.
   - Engage chuck vacuum ($\ge 70\text{ kPa}$ differential) and optically align wafer axes ($X\text{-}Y$ theta alignment $< 0.05^\circ$).

3. **Probe Tip Inspection & Planarization**
   - Inspect beryllium-copper (BeCu) or tungsten probe tips under high-magnification optics ($500\times$) for oxide residue or tip deformation.
   - Adjust needle contact angle and planarize probe needles to ensure simultaneous physical touchdown across all Kelvin force/sense terminals.

4. **Open Calibration / Fixture De-Embedding**
   - Position the probe tips directly above the MOSCAP gate test pads at the exact measurement Z-height ($50\text{ }\mu\text{m} \pm 5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ hover height).
   - Ensure probe tips are floating in air with no physical contact to the DUT or substrate.
   - Execute instrument `OPEN CAL` across the full characterization frequency spectrum ($100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static DC integration window.
   - Store the open admittance parameters ($Y_{\text{open}} = G_{\text{open}} + j\omega C_{\text{open}}$).

5. **Short Calibration / Residual Compensation**
   - Translate probe manipulators over the dedicated gold shorting pad on the calibration substrate.
   - Lower probes until contact is established using micro-stepped Z-travel with precise overdrive ($10\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $15\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - Execute instrument `SHORT CAL` across $100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - Store the short impedance parameters ($Z_{\text{short}} = R_{\text{short}} + j\omega L_{\text{short}}$).

6. **De-Embedding Verification & DUT Hand-off**
   - Retract probe tips to $50\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ hover height: measure residual open capacitance.
   - Land probes on the gold short pad: measure residual short series resistance.
   - Verify all acceptance thresholds pass before enabling automated step-and-repeat wafer mapping on the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOSCAP structures.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Open Capacitance ($C_{\text{residual}}$)** | $< 5.0$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | LCR Meter sweep at $100\text{ kHz} - 1\text{ MHz}$ ($50\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ probe air gap) |
| **Residual Short Resistance ($R_{\text{series}}$)** | $< 0.15$ | $\Omega$ (ohms) | 4-wire Kelvin measurement on gold calibration reference pad |
| **Quasi-Static Open Leakage Current ($I_{\text{open}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA}$ (femtoamperes) | Triaxial SMU integration at $V_{\text{force}} = \pm 1.5\text{ V}$, $25^\circ\text{C}$ dark box |
| **Probe Touchdown Overdrive Travel** | $12 \pm 3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ (micrometers) | Micro-positioner optical Z-encoder travel post-contact detection |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness**: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (measured with sub-Angstrom precision $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ via spectroscopic ellipsometry). *(Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering; Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology)*
- **Measurement Sensitivity Thresholds**: Requires sub-femtofarad capacitance resolution and leakage baseline below $1\text{ fA}$ to accurately evaluate gate oxide integrity and cell retention budgets. *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench)*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Fixture parasitics at high frequencies (100 kHz - 1 MHz) directly mask the intrinsic accumulation capacitance of ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxide MOSCAPs (~9.87 fF/um^2). Without precise Open/Short calibration referencing the exact probe-tip plane using co-planar calibration substrates or on-wafer de-embedding structures, coaxial cable inductance (~0.2 uH/m) and stray capacitance (>1-5 pF) introduce phase angle degradation and false negative conductance, corrupting subsequent High-Low frequency Dit extraction.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static and high-frequency C-V on 3.5 nm oxides require ultra-low leakage triaxial chuck connections and needle contact resistance below 2 Ohms. Direct mechanical scrub on thin poly-Si or metal gate dots risks micro-cracking the 3.5 nm dielectric, creating irreversible stress-induced leakage current (SILC) or catastrophic pinhole breakdown prior to sweep initiation. Controlled landing force (<50 mN) and high-precision piezo positioners are mandatory.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying custom beryllium copper (BeCu) or tungsten-rhenium (WRe) coaxial/triaxial probe tips and impedance standard substrates (ISS) carries extended procurement lead times (8 to 14 weeks) and high single-source vulnerability. Commercial off-the-shelf open/short calibration standards must be dual-sourced and cross-verified against cleanroom secondary standards to ensure continuous fab metrology uptime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration protocols must be strictly operationalized within standard wafer lot cycle times. Daily calibration drifts exceeding 15 minutes of engineer overhead impact overall metrology throughput; automated script-driven Open/Short compensation routines with clear numerical drift gates must be deployed before proceeding to active 180nm lot measurements.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete de-embedding of stray fixture admittance (residual capacitance >10 fF), leading to artificial Dit extraction spikes near the silicon band edges.
1. Probe-tip over-scrub piercing the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide layer, inducing catastrophic dielectric puncture and high gate leakage (>100 mA/cm^2) during initial C-V bias sweep.
1. Thermal drift or mechanical vibration of the unshielded probe station causing contact resistance fluctuation (>5 Ohms variance) during high-frequency measurements.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-1-01` | **Probe Fixture Open/Short Residual Calibration and Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Module (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with Triaxial Chuck, Impedance Standard Substrate (ISS 101-190). | 1. Raise probe tips 500 um above gold calibration pad and execute MFCMU Open Compensation across 1 kHz to 5 MHz (25 points/decade). 2. Land probe tips on ISS short-circuit standard with 35 mN contact force and execute MFCMU Short Compensation. 3. Re-verify residual open admittance by hovering tips 50 um above dummy oxide pad; record parallel capacitance (Cp) and conductance (Gp) at 100 kHz and 1 MHz. 4. Land on dedicated ISS 50-Ohm precision standard and record measured series resistance (Rs) and reactance (Xs). | `Residual Open Capacitance |Cp| <= 5.0 fF across 100 kHz to 1 MHz; Residual Open Conductance Gp <= 10.0 nS; Short Resistance Rs <= 1.50 Ohms with residual reactance |Xs| <= 0.20 Ohms at 1 MHz.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-1-02` | **MOSCAP Zero-Bias Contact Integrity and Pinhole Leakage Pre-Screen** | Keysight B1500A High-Resolution SMU (HRSMU) routed through B1505A triaxial matrix switch to MFCMU; microscope with 50x long-working-distance objective. | 1. Position high-force-precision probe needle onto the 100 um x 100 um gate contact pad using micro-positioner with <30 um scrub mark length. 2. Verify contact potential by executing 2-point I-V sweep from -0.1 V to +0.1 V at 10 mV steps using HRSMU. 3. Measure quiescent gate leakage current (Ig) at Vgate = -1.0 V (accumulation regime for p-type substrate) with 100 ms hold time. | `Linear contact resistance R_contact <= 2.0 Ohms across [-0.1 V, +0.1 V]; Quiescent gate leakage current density Jg <= 1.0 x 10^-6 A/cm^2 at -1.0 V (absolute Ig <= 100 pA for 10^4 um^2 pad).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (anti-static ESD rated), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting safety resistor, Full static-dissipative cleanroom frock and ESD safety booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA clean solvent: Flush with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes at cleanroom eye wash station. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, relocate individual to fresh air. If electrical shock occurs from high-voltage SMU modules (>40V interlock fault), disconnect system power immediately, perform CPR if required, and notify site emergency medical response.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local chemical exhaust hood for IPA probe needle wipe down; continuous mini-environment laminar flow HEPA filtration (Class 100/ISO 5) with positive N2 overpressure inside probe station enclosure to prevent airborne hydrocarbon deposition.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked microfiber wipes in designated hazardous waste solvent cans equipped with flame arrestor lids; exhausted IPA liquid to be collected in dedicated flammable solvent waste carboys for commercial licensed reclamation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for tip cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2) Purge Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly post-metallized and post-forming-gas-annealed (400 °C H2/N2) MOSCAP pads with clean native-oxide-free aluminum or poly-Si contact surfaces; free of moisture and organic residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated probe-tested gate contact pads exhibiting minimal mechanical scrub marks (<30 um lateral displacement, <50 nm depth), free of pinhole punch-through, ready for full C-V bias and frequency sweeps.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure beyond 30 minutes induces moisture absorption and atmospheric hydrocarbon chemisorption onto open pad surfaces, leading to elevated parasitic contact resistance (>10 Ohms) and false interface trap states (apparent Dit increase > 5 x 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full open and short fixture calibration of the semi-automated RF/quasi-static probe station completed, achieving sub-5 fF open stray capacitance and sub-1.5 Ohm short impedance across 1 kHz to 1 MHz. Initial contact and dielectric pre-screening on 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOSCAP test structures verified, establishing baseline readiness for precision High-Low C-V Dit extraction.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CAL_REPORT_FIXTURE_DEEMBED_180NM_REV1.pdf`
- [ ] `OPEN_SHORT_RESIDUAL_S_PARAMETERS.csv`
- [ ] `MOSCAP_PRESCREEN_LEAKAGE_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual fixture open-circuit parallel capacitance across high-frequency band** | `0.00 fF` | +5.00 fF | Keysight B1520A MFCMU open compensation measurement at 100 kHz and 1 MHz with probe tips elevated 50 um above wafer. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Closed-loop fixture short-circuit contact resistance** | `1.00 Ohm` | ±0.50 Ohm | Keysight B1520A 4-point impedance measurement on ISS short standard at 100 kHz. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Quiescent gate oxide leakage current density before C-V sweep** | `1.00e-7 A/cm^2` | <= 1.00e-6 A/cm^2 | Keysight B1500A HRSMU spot measurement at Vgate = -1.0 V on 100 um x 100 um MOSCAP pad under dark Faraday enclosure. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Fixture Open residual Cp <= 5.0 fF and Short Rs <= 1.5 Ohms confirmed across 3 consecutive trials; zero electrical shorts or dielectric punch-through events detected on initial 5 MOSCAP screening sites across the center and edge dies; automated sign-off log generated with time-stamped engineer digital signature.

nodes.label: High-Frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) LCR Meter Dual-Frequency Bias Sweep Execution
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) LCR Meter Dual-Frequency Bias Sweep Execution

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Setup & Open/Short/Load Fixture Calibration │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Dual-Frequency Bias Sweep (100 kHz & 1 MHz) │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Dispersion Analysis & Series Correction     │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Pass/Fail Acceptance Criteria Metrology     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the industrial protocol for executing high-frequency ($100\text{ kHz}$ and $1\text{ MHz}$) dual-frequency capacitance-voltage ($C\text{-}V$) bias sweeps on test structures and cell capacitor arrays of the 180nm Open-Source DRAM node (DRAM Foundation VN). The sweep characterizes the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide / high-$\kappa$ capacitor dielectric stack, extracts accumulation capacitance, corrects for parasitic series resistance ($R_s$), and supplies high-frequency baseline data for interface trap density ($D_{it}$) profiling.

---

### 2. Standard Operating Procedure (Step-by-Step)

1. **Pre-Sweep Instrument Calibration & Nulling:**
   - Connect the precision LCR meter (four-terminal pair / Kelvin configuration) to the shielded wafer prober chuck and high-frequency triaxial probe tips.
   - Execute Open/Short/Load calibration at both test frequencies ($100\text{ kHz}$ and $1\text{ MHz}$) directly at the probe tips to cancel cable parasitics, residual series inductance, and stray capacitance.
   - Set the AC oscillation level to $15\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$ (small-signal condition, $\le 25\text{ mV}$).

2. **Wafer Alignment & Contact Placement:**
   - Mount the 180nm processed test wafer on the temperature-controlled vacuum chuck set to $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (ambient baseline) or $85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (retention qualification thermal stage).
   - Align micro-probes to the MOS capacitor / stacked capacitor array test pads under the microscope with a contact overdrive of $15\text{ }\mu\text{m} \pm 3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.

3. **Dual-Frequency Voltage Bias Sweep Execution:**
   - Configure DC bias range from inversion/depletion to strong accumulation: sweep from $-2.5\text{ V}$ to $+2.5\text{ V}$ in discrete steps of $25\text{ mV}$ with a settling dwell time of $100\text{ ms}$ per step.
   - Execute Sweep A at $f_1 = 100\text{ kHz}$ recording parallel capacitance ($C_p$) and conductance ($G_p$).
   - Execute Sweep B at $f_2 = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ across the identical DC bias grid in a dual-frequency continuous sweep mode.
   - Apply two-frequency series resistance correction to eliminate series resistance attenuation at $1\text{ MHz}$:
     $$C_\text{corr} = \frac{C_p}{(1 - R_s G_p)^2 + (\omega C_p R_s)^2}$$

4. **Post-Measurement Data Extraction & Logging:**
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance ($C_\text{acc}$) to calculate equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) based on the target physical dielectric thickness.
   - Log dispersion between $100\text{ kHz}$ and $1\text{ MHz}$ in the accumulation regime ($\Delta C / C_\text{acc}$) to verify lack of severe loss-tangent distortion.
   - Export raw $(V_\text{bias}, C_p, G_p, f)$ arrays to the metrology database for subsequent quasi-static high-low $D_{it}$ extraction.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from $C_\text{acc}$ in accumulation at $1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0$ to $30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked capacitor array under nominal bias ($V_{DD}/2$) |
| **Capacitance Frequency Dispersion ($\Delta C/C$)** | $< 3.0$ | $\le 5.0$ | $\%$ | Accumulation regime dispersion: $\frac{\|C_{100\text{ kHz}} - C_{1\text{ MHz}}\|}{C_{100\text{ kHz}}}$ |
| **Leakage Current per Cell ($I_\text{leak}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Monitored across dielectric at $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ retention baseline |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context verified:* Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); minimum storage capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ to ensure noise immunity; leakage current target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh performance.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Context verified:* 1T1C stacked capacitor requiring $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ retention budget ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$); thermally grown dry gate dielectric target of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$; capacitor EOT target of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - *Context verified:* Sensing operation and signal development with typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ against bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ generating $\Delta V \approx 100\text{--}150\text{ mV}$ signal margin.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-frequency (100 kHz vs 1 MHz) extraction of interface trap density (Dit) requires precise synchronization and impedance model validation. For ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate dielectric stacks, parasitic cable inductance, contact probe series resistance (Rs), and chuck back-contact shunt conductance can dominate admittance parameters at 1 MHz, severely skewing the equivalent parallel conductance Gp/w and accumulation capacitance Cox. A full open/short/load calibration and 5-element circuit de-embedding (accounting for series resistance Rs) must precede bias sweep acquisition.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 3.5 nm physical EOT, direct quantum-mechanical tunneling leakage (gate current density Jg > 10^-2 A/cm^2 at accumulation) induces a significant conductive parallel loss, invalidating standard two-element parallel Cp-Gp extraction unless corrected using the Nicollian-Brews or Yang-Spicer tunneling conductance model. Furthermore, 1 MHz may not fully freeze out fast donor/acceptor traps near the midgap in Gen 1 unannealed poly-Si/SiO2 interfaces, necessitating careful frequency dispersion verification between 100 kHz and 1 MHz across the depletion regime to prevent underestimating Dit.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision precision LCR meters (Keysight E4980A or QuadTech 7600+) with four-terminal pair Kelvin probe triaxial configurations and low-leakage dark probe stations (micromanipulators with BeCu or tungsten tips) face constrained lab availability and calibration lead times. Sourcing triaxial low-noise cables rated for < 10 fF parasitic stray capacitance and gold-plated vacuum chucks with back-contact resistance < 0.5 ohm is critical to avoid erroneous C-V dispersion.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-frequency sweep sequences add significant testing overhead per die compared to single-point capacitance monitoring. We must standardize automated bias step sizes (e.g., 20 mV increments) and settle times (<= 50 ms) to keep total sweep time under 45 seconds per test structure, ensuring overall metrology throughput meets the pilot-line lot dispatch schedule for 180nm baseline qualification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic series resistance masking accumulation capacitance roll-off at 1 MHz, leading to false negative EOT extraction and inflated Dit estimations.
1. Direct gate dielectric tunneling leakage exceeding 1 mA/cm^2 causing LCR bridge phase angle collapse below 85 degrees in accumulation.
1. Chuck back-contact oxidation or unscrubbed backside native oxide introducing an unpredictable floating substrate potential and hysteresis shift during bias ramps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-2-01` | **Dual-Frequency (100 kHz & 1 MHz) Accumulation Capacitance & Series Resistance Correction** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (four-terminal pair triaxial configuration), Temptronic dark shielded probe station, gold-plated vacuum chuck, Keithley 2450 SMU monitoring gate leakage. | 1. Land high-frequency microprobes on 100 um x 100 um MOS capacitor pad. 2. Configure LCR meter to Cp-D mode with 15 mV RMS AC oscillator level. 3. Sweep gate DC bias from -1.8 V to +1.8 V (accumulation to inversion for p-substrate) in 25 mV increments at 100 kHz, recording Cp and Gp. 4. Repeat exact bias sweep at 1 MHz without lifting probes. 5. Calculate corrected accumulation capacitance Cox and series resistance Rs using dual-frequency correction formulas: Rs = (G_m1 - G_m2) / (w1^2 * C_m1^2 - w2^2 * C_m2^2) and de-embedded Cox. | `Accumulation capacitance Cox at -1.8 V must evaluate to 9.87 fF/um^2 +/- 6% (corresponding to 3.5 nm physical dry SiO2, EOT = 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm). Measured phase angle theta in accumulation must exceed 84.0 degrees at 100 kHz and 78.0 degrees at 1 MHz; extracted series resistance Rs < 25 ohms.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-2-02` | **High-Frequency Dual-Bias Dispersion and Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction** | Keysight E4980A LCR Meter, triaxial low-noise probe heads, automated wafer stage with temperature controller stabilized at 25.0 C +/- 0.5 C. | 1. Perform bidirectional gate voltage sweep from depletion (-0.5 V) through weak inversion (+0.6 V) at 100 kHz with 10 mV step resolution and 100 ms hold time. 2. Measure corresponding parallel conductance Gp(w, Vg) and capacitance Cp(w, Vg). 3. Repeat sweep at 1 MHz over identical voltage window. 4. Extract (Gp/w)_max peak in the depletion regime and subtract gate tunneling shunt baseline. 5. Compute Dit = (2.5 / q) * (Gp / w)_max / A_cap. | `Interface trap density Dit across bandgap within midgap regime (E_v + 0.35 eV to E_c - 0.35 eV) must be <= 3.0E+10 eV^-1 cm^-2. C-V hysteresis shift delta-Vfb between forward and reverse sweeps must be <= 15 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Anti-static ESD dissipative cleanroom lab coat and ESD heel straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious cleanroom eyewash water for at least 15 minutes. In case of skin exposure: Remove contaminated gloves and rinse skin with soap and DI water. For electrical shock from SMU/LCR lines: Immediately hit E-stop to cut high-voltage supplies, ensure airway, and administer CPR/first aid if unconscious.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow hood (downflow velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 20%) with local chemical bench vapor exhaust for IPA wipe cleaning; continuous dry N2 bleed exhaust for the probe enclosure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA-saturated wipes placed in dedicated sealed, self-closing flammable waste cans; spent solvent disposed of via certified non-halogenated organic solvent waste stream.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (probe tip and chuck clean)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (chuck and chamber purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly patterned aluminum or polysilicon gate electrode pads over 3.5 nm dry gate oxide, post-forming gas anneal (FGA 400 C H2/N2), dry and free of particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested gate pads with microscopic probe scrub marks (< 3 um scrub length), wafer surface dry and purged with UHP N2, ready for automated parameter extraction or dicing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended atmospheric exposure (> 30 min) causes moisture adsorption and airborne organic contaminant condensation onto unpassivated thin gate edges, causing anomalous leakage currents, apparent C-V flatband voltage drift (> 50 mV), and artificial Dit inflation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful dual-frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) LCR bias sweep characterization of 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOS structures. The dataset provides de-embedded C-V and G-V characteristics across accumulation, depletion, and inversion regimes, verifying an oxide physical thickness of 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm and an interface trap density Dit <= 3.0E+10 eV^-1 cm^-2.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CV_GV_DualFreq_100k_1M_Raw_Deembedded.csv`
- [ ] `Dit_Bandgap_Profile_Extraction_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Probe_Scrub_Microscopy_Verification.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) extracted from de-embedded accumulation capacitance at -1.8V** | `3.50 nm` | +/- 0.20 nm | Quantum-mechanically corrected C-V profile extraction at 100 kHz / 1 MHz with de-embedded series resistance |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Midgap Interface Trap Density (Dit) from conductance peak method** | `2.0E+10 eV^-1 cm^-2` | <= 3.0E+10 eV^-1 cm^-2 | Peak parallel conductance extraction (Gp/w)_max versus bias across 100 kHz to 1 MHz range |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Flatband Voltage Hysteresis (delta-Vfb) on bidirectional gate bias sweeps** | `5.0 mV` | <= 15.0 mV | Inflection point tracking on forward and reverse high-frequency C-V bias curves |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Both 100 kHz and 1 MHz sweeps complete without LCR bridge unbalance or overload alarms; phase angle remains >= 78 degrees in accumulation; de-embedded series resistance Rs < 25 ohms; extracted EOT = 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm; extracted midgap Dit <= 3.0E+10 eV^-1 cm^-2; all deliverable CSV and PDF artifacts signed off and uploaded to the metrology repository.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Quasi-Static Ramp-Rate C-V Measurement and Displacement Current Extraction

- **Task ID / Title**: Quasi-Static Ramp-Rate C-V Measurement and Displacement Current Extraction
- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy**: Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction > High-Low Frequency Method $D_{it}$ Extraction and Bandgap Profiling Analysis > High-Frequency (100 kHz - 1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Characterization Sweep > Quasi-Static Ramp-Rate C-V Measurement and Displacement Current Extraction
- **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Objective & Principle
To execute ultra-low noise linear voltage-ramp quasi-static capacitance-voltage (QS C-V) metrology on test MOS capacitors fabricated with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. By measuring the minute charging/displacement current ($I_{disp} = C_{qs} \cdot \frac{dV}{dt}$) under true thermal equilibrium, the quasi-static capacitance curve is obtained to serve as the low-frequency reference for high-low frequency interface trap density ($D_{it}$) extraction and bandgap profiling.

---

### 2. Equipment & Tooling Setup
- **Instrumentation**: Precision Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / Electrometer (e.g., Keysight B1500A with High-Resolution SMU / B1530A WGFMU or Keithley 595 / 4200-SCS with Quasi-Static C-V unit).
- **Probing Environment**: Triaxial-shielded probe station enclosed in a light-tight, grounded Faraday shield.
- **Chuck Temperature**: Maintained at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (standard ambient probe) or configured up to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for thermal stress characterization.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       QUASI-STATIC C-V EXECUTION FLOW                         |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  1. Sample Mount & Triaxial Grounding (Light-tight Faraday enclosure)         |
|                                |                                              |
|                                v                                              |
|  2. Open-Circuit Nulling & Background Leakage Cancellation (< 10 fA)          |
|                                |                                              |
|                                v                                              |
|  3. Linear Linear Voltage Ramp Sweeps (Forward & Reverse, dV/dt = 10-100 mV/s)|
|                                |                                              |
|                                v                                              |
|  4. Displacement Current ($I_disp$) Extraction & Leakage Current Subtraction  |
|                                |                                              |
|                                v                                              |
|  5. Extraction of Quasi-Static Capacitance Curve ($C_qs = I_disp / (dV/dt)$)  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Substrate Contact & Shielding Setup**:
   - Mount the test wafer/die containing 180nm gate dielectric test capacitors onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck.
   - Connect the gate probe to the Force/Sense triaxial line of the high-resolution SMU / electrometer and chuck backside to guard/ground.
   - Enclose the probe station inside the grounded dark box/Faraday shield to eliminate optical carrier generation and EMI pickup.

2. **Cable & System Zero-Correction / Leakage Offset**:
   - Lift probes 50 $\mu\text{m}$ above contact pads and perform open-circuit offset calibration across the intended voltage sweep range ($-2.0\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$).
   - Verify that background open-circuit noise floor and stray leakage current are strictly below $10\text{ fA}$.

3. **Equilibrium Pre-Soak / Hold Step**:
   - Lower probe onto the MOS capacitor pad.
   - Apply the starting voltage bias ($V_{start} = -1.8\text{ V}$ to $-2.0\text{ V}$ in strong accumulation) with a hold time of $t_{hold} = 10\text{ s}$ to $30\text{ s}$ to allow slow interface states to fully equilibrate.

4. **Linear Voltage Ramp Execution**:
   - Apply a precise, continuous linear ramp voltage $\frac{dV}{dt}$ from $-2.0\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$ (accumulation through depletion into inversion).
   - Set ramp rates between $10\text{ mV/s}$ and $100\text{ mV/s}$ (e.g., nominal $50\text{ mV/s}$) ensuring quasi-static thermal equilibrium while maintaining a measurable displacement current ($I_{disp} \approx 0.1\text{ pA} - 10\text{ pA}$).
   - Record the measured current $I_{meas}(V)$.

5. **Displacement Current Extraction & Leakage Correction**:
   - Execute a complementary reverse ramp (from $+2.0\text{ V}$ down to $-2.0\text{ V}$) at identical $\left|\frac{dV}{dt}\right|$ or perform stationary DC stepping to isolate DC leakage current ($I_{leak}$).
   - Extract true displacement current:
     $$I_{disp}(V) = \frac{I_{meas, forward}(V) - I_{meas, reverse}(V)}{2}$$
     (or $I_{disp}(V) = I_{meas}(V) - I_{leak}(V)$).
   - Compute quasi-static capacitance:
     $$C_{qs}(V) = \frac{I_{disp}(V)}{dV/dt}$$

6. **Data Output & Handover**:
   - Export extracted $C_{qs}(V)$ array paired with high-frequency $C_{hf}(V)$ (100 kHz - 1 MHz) for subsequent high-low frequency $D_{it}$ bandgap extraction.

---

### 4. Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Tolerance / Range | Purpose / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Linear Voltage Ramp Rate ($\frac{dV}{dt}$)** | $50\text{ mV/s}$ | $10\text{ mV/s}$ to $100\text{ mV/s}$ ($\pm 1\%$) | Ensures quasi-static equilibrium without minority carrier lag |
| **System Background / Leakage Current Floor** | $< 10\text{ fA}$ | Absolute limit $\le 10\text{ fA}$ | Open-circuit triaxial electrometer calibration |
| **Accumulation Capacitance Equivalence ($C_{ox}$)** | Equivalent to $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$ | Physical thickness within $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ | Matches high-frequency accumulation capacitance plateau |
| **Displacement Current Dynamic Resolution** | Measurable at sub-pA | $0.1\text{ pA}$ to $10\text{ pA}$ with $< 2\text{ fA}$ RMS noise | Verified by electrometer integrator output stability |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Confirms cell transistor geometries ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and operating leakage current considerations ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ target regime).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Linear ramp quasi-static C-V (QSCV) on ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide is extremely sensitive to direct tunneling leakage currents. The displacement current I_disp = C * (dV/dt) for typical MOS test capacitors (e.g., Area = 1e-4 cm^2, C_ox ~ 100 pF) at dV/dt = 50 mV/s is on the order of 5 pA. If the oxide leakage current exceeds 1 pA/cm^2 or approaches the displacement current level, standard displacement current extraction diverges, corrupting low-frequency capacitance C_LF and skewing D_it extraction across the silicon bandgap. Ramp-rate linearity and dual-sweep polarity compensation must be strictly enforced.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Quasi-static equilibrium requires that the voltage sweep rate dV/dt is slow enough (typically 10 to 100 mV/s) to ensure minority carriers and interface states maintain thermal equilibrium, yet fast enough to prevent electrometer integrator drift and keep I_disp well above the triaxial cable noise floor (fA range). Furthermore, light illumination must be eliminated using a light-tight Faraday probe enclosure; otherwise, photogenerated minority carriers will artificially elevate inversion capacitance and distort the high-low frequency method D_it profile.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires a calibrated ultra-low current electrometer/SMU (e.g., Keysight B1500A with High-Resolution SMU HRSMU or Keithley 6517B/4200-SCS with pre-amplifier), triaxial cabling with guard integrity intact, and gold-plated Faraday enclosure probing tips. Any supply chain substitution using coaxial BNC cables or standard SMUs without guarded preamps will introduce >100 fA leakage, completely invalidating QSCV measurements.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: QSCV metrology directly gates the Stage 2 to Stage 3 reality transition for 180nm CMOS logic and DRAM transfer gates. Cycle time is dominated by ultra-slow ramp rates (approx. 60-120 seconds per die site) and thermal/dielectric settling wait times. Ensure sample sizes are statistically representative across wafer center, mid-radius, and edge (minimum 9 sites per 150mm/200mm wafer) without blocking fab lot progression beyond the 4-hour N2 queue-time limit.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electrometer amplifier baseline drift or triax cable microphonics exceeding 100 fA, leading to negative or unphysical capacitance values in accumulation/depletion.
1. Excessive direct gate tunneling leakage across 3.5 nm SiO2 swamping displacement current, preventing clean C_LF extraction without Ziegler leakage correction.
1. Non-equilibrium deep depletion during ramp-down sweep due to insufficient thermal minority carrier generation rate under dark conditions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-3-01` | **Quasi-Static Displacement Current and Ramp-Rate Linearity Calibration** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with HRSMU (B1517A) & GNDU, triaxial guarded probes, dark Faraday cage shield, vibration isolation table. | 1. Probe 100 um x 100 um gate oxide MOS capacitor pad with triax guard connected to chuck shield. 2. Apply holding delay of 10.0 s at V_start = -1.5 V to establish accumulation equilibrium. 3. Execute linear continuous ramp sweep from -1.5 V to +1.5 V at dV/dt = 20 mV/s, recording I_disp1(V). 4. Repeat sweep at dV/dt = 50 mV/s, recording I_disp2(V). 5. Compute differential capacitance C_QS(V) = I_disp / (dV/dt) and verify displacement current scalability I_disp2 / I_disp1 = 2.5 +/- 0.05. | `Displacement current scaling ratio (I_disp2 / I_disp1) across accumulation region (-1.5 V to -1.0 V) must equal 2.50 +/- 0.08, and baseline noise floor in dark shield must be <= 30 fA RMS.` |
| `TC-DEAL-GROVE-DRY-OX-3-3-3-2-3-02` | **Dual-Polarity Quasi-Static C-V Curve Extraction for D_it Profiling** | Keithley 4200A-SCS with 4200-PA Remote PreAmp and 4210-CVU, triaxial guarded prober station, shielded environmental chamber. | 1. Position probe on MOS gate pad with backside wafer substrate contacted via gold-plated vacuum chuck. 2. Set ramp rate dV/dt = 50 mV/s with delay time of 15.0 s at -1.8 V. 3. Sweep gate bias from -1.8 V to +1.8 V (forward sweep) and measure I_fwd(V). 4. Hold at +1.8 V for 15.0 s, then sweep from +1.8 V back to -1.8 V (reverse sweep) and measure I_rev(V). 5. Extract C_LF(V) = (I_fwd - I_rev) / (2 * dV/dt) to cancel DC static leakage component. 6. Compare with 1 MHz C_HF(V) to calculate D_it at midgap via High-Low method: D_it = (C_ox / q) * [(C_LF / (C_ox - C_LF)) - (C_HF / (C_ox - C_HF))]. | `Calculated midgap interface trap density D_it must be <= 1.0e11 cm^-2 eV^-1; extracted C_ox in strong accumulation must match 9.87 fF/um^2 +/- 7% (corresponding to t_ox = 3.5 nm +/- 0.25 nm).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ESD-safe), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, ESD wrist strap connected to single-point earth ground, Full cleanroom bunny suit with conductive booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Electrical interlock trip: In the event of electric shock or contact with SMU potentials, immediately hit the red EMO (Emergency Machine Off) switch on the prober console. For IPA skin or eye exposure, flush affected area with cleanroom deionized water eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar airflow bench (0.45 m/s downflow) with local exhaust snorkel over solvent wipe station; N2 purge exhaust vented to house general exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes sealed into dedicated antistatic solvent waste bins and incinerated per cleanroom environmental management procedures; no liquid chemical effluent generated during dry electrical metrology.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (wafer backside chuck cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (purge & pneumatic float)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly metallized (aluminum or polysilicon gate electrode) dry gate oxide MOS test capacitors post-forming gas anneal (FGA, 400 deg C, 10% H2/92% N2, 30 min) with unpassivated topside bond pads.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically characterized wafer with non-destructive microscopic probe scrub marks (< 5 um diameter) on sacrificial metrology test pads, immediately returned to sealed dry-nitrogen purge FOUP.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom ambient air queue time causes moisture and airborne molecular contaminant (AMC, e.g., siloxanes, airborne amine cations) adsorption onto exposed oxide boundaries, shifting flatband voltage V_fb by > 50 mV and distorting surface potential mapping.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable delivery of calibrated quasi-static ramp-rate C-V characteristics, displacement current datasets, and extracted interface trap density (D_it) profiles across the Si bandgap for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide MOS structures, confirming compliance with Gen 1 DRAM transfer gate electrical gate stack criteria.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `QSCV_Displacement_Current_Raw_Profile_TC_01.csv`
- [ ] `C_LF_HighLow_Dit_Bandgap_Analysis_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `WaferMap_Dit_Midgap_Distribution_9Site.tiff`

| `ASSERT-03` | **Forward and reverse ramp-rate displacement current symmetry and leakage floor** | `0.0 pA DC offset` | <= 0.15 pA | Dual-polarity residual current extraction at depletion minimum point (V_gs ~ -0.4 V). |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
